jobs.title: Analyst, Digital Infrastructure
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

This Analyst role provides a great opportunity for someone eager to grow their career in an entrepreneurial environment.  Stream’s new Digital Infrastructure Team is dedicated to mission-critical digital infrastructure, including data centers, hyperscale campuses, AI training and inference facilities, and other power-intensive real estate. This position will support client pursuits and deal execution while helping design the tools that make the team faster and sharper. We're looking for a highly organized analyst who combines operational rigor with real curiosity about AI and the evolving compute-driven real estate landscape.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Support brokers on client pursuits, deal execution, and process development
• Build working knowledge of leasing, tenant representation, and commercial real estate fundamentals
• Own tracking and follow-through of pursuits, clients, deals, timelines, deadlines, and internal requests
• Manage and improve our workflow stack (monday.com, CRM, and related tools), keeping data clean and updates timely
• Liaise with brokers, leadership, marketing and business development support team on specific pitches and pursuits
• Evaluate and implement AI tools, agents, and automations to streamline recurring workflows
• Contribute to research and platform development, including interactive infrastructure maps and periodic market reports

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, real estate, or related field
• Previous Internship experience preferred
• Demonstrated strength in organization, process improvement, and building scalable workflows
• Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation, through work, projects, or coursework (Claude experience a plus; tool-agnostic thinking valued)
• Strong analytical skills and comfort with data, research, and synthesizing findings into clear deliverables
• Proficient with MS Office & Excel
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think creatively and adapt to evolving business needs
• Excellent written communication and attention to detail
• Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a dynamic work environment
• Preferred: experience with CRM, project management, or workflow platforms (monday.com a plus)
• Preferred: experience or knowledge of data centers, powered land, infrastructure, or related real estate transactions (internships, coursework, and projects count)

Once you have completed your application, you will receive an email from notifications@smartrecruiters.com with a link to the Culture Index survey, which will help us gain a better understanding of your strengths and motivational drives. We kindly request that you set aside 10 uninterrupted minutes within 48 hours of submitting your application.

jobs.title: Calibration Systems Technician
jobs.description:
The Calibration Systems Technician is responsible for setting up, checking, and maintaining operation of lab areas, tools, and equipment while adhering to pre-established guidelines and engineering specifications. This role includes the responsibility to manage and coordinate test equipment calibration and repair. The Calibration Systems Technician is also responsible for keeping the labs clean with materials and lab equipment organized. This is a full-time non-exempt position in which the work is performed under general supervision by the Director, Quality Assurance and is evaluated on results obtained.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

• Coordinate monthly equipment calibration activities with internal customers and vendors.
• Maintain, analyze, troubleshoot, and repair electronic systems, hardware and computers.
• Document, maintain, and repair hardware and software systems.
• Support Calibration and Lab Audits.
• Monitor adherence to lab rules and standards.

Other Duties/Responsibilities:

Labs

• Satisfy the test equipment requirements for multiple programs.
• Coordinate program specific computing requirements with IT.
• Schedule and keep track of where equipment is being used or stored for quick location.
• Keep utilities such as clips and probes organized and in stock.
• Enforce lab rules in accordance with audit requirements.

Test Equipment

• Keep test equipment clean, up to date, and in working order.
• Dispose of old assets, lab equipment, prototypes and engineering models.
• Order and maintain stock of lab supplies, tools, and accessories.
• Coordinate equipment repair and replacement.
• Maintain equipment and keep software up to date.
• Manage rental equipment orders and keep track of all accessories.
• Support quoting of new equipment rentals and purchases.
• Maintain equipment calibration database and material tracking.
• Maintain vendor relations with test equipment suppliers and repair houses.
• Coordinate training for test equipment resources and oversee proper use.
• Maintain test equipment RFID tracking system.
• Other duties as assigned

Education or Formal Training

• Associates degree in Electrical Technology or related field; or the equivalent combination of training and experience.

Experience

• 3+ years of experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Detailed knowledge of various types of general test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators, DMM’s, torque wrenches, Physical dimensional tooling, etc.
• Knowledge of safe material handling practices for ESD and sensitive equipment.
• Knowledge of standard assembly and repair concepts, practices and procedures.
• Knowledge of vendor test equipment product lines and capabilities.
• Ability to use experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals with minimal supervision.
• Knowledge of business English, spelling, punctuation, and grammar.
• Knowledge of a variety of software systems including Word, E-mail, Excel.
• Ability to prepare and maintain records and reports.
• Ability to organize and prioritize tasks.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
• Ability to establish good rapport with members of management and other employees.
• Ability to understand and follow written and oral instructions.
• Ability to work on more than one task at a time.
• Ability to proofread a variety of documents and to pay attention to detail.
• Ability to program and operate production equipment.
• Ability to operate all equipment and tooling associated with duties.

Compensation: Base pay range is $28-40/hour, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

jobs.title: Enterprise Workday Administration
jobs.description:
As our Enterprise Workday Administrator, you will be the driving force behind the success of our Workday platform. You’ll take full ownership of Workday, partnering closely with our implementation vendor, HR, Finance, and IS leadership to ensure a seamless launch and ongoing operational excellence. This is a highly visible, strategic role where your work will directly shape the way the organization leverages Workday for years to come.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Workday Ownership & Configuration

• Manage Workday tenant configuration, business processes, and system settings.
• Lead updates, releases, and system enhancements.
• Maintain documentation, configuration guides, and training materials.
• Evaluate and implement new Workday features to maximize organizational impact.

Troubleshooting & Tier 3 Support

• Serve as technical escalation point for complex Workday issues.
• Train and enable Tier 1 & Tier 2 support teams to resolve issues effectively.
• Manage ticket queues and resolve challenging system problems.

Change Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

• Lead Workday change control committee with HR, Finance, and IS stakeholders.
• Facilitate decisions for system changes and enhancements.
• Communicate updates, secure approvals, and implement changes, with organizational impact.
• Promote adoption and effective communication of Workday changes.
• Manage vendor relationships and third-party support to optimize system performance.

MUST HAVE:

• Education: Bachelor’s in Information Systems, Information Technologies, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a closely related field with equivalent experience.
• Technical Skills: Proficient in troubleshooting, tier-3 support, report building, and system documentation.
• Workday Experience: 7+ years of hands-on Workday administration, including tenant management, business processes, security roles and access control, integrations (EIB, Core Connect, APIs, Workday Studio), reporting, and release management.
• Technical Proficiency: Experience with cloud platforms, enterprise integrations, Microsoft Office 365, and data reporting/analytics tools (Prism, calculated fields, dashboards).
• Professional Development: Willingness to pursue Workday certifications (training provided) and stay current on best practices.
• Work Authorization Requirement: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. This position does not offer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

NICE TO HAVE:

• Enterprise Systems & Platforms: Experience managing integrations with third-party systems, Workday security management, identity and access management systems, and understanding of IT security best practices.
• Professional Certifications: Workday certifications (HCM, Finance, Security), additional Workday security or reporting certifications. CompTIA A+ Certification, or other IT certifications.
• Experience: Application administration, integrations/interface management, leading committees, supporting system implementations.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS CRITICAL FOR SUCCESS:

• Strategic Thinking & Process Improvement: Analyze processes and data to identify improvements, optimize workflows, and guide system design for long-term effectiveness.
• Technical & Analytical Expertise: Expert in system administration, process management, integrations, and reporting. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with knowledge of cybersecurity, data privacy, disaster recovery, and compliance. Able to support complex, multi-unit environments efficiently.
• Leadership & Change Management: Lead change committees, influence stakeholders, mentor support teams, and guide system updates, implementations, and enhancements with clear communication and organizational buy-in.
• Project Management & Execution: Plan and manage system upgrades and go-lives, juggling multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and high attention to detail.
• Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Translate technical concepts for non-technical users, present to internal audiences, and build strong relationships across HR, Finance, and IT.
• Adaptability & Learning Agility: Adjust quickly to system updates, process changes, and evolving organizational needs while embracing continuous learning and innovation.
• Customer Service & Team Orientation: Foster a collaborative, solutions-focused mindset and prioritize user satisfaction alongside organizational goals.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE:

Take the lead in shaping our Workday platform and make a real impact! In this highly visible, strategic role, you’ll guide a smooth go-live, influence system design, and collaborate closely with HR, Finance, and IT leaders to drive meaningful organizational change. You’ll implement lasting improvements, support over 2,000 users across multiple business units, and manage integrations, reporting, and system security at scale. Grow as a recognized Workday expert while thriving within a supportive, solutions-focused team that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

jobs.description:
Clinical Shift Coordinator RN-Telemetry Full-Time Nights

The  Clinical Shift Coordinator reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the hospitalized patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation. Effectively interacts with patient, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice. This nurse functions in a leadership, overseeing daily unit operations, staff, and care delivery, utilizing a staff focused leadership model.

Responsibilities:

• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions or help to patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Demonstrates proficiency as a staff nurse and serves as a role model and resource to staff.
• Maintains awareness of unstable, complex or high-risk patient conditions throughout the shift.
• Ensures appropriate assignment of care based on staff competency and patient acuity.
• Coordinates and monitors patient care to ensure patient safety.
• Collects, analyzes and organizes patient care data for the unit.
• Oversees that staff are in compliance with regulatory standards.
• Ensures adaptation of services as needed to reflect age, culture, gender, race, nationality, religion, etc.
• Oversees documentation of key critical elements for patient care and national patient safety goals (restraints, verbal orders, abbreviations, etc.)
• Ensures initial admit orders are received by end of shift.
• Demonstrates knowledge of staffing requirements for unit and ensures compliance with staffing matrix each shift. Consults with manager when
• variances are anticipated.
• Oversees accurate completion of daily charges to ensure unit receives all appropriate revenue.
• Contributes to cost reduction and supports interventions that promote unit cost effectiveness (LOS, HPPD, OT, flexible staffing, and use of alternative skill mixes.)
• Oversees staff scheduling per unit and PCS guidelines.
• Documents appropriate staffing information and justifications in Optilink each shift.
• Checks staff timekeeping on shifts worked and oversees compliance with time and attendance policies.
• Oversees documentation of occurrences on shift and reports to Nursing leadership and risk management as appropriate.
• Ensures compliance with patient life safety standards including fire safety, handwashing, crash cart checks, etc.
• Oversees accurate accounting of unit equipment.
• Demonstrates effective oral, written, and listening skills with staff, physicians, patients and families.
• Keeps all appropriate parties informed a timely manner and understands "chain of command" accountability.
• Completes leader rounding on assigned staff routinely and consistently.
• Provides input to and may assist with organization of staff meetings. Conducts staff huddles on shift.
• Collaborates with educator and manager to ensure appropriate and complete orientation of new staff. Identifies appropriate preceptor and assigns schedule to new staff.
• Participates in unit and PCS based teams, work groups and/or committees or shared governance councils. Demonstrates willingness to give 100% and voluntarily assists others.
• Keeps staff on shift informed of unit initiatives and incorporates outcomes of the team/committees work into practice.
• Ensures all RN's, PC's perform as a team in order to complete work on time and take uninterrupted meal breaks.
• Coordinates patient placement with Clinical Placement Nurse in a timely manner and with a positive and flexible attitude.
• Displays and is responsible for "welcoming spirit" for unit by integrating students and resource team.
• Develops open, functional working relationships with other units/physicians by understanding complexities of different stakeholders; has a house wide perspective.
• Promotes an atmosphere of collective accountability for the Unit/Department.
• Performs weekend leadership rounding on all patients and assists Clinical Manager during week as needed.
• Contributes to annual employee performance evaluation and is present when evaluation is given.
• Conducts formal staff rounding with assigned group of staff on a consistent basis at frequency identified by Manager. Follow up with all new employees on shift as identified by Manager.
• Contributes to completion of minor disciplinary action; may cover this independently with staff member under the approval of Clinical Manager. Provides feedback to Manager for development plans that are needed for staff they lead.
• Demonstrates ability to coach staff effectively using leadership skills.
• Participates in interview process for candidates seeking position on his/her shift.
• Uses retention strategies to recognize and reward staff on shift.
• Serves as Qualified Observer to ensure completion of annual competencies of staff on his/her shift.
• Participates in quality improvement initiatives for unit and as appropriate for PCS. Displays knowledge of PI process.
• Supports staff to incorporate EBP/research findings into practice at the bedside.
• Oversees environment of care and regulatory readiness with all regulatory bodies.
• Is a shift leader and is accountable for hardwiring evidence based and unit specific tactics for patient satisfaction (Hourly Rounding, bedside shift report, discharge calls, and AIDET.)
• Monitors for improvement of chart audit findings at employee level and provides follow-up.
• Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Required

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• 3 Years RN experience
• Licensed RN in the State of Illinois
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Telemetry competency
• Basic computer knowledge.
• Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
• Excellent customer service skills.
• Consistently works within the framework of the Illinois Practice Act for Nursing and ANA Standards of Professional Nursing Practice.
• Ability to assess and determine situations requiring an interpreter and to use interpreter services effectively.

Preferred

• Master of Science in Nursing (MSN)
• 2 or more years in pertinent clinical specialty
• Cert NRN
• Specialty certification such as CV-RN, CHFN, CCRN, PCCN, CNML, NE-BC, etc. required within 2 years

jobs.title: Staff Machine Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

We are looking for an experienced machine controls engineer to lead the development of advanced mechatronic instrumentation for patient care applications. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of architecting and developing control and sensing software for medical robots or diagnostic instrumentation from prototype to commercialization. A strong skillset in experimental design, empirical data collection, and data analysis/visualization is critical. Experience in low-latency machine controls, high-precision optical control, and biological sample handling applications is highly desired. This position reports on-site at offices in the San Francisco Bay Area CA.

What You'll Do

• Architect, design, and implement control and sensing software for advanced mechatronic instrumentation
• Work hands-on with mechatronic hardware daily in system bring-up, calibration, operation, experimentation, and debugging
• Lead system optimization and debugging activity with thoughtful experimental design, execution, and data analysis/visualization
• Interface with embedded systems engineers and electrical engineers to develop appropriate software interfaces to lower-level controllers and firmware
• Work closely with systems engineering and mechanical engineering to architect, select, and optimize electrical control boards, motors, sensors, and other hardware components
• Write clean, structured and maintainable code, document software designs for various instrument configurations, inclusive of error recovery
• Write and execute unit tests ensuring excellent test coverage for software code
• Use scripting languages (e.g. Python) for bringing up various hardware prototypes, for test automation, and for data analysis/visualization
• Generate detailed software requirements, design specifications, and software test protocols for the company’s Quality System
• Work closely with a multidisciplinary engineering team and company leadership to deliver key technical milestones
• Prioritize and debug reported software issues/bugs

Required Skills and Experience

• BS/MS in Computer Science or related field with 8+ years industry experience, or PhD degree with 5+ years industry experience in systems control and sensing
• Strong knowledge across programming languages for real-time and pseudo-real-time control (C#, C, C++) on Linux OS
• Demonstrated experience in architecting and writing motion control, sensing, and state machine code for one or more diagnostic instruments or medical robots that have reached production
• Experience in low-latency machine controls for time-sensitive applications
• Strong experimental design, empirical data collection, and analysis/visualization skills to support design iteration and optimization using scripting languages such as Python
• Experience developing medical device software per FDA requirements including software risk analysis and cybersecurity through all phases of product development lifecycle (design, implementation, debug, verification, validation and transfer to manufacturing)
• Strong analytical skills and a creative mindset

Required Education and Training

• Bachelors, Master or PhD in Computer Science or related field

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience controlling high-speed precision optics

• Experience with instrumentation involving biological sample processing

• Experience using OpenCV for camera sensing / computer vision applications

• Strong background in performance optimization to ensure deterministic execution of pre-defined software protocols

• Experience developing / interfacing with backend software for instrument data storage and network transmission

jobs.title: Senior Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor – Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor to support a large-scale, multi-phase hyperscale data center program.

This position can be based in the Chicago, IL area, with travel to the project site near St. Louis, MO approximately once per month for 2–3 days.

In this role, you will serve as a key day-to-day client interface, leading the delivery of high-value cost management services across a complex, multi-phase data center development. You will be responsible for driving cost planning, procurement strategy, change management, and commercial governance, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and rigor across multiple workstreams and packages.

The ideal candidate is a confident, client-facing professional with strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to operate both independently and collaboratively within a high-performing project team.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as the key, day‑to‑day client interface; ensure client objectives are met through best‑in‑class cost management.

• Prepare and present clear written and verbal updates, executive summaries, and recommendations.
• Develop estimates and cost plans through design, presenting updates at each design milestone.
• Review and reconcile estimates with the GC/CM and design team; validate quantities and scope alignment.
• Provide commercial input to design optioneering and value engineering (VE); inform engineering priorities based on cost/constructability.
• Support procurement strategy and contract administration; review contractor/subcontractor pricing.
• Lead/assist price negotiations to drive fair and competitive contract values.
• Provide independent cost/market inputs using internal benchmarks and supplier intelligence.
• Manage change orders end‑to‑end: evaluate, negotiate, and track through approval.
• Maintain commitment tracking, contingency management, trend analysis, and risk registers.
• Ensure robust cost validation, auditing, and change control processes throughout delivery.
• Produce timely monthly cost reports, forecasts, cash flows, and variance analyses.
• Coordinate funding data, develop executive‑level summaries, and facilitate VE/risk sessions.
• Implement and maintain Turner & Townsend Business Management Systems (BMS) and delivery tools; comply with SOX controls where applicable.
• Mentor and coach junior team members; model T&T purpose, values, and service excellence.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of internal tools, templates, benchmarks, and best practices.
• Support account growth and cross‑selling through strong stakeholder relationships.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Ability to travel to the St. Louis, MO area monthly for a 2–3 day trip.
• Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or related field (advanced degree a plus).
• A minimum of 6-7 years of cost management / project controls experience, including leading cost deliverables on medium‑to‑large, complex projects.
• Data center or mission‑critical/industrial project experience strongly preferred.
• Consultancy experience preferred; strong knowledge of procurement, commercial management, contracts, change, and risk.
• Demonstrated expertise in estimating, cost planning, budgeting, reporting, and cost control systems.
• RICS accreditation (or working toward it) strongly preferred.
• Excellent client‑facing communication and negotiation skills; ability to influence stakeholders.
• Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail; proficiency with industry‑standard cost tools.

jobs.title: CMiC Application Support Analyst- ACOM Hunt
jobs.description:
AECOM Hunt is seeking a technically skilled CMiC Application Support Analyst to join its Information Technology team. This role goes beyond frontline helpdesk support — we are looking for someone with hands-on experience in CMiC ERP environments who can operate fluently at the intersection of construction business processes, application configuration, and data. The ideal candidate understands how CMiC data flows across modules, can write queries to investigate and validate data, and has built or maintained reports that put operational information in the hands of business users.

This position will support the CMiC platform used daily across AECOM Hunt's project, finance, and operations teams. The right candidate is someone who has walked the path from ERP support into broader technical contribution — curious about the data behind the system, comfortable with SQL, and capable of building lasting solutions rather than just closing tickets.

This position will offer flexibility for primarily remote work schedules and can be based from a variety of locations in the US

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

• Provide CMiC application support across Finance, Job Costing, Project Management, Procurement, and Payroll modules — diagnosing configuration issues, data anomalies, workflow interruptions, and process errors.
• Assist end users with CMiC navigation, module functionality, and business process questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and application defects.
• Troubleshoot and resolve access issues including user account lifecycle management (create, modify, deactivate), role assignments, and permission structures aligned with job responsibilities.
• As AECOM Hunt's corporate ERP and single source of truth for financials, CMiC sits at the center of how the business operates. Candidates who bring an understanding of how data flows through an ERP — and who are comfortable using SQL to help investigate issues or validate outputs — will find themselves well-equipped to provide meaningful support in this environment.
• Support and maintain integration points between CMiC and adjacent systems (Textura, Concur, Prophix, CorPay, DocuSign, ClearStory, and others); candidates who have experience supporting downstream analytics or reporting platforms that consume CMiC data — such as Power BI — are strongly encouraged to apply, though this is not a requirement of the role.
• Document issues, root causes, and resolutions to build a structured knowledge base; identify recurring patterns that merit permanent fixes or process improvements.

Minimum Requirements:

• BA/BS in Information Technology, Business, Construction Management, or a related field + 4 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience supporting or administering a construction ERP platform — CMiC experience strongly preferred; comparable systems (Viewpoint, Procore Financials, Sage 300 CRE, or similar) considered.
• Working knowledge of SQL — ability to write queries, investigate data, and validate results in a relational database environment (Oracle or SQL Server).
• Familiarity with CMiC modules including Financials, Job Costing, Project Management, and/or Procurement.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills — ability to trace an issue from the user interface back to its data or configuration root cause.
• Demonstrated ability to work across technical and business stakeholders and communicate clearly in both directions.

• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position
• Qualified applications who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
• This position does not include relocation benefits
• THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY January 16 2027.

jobs.description:
DUTES:

· Develop and review sustainable land use and master plans, including sustainability elements such as renewable energy, energy efficiency, and water and waste management, with a view to establishing greener areas, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and moving towards the creation of a sustainable, carbon pollution-free city.

· Critically review and interpret local, state, and federal environmental regulations and voluntary sustainability commitment frameworks and advise clients on evolving regulations and zoning and building codes that require environmental action and conservation.

· Perform greenhouse gas inventory development and verification activities.

· Assist clients in voluntary greenhouse gas and sustainability reporting activities, in alignment with standards and frameworks including CDP (formerly Carbon Disclosure Project), Greenhouse Gas Protocol, Sustainability Accounting Standards Board, Global Reporting Initiative, and others.

· Analyze sustainable site plans and greenhouse gas mitigation measures and propose strategies to reduce community-scale environmental impacts of buildings and transportation, including promoting active transportation, public transit, and electric vehicles.

· Evaluate applicability and feasibility of industry-standard sustainability programs (e.g., building labeling schemes, accreditation programs, UN Sustainable Development Goals, etc.).

· Actively participate in a growing network of Ramboll sustainability practitioners that span our services across environment/health, energy, and water.

· Present project proposals to community, stakeholders, and planning authorities; and facilitate meetings with developers, officials, and the general public.

· Telecommuting is permitted.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Education Required: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Environmental Science/Studies or a related field.

Experience Required: 10 years of experience as Sustainable Development Planner, Urban Planner, or related occupation.

Special Skills Required: developing sustainable master plans for communities, including energy efficiency, building design, district energy infrastructure, water recycling, and waste management; creating policies for commercial and residential building development; implementing sustainability programs, including developing plans, establishing baselines, and setting targets; performing greenhouse gas accounting, forecasting, and modeling; developing policies focused on deconstruction, building materials reuse and recycling; designing and implementing incentive programs for decarbonization, energy efficiency, and renewable energy; and planning and implementing stakeholder engagement including public, industry, employee, homeowner, and customer-facing.

jobs.title: Digital Services Technologist
jobs.description:
The Digital Services Technologist will:

• The Digital Services Technologist supports IT interfaces (e.g., CSMI) and edge device solutions (e.g., cCSMI, PT100, DOPAC) that run on or are connected to manufacturing equipment and collect machine data. This role is responsible for troubleshooting and supporting these interfaces and solutions, which requires in-depth knowledge of the associated hardware, software, and machine sequences across all manufacturing areas.
• Provides support for IPC Management and Change Management within the plant. Responsibilities include patching, backing up, securing, and maintaining control system software and hardware, such as IPCs, PLCs, drives, communication devices, etc.
• Supports digital and automation projects during the rollout and implementation phases (e.g., PT100, SOCCeR), ensuring successful deployment and transition to operations.
• Required qualifications: Strong communication skills, the ability and willingness to train personnel in both production and maintenance areas, and the ability to work effectively within a team environment
• Preferred qualifications: good knowledge of industrial networking, computer systems, and programming/troubleshooting in Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff, and Siemens automation platforms. Experience with Python and C# is considered an advantage.

Overview of IT Interface Systems

IT Interface Systems are machine-to-IT integration solutions that follow Continental standards. They are implemented at the machine level and serve as a bridge between production equipment and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). Provide support for Order Execution, including validation of materials, operators, recipes, and related production data.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES: (Individual tasks, duties and responsibilities of the position)

1. Provide hands-on assistance with CSMI and edge device solutions (e.g., cCSMI, PT100, DOPAC) and other machine system integrations. Machine knowledge across the entire manufacturing process is required.

2. Provide hands-on assistance with patching, backups (IPC and PLC), and software version management.

3. Coordinate, organize, or assist in scheduling machine downtime required to complete activities described in items 1 and 2.

4. Organize, coordinate, or assist in the delivery of technical training related to CSMI and other IT systems for craftsmen on the shop floor and personnel within Digital Services.

5. Assist in the design, installation, commissioning, and startup of new or modified equipment.

6. Assist with CGMS and other system client software updates, upgrades, installations, and testing.

7. Support the installation, maintain documentation of machine IPC backups.

8. Maintain records of temporary, evaluation, or special circumstance PLC and IPC program changes.

9. Support IPC Management and Change Management activities within the plant.

10. Develop or assist in the creation of detailed step-by-step procedures for machine setup, troubleshooting, problem resolution, and off-shift training activities.

11. Perform other duties as assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor, Maintenance Coordinator, Maintenance Manager, or Plant Engineer.

12. Be available to work on-site and support operations across rotating shifts, including mornings, afternoons, and nights

13. Provide coverage for vacancies or resource gaps within the Digital Services Engineering team as required.

14. Communicate effectively, positively, and professionally with maintenance, engineering, and production personnel.

15. Ensure all ESH procedures, policies, and legal requirements are implemented, followed, and continuously monitored.

NOTE: May not be inclusive of all work required and may be updated as needed.

Basic Qualifications

• Associates Degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering or other Technical Field
• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job posting.
• No relocation assistance is offered for this position

Environment

• Safety is our highest priority and safety procedures/ guidelines must be always adhered to. This includes safety wear such as hearing protection and steel toe shoes.
• The role involves various physical tasks, including lifting, bending, stooping, pushing, pulling, and with comprehensive training provided.

THE PERKS

• Robust Total Rewards Package
• Paid Time Off
• Tuition Assistance
• Employee Discounts, including tire discounts
• Employer 401k Match
• Diverse & Inclusive Work Environment with 20+ Employee Resource groups.
• Employee Assistance Program
• Future Growth Opportunities, including personal and professional
• And many more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

Adult Health (Medical-Surgical) Nursing

The focus of this course is on the needs of adult patients and their families in relation to health promotion and management of conditions that require acute and chronic care. The nursing process is used in the discussion of health alterations affecting selected life processes. Students continue their professional skill development as members of the health team

• Plans clinical experiences for and provides direct supervision and evaluation of nursing students delivering nursing care to an individual or group of individuals.

• Makes self-available to staff at the agencies.

• Develops and posts written clinical assignments consistent with student's knowledge base, skill competency and individual learning needs.

• Corrects and returns homework, quizzes, tests, lab assignments, clinical paperwork and other written work in a timely manner.

• Contributes to the ongoing development, implementation, and evaluation of the programs and the College.

• May teach didactic course content under supervision of course coordinator.

• Keeps course coordinator informed of all student and agency issues and concerns.

• Works with college administration, staff and other faculty members to improve the overall operation of the college and student satisfaction rates.

• Participates in the implementation of the College Assessment Program, campus retention efforts, and both departmental and campus policies.

• Serves as a professional role model for other faculty, staff, and students in the areas of customer service, collaboration, communication, excellence, dress, attendance, and general professionalism.

• Utilizes relationship skills in situations requiring group problem solving, consensus building, and win-win negotiation.

• Complies with all applicable regulatory rules and standards.

• Reports to the dean or assistant dean: a course coordinator will also provide direct oversight.

• Handles related duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer (C++/Python)
jobs.description:
In this role, you’ll use C++ to build important software that powers machine learning, computer vision, and 3D modeling applications. This software will rely on mathematical concepts to analyze images and create realistic 3D models based on real-world data.

You’ll get to work with the latest research in fields like artificial intelligence, computer vision, and computer graphics.

To keep track of your code and changes, you’ll use Git. You’ll also test and run your code on a cloud platform, working with large-scale geospatial data (like maps and geographic information) to create 3D content that users will eventually use.

Responsibilities include, but not limited to:

• You will implement, in C++, core machine-learning/computer vision and (inverse-) procedural modeling algorithms, with varying levels of oversight. These algorithms rely on mathematical techniques from linear algebra, probability, and geometry.
• Apply cutting-edge research in machine learning, computer vision, and computer graphics.
• Work closely with leadership to understand high-level product vision and customer requirements.
• Utilize Git for effective source code management.
• Deploy and test your code on large scale geospatial datasets (and ultimately generate 3D content that will be available to users) This requires you to interact with remote machines via a Unix shell.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
• 3+ years of relevant industry experience in a fast paced, high growth tech environment.
• Team-oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude, enthusiasm and willingness to learn new methods, tools, practices and skills
• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience in designing and building high-performance, efficient systems using C++, with a strong focus on optimizing code for speed, scalability, and resource management.

Desired Characteristics:

• Familiarity with modern C++ will allow you to better interface with other portions of our data ingestion and product pipeline.
• A mathematical background covering some subset of linear algebra, probability, and geometry will also be helpful.
• Experience with Git is preferred, but a background with Mercurial or other DVCs is an acceptable substitute.
• Our development and production environments are Linux and macOS based. Confidence in a Unix shell environment (e.g. bash) is essential for working in our setup.
• Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in game technology, with expertise in areas such as Unreal Engine, C++, computational geometry, and computer graphics, driving the development of cutting-edge, high-performance gaming systems.
• We use CMake for project management. However, for something other than vim/make or Xcode, we need a convincing demonstration that you will be able to self-support in the environment of your preference.

jobs.title: Community Health Visiting Professor
jobs.description:
Do you remember the professor who encouraged you to believe in yourself and in your ability to be the successful nurse professional you are today?  Now you have the unique opportunity to be that professor  and create the "a-ha" moment of sudden insight and comprehension that will change a nursing student's life forever. As a Part-Time Visiting Professor, you will inspire our motivated students to realize their educational and career goals while enjoying a flexible schedule, excellent compensation, strong mentorship and support programs, plus significant opportunities for career growth. From individual professor support and student-led study groups to diverse clinical and career networking opportunities, the institution's community shares a common goal: to give each other the care we need to succeed and make a difference by transforming healthcare.   If you are passionate about nursing and advancing your career through the power of education, we want to talk with you today.

Community Health Nursing

Theory and concepts of community/public/global health utilizing levels of prevention are presented in this course. The public/community health nurse’s role as a partner with the community to shape conditions supportive of health is emphasized through application of the nursing process, beginning with the assessment of the community’s health, wellness needs and available resources. jobs.title: Project Controls & QA/QC Project Manager - EV Charging Programs
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking a detail-driven Project Controls & QA/QC PM with 5+ years of experience to support a fast-growing EV charging program for a leading autonomous vehicle client. The program develops fleet charging depots with third-party charging partners under a Charging-as-a-Service (CHaaS) model, with an active pipeline across USA, EMEA and APAC.

You will be the quality and control backbone of a regional delivery team. You will own the program's trackers, reporting and workflow discipline, and run first-line quality checks on feasibility reviews, project charters and partner submissions before they reach leadership. This role suits someone who enjoys bringing order to a high-volume pipeline, catches what others miss, and wants to grow toward program management in EV infrastructure.

Responsibilities

Quality assurance and quality control

• Run first-line QC on feasibility reviews and project charters
• Verify completeness and consistency: site data, charger details, electrical service etc
• Validate deliverables against client standards; track issues to closure.
• Build, maintain and version-control QC checklists, templates and document standards.
• Track QC metrics and report on trends.

Project controls and reporting

• Own the program pipeline tracker and single source of truth for sites across all stages.
• Produce weekly and monthly program reporting
• Monitor SLA performance; flag aging items and bottlenecks early.
• Maintain intake logs, including ad-hoc sites outside the formal pipeline

Systems and reporting

• Maintain the program's reports and dashboards in Smartsheet (or future platforms).
• Develop standards and short user guides so Regional PMs enter data consistently.
• Act as first point of contact for PM tool questions

Program operations

• Manage project intake screening and keep project records complete.
• Capture meeting decisions and track action items.
• Maintain site tour logs and consolidate PM feedback from site visits.
• Coordinate document control across the client, charging partners and internal teams.

Continuous improvement

• Identify repetitive manual work and seek out automation opportunities.
• Support the Team Lead on process, playbook and tooling improvements
• Provide support to Regional PMs on routine deliverables during peak periods.
• Adhere to SOX control responsibilities where applicable.

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture or a related field, OR equivalent experience.
• If you live in/near San Francisco, CA, you should be able to be onsite 3 days a week.
• 5+ years in project controls, QA/QC, project coordination or assistant project management on capital, real estate or infrastructure programs.
• Experience supporting construction of service centers, transportation hubs, or infrastructure-heavy facilities.
• Familiarity with permitting and utility coordination processes.
• Strong organizational and communication skills.
• Proficiency in Google workspace, and project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet or Sitetracker).
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing project needs.
• Comfortable working in both field and office settings, with occasional travel as needed.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage documentation across multiple projects.
• Knowledge of EV systems, charging infrastructure, or fleet operations is beneficial.
• Proven experience reviewing technical documents for completeness and accuracy against standards or checklists.

Preferred:

• Exposure to EV charging infrastructure, fleet depots, utility coordination or permitting.
• Experience with multi-party delivery models (developer, partner or owner's rep).

jobs.title: Physician - Part Time
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.




BEFORE YOU APPLY: THESE ARE PART-TIME OPENINGS.

 

We are seeking part-time Nurse Practitioners for our SoHo clinic in New York. Each role is approximately 23 hours per week, scheduled across three days. Part-time clinicians receive prorated paid time off and sick leave. Health benefits are available to full-time clinicians only.

 


CLINIC HOURS:

 - Monday to Thursday: 7:15 AM to 8:00 PM

 - Friday and Saturday: 7:15 AM to 3:30 PM

 - Closed Sundays

 


SCHEDULING DETAILS:

 - All part-time openings require Friday and Saturday shifts each week, 7:15 AM to 3:30 PM.

 - In addition, select one weekday half-day from the following options:
   
   - Monday morning: 7:15 AM to 1:30 PM
   
   - Monday afternoon: 1:45 PM to 8:00 PM
   
   - Thursday morning: 7:15 AM to 1:30 PM
   
   - Thursday afternoon: 1:45 PM to 8:00 PM

 - Role Purpose
   
   As a Physician at Neko you will deliver Neko's preventive-care model to members in our New York clinic(s). This is a role that allows you to practice preventive medicine – intentionally and fully. You'll sit down with members, talk openly about their health, and help them leave knowing what matters and what to do next. Neko's non-invasive screening gives you an early, detailed picture. Your part is turning that picture into a warm, honest, two-way conversation that genuinely changes what healthcare feels like for Neko members.
   
   This is a deeply collaborative role at the intersection of clinical excellence, member experience, and a conviction that catching things early changes lives. You'll work closely with Operators (medical assistants), APPs, and cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless member experience.
   
   What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months
   
   - Consultations that feel like conversations: you ask, listen, and explain findings in plain language, so every member feels heard and leaves with a clear picture of their health.
   
   - Personalized, action-oriented health plans built together with the member from their screening results and what matters to them, translated into next steps they actually take, measured by member follow-through and downstream outcomes.
   
   - Member education on dermatological and cardiovascular risk factors and lifestyle strategies, shared as a dialogue rather than a lecture, and measured by how the member felt about the consultation, not just the clinical findings.
   
   - Comprehensive preventive health screenings with consistent quality across every member visit, using Neko's skin imaging, cardiovascular assessments, and AI-powered decision support as tools that support your clinical judgment while the conversation stays with the person in front of you.
   
   - Clinical oversight and escalation support for APPs, serving as supervising or collaborating physician and raising the bar for clinical quality and team performance across the clinic.
   
   - Cross-functional collaboration with Operators, APPs, and care teams that improves continuity of care and the end-to-end member experience.
   
   
   
   What We’re Hiring For
   
   - Natural warmth and presence: people open up to you. You put members at ease quickly, stay curious about their lives, ask good questions, and listen more than you talk.
   
   - Genuine, personal commitment to preventive medicine, not just as a specialism, but as a way of practicing. A conviction that prevention should be the core of medicine. 
   
   - Member-first instinct: you take the member experience personally, not just procedurally, and measure a consultation's success by how the member felt, not only by the findings.
   
   - Team-lifting collaboration: you make the people around you better by showing up consistently, sharing what you know, and caring how the team performs as a whole.
   
   - Ease with novel technology beyond what you learned in your training. You're interested in the tools because they help you care for members better, and you're happy to learn new ones.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - Active New York State medical license.

 - Board certified in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or equivalent.

 - At least 1 year of post-residency experience.

 - Recent outpatient experience (at least a year in the past 5 years).

 - Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross,

 - Comfort working in a tech-forward, fast-moving clinical environment.

 - Availability to work Fridays and Saturdays from 7:00am-4:30pm




BENEFITS

 - Complimentary full Neko scan for you and eligible family members.

 - Flexible time off

jobs.title: Water Treatment Plant Operator
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Responsible for the operation, routine servicing and care of a wide variety of specialized equipment and apparatus in a plant/treatment facility including pumps, motors, chemical preparation and feeding; physical, chemical and biological treatment and/or water treatment processes; control equipment and monitoring equipment. Maintains records of operations, completes and submits routine and special reports as assigned. Inspects all mechanical equipment for proper operation, performs normal lubrication, adjustments, seal packing, minor maintenance and minor repairs as necessary. Performs related field and laboratory tests, which are necessary to monitor and control the facilities, and makes necessary adjustments to equipment, processes and chemical feeders, as test results may indicate and as instructed by the Supervisor. Operates and assists in repairs to water systems and plants. Operates plant(s) as designed to produce safe potable water for consumption ensuring compliance with all applicable New Jersey Administrative Codes, laws, rules, standards and permit requirements. Performs daily operational procedures, laboratory and field analyses, and routine calibrations and maintenance in order to maintain optimal treatment process. Maintains neat and accurate records of operations, completes and submits routine and special reports as assigned. Trains other employees in the operation and maintenance of the facilities including maintenance, repairs, laboratory work and safety as required.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Strong knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, chemical principles.
• Knowledge of applicable health and safety regulations, practices, procedures and water quality monitoring practices.
• Conducts safety inspections and follows all safety rules and procedures.
• Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, layouts, wiring diagrams, logic drawings, P&ID’s, technical O&M manuals and specifications.
• Capable of completing written operating procedures, work requests and other documentation completion.
• Responsible for start-up, shutdown, operation and periodic checks of water treatment processes, components and equipment.
• Adjustments of plant equipment such as pumping systems, chemical feeders, auxiliary equipment and control system storage tanks levels and pump stations indicators.
• Develops, assists, and revises operations and maintenance related procedures.
• Performs routine preventative/corrective maintenance.
• Capable of making repairs to chemical feed systems including PVC manifolds, peristaltic hoses, pump rotors, piping and fittings.
• Monitors all charts, gauges and other operating equipment via manual and electronic means such as a SCADA system.
• Load and unloads chemicals used at the treatment plants.
• Assists in ordering, delivery and inventory of chemicals, lab reagents, materials and supplies.
• Maintains accuracy of shift operating logs, records, time sheets, work orders and other administrative documents.
• Responds to abnormalities and takes appropriate corrective action consistent with established operating procedures and good engineering practices.
• Assists in the development, utilization and effectiveness of the preventative maintenance CMMS system.
• Completes accurate reporting of all work execution activities.
• Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks efficiently.
• Ability to diagnose abnormalities in complex controls, interlocked control schemes and other operating systems.
• Experience performing maintenance and operational tasks of substantial variety and complexity without close technical supervision.
• Ability to prepare/communicate orally and in writing and interact effectively and diplomatically with management and/or bargaining unit employees as well as regulators, consultants, municipal officials, health officers, customers, contractors, and the general public.
• Computer and software usage as required by the position.
• Ability to work with peers as a team player.
• Ability to work alone and maintain productivity without direct supervision.
• Availability for first response calls and problem solving.
• Strong laboratory and sampling experience.
• Performs routine housekeeping chores, light building repairs and maintenance as directed by Supervision.
• Ability to troubleshoot failures of water treatment equipment.
• Performs operations in accordance with established SOPs and job safety standards.
• Performs other duties necessary to fulfill facility operation.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Must be able to comprehend both oral and written instructions and to communicate in English, both orally and in writing.
• Must have technical knowledge of, and hands-on experience working in the operation of advanced water treatment plant facilities on the assigned shift.
• Must be flexible and enjoy a diversity of responsibilities.
• Thorough knowledge of the operating characteristics and maintenance requirements of water treatment plants.
• Knowledge of electrical and electronic systems.
• Knowledge of hydraulic, chemical and mechanical principles pertinent to water treatment plant operations.
• Thorough knowledge of occupational hazards of the work and the necessary safety precautions.
• Ability to operate a computer, mobile devices, applications and other electronic devices relative to the operation of the plants.
• Troubleshooting malfunctions and recording data.
• Ability to detect flaws in the operation of mechanical equipment and to determine proper remedial measures.
• Ability to conduct water quality testing, validations and all other necessary water quality instrumentation use/maintenance.
• Ability to understand and follow complex oral and written instructions.
• Ability to work in adverse conditions.
• Skill in the proper operation and care of a variety of specialized water equipment, materials and tools.
• Ability to troubleshoot and repair and wide variety of plant equipment is essential.
• Ability to report to work on time and perform the duties of the position for an entire shift for the entire workweek and to perform overtime. May be required to work evenings, nights, weekends, holidays and/or standby shifts.
• Ability to read and comprehend drawings, plans and maps.
• Ability to perform tasks with minimum of supervision.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers and the public.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection T-2 License, or ability to obtain within one year.
• Ability to learn and be certified in CPR and first aid.

Physical Requirements:

• Climb in and out of vehicles.
• Manipulate both large and small hand tools.
• Ability to constantly bend, squat, kneel, twist, push and pull.
• Ability to lift and carry objects, tools and equipment weighing 50 pounds.

Pay Rate: $38.85 per hour.

Benefits: Our employees are covered by comprehensive benefits packages including paid time off policies; health, dental, vision, and life insurance; retirement plans, savings accounts; tuition reimbursement; paid volunteering and more.

As an early member of our go-to-market organization, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product, help us build a stellar team, and accelerate pipeline across North America. 

This hire must be in our HQ in San Francisco.



You will:

 - Open doors. Take a data-driven approach to prospecting that builds a pipeline across key customer segments, while building connections and establishing Watershed’s brand in markets we will be entering soon.

 - Inspire action. Persuade prospects of the urgency of climate action and help them understand how Watershed can help them build a high-impact program, fast.

 - Communicate like an expert. Companies will feel delighted and informed by your interactions, looking to you for both climate and Watershed product expertise.

 - Take extreme ownership. Identify and actively address inefficiencies, : we need to leverage our tools for prospecting at speed

 - Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonizing their supply chain.



You might be a fit if:

 - You have 1-3 years of experience in sales or sales development and a consistent record of over-achieving your goals.

 - You take extreme ownership of our customers’ first impressions of Watershed. Customers you’ve worked with in the past should rave about working with you.

 - You’re flexible, adaptive, and resilient with a history of leaving systems, processes, and content better than you found them.

 - You have a great attitude, a love of close team collaboration, and a desire to move and grow quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.



Role Location: This role will be based in our San Francisco HQ with the expectation of being in office 4x/week.

   





   

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.



What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Director of Provider Onboarding
jobs.description:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

Nourish's growth depends on growing the number of providers on the platform, and every provider who joins us passes through our onboarding funnel. Provider Onboarding owns activation, focused on taking a dietitian, medical provider, or therapist from signed offer to confidently seeing their first patient. This team sets the stage for a successful provider start, and if done right, a provider starts fast, stays longer, and performs better.

As Director of Provider Onboarding, you'll own that function end-to-end, across the team, the operating model, and the systems behind it. This is a rare opportunity to optimize an existing team already onboarding providers at scale (RDs), while creating the 0>1 onboarding approach for new providers. On the RD side, activation has held around flat all year with minimal movement, and needs further investment and focus to structurally change the rate at which providers successfully start. At the same time, you'll build the 0→1 onboarding motion for Nourish Medical and Therapy as we expand beyond dietitians into a full virtual metabolic health clinic.

You'll manage and grow a team of Provider Onboarding Associates, and partner closely with Provider Recruiting upstream, and Provider Strategy and Provider Enablement downstream, and Credentialing, People, and Product throughout. This person will report into our VP of Provider Growth.

This role is full-time and open to NYC-based candidates only (expectation to work in-person 3-4 days per week, with some remote flexibility). Our office is located in Gramercy.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own provider activation across every provider type: Set the org strategy/vision and lead the team to execute against it, diagnose where providers stall between signed offer and first patient, and build the system/processes to ensure successful improvement of metrics over time

• Build and develop the onboarding team: Hiring and ramping new associates as the team scales, and establishing the performance expectations, coaching cadence, and accountability structure that motivates the team to achieve great outcomes.

• Design the operating model and systems: Use our CRM, sequencing, and LMS tooling to automate low-value touchpoints

• Stand up onboarding for new provider types: Build the Medical and Therapy motions from scratch and deciding what's shared infrastructure versus provider-type specific

• Own the capacity and ROI model: Build headcount and investment plans to drive further activation improvements in 2027 and beyond.

• Partner cross-functionally: Across product, recruiting, and ongoing provider strategy, you’ll ensure there are thoughtful handoffs and great product to drive an overarching provider experience that increases overall supply and drives NPS

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have 8+ years of experience, ideally in a marketplace, provider network, or high-growth startup environment

• You've owned a critical funnel metric end-to-end, and know what it takes to structurally improve key funnel metrics

• You’ve led teams before and are excellent at people management & driving teams to high performance. You’re results-driven and metrics-oriented, and not afraid of holding people accountable to targets.

• You have strong instincts for systems and automation, knowing which human touchpoints to replace with AI automation, and which ones to protect to maintain a delightful provider experience

• You're comfortable in the numbers, from cohort analysis to caseload modeling to building the ROI case for your own headcount

• You hold a high bar for the provider experience and want to help Nourish be the best place for providers to work

• You're energized by ambiguity, moving through roadblocks and challenges to get to a final approach that achieves outcomes

jobs.title: Scientist, Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM)/ Nanoindentation
jobs.description:
EAG Laboratories is seeking a Scientist to join our Materials Characterization team with primary responsibility for operating and interpreting data from Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM), Nanoindentation, and Optical Profilometry (OP) instrumentation.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience characterizing mechanical, surface, and nanoscale material properties and be comfortable with all phases of the analytical process, including experimental design, sample preparation, data acquisition, data interpretation, technical reporting, and customer interactions.

This position requires a strong technical foundation in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

What You'll Do

A typical day may include:

• Designing analytical approaches to address customer questions and technical challenges.
• Preparing samples and acquiring data using AFM, Nanoindentation, and Optical Profilometry systems.
• Performing advanced surface characterization, topographical analysis, roughness measurements, mechanical property characterization, electrical characterization and nanoscale mapping.
• Working with internal sample preparation teams when cross-sectioning or specialized sample preparation is required.
• Processing, analyzing, and interpreting data to generate meaningful technical conclusions.
• Writing comprehensive scientific reports that clearly communicate methodology, results, and recommendations.
• Presenting findings to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams of scientists and engineers on complex investigations

Client-Facing Responsibilities

In addition to laboratory work, you will regularly:

• Meet with customers to discuss project goals, results, and future analyses.
• Partner with EAG business development and sales teams to recommend analytical solutions.
• Participate in technical discussions that help customers solve materials, process, and reliability challenges.
• Support proposal development and scope definition for new projects.

Long-Term Growth Opportunities

Scientists are encouraged to expand their expertise through:

• Development of new analytical methodologies.
• Research and characterization of emerging materials and technologies.
• Publication of technical papers and participation in industry conferences.
• Creation of technical marketing content and application notes.
• Collaboration with instrument manufacturers and service providers.
• Cross-training in complementary surface and materials characterization techniques.

What Success Looks Like

Successful candidates thrive in a fast-paced consulting laboratory environment where multiple projects move simultaneously. They are curious scientists, strong communicators, and collaborative teammates who can independently manage priorities while delivering high-quality scientific results.

Important ITAR Requirement

Use of information in this role is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). To be considered for this position, applicants must qualify as a U.S. Person under ITAR. A U.S. Person includes:

• U.S. Citizen
• U.S. Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder)
• Political Asylee
• Refugee

Education & Experience

• PhD in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, or related scientific discipline.
• 1+ years of industrial, academic, or research experience using AFM, Nanoindentation, or related materials characterization techniques.
• Experience designing analytical protocols and conducting independent scientific investigations.
• Experience interpreting experimental data and applying findings to solve practical engineering or materials challenges.
• Experience writing technical reports and communicating scientific results.

Preferred Technical Skills

Strong preference for experience with:

• Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM), including modes such as SCM, SSRM, sMIM, KPFM, MFM and mechanical testing modes
• Nanoindentation / Nanomechanical testing
• Optical Profilometry / White Light Interferometry
• Surface roughness and topography measurements
• Thin film characterization
• Mechanical and electrical property characterization
• Failure analysis and root cause investigations
• Semiconductor, advanced materials, or microelectronics characterization

Highly Desired AFM Experience

Experience with one or more advanced AFM modes is highly desirable:

• PF-QNM (PeakForce Quantitative Nanomechanical Mapping)
• SCM (Scanning Capacitance Microscopy)
• SSRM (Scanning Spreading Resistance Microscopy)
• sMIM (Scanning Microwave Impedance Microscopy)
• Conductive AFM
• Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy (KPFM)

Additional Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following techniques is a plus:

• Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM)
• Focused Ion Beam (FIB) /Dual Beam (DB)
• TEM/STEM
• Raman Spectroscopy
• FTIR
• XPS
• NanoIR
• Materials and surface analysis techniques

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
• Customer-focused mindset with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts clearly.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Physical Requirements:

• The person in this position needs to move about inside the office or laboratory to access file cabinets, machinery, equipment etc.
• Ability to continuously operate a personal computer or lab equipment for extended periods of time (4 or more hours).
• Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate a keyboard and other lab equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead.
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position 90% of the time.
• Ability to speak and hear well enough to communicate clearly and understandably with sufficient volume to ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone online, and in a group setting.
• Learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, make timely decisions in the context of a workflow, ability to communicate with visitors, ability to complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

The essential physical and mental requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We will consider reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you.

Compensation is aligned with market standards for the region and tailored to individual qualifications and experience.

What It’s Like to Work Here:

• Learning & Development: Take on career development programs and goal setting to create big possibilities for your career and life. Develop within the company; be mentored and grown as a leader.
• Diversity & Authenticity: We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Benefits & Perks to Foster Work/Life Balance:

✓ Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

✓ 401k Company Matching

✓ …and more!

If you enjoy being immersed in technology, tackling problems head-on, finding solutions through teamwork, and taking pride in accomplishments, join us today!

jobs.title: Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Systems Architect

About the Role

The Systems Architect leads the design, operation, and modernization of a hybrid enterprise IT environment, with responsibility for both the current on-premises data center and its ongoing migration to a cloud architecture. The on-premises environment includes Cisco network switching, enterprise data storage, and virtualized servers. This role will drive the phased migration of these workloads to the cloud while maintaining a stable, secure, and well-documented hybrid environment for the foreseeable future.

The Systems Architect designs target-state architectures, plans and executes migration workstreams, and ensures on-prem and cloud components operate cohesively throughout the transition — balancing modernization with the reliability of existing infrastructure.

Location: Washington, D.C. (Hybrid — 2 days onsite)

Clearance: Must possess active Top Secret clearance

Status: Exempt

Responsibilities
