jobs.title: Entry-Level SDR – Renewable Energy Recruitment | Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Entry-Level SDR – Renewable Energy Recruitment | Los Angeles, CA

Location: Santa Monica, Los Angeles, CA
Company: Piper Maddox | Part of LHi Group
Industry: Renewable Energy, Clean Energy & CleanTech
Position: Entry-Level Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Recruitment Consultant
Base Salary: $50,000 + $10,000 Guaranteed Commission + Uncapped Commission
Average First-Year Earnings (OTE): $70,000–$80,000+
Experience: Entry-Level | No Previous Sales or Recruitment Experience Required
Training: 12-Week Structured Sales & Recruitment Training Program

Launch Your Sales Career in Los Angeles

Looking for an entry-level SDR job in Los Angeles where your ambition, communication skills, and sales performance can directly influence your earnings and career progression?

Piper Maddox, part of LHi Group, is hiring an Entry-Level Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team in Santa Monica, Los Angeles.

This opportunity is ideal for recent college graduates, aspiring sales professionals, career changers, and individuals with experience in customer service, hospitality, retail, or other customer-facing roles who want to transition into a professional sales career.

You'll develop skills in business development, lead generation, cold calling, client acquisition, negotiation, and consultative selling while building relationships with companies and professionals across the renewable energy and CleanTech industries.

Unlike a traditional SDR position focused exclusively on qualifying leads, this role provides the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle sales and recruitment consultant, managing relationships, negotiating deals, and earning commission through successful placements.

No previous sales, recruitment, or renewable energy industry experience is required.

We provide comprehensive training, ongoing mentorship, and a clear pathway for career progression.

If you're competitive, motivated by financial rewards, enjoy connecting with people, and want to build a long-term career in sales, we'd love to hear from you.

What Does an Entry-Level SDR Do at Piper Maddox?

As an Entry-Level Sales Development Representative, you'll learn how to generate new business opportunities and develop relationships with organizations hiring specialist professionals.

Your role combines B2B sales, business development, talent acquisition, and relationship management.

You'll identify prospective clients, conduct outbound sales outreach, build professional relationships, and connect businesses with specialist talent across the renewable energy and CleanTech sectors.

As your experience develops, you'll gradually take ownership of the complete recruitment sales cycle, from initial prospecting and lead generation through to client management, candidate placement, and successful deal completion.

This is a sales-driven, revenue-generating position with uncapped commission potential.

From day one, you'll receive structured training and coaching to develop your sales confidence, commercial awareness, and industry knowledge.

Why Piper Maddox? Sales Careers in Renewable Energy

Piper Maddox specializes in recruitment across the Renewable Energy, Clean Energy, and Clean Technology industries.

We partner with organizations developing innovative technologies, delivering energy projects, and transforming how energy is generated, stored, distributed, and used.

Our specialist markets include:

• Renewable Energy
• Solar and Wind Energy
• Energy Storage and Battery Technology
• Electric Mobility (eMobility)
• Nuclear Power
• Energy Trading
• Clean Technology and Energy Innovation

As an SDR specializing in renewable energy recruitment, you'll develop commercial expertise while building relationships with organizations operating across these markets.

You'll learn how businesses hire specialist professionals, understand emerging industry trends, and develop a network of clients and candidates.

You don't need previous energy industry knowledge. We'll provide the market training and support you need to become a specialist in your sector.

Why Join LHi Group?

Piper Maddox is part of LHi Group, a global, 100% employee-owned specialist talent solutions business.

Joining our Los Angeles team means becoming part of an ambitious, collaborative environment where performance, professional development, and long-term career progression are encouraged.

Here's what makes LHi Group different:

• Employee Ownership: Join a 100% employee-owned business where employees share in the company's long-term success.
• Sales Training & Development: Benefit from structured sales and recruitment training, ongoing mentorship, and practical coaching.
• Merit-Based Career Progression: Build your career through performance, professional development, and ambition.
• International Opportunities: With offices across the US, UK, and Europe, international career development opportunities may be available.
• Specialist Industry Expertise: Develop valuable commercial knowledge and professional networks within a dedicated recruitment market.
• Collaborative Sales Culture: Work alongside motivated colleagues in an environment that recognizes achievement, encourages teamwork, and celebrates success.

Salary, Commission & Benefits – Los Angeles SDR Jobs

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward ambition, performance, and professional growth.

Competitive Compensation & Uncapped Commission

• $50,000 annual base salary
• $10,000 guaranteed commission during training, paid biweekly
• Uncapped performance-based commission
• Average first-year total earnings of $70,000–$80,000+, including base salary and commission
• Opportunities to increase earnings as your sales performance and experience develop

Generous Paid Time Off

• 20+ days of paid time off
• 13 company holidays including your birthday off
• 5 sick days
• 2 Mind & Body Days
• 1 volunteering day
• Summer Fridays

Comprehensive Employee Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) retirement plan with company match
• Commuter benefits
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee ownership opportunities, including eligibility for shareholder equity after 12 months

Sales Training & Career Development

• Structured 12-week sales and recruitment training program
• Ongoing one-on-one coaching from your manager
• Hands-on B2B sales and business development training
• Cold calling, prospecting, and lead generation development
• Negotiation and closing training
• Specialist renewable energy market training
• Clear career progression opportunities

Sales Incentives & Company Culture

• Weekly sales incentives and performance recognition
• Summer and holiday parties
• Monthly promotion lunches
• Breakfast clubs and quarterly lunch clubs
• Opportunities to earn up to two international incentive trips per year
• Employee-led equity, diversity, and inclusion initiatives
• Long-service rewards, including additional paid time off, international office trips, sabbatical opportunities, and luxury rewards

Key Responsibilities – Entry-Level Sales Development Representative

As an Entry-Level SDR at Piper Maddox, you'll learn how to identify new business opportunities, develop client relationships, and generate revenue through specialist recruitment solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

Outbound Sales & Lead Generation

• Identify prospective clients and generate new business opportunities within the renewable energy and CleanTech markets.
• Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, networking, and other outreach strategies.
• Build and manage a pipeline of prospective clients and business opportunities.
• Research target companies, decision-makers, hiring trends, and emerging market opportunities.

Business Development & Client Acquisition

• Develop relationships with prospective clients and understand their recruitment needs.
• Introduce Piper Maddox's specialist recruitment services to new businesses.
• Learn consultative selling techniques to identify client challenges and provide tailored recruitment solutions.
• Support new business development and contribute to the growth of your specialist market.

Candidate Sourcing & Talent Acquisition

• Identify, source, screen, and engage specialist professionals across renewable energy and CleanTech.
• Build relationships with candidates and develop professional talent networks.
• Use LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and direct outreach to identify potential candidates.
• Match qualified professionals with relevant client opportunities.

Full-Cycle Sales & Recruitment

• Coordinate client and candidate interviews.
• Manage recruitment processes and communicate feedback.
• Support salary and contract negotiations.
• Develop skills in objection handling, negotiation, and closing.
• Build long-term client and candidate relationships that support repeat business.

Sales Performance & Market Development

• Work toward daily, weekly, and monthly sales activity targets and KPIs.
• Track business development activity, pipeline growth, and recruitment performance.
• Research renewable energy market trends and specialist hiring needs.
• Develop commercial knowledge and build your reputation within your specialist market.

You'll receive ongoing support as you learn, with increasing responsibility as your confidence, skills, and sales performance develop.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for ambitious, motivated, and commercially minded individuals who want to build a successful career in sales, business development, and recruitment consulting.

You don't need previous SDR, BDR, sales, or recruitment experience to apply.

You could be a great fit if you're:

• Sales-Driven: Motivated by goals, financial incentives, competition, and measurable results.
• Ambitious: Looking for a long-term career with uncapped earning potential and opportunities for professional progression.
• Confident Communicator: Comfortable speaking with new people, building relationships, and developing your communication skills.
• Resilient: Able to handle rejection, learn from setbacks, and maintain motivation in a target-driven environment.
• Proactive: Willing to take initiative, develop new skills, and step outside your comfort zone.
• Relationship-Focused: Enjoy connecting with people and building long-term professional relationships.
• Coachable: Open to feedback, ongoing training, and continuous improvement.
• Goal-Oriented: Energized by targets and motivated to achieve individual and team-based objectives.
• Team-Oriented: Embody LHi Group's Good Human ethos by contributing to a positive, supportive, and collaborative environment.
• Interested in Renewable Energy: Excited by the opportunity to develop expertise within clean energy, CleanTech, and emerging technologies.

Previous Experience That Could Be Relevant

Experience in any of the following areas may be beneficial, but is not required:

• Sales or business development
• Customer service
• Hospitality or retail
• Account management
• Marketing or lead generation
• Recruiting or talent acquisition
• Other customer-facing or target-driven positions

Recent graduates, career changers, and candidates without a university degree are encouraged to apply.

We hire for attitude, ambition, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

SDR Training & Sales Career Progression

We don't expect you to know everything about sales or recruitment when you join Piper Maddox.

Our 12-week structured sales and recruitment training program is designed to help you develop the commercial skills needed to succeed.

Your training will cover:

• B2B sales fundamentals
• Outbound prospecting and cold calling
• Lead generation and pipeline development
• Business development and client acquisition
• Consultative selling and relationship building
• Candidate sourcing, screening, and interviewing
• Client relationship and account management
• Objection handling and negotiation
• Sales closing techniques
• Market mapping and industry research
• Professional networking and personal branding
• Renewable energy and CleanTech market knowledge

You'll receive hands-on coaching, regular feedback, and ongoing support from experienced recruitment consultants and sales leaders.

Sales & Recruitment Career Path

Unlike traditional SDR positions where career progression may be limited to lead generation, this opportunity provides a pathway into full-cycle sales, client management, and specialist recruitment consulting.

A potential career path includes:

Entry-Level SDR / Recruitment Consultant → Recruitment Consultant → Senior Recruitment Consultant → Principal Consultant or Team Leader

Further progression opportunities may include senior individual contributor positions, team management, and leadership roles, depending on your performance, development, and ambitions.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I Need Previous SDR or Sales Experience?

No. This is an entry-level sales and recruitment opportunity.

You'll receive structured training and ongoing coaching to develop your sales, business development, and recruitment skills.

Is This a Traditional SDR Position?

Not exactly.

While you'll develop core SDR skills such as cold calling, lead generation, prospecting, and client acquisition, this position also provides the opportunity to manage the full recruitment sales cycle.

You'll learn how to develop client relationships, source candidates, negotiate offers, and earn commission through successful placements.

Is Recruitment Consulting a Sales Career?

Yes. Recruitment consulting is a commercially focused career involving B2B sales, business development, relationship management, and revenue generation.

You'll work with clients and candidates, build your professional network, and earn commission through successful recruitment placements.

Do I Need a College Degree?

No. A university degree is not required.

We welcome recent graduates, career changers, and individuals who have developed relevant skills through previous employment or other experiences.

How Much Can an Entry-Level SDR Earn in Los Angeles?

This position offers a $50,000 annual base salary plus $10,000 in guaranteed commission during training, paid biweekly.

You'll also have the opportunity to earn uncapped performance-based commission.

Average first-year total earnings are $70,000–$80,000+, including base salary and commission. Actual earnings depend on individual performance.

Do I Need Renewable Energy Industry Experience?

No. Previous renewable energy or CleanTech experience is not required.

You'll receive specialist market training to help you understand the industry, develop professional relationships, and identify commercial opportunities.

Where Is This SDR Position Located?

This position is based in Santa Monica, Los Angeles, California, within Piper Maddox's Los Angeles team.

Apply Today – Entry-Level SDR Jobs in Los Angeles

Ready to launch your career in sales and business development?

Join Piper Maddox, part of LHi Group, and develop valuable commercial skills while building relationships with organizations and professionals across renewable energy and CleanTech.

Whether you're a recent college graduate, transitioning from a customer-facing role, or exploring a new career in professional sales, this opportunity offers structured training, uncapped commission potential, and long-term career progression.

Apply today for our Entry-Level Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Renewable Energy Recruitment position in Santa Monica, Los Angeles, CA.

LHi Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Digital Customer Success Intern
jobs.description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

This position is a hybrid role open to candidates in the greater Tampa Bay area. This position will require the intern to work in our Clearwater, FL office 3 days a week.

Dates of Program: January 25th, 2027 - April 16th, 2027 (12 weeks)

Application Dates: You should apply as soon as possible but understand that because of our large pool of applicants, the selection process can take a few months. We strive to create a diverse group of interns as we feel that it improves the overall internship experience.

Attention: This is a paid internship. Please note that the intern would be responsible for relocation (if needed) and lodging for the duration of the internship.

Internship Program Details: Join the best internship program around! Interns get unique insight into the minds of the CEO and senior executives during Ask Me Anything sessions. Interns will receive company training, onboarding, and professional development workshops to help transition into the workplace. Interns will also engage in team-building activities and awesome socials. For more information on the internship program, visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/internships.

The Digital Customer Success Intern will support the Digital CS Program within Customer Success, helping customers adopt and realize value from KnowBe4’s security awareness training and phishing simulation platform through digital, lifecycle-aligned engagement. This temporary, for-credit internship is designed for someone eager to learn digital customer engagement, campaign execution, and customer health and adoption management in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

You will work alongside the Digital Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Renewal Specialists, and cross-functional partners (e.g., Support, Product Marketing, Account Management) to execute campaigns, maintain engagement data, respond to customer requests, and support internal process improvement. Successful interns may be considered for a full-time Digital Customer Success role after the semester concludes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support digital campaign execution by assisting with the build and quality review of targeted, lifecycle-aligned email journeys that deliver value-added content to the right contacts at the right time, under the guidance of the Digital Success Manager.

• Maintain audience segments and engagement data by building and updating segments, applying campaign entry and exit criteria, and keeping contact, subscription, and engagement records accurate.

• Monitor campaign performance by pulling and summarizing opens, clicks, and delivery metrics, and flagging trends across contacts, accounts, and designations for the team to review.

• Prepare adoption and value plays by drafting customer-facing content around a clear call to action and queuing timely plays for review and approval before delivery.

• Respond to inbound requests for enablement, self-service guidance, and support case review by triaging requests, routing them to the right owner, and drafting responses from approved templates.

• Ensure content meets brand standards by checking drafts against KnowBe4’s brand, design, tone, and voice guidelines before they go to review and approval.

• Build product knowledge across the KnowBe4 Platform, including security awareness training, phishing simulation, email & collaboration security, and AIDA, so you can speak to how customers use the product.

• Monitor adoption signals for assigned accounts and share usage and engagement trends with CSMs and Renewal Specialists to support retention and renewal goals and identify expansion opportunities.

• Capture customer feedback and share it with Product Management, Technical Support, and Sales through the established channels.

• Participate in team initiatives and ad hoc campaign requests that improve customer experience, such as refreshing templates, updating onboarding checklists, documenting playbooks, and preparing assets for the CSMs.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a diploma or degree program in Business, Marketing, Communications, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (enrollment is required for this for-credit internship)

• Comfortable with spreadsheets and documents (Excel/Google Sheets; Word/Google Docs)

• Familiarity with email and collaboration tools (Gmail, Google Workspace)

• IT experience or exposure is a plus

• Strong verbal and written communication, including concise customer-facing writing with a clear call to action

• Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks with guidance

• Comfortable reading engagement data and drawing simple conclusions from it

• Curious, coachable, and comfortable working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

• Interest in cybersecurity, SaaS, digital marketing, or customer-facing roles

• Exposure to marketing automation or customer success platforms (e.g., Marketo, ChurnZero, Gainsight) or CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce)

• Coursework or projects involving email campaigns, data analysis, customer support, onboarding, or account management (school, part-time, or internships)

• Fluency in additional languages (not required); KnowBe4 localizes campaigns for markets including Japan and Germany

Our Fantastic Benefits

We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits.

Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Part-Time) - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®..

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a part-time Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend.

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, CI/CD & ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

You will define and build the CI/CD systems that qualify frontier models and the software stack running on OpenAI’s custom AI accelerators. Your work will make correctness, performance, and stability measurable on every change, from individual commits through production releases.

This role spans model workloads, accelerator software, systems infrastructure, and developer productivity. You will establish scalable CI/CD, GitOps, and monorepo practices; design trustworthy regression and benchmarking pipelines; and partner with model, compiler, kernel, runtime, firmware, and hardware teams to shorten feedback loops without compromising production readiness.

In this role, you will:

 - Define the model CI strategy for frontier models running on OpenAI custom silicon and integrated accelerator systems.

 - Build production CI/CD pipelines for functional regression, performance benchmarking, software stability, and release qualification.

 - Design representative test matrices across models, configurations, hardware generations, software components, and deployment environments.

 - Create reliable performance baselines, regression detection, bisect and triage workflows, and clear ownership for failures.

 - Establish GitOps practices for reproducible configuration, promotion, rollback, auditability, and environment consistency.

 - Shape monorepo architecture, dependency management, build and test boundaries, change validation, and developer workflows at scale.

 - Develop scalable orchestration, artifact management, caching, scheduling, observability, and capacity controls for accelerator-backed CI.

 - Partner with model, compiler, kernel, runtime, firmware, validation, and hardware teams to translate release risks into automated gates.

 - Improve CI reliability, speed, debuggability, and cost efficiency while maintaining high confidence in production software.

You might thrive in this role if:

 - Have built or operated large-scale CI/CD, developer infrastructure, test automation, or production engineering systems.

 - Understand modern software delivery practices, including GitOps, release promotion, rollback, reproducibility, and policy-driven automation.

 - Have experience designing monorepos, build systems, dependency graphs, test selection, or change-impact analysis.

 - Can design regression and performance-benchmarking systems with stable baselines, useful metrics, and actionable failure diagnosis.

 - Are proficient in Python, Go, Rust, C++, or another language used to build reliable infrastructure and automation.

 - Have worked with distributed systems, schedulers, containers, clusters, or heterogeneous compute infrastructure.

 - Can collaborate with model and systems engineers to turn complex accelerator workloads into repeatable production qualification.

 - Care deeply about reliability, observability, developer experience, and reducing time from code change to trustworthy signal.

• Minimum of 3 Weeks Paid Time Off for Full Time

Top Work Places for 12 consecutive years, Great Places to Work certified for 6 consecutive years, and we believe that exceptional care starts with exceptional people. We are a leading provider of Physician Services, Home Health, and Hospice that encourages collaboration, innovation, and clinical excellence. From chronic disease management and rehabilitation to end-of-life care, our focus is on improving outcomes and enhancing quality of life.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer III
jobs.description:
What’s in it for you?

Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we’re still in the midst of exciting product growth — it’s a fantastic time to join us. Everything you’ll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you’ve ever worked with, then we hope you’ll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

About the team & opportunity

Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it’s also what makes it a target. The Trust & Safety team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down.

We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows.

Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can’t rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust & Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build.

In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust & Safety team.

A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly

On a typical day, you will be working on:

• Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic.

• Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends.

• Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives.

• Responding to active abuse, including during on-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones.

• Building tools that help our Trust & Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action.

• Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we ship.

• Working with other product teams to add protections to the flows they own.

• Reviewing implementation plans and pull requests, and sharing what you learn with the team.

What do we need from you?

• 3+ years of professional software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, including building and running production systems.

• Strong backend skills: building services, APIs, and data-heavy workflows in a service-oriented architecture.

• Experience with Rails, Node/TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language or framework, and a willingness to work across more than one.

• Comfort with relational databases and SQL, and with using data to check whether a change actually worked.

• An analytical, curious mindset: you think about how a system could be misused, not only how it’s supposed to be used.

• Good judgment about trade-offs, such as stopping bad actors without adding friction for real customers.

• A commitment to clean, reliable, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping in small increments.

• Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers alike, including Operations and Support partners.

• Comfort and skill with AI tools in your engineering work, including reviewing their output critically.

• Availability to take part in an on-call rotation for critical services.

• Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time.

Nice to have

• Experience in trust and safety, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention.

• Experience with email or SMS delivery, such as deliverability, sender reputation, or messaging compliance.

• Experience with bot protection, rate limiting, or third-party risk and verification services.

• Experience building rules engines, risk scoring, or ML-backed decisions in production.

• Experience using LLMs to classify or moderate user-generated content.

• Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or Redis.

Tier 1 Salary Hiring Range

$187,680—$227,424 USD

Tier 2 Salary Hiring Range

$172,040—$208,472 USD

Tier 3 Salary Hiring Range

$156,400—$189,520 USD

The ranges listed above are the expected annual base salary for this role, subject to change.

Calendly takes a number of factors into consideration when determining an employee’s starting salary, including relevant experience, relevant skills sets, interview performance, location/metropolitan area, and internal pay equity.

Base salary is just one component of Calendly’s total rewards package. All full-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program.

Calendly uses the zip code of an employee’s remote work location, or the onsite building location if hybrid, to determine which metropolitan pay range we use. Current geographic zones are as follows:

• Tier 1: San Francisco, CA, San Jose, CA, New York City, NY

• Tier 2: Chicago, IL, Austin, TX, Denver, CO, Boston, MA, Washington D.C., Philadelphia, PA, Portland, OR, Seattle, WA, Miami, FL, and all other cities in CA.

• Tier 3: All other locations not in Tier 1 or Tier 2

If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please let your Recruiter know when first connecting with them. Calendly is registered as an employer in many, but not all, states. If you are located in Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, and West Virginia, you will not be eligible for employment. Note that all individual roles will specify location eligibility.

jobs.title: Content Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is building a new kind of power company, and we're growing fast. Each new market means more homeowners hearing about Base for the first time, and more people deciding whether to build their careers here.



As our Content Lead, you'll shape how both groups get to know us. About half your time goes to member content: the website, the blog, and the emails and texts that help homeowners decide to join. The other half goes to our employer brand: telling the stories of the people building Base so great engineers, operators and field teams want to work here.



This role is for someone who loves writing and is great at it. You'll have a lot to work with: a product that keeps homes running through outages, a team building hardware, software and an energy company at the same time, and plenty of stories that haven't been told yet.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A portfolio that shows you're an excellent writer. You make complex topics clear and simple without talking down to the reader.

 - A love of writing. It's the thing you're best at, and you'd do it even if no one asked.

 - Experience owning content end to end at a fast-growing company, a consumer brand, or a publication.

 - An audience-first habit. You use interviews, data and research to understand who you're writing for before you start.

 - A working knowledge of how content gets distributed across web, social and email.

 - The ability to ship volume without losing quality: seven or more pieces a month, plus lifecycle copy.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own content across the customer acquisition journey, from the website and blog to email, text and social.

 - Lead Base's employer brand content and tell the stories of the people building the company.

 - Set the voice and editorial standards the rest of Base writes to.

 - Build the content distribution strategy

 - Partner with lifecycle, growth, recruiting, product and design to turn their work into content people want to read.

 - Talk to members and teammates to find the stories worth telling.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Marketing team owns how homeowners first hear about Base, come to understand it, and decide to join. Most of the people we reach have never thought about where their power comes from until it goes out. Our job is to make a new kind of power company feel simple, credible, and obvious. We work side by side with sales, product, and design, and our results directly decide how fast Base can grow into new markets.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

jobs.title: Mental Health Rehabilitation Specialist
jobs.description:
The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Who We Are

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

The Team

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system. Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

The Role

We are hiring a full-time Mental Health Rehabilitation Specialist (MHRS) to join our team at our Orange County clinic in California. This is a unique opportunity to be part of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to delivering personalized, compassionate, and high-quality care for individuals with serious mental illness, including the Medi-Cal population.

The Opportunity:

As a key member of the interdisciplinary clinic team, the Mental Health Rehabilitation Specialist (MHRS) helps members build the skills and confidence to live more independent, connected, and meaningful lives. You’ll lead psychosocial rehabilitation and life-skills groups, teach illness self-management and independent living skills, and support members’ community integration and vocational readiness. Working closely with our psychiatrists, therapists, and the broader care team, you’ll contribute to treatment planning, supporting members with medication adherence, and helping connect members to the resources they need. You’ll also ensure your rehabilitation services are documented in a Medi-Cal compliant way. This is a hands-on, member-facing role, ideal for someone passionate about recovery-oriented care and excited to make a meaningful impact in their community.

About You:

You’re an experienced, compassionate behavioral health professional who believes in recovery and meets people where they are. You’re a confident group facilitator, comfortable working with adults living with serious mental illness, and you bring patience, structure, and positive energy to everything you do. You thrive as part of a multidisciplinary team, communicate openly, and stay organized and thorough in your documentation. Curious and eager to learn, you welcome feedback and are motivated to keep growing your skills. Most of all, you lead with empathy and keep members at the heart of everything you do. If you’re excited to help shape a growing clinic and make a lasting impact in your community, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Work On:

• Lead psychosocial rehabilitation and life-skills groups, teaching independent living and illness self-management skills that help build daily stability and confidence.

• Support members’ community integration and vocational readiness, connecting them to opportunities and resources that promote long-term wellness and independence.

• Partner with psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, and peer support in treatment planning and coordinating member care.

• Connect members with community resources and supports that promote wellness.

• Document rehabilitation services accurately and in compliance with Medi-Cal requirements, supporting both quality care and program integrity.

What You'll Have:

• Bachelor’s degree in a behavioral health or related field (e.g., Psychology, Social Work, Behavioral Sciences, Public Health, Sociology, Human Services, etc)

• 4+ years of behavioral health experience, or equivalent experience consistent with California’s MHRS qualification pathways under Title 9 Up to two years of graduate professional education may count toward the experience requirement, consistent with California MHRS qualification pathways

• Experience facilitating groups

• Experience working with adults with serious mental illness, such as psychotic disorders (schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder), bipolar disorder, severe depression, or co-occurring substance use disorders

Preferred Experience:

• Experience in community mental health, ACT/FSP, PHP/IOP, residential treatment, inpatient psychiatry, or crisis programs

• Training in Motivational Interviewing and trauma-informed care

• Strong interdisciplinary teamwork and documentation skills

• Ability to document services in a Medi-Cal compliant manner

What We're Building

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

• A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.

• Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.

• A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.

• New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.

• A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The hourly compensation range for this non-exempt position is $28-$32 per hour, based on relevant experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Parental leave and programs built around well-being. We’ll share specifics during the interview process.

Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.

What We Value

• We center care in all we do. Empathy is not a brand value. It’s how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.

• We challenge convention. The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.

• We take the work seriously, not ourselves. High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.

• Your job isn’t done until the job is done. We close gaps, we follow through, and we don’t hide behind titles or org charts.

• We win together and fail together. We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don’t do blame.

• We hustle with humility. Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.

jobs.title: AI Product Evangelist & Community Builder (Contract)
jobs.description:
Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.

Sia Title: Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

Project Title: AI Product Evangelist & Community Builder

Project Length: This is a temporary position with an expected duration through 6/30/27, may extend

Project Hours: 40 hours per week

Rate: $75-95/hour

The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

PLEASE REVIEW THESE INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE APPLYING TO THIS ROLE

Show Us Your Influence

We want to see how your enthusiasm for AI translates into discoveries other people use. If your résumé references that you are leading or contributing to AI product communities on Discord, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, X, or other platforms, please include your handles, profile or community links, and specific examples of your contributions. If you are referencing demos, tutorials, conversations, or workflows people follow you for, please include those links or evidence that others engage with, adopt, or build on your discoveries. For private communities, screenshots with other members’ identifying information removed are welcome. Existing work only; no new projects are required.

A large following isn’t essential. Demonstrated product expertise, trusted participation, and meaningful influence are.

About the Role

You live and breathe frontier AI. You’re testing new releases, pushing agents beyond their obvious uses, and discovering possibilities you can’t wait to show other people. This is how you spend your time because you love it. You’ve already brought others along through a community, channel, blog, or the conversations where people turn to you for ideas and advice.

Sia Experience’s Marketing Advisory is providing consulting to one of the world’s leading technology companies on go-to-market strategy to grow adoption of its next-generation consumer AI agent, and we’re looking for an AI Product Evangelist to help drive that growth. In this role, you’ll immerse yourself in the product, uncover unexpected applications, and show people how to get more from its capabilities. You’ll connect with other enthusiastic users, build on their discoveries, and turn individual experiments into ideas and resources that inspire broader adoption.

You’ll bring firsthand knowledge of what users are building, what they’re discussing, and where the product could go next. Your insights should introduce the team to possibilities they haven’t explored and help translate emerging user behavior into meaningful product opportunities.

Your background might be in product, engineering, creative technology, education, content, community, or another discipline. What matters most is your demonstrated ability to explore AI deeply, share what you discover, and get others involved.

What You’ll Do

Bring the exploration, discoveries, and connections you’re already making into a direct partnership with the team building the product. You may already be a power user of this product, or bring deep experience with another frontier AI agent and the curiosity to quickly become one. This role gives you the opportunity to expand that work, involve the internal team, and help more people discover what’s possible.

Discover and Demonstrate What’s Possible

• Build on your existing product knowledge and experiments, exploring new features, integrations, and agent capabilities as they emerge.

• Expand the practical, creative, and unexpected use cases you’re already discovering, bringing the team into what you’re testing and learning.

• Push beyond established examples to uncover new workflows and applications, collaborating with Product and Engineering to explore their potential.

• Turn the discoveries you already share into compelling demos, tutorials, posts, and reusable resources that reach more people.

• Bring your ongoing immersion in frontier AI into the team’s thinking, sharing emerging capabilities, relevant developments, and informed user perspectives.

Inspire and Connect Users

• Deepen the conversations and relationships you already have in Reddit threads, Discord channels, and other spaces where AI enthusiasts exchange ideas and build together.

• Extend the trust you’ve earned through useful contributions, firsthand product knowledge, and helping others experiment.

• Bring inventive users and compelling projects to the team’s attention, connecting people who could learn from or collaborate with one another.

• Build on the ways you already get others involved through shared experiments, demonstrations, challenges, and collaborative activities.

• Several years of being the product geek who tests every release, finds the unexpected use case, and gets everyone else saying, “Wait, how did you do that?” Your experience with frontier AI may be more recent, but your instinct to explore runs deep.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI agents or advanced AI platforms, including building tools, executing complex workflows, or automating tasks beyond conversational prompting.

• A portfolio of projects, demos, tutorials, workflows, or public contributions that demonstrates product fluency and inventive applications.

• Experience building or actively contributing to an AI or technology community, with evidence that others engage with, learn from, or build on your contributions.

• Ability to create clear, compelling content that helps users understand capabilities, reproduce use cases, and get more value from a product.

• Experience identifying user needs, product limitations, and emerging behaviors, and translating those observations into actionable recommendations.

• Practical knowledge of using agents, bots, integrations, or automation to support community participation and reduce repetitive work.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage enthusiast communities authentically and collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and Marketing.

• Ability to independently prioritize work, test ideas, follow through on commitments, and adapt as product capabilities evolve.

Direct experience as a power user of the product is strongly preferred. Deep experience with another frontier AI agent or platform is also relevant. A formal community management title is not required.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Sia Partners, we are committed to treating all Applicants and Associates fairly based on their abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by law.

Quality service and innovative technology starts with happy and dedicated employees. Join our team and learn for yourself what sets NISC apart.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an advanced career scientist with a passion for process chemistry. You will be a hands-on experimentalist leading scientific investigations, coordinating cross-disciplinary decisions, and solving critical problems affecting process transfer and clinical supply. You will own complex drug substance development work.  The role requires experience working in support of regulatory filings, and a record of solving problems, and exercising sound technical judgment in complex and ambiguous development situations.

• Personally design and execute pivotal experiments to resolve difficult chemistry problems, develop new methods, and test high-impact scientific hypotheses.

• Lead investigations of complex reaction behavior, process variability, and impurity formation; establish scientifically justified recommendations for process control.

• Direct integrated process development across assigned programs or complex workstreams, establishing technical priorities and evaluating alternative development strategies.

• Manage a small group of scientists and research associates, developing technical capability through clear objectives, rigorous data review, coaching, and performance feedback.

• Lead cross-disciplinary technical discussions and decisions with analytical development, quality, manufacturing, regulatory, and supply chain partners.

• Direct laboratory scale-up and technology transfer to CDMOs, evaluate implementation risks, and lead resolution of significant manufacturing problems.

• Author and review process chemistry documentation and scientific justifications in support of regulatory filings, ensuring that development evidence supports the proposed manufacturing process.

• Identify broader implications of experimental findings for subsequent development, influence project strategy, and maintain strong standards of laboratory safety and knowledge capture.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• PhD in organic chemistry and at least 8 years of related experience, which may include postdoctoral research, with substantial pharmaceutical industry process development experience.

• A record of solving complex and ambiguous small-molecule process chemistry problems and delivering robust processes for clinical manufacturing.

• Direct experience contributing to regulatory submissions and leading process development, scale-up, and technology transfer activities.

• Advanced hands-on synthesis, experimental design, mechanistic reasoning, impurity investigation, and interpretation of analytical evidence.

• Demonstrated leadership of cross-disciplinary scientific work and experience supervising scientific staff and developing direct reports.

• Strong understanding of cGMP manufacturing, drug substance control strategies, process safety, and development needs from early through later stages.

• Ability to make and communicate consequential technical recommendations, balance competing project needs, and remain active in the laboratory.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience supporting multiple IND submissions or progressing drug substance processes through successive clinical development stages.

• Experience developing novel process solutions, leading significant manufacturing investigations, or contributing to scientific publications or intellectual property.

Maintain inventory control, including controlled drugs, by monitoring product quantities, qualities, and price points. This includes equipment and dealing with returns.
• Manage and/or implement hospital policies, including DEA/Controlled Substances and OSHA.
• Ensure payroll is completed and submitted accurately and in a timely manner.

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

Wing is looking for a Senior Talent Partner to drive recruiting for our business and finance functions, translating long term business roadmaps into sophisticated search strategies and hiring results. Based in Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid), you will serve as a high level advisor to Wing’s Business and G&A leaders, driving the talent strategy required to scale the global infrastructure behind autonomous drone delivery. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hello Patient is hiring a Strategic Account Manager to own the health, retention, and growth of our customer accounts from signature through post-go-live. You will be the primary relationship holder for your accounts, responsible for ensuring customers consistently realize value from Mia, identifying risks early, and helping customers expand how they use HelloPatient over time.

This is a proactive, ownership-driven role. You’ll maintain a clear, up-to-date understanding of how each account is performing, monitor key signals to catch issues before they escalate, and partner closely with internal teams to drive resolution.

Customers should view you as a trusted partner, essentially an extension of their team who understands their business, not just a point of contact for a software vendor.

While you’ll stay involved during the initial implementation to establish the relationship and ensure smooth handoffs and communication, your core responsibility ramps up after go-live to own the customer experience, manage communication and expectations, and be accountable for long-term customer success.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


OWN ACCOUNT HEALTH

 - Track how the agents are performing across your accounts, including containment, transfers, and reschedule, cancel and confirm rates. Dig into anything unusual before the customer notices it.

 - Review call logs and transfers to find where the agent falls short, and suggest fixes to the call flow.

 - Turn issues into clear tickets for Product and Engineering, follow them through to resolution, and keep customers updated along the way.


MANAGE CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIPS

 - Be the day-to-day point of contact for your accounts. Build a trusted advisor relationship so customers see you as part of their team, not just a vendor contact.

 - Run regular check-ins and program reviews, and send a clear status recap after each one.

 - Support customers through soft launch, go-live and ongoing agent updates, like new locations, providers, voice and script changes.

 - Work with Product, Engineering, QA, Sales and Solutions to get customers what they need, and wear whatever hat the day calls for.

 - Join onsite visits, whiteboarding sessions and industry events.


DRIVE PERFORMANCE & GROWTH

 - Build recurring performance reports and use them to help customers understand the value they're getting from Mia.

 - Help build ROI models from customer data and turn them into clear stories for customer leadership.

 - Spot expansion opportunities, such as new agents, chatbot, billing, referrals and new locations, and help Sales and Solution Engineers scope them.

 - Support order forms, renewals and invoicing follow-up.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


MUST HAVE:

 - 3+ years in account management, customer success or a similar client-facing role.

 - Strong written and verbal communication. You can read between the lines, build excitement and handle pushback with confidence.

 - A strong storyteller who can turn data into a clear story about value.

 - Collaborative and works well with cross-functional teams. You're happy to wear multiple hats.

 - Strong attention to detail, so nothing falls through the cracks between customers and internal teams.

 - Comfortable with data. You can work in spreadsheets, read dashboards and explain what the numbers mean.

 - Proactive and comfortable with ambiguity. You know when to solve a problem yourself and when to escalate.

 - You love building from the ground up. You're open to change, can pivot quickly and do well in a fast-paced startup.


PREFERRED:

 - Experience in healthcare, health tech or working with medical practices.

 - You use AI or automation tools every day to work faster.

 - Background in practice operations, revenue cycle or patient scheduling.

 - Some exposure to SQL, BI tools or call center metrics.


COMPENSATION

Base salary: $80K–$110K

Equity: Meaningful ownership in a fast-growing healthtech startup

About Hello Patient

Hello Patient is transforming healthcare communication through advanced conversational AI. Our founding team spent 3.5 years scaling Carbon Health's technology during hypergrowth, where we saw firsthand how much clinical time gets wasted on basic communication—great clinicians buried in admin work, patients stuck in phone tag.

Our AI platform proactively engages patients through perfectly timed calls and texts, resolving complex interactions end-to-end—from scheduling to billing to retention. Built with security and compliance at its core, our technology integrates with existing healthcare infrastructure to deliver 24/7 patient engagement.

Backed by Scale and 8VC, we're building the future of healthcare communication, one conversation at a time.

jobs.title: QC Analyst I, QC - Micro & EM(2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
Forge Your Future with Us:

At Forge Biologics, we believe in turning bold ideas into life-changing realities. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to enable access to life-changing gene therapies and help bring them from ideas into reality. We partner with scientists, physicians, biotech and pharma innovators, and patient communities — all united by one goal: improving lives. If you’re driven by purpose and excited to make a tangible impact, this is where your journey begins.

Our team works out of The Hearth, a state-of-the-art, 200,000-square-foot cGMP facility in Columbus, Ohio. Here, you won’t just watch innovation happen — you’ll be part of it. Whether you’re scaling AAV manufacturing, collaborating on cutting-edge therapies, or supporting complex technical projects, you’ll play a key role in bringing hope to patients with genetic diseases.

What sets Forge apart is our culture of H.O.P.E. We are hardworking, showing up each day with determination and grit. We are open, creating a space where ideas flow freely, and every voice is valued. We are purpose-driven, with every task directly tied to changing lives. And we are engaged, energized by the challenges we face and the milestones we achieve together.

At Forge, your growth matters. We’re committed to helping you expand your skills, take on new challenges, and develop your career through mentorship, hands-on learning, and opportunities for advancement. Our people are our greatest investment, and we’re proud to see team members grow with us.

Position Overview:

QC Analyst I (EM &Micro) will be a supporting contributor to the Environmental Monitoring (EM) program, supporting the aseptic manufacturing environment and ensuring compliance with GMP standards. The Analyst I will support EM initiatives and QC microbiology lab routine testing. This position also requires a good understanding of cleanroom behavior, sterile gowning, and aseptic sampling.

Responsibilities:

• Performs EM sampling that incorporates application of GMP principles and methodologies.

• Conduct environmental monitoring activities including air, surface, and personnel inside the sterile manufacturing areas.

• Support trending of EM data using software’s eg: JMP and LIMS.

• Performing microbial testing including but not limited to: Gram-stain, Growth promotion, Endotoxin, Bioburden, Osmolality, pH, etc.

• Supports thorough investigations to determine root cause of OOS investigations in the implementation of appropriate corrective and preventative actions in a timely manner.

• Trains junior staff in laboratory skills and scheduling EM sampling.

• Plans work to meet production and schedule requirements from clients (internal and external).

• Prepares EM data forms, EM labels, and executes the EM testing.

• Deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

• Participates in Media Fill/Aseptic Process Sims (APS) qualifications.

• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• Minimum of a High School Diploma or GED equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, Biology, or a related scientific field preferred.

• Minimum 1-2 years’ experience in a GMP or QC environment is strongly preferred.

• Must be self-motivated, organized, and proactive.

• Strong technical aptitude, including demonstrated experience in applying scientific reasoning to solve complex problems.

• Ability to work hours necessary to support QC and production

• Job activities require long periods of standing and use of controlled movements as well as aseptic techniques/behaviors in the sterile filling suites.

• Knowledge of aseptic techniques preferred.

• Ability to work in confined spaces like clean rooms and near operating equipment.

• Ability to work in loud noise environments and in Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Clean Room sterile gowning attire as needed.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Skills:

• Knowledge of aseptic techniques and behavior.

• Experience in a GMP environment or other regulated industry.

• Prior experience of environmental monitoring activities including air, surface and personnel inside the sterile manufacturing areas.

• Prior experience performing microbial testing including but not limited to: Gram-stain, Growth promotion, Endotoxin, Bioburden, Osmolality, pH, etc.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned.

jobs.title: Lab Manager
jobs.description:
WHY VEIR?

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, VEIR is a U.S.-based designer and manufacturer of category-defining superconducting power delivery systems built for the extreme energy demands of the AI era. By commercializing next-generation superconducting technology into deployable, real-world systems, VEIR delivers ~10× higher power density than conventional options, enabling “speed-to-power” where incremental optimization falls short. VEIR’s initial focus is AI data centers behind the meter, with solutions engineered for repeatable deployment through reference designs and integrated controls, designed to incorporate learnings as deployments scale.

The Role

Own the coordination and allocation of lab resources across VEIR's lab test operations, ensuring technician time, equipment, and testbeds are assigned efficiently to meet engineering priorities. Bring the engineering depth to scope, challenge, prioritize, and troubleshoot test requests. Plan and organize testing activities within VEIR's internal labs, own external test programs with partner facilities, and keep VEIR's labs safe, organized, and test-ready.

Direct Reports: Approximately 7 lab technicians, plus temporary lab staff as needed

Travel: Approximately 10–15% to external test partners and facilities

Core Responsibilities

• Assign and coordinate technician and lab resources across concurrent, competing test campaigns (e.g., electrical, mechanical, thermal, and environmental testing)

• Supervise lab technicians and temporary lab staff, including day-to-day direction, performance feedback, and development

• Serve as the primary point of contact for engineers and program leads requesting lab or technician support; triage and prioritize competing resource requests across teams

• Maintain working technical fluency in test methods, testbeds, and instrumentation sufficient to evaluate scope, staffing needs, risk, and realistic timelines for incoming test requests

• Forecast technician and temporary staffing needs based on upcoming test volume, hardware build schedules, and program pipeline; make the case for additional resources when needed

• Own planning and execution of external test programs (e.g., KEMA, third-party test labs, factory acceptance testing, on-site equipment vendors), including securing test slots, test readiness, staffing, logistics, and equipment coordination; evaluate and onboard new partner labs

• Lead planning and scheduling for system integration testing (SIT), coordinating resources, test readiness, and schedule with program leads

• Track ongoing test activities, resource allocation, and schedule commitments using shared tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com boards) to keep a centralized, up-to-date view of lab workload

• Partner with engineering and program leads to sequence test campaigns, resolve scheduling conflicts, and keep the lab from being overcommitted

• Own the lab budget, including test equipment capex planning, consumables, and external test spend; provide inputs to budget reforecasts

• Manage the test equipment lifecycle: calibration, preventive maintenance, asset inventory, and specification and procurement of new instrumentation and test equipment

• Establish and maintain test procedures, test records, and data management practices; support customer witness tests and third-party certification testing

• Maintain lab organization, housekeeping (5S), and readiness across VEIR's Woburn sites, including for customer and investor visits

• Partner with Facilities/Operations to ensure test infrastructure (power, cryogenic supply, testbed installation) is ready ahead of test campaigns, with clear handoffs between lab and facilities ownership

• Champion a strong lab safety culture: ensure test activities are planned and staffed with appropriate safety reviews, hazard assessments, PPE, training, and procedures (e.g., high voltage, high current, cryogenics and LN2 handling, oxygen-deficiency hazards, pressurized systems, lifting/rigging), and that safety requirements are factored into scheduling and resourcing decisions; partner with EHS on incidents, lab access controls, and corrective actions

• Support onboarding and ramp-up of new technicians and temporary lab staff

• Escalate resourcing gaps, safety concerns, or schedule risks to leadership with clear tradeoffs

• Collaborate with People/HR on technician role definitions, job leveling, and hiring needs as the lab organization grows

Required Qualifications and Competencies

• Strong project and resource management skills; comfortable running multiple concurrent workstreams with shifting priorities

• 5+ years of experience in engineering test, lab, or test operations environments, including people or team leadership; engineering background (e.g., degree or equivalent experience in electrical, mechanical, or a related discipline) with the ability to understand technical test plans, instrumentation, and data well enough to make informed staffing, scheduling, and prioritization decisions

• Working knowledge of lab safety practices and hazard controls (e.g., electrical safety, lockout/tagout, cryogenic safety, job hazard analyses) and a commitment to making safety a non-negotiable part of test planning

• Experience coordinating with external vendors, test facilities, or contractors

• Strong communication and stakeholder management across engineers, technicians, and leadership

• Sound judgment under ambiguity; able to make prioritization calls and clearly communicate tradeoffs

• Familiarity with project tracking tools and comfort building lightweight processes to keep work visible

• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to plan several weeks to months ahead while adapting to day-to-day changes

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with high-voltage or utility-scale power equipment testing, including relevant IEEE/IEC test standards

• Experience with cryogenic systems, superconducting (HTS) technology, or related test environments

• Experience managing test programs at external high-power or certification labs

• Experience owning a lab or test budget, including capex planning

Success Measures

• Test campaigns start on schedule with the right people, equipment, and procedures in place

• A current, centralized view of lab capacity and commitments that leadership can rely on for planning

• Zero recordable safety incidents, with safety reviews completed ahead of every test campaign

Additional Information

Physical requirements: Regular on-site lab presence; ability to wear required PPE and to lift up to 50 lbs.

VEIR is committed to equal pay for equal work in its compensation practices. The base salary range for this position in the U.S. is $120,000 - $130,000 per year + equity + benefits. A candidate's salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications, job level, supervisory status, and location.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Healthcare coverage with 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision

401(k) Retirement Savings Program

12 Company Holidays + unmetered PTO

12 Weeks 100% Paid Parental Leave for all new parents

Regular teambuilding, off-sites, and lunch & learns

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:

We strive to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and are committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees.
