Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb’s various functions embody the company’s innovative spirit, and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The Content & Knowledge Management (CKM) team that you would join makes accurate and authoritative information available at scale by creating, editing, and managing metadata and support content—including the public Help Center and internal knowledge bases—used by customers, CS agents, and consuming applications, including AI chatbots.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge Architecture will help establish and evolve the emerging discipline of content engineering—designing, structuring, delivering, and managing content so it’s strategic, scalable, consumable across surfaces, and efficiently adjusted, rather than a collection of one-off articles or chunks—within our organization.

In this leadership role, you'll own CKM inputs and influence infrastructure that construct and ingest an information layer, which serves various audiences and product surfaces. You will own decisions that determine how knowledge is created, updated, architected, organized, stored, retrieved, and surfaced. You'll also steer the cross-functional coordination that keeps CKM content aligned with product launches and other business developments or needs.

You’ll lead the teams who run taxonomy and ontology, content tooling and AI-focused optimization, as well as content operations planning. You’ll be accountable for how well they perform together: setting direction, clarifying who owns what, and developing the leaders and teams who make it work.

We seek someone who sees how systems underneath our content — taxonomy, tooling, authoring processes, information architecture, and operational planning — increasingly determine whether that content reaches the people and machines that need it. You should understand how user-facing content, metadata, measurement and authoring systems, and consuming applications all depend on each other, and you can spot where inconsistency in one area will eventually break something in another. Most importantly, you should view these as a cohesive unit, not several separate functions that happen to share a roof.

A Typical Day:

• Define and champion the evolving discipline of content engineering within CKM, establishing standards for how knowledge is structured, stored, and delivered across surfaces and applications.

• Own the roadmap for metadata, taxonomy, and information architecture that determines how content is organized, discovered, and reused.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to define and prioritize tooling investment that improves content quality, efficiency, and innovation.

• Establish governance frameworks that embed standards and quality checks directly into content creation, review, and publishing workflows.

• Define the metrics and reporting that give leadership visibility into content health, coverage, and performance, as well as authoring efficiency.

• Steer cross-functional coordination that keeps CKM content aligned with product launches and other business needs.

• Lead and develop the managers and senior team members in your group: set clear goals, give candid feedback, and hold each accountable for results.

• Own talent decisions for the group, including hiring, calibration, promotion, and succession planning, applying clear leveling criteria so people are developed and recognized fairly.

• Define roles and ownership across taxonomy and ontology, tooling and AI-focused optimization, and content operations planning, so everyone in the group knows what they own, what they influence, and where work hands off.

• Set priorities and allocate resources and capacity across the group’s programs and roadmap.

• Coach managers on team design and career development for their own teams, and help senior team members grow toward their next role. Sponsor a diverse group of talent and model Airbnb’s belonging behaviors.

• Build strategic relationships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Design, among others, to ensure knowledge systems keep pace with company-wide priorities.

• Champion a culture of technical and data fluency, editorial and operational excellence, and continuous improvement across a diverse team.

Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of progressive experience in content strategy, content operations, or knowledge management, including substantial experience with content systems, taxonomy, and/or information architecture at scale.

• 5+ years of managing managers, with a track record of developing high-performing, distributed teams, and steering them toward a shared strategy and standard.

• Hands-on experience owning talent decisions, including hiring, performance management, calibration, and succession planning.

• Experience in customer support, contact center operations, or a similar global service organization is a plus.

• Advanced degree in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Information Science, Technical Writing, or similar) — or equivalent practical experience.

• Deep expertise in content strategy, knowledge management, and information architecture, with a demonstrated understanding of AI/ML applications in content operations.

• Expert knowledge of content management systems and authoring tooling; practical experience with AI-powered content optimization.

• Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on system architecture, data structures, and retrieval mechanics — deep technical fluency is essential.

• Collaborative, solution-oriented, and able to execute at scale across genuinely distinct disciplines.

• Highly developed executive presence, with the ability to build and present business cases to VP/C-level stakeholders.

• Proven ability to steer and shape the work of multiple related teams and their leaders, removing ambiguity for executing parties and raising the capability of an already-strong team.

• A proven people leader who hires, develops, and retains senior talent, coaches leaders through growth and difficult conversations, and builds an inclusive team where people feel they belong.

• Skilled at joining an established team and leading it through change: earns trust quickly, respects existing expertise, and aligns leaders around shared goals.

Your Location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in the State of California, the State of Washington, or the State of Oregon to be able to conduct their work. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$196,000—$245,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Assistant Controller
jobs.description:

We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.

Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London, and Singapore.

What you’ll do as an Assistant Controller at Akuna:

Akuna is seeking an Assistant Controller to join our Finance department and report to the Financial Controller. We are looking for a proactive self-starter who can work independently to achieve both individual and team goals. This position will work closely with other team members from Finance, Trading Operations, Procurement, Tax, and Compliance. As Akuna continues to expand by opening new offices and entering new markets, this position will continue to gain exposure and experience within the global trading industry. In this role, you will:

• Take end-to-end ownership of key monthly close workstreams while reviewing the work of senior accountants

• Maintain complete and accurate accounting records for multiple entities, including the general ledger, income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows

• Support global intercompany transfer pricing processes

• Support monthly management reporting for senior stakeholders

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting for regulators, banks, and other third parties

• Strengthen financial controls and procedures as the firm scales, researching technical accounting matters and maintaining documented accounting policies that comply with US GAAP

• Identify and implement system, process, and automation improvements across the monthly close and reporting cycle

• Lead the annual audit through issuance, including preparing the financial statements and footnotes and serving as a primary contact for the external auditors

Qualities that make great candidates:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or similar

• 5+ years of trading industry or public accounting experience in the financial services field

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Experience reviewing the work of others

• Advanced Excel skills; NetSuite experience preferred

• Process-improvement and automation mindset

• Ability to multitask and prioritize meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to preparing accurate work

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want all groups to feel empowered to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!

In accordance with Illinois Equal Pay Act, the minimum base salary starts at $140,000. Exact compensation offered may vary based on many factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set. This role is also eligible for a discretionary performance bonus as part of the total compensation package and includes a comprehensive benefits package that may encompass employer-paid medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other benefits. The minimum base salary herein was determined in good faith by Akuna Capital LLC.

jobs.title: Member Advocate
jobs.description:
Most of what makes American healthcare expensive isn’t medical care. It’s the machinery wrapped around it: middlemen taking a cut, fraud nobody stops, and billing systems designed to fight over payment instead of deliver care. The result is higher premiums, denied claims, surprise bills, and a system patients increasingly experience as adversarial.



Arlo is rebuilding health insurance for small businesses from first principles: making sure as much of every premium dollar as possible goes to care instead of getting absorbed by the system around it. We do that by identifying fraud earlier, steering members toward higher-quality and lower-cost care, automating operational overhead, and eliminating vendors whose business exists mostly to take a cut.



AI is the foundation that makes this work. We use it across underwriting, operations, clinical programs, and member experience to build an insurer that becomes more efficient as the technology improves.



We’re already operating at meaningful scale: profitable, hundreds of millions in premiums, tens of thousands of members covered, and growing quickly through brokers, employers, and partners. Backed by Upfront Ventures, 8VC, and General Catalyst, with a team from Palantir, YC companies, and longtime healthcare operators.


ROLE:

As a Member Advocate, you’ll be the first point of contact for members, responding to questions and concerns with empathy and professionalism across text, email, and live messaging. You’ll take ownership of each interaction—helping members navigate their health insurance, benefits, and claims from start to finish. You’ll also work closely with teams across Sales, Product, Operations, and Engineering to continuously improve the member experience. Your goal: to ensure every member feels heard, supported, and confident in their care.

You’re best suited to this role if you thrive on solving problems for others, communicate clearly and kindly, and enjoy working across teams to create a better experience for everyone.

Your key focus areas will include:

 - Member Experience: Deliver fast, thoughtful chat-based support that builds trust and confidence.

 - Issue Resolution: Take ownership of problems, drive them to resolution, and follow through with clear communication.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams to surface insights and improve systems and workflows.

 - Process Improvement: Identify patterns, inefficiencies, or recurring questions and contribute to better tools, resources, and documentation.


SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 1-3 years of customer service experience in a health plan/health insurance environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics quickly, clearly, and empathetically.

 - Comfort using multiple channels and tools (e.g., CRM systems, chat platforms, text, and email support).

 - Detail-oriented and organized, with strong follow-through and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a positive member experience.

 - Passion for helping people and improving the healthcare experience.

 - Availability to work an 8 hour shift within the timeframe of 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with preference given to candidates in Eastern or Central time zones.

Nice to Have:

Experience in care management / clinical care coordination





WHY JOIN ARLO:



 - High ownership: You’ll get real responsibility from day one—our high-trust team empowers you to run with big problems and shape core parts of the company.

 - Join an important mission: Your work directly influences how people access care and improves lives at scale.

 - Growth & expansion: We’re moving fast, and as we grow, your scope will grow with us—new challenges, bigger opportunities, and rapid career velocity.

 - Apply AI to a problem that matters: Instead of optimizing ads or cutting labor costs, you’ll use AI to fundamentally reimagine how people get healthcare.

 - High pace, high collaboration: We operate with velocity, first-principles thinking, and a team that works closely, openly, and with ambition.


Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process.

Arlo is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on age, race, color, creed or religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military status, sex, disability, predisposing genetic characteristics, marital status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or arrest or conviction record, as defined under New York State law.

🔒 Your safety matters to us. If you're selected to move forward in our hiring process, you'll hear directly from a member of our Recruiting team via an @joinarlo.com email address. We will never ask for personal or financial information outside of our formal onboarding process. When in doubt, please reach out to us to verify at: recruiting@joinarlo.com http://joinarlo.com.

jobs.title: Technical Lead Manager, AI Platform
jobs.description:
Build AI contracting at enterprise scale. Ship it fast.

Ironclad is building AI on one of the most consequential datasets in enterprise software: over 2 billion contracts across thousands of the world's largest organizations. Contracts run every dollar, deal, and business relationship on the planet, and the AI transformation of this space is still largely uncharted. Engineers here are building agentic solutions to problems that haven't been solved yet, in a category that's still being defined. The feedback loop is short, the data is rich, and the people closest to the work are the ones deciding what gets built next. That ability to deliver impact quickly is why the the companies at the forefront of AI choose Ironclad to manage their contracts.

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com http://www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Tech Lead Manager to lead a team of engineers building production generative AI systems. You'll combine hands-on technical leadership with people management, setting the technical direction for the team while growing the engineers on it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow a team of engineers, balancing hands-on technical leadership with people support.

 - Own the technical roadmap and quality bar for your team's systems.

 - Own the business outcome. Partner with product management and work across teams to translate customer and business needs into technical deliverables.

 - Personally contribute direct technical output: write design docs, drive key architectural decisions, and write production code yourself for the highest-leverage or highest-risk problems.

 - Stay close to the architecture and technical details of what your team builds well enough to review design decisions, unblock engineers, and make prioritization calls.

 - Set and uphold engineering standards: code quality, testing, eval-driven development, and production monitoring for both reliability and output quality.

 - Manage prioritization and tradeoffs across competing priorities, and coordinate closely with adjacent teams whose work depends on yours.

 - Hire, mentor, and develop engineers; run performance and career development for direct reports.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven experience leading engineering teams as a manager, with a track record of shipping production systems.

 - Strong technical background in generative AI / LLM-based systems, with enough expertise to provide the technical depth and direction where the team needs.

 - Able to work directly as a technical contributor, creating design and implementing solutions.

 - Experience operating production ML/LLM systems: eval-driven development, monitoring for both reliability and output quality, and staged rollouts.

 - Past experience in one or more of the following areas: NLP, content/document understanding, search/retrieval, Agent framework or LLM training infra/frameworks.

 - Track record of hiring, mentoring, and growing engineers, and of navigating performance and leveling conversations directly.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership skills — comfortable setting a technical roadmap in a room with product, other engineering leads, and company leadership.

 - Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced, outcome-driven environment with real ambiguity in scope.




GREAT TO HAVE

 - Experience scaling a team through a significant architectural transition.

 - Familiarity with canary rollouts for ML/LLM systems.
   

Base Salary Range: 

The base salary range represents the minimum and maximum of the salary range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our base salary is just one component of Ironclad’s competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.


US Full-Time Employee Benefits at Ironclad:

 - 100% health coverage for employees (medical, dental, and vision), and 75% coverage for dependents with buy-up plan options available

 - Market-leading leave policies, including gender-neutral parental leave and compassionate leave

 - Family forming support through Maven for you and your partner

 - Paid time off - take the time you need, when you need it

 - Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) cell phone use

 - Mental health support through Modern Health, including therapy, coaching, and digital tools

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (US Employees)

 - 401(k) plan with Fidelity with employer match (US Employees)

 - Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun

 - And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at

**UK Employee-specific benefits are included on our UK job postings

jobs.title: Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) - Sign-On Bonus
jobs.description:
At Woven Care, we've built a culture that embraces challenges: we're driven by clinical excellence while encouraging fun (we do work with kids, after all!). We believe in the impact of direct care, backed by BCBAs who are in the building every day and a career path that's real, from Mentor RBT to QASP-S to BCBA. We offer guaranteed hours, tuition assistance toward your next credential, and a multidisciplinary team that has your back. We think this is what makes Woven Care such a special place to work, and why such special people choose to work with us!

What You'll Earn

• $20–$24/hour based on experience and certification

• $500 sign-on bonus for all new RBT hires

• Up to $9,000 in tuition assistance, whether you're pursuing your BCBA, a master's degree, or a related career in Physical Health

• 30 guaranteed hours/week (client cancellations don't affect your paycheck)

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match after 1 year

• PTO that grows with your tenure + six paid holidays

Your Schedule

Required availability is Monday–Thursday, 8am–5pm, Friday 8am-4pm. No weekends unless desired, no late nights. 30 hours guaranteed each week regardless of any client cancellations.

What You'll Do Day-to-Day

• Deliver one-on-one ABA sessions with children with autism, ADHD, and other developmental challenges

• Maintain continuous, attentive supervision of your client throughout each session

• Respond immediately to client behaviors that may present a risk of harm, including running or sprinting when necessary to reach a child quickly

• Implement approved behavior intervention and crisis management techniques

• Collaborate daily with BCBAs and a multidisciplinary team (OT, PT, SLP)

• Track session data and celebrate real progress with kids and families

• Show up fully present — this work is active, immersive, and demanding, and the breakthroughs make it worth every bit of it

Where This Role Can Take You

We invest in your next step, whatever that looks like:

• Lead RBT — train new teammates while deepening your clinical skills

• Mentor RBT — shape clinic culture and support fellow RBTs

• QASP-S — oversee treatment quality across ABA programs

• BCBA — we support RBTs pursuing their master's degree with internships and tuition assistance

• OT, PT, SLP, or healthcare administration — we'll support whichever direction you choose

What It Takes to Thrive Here

We're looking for people with a passion for working with kids and a belief that progress, however small, is worth showing up for every day. The best RBTs we know didn't necessarily start having done it before, but come ready to learn and grow. If that resonates, you'll fit right in!

You'll also need:

• Active RBT certification, or completed 40-hour training with your exam scheduled (you can also join as a BT and earn your certification with our support)

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 18 years or older

• Reliable transportation, Monday–Friday, with full 8:00 AM–5:00 PM availability

• Comfort working independently in direct care settings

Physical Requirements:

• Physical stamina to stay alert and responsive through full therapy sessions, including during high-energy or challenging moments

• Stay physically active throughout the day: you'll be constantly moving, on the floor, kneeling, squatting, bending, and transitioning between positions. You'll lift and assist clients or equipment up to 50lbs

Equal Employment Opportunity: We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or any other status protected by law. Woven Care uses e-Verify to authorize eligibility for employment.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Revenue Team:

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Director, Enterprise Retail Sales to lead a team of Account Executives responsible for some of Affirm’s most strategic retail opportunities across fashion, beauty, apparel, sporting goods, electronics, furniture, and other lifestyle categories. Reporting to the Senior Director of Enterprise Retail Sales, this leader will lead a senior sales team while remaining hands-on in complex commercial opportunities.

The Director will coach and develop experienced AEs, help shape and progress complex deals, build relationships with senior merchant executives, and work closely with cross-functional partners to support strategic merchant growth.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of senior Account Executives, setting clear expectations and driving accountability, performance, and consistent execution against team goals

• Own team performance across pipeline health, forecast accuracy, deal progression, merchant acquisition and expansion, and revenue outcomes

• Coach through complex, strategic opportunities, helping AEs build business cases, navigate stakeholder dynamics, structure commercial solutions, and negotiate effectively

• Build trusted relationships with senior leaders at major retail merchants and engage directly in high-priority opportunities where executive involvement can help move the business forward

• Shapes and evolves Enterprise Retail GTM strategy and objectives with senior leadership including account planning, territory management, pipeline reviews, sales planning, and operating discipline

• Drive commercial and operational outcomes by partnering across Product, Client Success, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and RevOps to maintain shared accountability for key milestones, resolve escalations, and influence company-level initiatives

• Drive operational excellence and sales effectiveness by leveraging data, AI, and modern tools to bring structure and innovation to planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and deal strategy

• Travel as needed for merchant meetings, deal support, industry events, and team gatherings

What We Look For:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, or commercial leadership, including significant experience leading senior sales teams in complex, high-growth environments

• Demonstrated experience directly managing and developing senior, quota-carrying Account Executives

• Proven success leading teams through large, complex sales cycles involving executive stakeholders, commercial negotiations, and significant cross-functional coordination

• Strong alignment with Affirm’s mission and a clear understanding of the value Affirm delivers to merchants and consumers

• Experience selling to large retail merchants, ideally in payments, fintech, commerce, or another complex solution-selling environment

• Strong judgment, communication, and executive presence, with the ability to build trust and influence C-level merchant stakeholders and senior internal partners

• Track record of developing high-performing sales talent, improving performance, and creating consistent operating discipline across a team

• Proficiency with data, AI, automation, and modern sales tools to improve sales effectiveness and decision-making

Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 12

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes the annual base pay and the sales incentive target.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA On Target Earnings (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $370,000 - $490,000

USA On Target Earnings (all other U.S. states) per year: $328,000 - $448,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. jobs.title: Scientist II, Process Chemistry
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a gifted experimentalist to join our team as a laboratory-based process chemist to own development workstreams for a small-molecule drug substance. You will independently design and execute experiments, solve complex chemistry problems, and develop robust processes suitable for scale-up and technology transfer. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with responsibility for scientific recommendations and delivery of assigned development objectives.

• Own the development of reactions, process steps, or development workstreams, setting experimental approaches and coordinating work to meet agreed project objectives.

• Design and execute experiments to evaluate alternative routes and optimize reactions, workup, isolation, and crystallization conditions.

• Investigate complex reaction behavior and impurity formation using mechanistic reasoning, experimental design, comparison of analytical data, and understanding relevant scientific literature.

• Develop robust processes by defining parameter sensitivity, reproducibility, impurity control, solubility limits, and other practical requirements for manufacturing.

• Plan and execute laboratory studies and translate results into recommendations for process implementation at large-scale.

• Prepare technology transfer procedures and work with external contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) to resolve implementation issues.

• Author process development reports and technical content supporting regulatory documentation; maintain complete electronic laboratory records.

• Provide scientific guidance to research associates, present recommendations to project teams, and identify and address laboratory and process safety risks.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• PhD in organic chemistry and at least 2 years of related experience, which may include postdoctoral research.

• Demonstrated ability to independently design and execute process development studies and solve complex synthetic chemistry problems.

• Strong hands-on skills in multistep synthesis, reaction optimization, isolation, and characterization using NMR, chromatography, and mass spectrometry.

• Ability to connect experimental results with process robustness, scale-up considerations, and project objectives.

• Experience taking responsibility for a defined scientific workstream and providing technical guidance to colleagues.

• Clear scientific writing, effective collaboration, and proficiency with electronic laboratory notebooks, data analysis tools, and ChemDraw.

Preferred Skills:

• Industry experience in pharmaceutical process development, laboratory scale-up, crystallization, or technology transfer to CDMOs.

• Experience with design of experiments, automated laboratory reactors, cGMP manufacturing, or drug substance regulatory documentation.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Behavior Technician (BT)
jobs.description:
At Woven Care, we've built a culture that embraces challenges: we're driven by clinical excellence while encouraging fun (we do work with kids, after all!). We believe in the impact of direct care, backed by BCBAs who are in the building every day and a career path that's real, from Mentor RBT to QASP-S to BCBA. We offer guaranteed hours, tuition assistance toward your next credential, and a multidisciplinary team that has your back. We think this is what makes Woven Care such a special place to work, and why such special people choose to work with us!

What You'll Earn

• $20–$24/hour based on experience and certification $15.16/hour during your training period, with your RBT exam and certification costs fully covered by us

• Up to $9,000 in tuition assistance, whether you're pursuing your BCBA, a master's degree, or a related career in physical health

• 30 guaranteed hours/week once certified (client cancellations don't affect your paycheck)

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match after 1 year

• PTO that grows with your tenure + six paid holidays

Your Schedule

Required availability is Monday–Thursday, 8am–5pm, Friday 8am–4pm. No weekends unless desired, no late nights. 30 hours guaranteed each week once certified, regardless of any client cancellations.

Where This Role Can Take You

We invest in your next step, whatever that looks like:

• RBT — we'll get you certified and support you every step of the way

• Lead RBT — train new teammates while deepening your clinical skills

• Mentor RBT — shape clinic culture and support fellow RBTs

• QASP-S — oversee treatment quality across ABA programs

• BCBA — we support team members pursuing their master's degree with internships and tuition assistance

• OT, PT, SLP, or healthcare administration — we'll support whichever direction you choose

What You'll Do Day-to-Day

• Deliver one-on-one ABA sessions with children with autism, ADHD, and other developmental challenges

• Maintain continuous, attentive supervision of your client throughout each session

• Respond immediately to client behaviors that may present a risk of harm, including running or sprinting when necessary to reach a child quickly

• Implement approved behavior intervention and crisis management techniques

• Collaborate daily with BCBAs and a multidisciplinary team (OT, PT, SLP)

• Track session data and celebrate real progress with kids and families

• Show up fully present — this work is active, immersive, and demanding, and the breakthroughs make it worth every bit of it

What It Takes to Thrive Here

We're looking for people with a passion for working with kids and a belief that progress, however small, is worth showing up for every day. The best BTs we know didn't necessarily start having done it before, but come ready to learn and grow. If that resonates, you'll fit right in!

You'll also need:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 18 years or older

• Reliable transportation, Monday–Friday, with full 8:00 AM–5:00 PM availability

• Comfort working independently in direct care settings

Preferred:

• BLS for Healthcare Providers/CPR certification

• Experience working with children with developmental disabilities

• RBT certification or completed 40-hour RBT training (no experience? no problem — we provide full training and cover your exam costs)

Physical Requirements

• Physical stamina to stay alert and responsive through full therapy sessions, including during high-energy or challenging moments

• Stay physically active throughout the day: you'll be constantly moving, on the floor, kneeling, squatting, bending, and transitioning between positions. You'll lift and assist clients or equipment up to 50 lbs.

Equal Employment Opportunity: We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or any other status protected by law. Woven Care uses e-Verify to authorize eligibility for employment.

jobs.title: Director of Business Development
jobs.description:
About the role and the team:

Reporting directly to the U.S. Head of Sales, you will be joining a high-performing team of professionals spread across the U.S., a group fully dedicated to bringing in new customers and fueling DataDome’s rapid growth. This team has been the driving force behind our exponential expansion in recent years, so get ready to join a rocket ship! 🚀

DataDome’s core values include #TeamSpirit and #Passion. You will be expected to collaborate closely with other teams and show great enthusiasm and energy.

Your scope: As the U.S. Business Development Director you will build and lead DataDome’s U.S. outbound motion, an important source of pipeline for a fast-growing cybersecurity company that is a pioneer in our industry. You will manage a team of 8: 5 BDRs targeting Enterprise accounts, a BDR Team Lead and 2 Commercial Account Executives who own the full sales cycle on mid-market and commercial accounts.

👉 You will be more specifically in charge of...

Outbound and BDR team

• Build and execute the outbound strategy and tactics to book meetings with DataDome target accounts: territory and account assignment, outreach plays, and activation of intent signals sent by the Growth team.

• Provide day-to-day team animation and management: individual and team performance goals, activity tracking, review of tactic efficacy, blitz routines, cross-training, coaching and mentoring.

• In close collaboration with the Sales Enablement team, ensure BDRs are trained on Account Executive partnership, uniform reporting practices (through Salesforce), product information, and outreach strategy and templates.

• Work with Marketing & Growth teams to build coordinated programs tied to performance, and adapt them based on results.

• Own the BDR to AE handoff: quality of meetings, show rate and conversion to opportunity.

Commercial Account Executives

• Lead, coach and develop the Commercial AEs through the full sales cycle: MEDDPICC discovery and qualification, product demo, proof of concept with our solutions engineers, procurement and signature.

• Monitor sales performance: activity, pipeline, forecasts and closed deals. Run pipeline reviews and forecast calls, and be accountable for the achievement of the team’s targets.

• Recruit, onboard and develop new team members as the team grows.

• Partner closely with the U.S. Head of Sales, the CRO and the Growth, Marketing and Solutions Engineering teams to ensure long-term company success.

Across the team

• Anticipate challenges and scale processes, technology and team to support the growth of pipeline over time.

• Take ideas, test them against data, turn them into action and supervise the success of projects and system improvements.

• Continuously innovate our sales approach and share best practices to accelerate customer acquisition and revenue growth.

Required

• Proven experience managing both outbound BDR teams and closing (quota-carrying) Account Executives in a SaaS environment

• 5+ years leading a team of BDRs and/or Account Executives

• Hands-on experience with deal inspection, MEDDPICC (or a comparable methodology), pipeline reviews and forecasting in Salesforce

• Strong mentoring and development skills with a track record of building successful teams

• Passion for prospecting and sales standard methodologies

• Self-motivated, standout colleague with a can-do attitude

It would be great if you...

• Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Bonus points if you have...

• Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Nooks, Gong and Sales Navigator

• Experience in Bot Management or the cybersecurity industry

• Experience scaling BDR teams in a scale-up environment

Location and compensation

• Location: New York, hybrid (our NY office is located in the heart of Soho)

• Target on-target earnings (OTE): $280K - $300K

• Base salary range: $150K - $170K

• Variable compensation: on the BDR team side, based on meetings booked and SQLs generated; on the Commercial AE side, based on closed ARR.

What’s in it for you?

• Flex Life: Hybrid and in-office options. Our new office is in the heart of Soho, with complimentary snacks, drinks and social events in one of the trendiest neighborhoods in Manhattan, plus a $500 WFH stipend to set up your ideal workspace.

• Generous Health Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you at your best.

• Professional Development: #Growth is part of our DNA, therefore we provide an annual stipend to invest in yourself.

• Events & Team building: Feel the #TeamSpirit both virtually & onsite, with several events and workshops planned throughout the year including two annual offsite events, summer & winter parties, lunch & learns, & much more.

• Perks: We prefer to adapt to what works best for you. Some prefer lunch on us, others prefer sports with friends, therefore we believe DataDomers should decide what works best for them.

• Parent Care: Gifts & care packages.

• PTO: 27 days + 13 national holidays.

• 401(k) eligibility + matching.

What are the next steps?

• You x Hiring manager: you will meet our U.S. Head of Sales and assess together how your experience and skill set will allow you to outperform in this role.

• You x Panel: case study and presentation, based on a real-life situation very similar to what you’ll face on a daily basis at DataDome.

• You x Chief Revenue Officer

• You x The CEO: let’s solidify it is a great fit for both!

• Welcome to DataDome!

DataDome stops cyberfraud and bots in real time, outpacing AI-driven fraud from simple to sophisticated across your sites, apps, and APIs. Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Bot Management, the DataDome platform is built on a multi-layered AI engine that focuses on intent, not just identity. Because it’s not about knowing who’s real, it’s about what they intend to do. With thousands of AI models that adapt to every fraudulent click, signup, and login, DataDome blocks fraud in less than 2 milliseconds, without compromising performance. DataDome is fully automated and integrates seamlessly into any tech stack. Backed by a 24/7 SOC team of advanced threat researchers, DataDome stops over 350 billion attacks annually. Experience protection that outperforms with DataDome.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation Operations
jobs.description:
About the Role

Every closed-won deal starts as a signal. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost.

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation Operations, you'll be the strategic business partner to Abnormal's Revenue Marketing and Digital Marketing leaders, and the person who connects marketing activity to revenue outcomes. Reporting to Ted Noble, VP of GTM Operations, you'll translate ARR and pipeline targets into operational demand generation strategies and execution roadmaps, then ensure we are exceeding our plan for full funnel from MQL to Closed Won. When conversion stalls, a handoff breaks, or a stage gets stuck, you'll find out why and fix it. This is a role for someone who is energized by funnel math, cross-functional alignment, and turning messy data into clear decisions, and who wants to help make Abnormal the #1 AI-native company.

The targets are ambitious because the momentum is real. Abnormal closed FY26 at roughly $380M in ARR, growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. As we expand from email security into the Abnormal Behavioral AI platform, the funnel gets more complex: more products, more buying committees, and more paths from first touch to closed-won. Hitting our growth goals depends on a demand engine that is measured clearly, managed tightly, and improved every quarter. You'll build and run that engine.

What You Will Do

• Turn targets into plans. Translate ARR and pipeline targets into operational demand generation strategies, funnel models, and execution roadmaps, working back from revenue goals to the volume, conversion, and velocity needed at every stage.

• Be the strategic partner to marketing leadership. Serve as the operational business partner to the leaders of Revenue Marketing and Digital Marketing, helping them plan, prioritize, and invest where the funnel says it will matter most.

• Own the lead lifecycle model. Establish and refine the end-to-end lead lifecycle model (MQL, GP, SAL, QP, POV, Closed Won), conversion benchmarks, and Sales-Marketing Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Run the funnel reviews. Lead regular pipeline velocity and campaign performance reviews with Sales, Business Development (BDR/SDR), and Marketing executives to identify funnel bottlenecks and optimize conversion paths.

• Solve bottlenecks from MQL to Closed Won. Diagnose where and why pipeline stalls, whether in lead quality, speed-to-lead, handoffs, stage progression, or win rates, and drive the fixes with the teams that own them.

• Hold the line on SLAs. Monitor SLA adherence and stage latency across Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams, and make performance visible so accountability is shared and gaps get closed quickly.

• Connect programs to pipeline. Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Analytics to measure campaign and channel performance against pipeline and revenue, so investment decisions are grounded in real outcomes.

• Plan for a multi-product funnel. Help evolve the funnel model, targeting, and account-based planning as we sell more products into more buying committees across the platform.

• Use AI to see problems sooner. Bring an AI-first mindset to funnel monitoring, using automation and AI-driven insights to surface early warning signs and recommended actions before they become missed quarters.

• Partner across GTM. Work closely with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Systems & Analytics, Sales, and SDR leadership so systems, definitions, and reporting stay aligned across the funnel.

Must Haves

• 7+ years of experience in demand generation operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, or a related analytical GTM role at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

• Proven track record translating revenue and pipeline targets into demand generation plans and funnel models.

• Deep experience designing and managing lead lifecycle models, stage definitions, conversion benchmarks, and Sales-Marketing SLAs.

• Experience leading pipeline and campaign performance reviews with senior Sales and Marketing leaders, and driving action from the findings.

jobs.title: Enterprise SDR - US
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 






WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY FEELS LIKE

This is a build job.

When you join, BLP has no US pipeline, no US case studies, and no local playbook. It’s not the well-oiled machine with sophisticated processes for everything. What you get instead: an experienced Senior Account Executive sitting next to you, a country manager owning the strategy, a direct reporting line to the VP of Business Development in Europe and a strong DACH SDR team willing to support. You get a winning product and a market nobody here has sold into yet. All of that comes with strong support from the Switzerland HQ.


Your first job is to work out who buys, why, and what makes them pick up the phone. You will hear no far more often than yes. The yes is a 30-minute discovery call with a CFO, COO, or Head of Finance at a large US manufacturer or industrial business, where you run the meeting, present the value, and map the stakeholders live.

If you want a finished machine to plug into, this is the wrong role. If you want to help build the machine, read on.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE


As our SDR in Boston, you will own outreach into US enterprise accounts. You will prospect and open relationships with Finance and Procurement leaders (CFO, COO, Head of Shared Services, Process Excellence, AP) and generate qualified opportunities for our agentic AI platform automating Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash. Don’t expect inbounds to carry you from day one.

You are one of the first commercial hires on the ground in a new market. You prospect, you run the connect calls, and you help write the playbook the next US hires will use. You report directly to the VP of Business Development for now, work day to day with the US Account Executive as a tag-team, and lean on the Team in Europe for what already works.

You will monitor the US market with regards to procurement and finance processes, ERP transformation announcements and buying triggers, and turn what you learn into better targeting. We need you to flag what is not working early and bring it to the team, so we fix the approach fast instead of grinding on a broken one.

You won’t be the only commercial hire on the ground, as a team of BDRs and a BDR manager are being hired.

 


TECH STACK

You will work with a sharp outbound stack: HubSpot as our CRM and source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for AI assisted tasks and research, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging. That said, the work has a strong outbound and calling focus. You will help decide what to add as the motion matures.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Take ownership of strategic outreach into enterprise accounts through cold calls and personalized messages, engaging CFO, CIO, CPO and COO stakeholders.

 - Craft tailored value propositions by understanding the specific pain points of stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Operations and IT in Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes.

 - Prospect large accounts and build multi-threaded stakeholder maps across Finance, Procurement, Operations, IT and the executive sponsor.

 - Run and present in 30-minute discovery calls with C-level stakeholders. You own the meeting, not just the booking.

 - Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR, IDP, workflow automation, RPA, copilots) with an end-to-end, exceptions-first narrative.

 - Stay ahead of the market by continuously updating your commercial knowledge, analyzing procurement and finance processes, and tracking industry trends in agentic AI and ERP automation.

 - Prioritize complex tasks with clients and identify potential bottlenecks to keep things moving forward.

 - Own a pipeline generation target and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

 


WE'RE EXCITED ABOUT YOU BECAUSE

 - You have roughly 1 to 2+ years in a B2B SaaS SDR or BDR role, most of it outbound, and you have built or helped build an outbound motion rather than only working an established one.

 - You know the US market and can navigate US enterprise buyers, ideally with experience selling into manufacturing, industrial, or finance and procurement buyers, 

 - You communicate clearly, concisely, and persuasively, and adapt your style to a CFO, CIO, CPO or COO conversation.

 - You can run a discovery call with a senior stakeholder: you hold the room, communicate clearly, adapt to a CFO or a Head of Procurement, and understand the buying center.

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity. No inbound, no case studies, no script on day one does not rattle you, it interests you. You see opportunity.

 - You enjoy problem-solving and have a natural curiosity that drives you to find creative solutions.

 - You are looking for a role that comes with key responsibility beyond the typical SDR scope.

 - You take ownership, ask for help when you are stuck, act on feedback, and pass on what you learn to the people who join after you.

Bonus points

 - You have been the first SDR in a new market, or helped stand up a new territory.

 - You know the ERP domain, or have sold Finance, Procurement, or industrial software and are familiar with P2P/O2C processes.

 - You are familiar with HubSpot as a CRM and use AI daily to make you more productive.

 


WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - US office. This role is based in our Boston office.

 - High earning potential. Uncapped commission and expected 6-figure package.

 - Equal OTEs. As we share the same incentives, you'll be comped as the Account Executives.

 - Training and development. There is onboarding material that trains you on our product, you get support from the EMEA SDR team and direct reporting line to the VP Business Development.

 - Aligned incentives with the AE team. You share the same on-target earnings structure as our Account Executives, because you share the same goal. Your work is treated as revenue generation, not lead handoff.

 - A stake in what you build. Long-term participation in the company's success, with details discussed openly during the process.

 - 25 days of paid vacation. European-standard time off, well above the US norm, because sustained performance depends on it.

 - Benefits. Plans around Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life and disability 

 - Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

 - Exceptional colleagues. Ambitious, collaborative people from strong academic and professional backgrounds who push each other toward excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers http://blp.digital/company/careers.

 

blp is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Labs
jobs.description:
About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to set the technical strategy for Data Labs, the team that builds the benchmarking systems, data pipelines, and RL environments behind our AI training engagements. The frontier labs and enterprises we work with are changing how they train, evaluate, and deploy models every quarter. Your job is to see where that market is going and make sure Data Labs is built for it before our clients ask.

You'll decide which capabilities we invest in, which we standardize into platform, and which we leave to individual engagements. You'll track how training methods, evaluation practices, and data needs are shifting across the industry, and turn that into a technical roadmap and a point of view our commercial and research teams can sell against.

You'll lead a group of engineering managers, forward deployed engineers (FDEs), and senior ICs, and partner closely with applied research, product, and go-to-market leadership. This is a hands-on strategic role. You won't spend much time writing code, but you'll stay close enough to the technical work to make and defend hard architectural calls, and close enough to clients to know which calls matter.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the multi-year technical strategy for Data Labs, and translate it into a roadmap tied to where the AI training and evaluation market is heading.

• Decide where to build shared platform versus engagement-specific solutions, weighing reuse against team autonomy so platforms speed teams up rather than creating over-dependency.

• Set architectural direction for benchmarking infrastructure, data pipelines, and RL environments so they stay reproducible, portable across client deployments, and ready for the next generation of training methods.

• Anticipate technical shifts 6–18 months out, such as new post-training techniques, agentic evaluation, and synthetic data, and place the bets that keep Invisible ahead of them.

• Set expectations for how AI is used in design reviews and day-to-day engineering work.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

• Build a clear, current view of how frontier labs and enterprises are training, evaluating, and deploying models, and what that means for the data and infrastructure they'll need from us.

• Track the competitive landscape across AI data, evaluation, and RL environment providers, and help define where Invisible differentiates.

• Turn client signals, research developments, and market trends into investment recommendations for executive leadership.

• Partner with product and commercial teams to shape new offerings, pricing logic, and the technical story behind them.

Evaluation & Data Strategy

• Define Invisible's point of view on benchmarking and evaluation, including pre- and post-engagement comparisons, capability gap analyses, and regression tracking.

• Make sure evaluation design ties to client-defined success metrics, validate automated checks against human judgment, and be explicit about what each approach can't see.

• Identify reusable data assets, frameworks, and pipelines that become durable advantages and improve margins across engagements.

• Shape practices for data licensing, privacy, and contamination risk as a strategic differentiator, not just a compliance requirement.

Client & Executive Engagement

• Represent engineering in executive conversations, strategic client relationships, and pre-sales, translating technical reality into clear, honest narratives.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor to client research and engineering leaders, bringing back what you learn to inform the roadmap.

• Help leaders weigh client-specific asks against broader platform and business goals, with clear short- and long-term paths.

Organizational Leadership

• Lead and grow an engineering org of multiple teams, including engineering managers, senior managers, FDEs, and Staff+ ICs.

• Coach managers to build sound technical judgment and strategic awareness in their teams.

• Build hiring pipelines that reinforce a rigorous, client-focused, strategy-aware engineering culture.

• Make sure the org has the planning, quality, and operational practices it needs to execute on the strategy reliably, delegating day-to-day delivery to strong managers.

What We're Looking For

• 10+ years in software engineering, with significant experience building ML or AI systems.

• 5+ years in engineering leadership, including experience managing managers across multiple teams.

• A track record of setting multi-year technical strategy and making platform investment decisions that paid off commercially.

• Deep, current understanding of the AI training and evaluation landscape, including how frontier labs and enterprises approach fine-tuning, RLHF/RLAIF, and evaluation methodology.

• Hands-on familiarity with LLM training pipelines, deep enough to make and defend architectural decisions.

• Experience building benchmarking, data curation, or RL infrastructure that produced measurable client outcomes.

• Ability to read market and competitive signals and turn them into a technical roadmap and a clear product point of view.

• Strong cross-functional partnership with applied research, product, and commercial teams.

• Excellent executive communication, and confidence acting as a technical advisor in client and pre-sales conversations.

Nice to Have

• Prior experience at an AI services firm, applied research consultancy, frontier lab, or enterprise AI product company.

• A visible point of view on the AI data and evaluation market, such as talks, writing, or open-source work.

• Familiarity with data licensing, synthetic data generation, or contamination detection involving client data.

• Experience shaping new product lines or service offerings from a technical foundation.

• Experience leading an org through rapid growth or significant change.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

For this position, the annual salary will include a 20% annual bonus and an additional incentive structure. The base salary range for SF/NY are:

Salary Range

$252,000—$300,000 USD

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in.

Country Hiring Guidelines:
Invisible is a hybrid organization with offices and team members located around the world. While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. Any location-based requirements or hybrid expectations will be communicated by our Talent Acquisition team during the recruiting process.

AI Interviewing Guidelines:
Our hiring team thoughtfully uses AI to support an efficient, engaging, and inclusive interview process. Since AI can also be a helpful tool for candidates, we've outlined expectations for using it ethically throughout your interview journey. Click here to learn more about how we use AI and our guidelines for candidates.

Accessibility Statement:
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request using our accommodation request form. A member of our team will follow up to support your request. Here is the link the google form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqsu0PCQ0m0lwt-VFeXovNbZxWk0jogv8QI_ciGqZsIbSBjQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=102356854798492362557

Equal Opportunity Statement:
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.
