jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Relief) - Leesburg, VA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($27 - $68) and 401k match

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODES HEALTH

At Codes Health, we are building the modern platform for medical record retrieval. Legacy record retrieval is notoriously slow and unreliable; our system uses AI to deliver decision-ready records much faster and more accurately.

Started just over two years ago, our volume is doubling MoM, with a clear path to category leadership. We support everything from Personal Injury Law to Specialty Healthcare. We are a well-funded, rapidly growing team focused on growing 100x from where we are today.

Our mission is to automate record retrieval, which will only be achieved through innovative engineering and relentless execution.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll be the person who makes sure the work we do translates to cash. Working closely with our Accounts Recievables team and reporting directly to our Head of Revenue Operations, you’ll own the full invoice-to-cash cycle: assembling invoices, delivering them, managing customer-billing relationships, and finding ways to optimize the workflow. 
It’s a core seat in Revenue Operations. You’ll interact with customers every day, work closely with Sales and Operations, and help build the systems we’ll use to scale. This isn’t data entry. You’ll have meaningful ownership, direct access to leadership, and a clear view of how the business makes money.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Invoice-to-cash, end to end

 - Pull billable activity from our internal systems and turn it into accurate, client-ready invoices

 - Own the monthly billing cycle so every invoice goes out correctly and on time

 - Keep our Master Invoice Tracker as the single source of truth for what’s been billed, sent, paid and outstanding

Customer relationships

 - Be the go-to billing contact for our law firm customers, answering questions, resolving disputes and setting up billing for new accounts

 - Run collections professionally and persistently, firmly enough to get paid and friendly enough to keep the relationship strong

 - Work with Account Executives to catch billing issues early and keep customers happy

Insight and reporting

 - Track AR aging, DSO and collection trends, and flag risks before they become problems

 - Reconcile payments against invoices and keep records audit-ready

 - Support month-end close, cash forecasting and ad hoc analysis

Building the machine

 - Find manual, repetitive tasks --> automate or streamline them

 - Help evaluate and set up tools (billing platforms, payment portals, CRM integrations) as we scale

 - Diligent documentation of processes so the function can grow past one person

Whatever finance needs

 - Pitch in on payables, commission calculations, vendor management, and other projects as they surface


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 1–3 years in accounts receivable, billing, bookkeeping, or a similar finance role (startup or B2B services experience is a plus)

 - Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills: lookups, pivots and working with large datasets shouldn’t scare you

 - Close attention to detail, because you know one wrong number on an invoice costs us trust

 - The ability to think outside of the box; effectively scaling these processes requires innate curiosity that extends beyond the tools already in place

 - Clear, confident written communication with external customers

 - An instinct for ownership: you see a messy process and want to fix it

 - Comfort in a fast-moving, remote environment where priorities shift
   
   


COMPENSATION DETAILS

 - Competitive salary

 - Healthcare, vision and dental insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Associate Director, Planning & Delivery
jobs.description:
The Associate Director, Planning & Delivery is responsible for developing and managing integrated Business Technology Solutions (BTS) demand, resource capacity, and portfolio planning processes that align technology investments and resources with business priorities. This role provides visibility into BTS demand, workforce capacity and skills, portfolio performance, and delivery risks to enable effective prioritization, resource allocation, workforce planning, and execution.

Responsibilities:

• Lead IT Demand Planning. Establish and manage a standardized process for capturing, evaluating, forecasting, and prioritizing technology demand across projects, products, and operational initiatives.
• Lead Resource & Capacity Planning. Develop a forward-looking view of workforce capacity and availability across employees and external resources and align available capacity with planned technology demand.
• Establish Knowledge Management Capabilities. Lead the development, embedment, and ongoing enrichment of Knowledge Management processes and tools.
• Lead Portfolio Planning & Prioritization. Manage the IT portfolio planning process, ensuring proposed and active initiatives are evaluated against strategic priorities, resource requirements, dependencies, capacity, and business value.
• Establish Delivery Governance & Standards. Develop and maintain consistent portfolio and project governance, including planning standards, stage gates, status reporting, risk and issue management, and escalation processes.
• Monitor Portfolio Performance. Provide visibility into portfolio health, milestones, dependencies, risks, resource constraints, and delivery performance, proactively identifying areas requiring leadership attention.
• Enable Resource & Workforce Decisions. Translate demand and capacity gaps into recommendations for resource allocation, hiring contractors, external partners, redeployment, and employee development.
• Lead Planning, Reporting & Analytics. Develop dashboards, forecasts, KPIs, and scenario analyses covering portfolio performance, demand, capacity, utilization, skills, and resource gaps.
• Facilitate IT Planning & Governance. Lead recurring portfolio, demand, and capacity reviews with IT leadership, driving decisions and accountability related to priorities, resources, risks, and delivery.

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Operations, Human Resources, or related field with 9 years of experience; OR Master’s Degree with 8 years of experience; OR PhD with 4 years of experience.
• Respective years of progressive experience in IT portfolio management, PMO, resource/workforce planning, technology planning, or related disciplines.
• 3+ years of people leadership, team leadership, or equivalent experience leading others through complex initiatives.
• Experience with portfolio and project governance, demand management, resource planning, or capacity planning.
• Experience translating projects, product, and operational demand into resource and capability requirements.
• Experience developing portfolio reporting and providing insights into technology leadership.
• Demonstrated experience partnering across IT and with functions such as Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, or business organizations.
• Strong understanding of demand management, capacity planning, resource management, and workforce planning concepts.
• Strong analytical skills, including forecasting, capacity modeling, scenario analysis, and data-driven decision making.
• Ability to design, implement, and continuously improve standardized processes and operating models.
• Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, prioritizing team activities, and establishing accountability.
• Ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new processes without direct authority.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex planning information into clear recommendations for leadership.
• Advanced proficiency with Excel and experience with reporting, visualization, portfolio management, resource management, or workforce planning tools.

Preferred:

• Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, Operations, or a related discipline.
• 9+ years of experience in IT portfolio management, PMO, technology planning, resource management, or strategic workforce planning.
• Experience establishing or significantly improving an IT PMO, portfolio management, or supply and demand planning capability.
• Experience developing technology skills inventories, capability frameworks, or resource forecasting models.
• Experience integrating portfolio planning with budgeting, workforce planning, hiring, contractor utilization, and annual planning.
• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics and visualization tools.
• PMP, PgMP, SAFe, ITIL, or other relevant project, portfolio, Agile, or IT management certification.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist, Quality Control
jobs.description:
The Associate Quality Control (QC) Scientist will ensure that company quality standards are met throughout various manufacturing processes for microbiological, next gen sequencing, and biologics products. This individual will partner with a team of quality control professionals that implement and maintain the quality management systems, support new product development, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. In partnership with site HR, manufacturing, and operational leadership, this role is expected to foster a positive work environment and a culture of ownership and accountability.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to capably perform each of the following essential functions:

• Independently perform operational workflows, following approved documentation and using standard microbiology, analytical chemistry, and aseptic techniques
• Process, record, and analyze data following approved test methods and work instructions and using good documentation practices
• Support the quality control group operations in maintaining standards in safety, speed, quality, cost, & equipment
• Support the organization’s commercial and development activities, while also ensuring compliance with applicable quality and regulatory standards
• Identify assay and process improvement opportunities based on first-hand observation and data review
• Maintain training requirements and execute on goal setting linked to business initiatives and other key performance indicators
• Support in continuous improvement projects and lean manufacturing initiatives
• Adhere to company Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) policy
• Perform other duties as required, or assigned by management, to meet business needs

Minimum Qualifications:

• Associate degree in an applicable life sciences field (molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, etc.)—or equivalent combination of applicable education and relevant work experience
• Prior success serving on operationally oriented or technical teams
• Proven ability to perform standard biological laboratory techniques in support of Next Gen sequencing workflows such as PCR, liquid handling machines etc.
• Ability to adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions to effectively meet production needs
• Ability to gather and coordinate information, interpret and develop appropriate recommendations for effective action
• Working knowledge and proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior work experience in a relevant industry (pharma, biotech, or medical device)
• Experience in cell-based assays and enzyme activity assays
• Proven ability to perform common analytical methods, such as electrophoresis, chromatography, mass spectrometry, and spectroscopy

Behavioural & Interpersonal Competencies:

• Resonate and operate in line with LGC’s core value behaviors: Passion, Curiosity, Integrity, Brilliance, and Respect
• Effective written and verbal communication skills with technical staff and peers
• Demonstrated autonomy: ability to self-start and drive whilst recognising the appropriate time for stakeholder engagement
• Effective analytical problem-solving skills, time management and organizational skills
• Passion for continuous improvement, with demonstrated initiative
• Aptitude to work in a complex and rapidly growing company
• Results-oriented, ensuring targets are met on time and on budget
• Must be highly accurate and detail-oriented
• Ability to work well in a team environment and possess an ability to adapt to change in the environment
• Demonstrated good professional judgment and reliability
• Promotes cooperation and commitment within a team to achieve goals and deliverables

LGC is a leading, global life science tools company, providing mission-critical components and solutions into high-growth application areas across the human healthcare and applied market segments. Its high-quality product portfolio is comprised of mission-critical tools for genomic analysis and for quality assurance applications, which are typically embedded and recurring within our customers’ products and workflows and are valued for their performance, quality, and range.

jobs.title: 3P Revenue Accounting & Reporting
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, 3P Revenue Accounting & Reporting to join our Accounting team. You will own revenue recognition, month-end close and reporting for Claude sold through our cloud service provider (CSP) channels: AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Azure Marketplace. These channels are among the fastest-growing revenue streams at the company. They run on consumption-based, partner-reported data that changes every month.

You will be the accounting point of contact for the finance and partner teams at AWS, Google and Microsoft. Internally, you will partner with Finance, FAB, Engineering and business teams to turn partner billing feeds into accurate, auditable revenue. You will also lead the automation of a close that is still heavily manual. If you want to build the financial infrastructure behind a fast-growing AI company, come join us in our mission to build safe, beneficial AI.

Key responsibilities

• Lead the revenue close for cloud service provider Marketplace within a listed company timeline.

• Prepare and review revenue, revenue-share, reserve journal entries, accruals and true-ups including memos for accounting assessments and judgments.

• Own balance sheet reconciliations, reserves, and the usage-to-invoice-to-cash bridge.

• Perform monthly and quarterly flux analysis and prepare flux decks for leadership.

• Own quarter-end deliverables, including footnote disclosures, flux commentary and presentations to leadership and Corporate Accounting.

• Serve as the primary contact for external auditors.

• Review the work of accountants and contractors, set the close calendar, and keep close packages complete and audit-ready.

• Own monthly and quarterly 3P revenue reporting for leadership and FP&A, by partner, model, product, region and customer.

• Review partner usage, invoice, disbursement and fraud reports each month, and resolve data issues before close.

• Serve as the accounting point of contact for the finance, engineering and product teams and drive reporting improvements that support an on-time close.

• Apply ASC 606 to 3P arrangements, including principal-vs-agent, variable consideration and reseller arrangements.

• Estimate and document reserves, including credit loss (ASC 326).

• Assess the accounting for new 3P products, programs and billing changes, partnering with Technical Accounting on complex judgments.

• Partner with the Engineering teams to automate manual close processes, including SQL-driven workbooks, automated reconciliations and system-generated journal entries.

• Own 3P SOX controls, including design, documentation, gap remediation and audit evidence.

• Partner with FP&A, Treasury, AR and business teams on forecasts, cash and partner disputes.

Minimum qualifications

• Have strong ASC 606 knowledge, especially principal-vs-agent, variable consideration, consideration payable to a customer, and consumption-based revenue.

• Have owned a month-end close with tight deadlines and reviewed journal entries, reconciliations and flux analysis.

• Have built revenue reporting from large, imperfect third-party data sets and reconciled it to the general ledger.

• Have managed external partner relationships where you depended on their data, and pushed for fixes.

• Have strong SQL skills (BigQuery or similar) and experience automating close workbooks or reconciliations.

• Have designed or operated SOX controls and supported external audits.

• Communicate clearly with accounting, finance, business and engineering teams.

• Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where processes are still being built.

Preferred qualifications

• Have 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3+ years managing revenue accounting or close teams.

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or equivalent (ACA, ACCA).

• Big 4 audit experience combined with industry experience at a high-growth tech or SaaS company.

• Experience with cloud marketplace, reseller or channel revenue (AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, Azure Marketplace).

• Experience with usage-based and subscription revenue models.

• Hands-on experience with Workday Financials, NetSuite, Numeric, Hex or similar close and reporting tools.

• Experience with IPO readiness.

• Experience using AI tools to automate accounting and reporting work.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$190,000—$230,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

You will be responsible for live Linux system triage, identity management integration (Authentik), Go/Python development, Terraform infrastructure automation, Docker builds, network/routing debugging (WireGuard, packet analysis), and deploying emerging AI/LLM tooling directly into operational workflows. • Supports capability improvements and helps implement technical strategies aligned with mission needs.

• Linux Systems & CLI Troubleshooting

• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / HCL)

• Go & Python Systems Development

• Networking & Packet Analysis (TCP/IP, Routing, WireGuard)

Nice to Haves

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. Reporting, Analytics, and Data Quality

Business Analysis and Requirements

Business Systems and Technology Solutions

User Experience and Process Improvement

Product Enhancement and Implementation Support

Documentation and Knowledge Management

• Develop standard operating procedures, job aids, process maps, data dictionaries, and knowledge resources that support consistent work and effective knowledge transfer.
• Reduce reliance on undocumented processes and single points of failure by keeping documentation accessible, current, and assigned to appropriate owners.

Data Stewardship

• Handle learner, customer, and organizational data in accordance with applicable DWI and APM requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, access, retention, and appropriate use.

Qualifications

• Experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboard development.

• Strong requirements gathering, workflow analysis, process documentation, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in workforce development, education, training, or SaaS environments.

Key Competencies

Success in This Role

Success in this role is measured by the individual’s ability to transform business needs into technology solutions, provide leadership with trusted data and insights, improve learner and customer experiences, strengthen operational efficiency, and maximize the value of DWI’s technology investments. By the end of the first year, the LMS Product & Solutions Analyst has become a trusted business systems resource, a bridge between DWI and APM IT, and a key contributor to DWI’s ability to scale and operate effectively through technology.

First-Year Success Indicators

jobs.title: Clinical Research Assistant
jobs.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

📍 Location: Portland, OR | 🏥 Site Name: Summit Research | 🕒 Full-Time | 🧪 Clinical Research

We’re seeking a Clinical Research Assistant (RA) for our clinical research site located in downtown Portland. As an RA, you won’t just be supporting research—you’ll be helping shape the future of healthcare. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals with clinical experience who are ready to grow their skillset and income potential within the clinical research field.

💼 The Role:

The Research Assistant is a vital member of the clinical research team, working under the supervision of the Site Director, Principal Investigator, and Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs). This role supports the day-to-day operations of clinical trials by ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and assisting in the smooth execution of study activities. The Research Assistant is integral in maintaining the integrity of data collection, patient care, and adherence to study protocols, contributing to advancements in clinical research.

Type:  Regular Full-time Employee
Schedule:  Mondays through Fridays, 8:00am - 5:00pm
Location:  Onsite in Portland, OR (no capabilities for remote or hybrid work)
Reports to:  Site Director
Benefits:  Our benefits package for full-time employees includes health insurance (medical, dental, and vision), Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Paid Time Off (PTO), a variety of disability, accident, and life insurance options, as well as many more.

🌟What We Offer

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Opportunities for professional development and career growth

• A mission-driven culture focused on advancing medicine and improving patient outcomes

Responsibilities:

• Study Preparation Prepare and maintain study documents, including source charts, study binders, regulatory binders, and laboratory kits. Schedule and confirm subject appointments, including ancillary visits such as diagnostic imaging and vendor-related services. Understand study protocols, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and regulatory requirements, ensuring compliance with FDA, Sponsor, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines. Assist in participant recruitment by prescreening electronic medical records, following up on referrals, and coordinating outreach efforts.

• Participant Care and Interaction Provide subject care, including explaining study procedures, answering questions, and monitoring diary compliance. Conduct study procedures, such as collecting vital signs, performing ECGs, and completing study questionnaires. Perform follow-up and reminder calls to ensure subject adherence to visits and study protocols. Assist with participant stipend tracking and processing.

• Laboratory and Specimen Handling Perform blood draws (phlebotomy) and process biological samples, including shipping per study requirements. Maintain laboratory equipment, supplies, and temperature control systems, ensuring compliance with study protocols. Generate and file weekly temperature reports for laboratory systems

• Data Entry and Management Enter and verify study data in Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), and other databases. Address system-generated queries and perform quality control checks to ensure data accuracy and completeness. Assist with case report forms (CRFs) and source document completion, including query resolution under study coordinator guidance.

• Administrative and General Support Maintain and organize participant charts, Investigator Site Files, and other regulatory documents. Support clinical research coordinators (CRCs) by filing, scanning, and faxing required documents. Clean, stock, and maintain exam rooms and department supplies to ensure readiness for participant visits. Participate in investigator meetings, study teleconferences, and trainings. Assist with onsite or remote clinical research monitor visits.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience;

• 1+ year of experience within a clinical research or healthcare environment.

• Medical Knowledge: Familiarity with medical terminology, lab procedures, and research protocols preferred.

• Attention to Detail: Ability to collect, compile, and analyze data accurately.

• Communication & Customer Service: Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.

• Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaboration & Independence: Comfortable working both independently and within a team.

• Compliance & Confidentiality: Understanding of HIPAA, FDA, GCP, and ICH guidelines (preferred).

• Research & Lab Skills: Basic computer literacy, with lab skills (e.g., blood draws, specimen processing) preferred.

• Certifications (Preferred): BLS/CPR, CNA, CMA, or similar certification.

Headlands Research will never ask a candidate for personal identifiable information (date of birth, social security number, driver’s license information, etc) via email or messenger tools, or for a financial deposit of any kind.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Lead Data Architect
jobs.description:
As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped.

This is a deeply hands-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure-primary with Databricks.

Responsibilities

Architecture Ownership and Direction

• Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups.
• Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning.
• Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re-solving solved problems.
• Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build-versus-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real-load latency.

Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture

• Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re-embedding and versioning.
• Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re-ranking; manage the recall-versus-precision and latency trade-off explicitly.
• Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers.

Generative AI Portfolio

• Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes.
• Own the AI gateway and multi-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re-tested as the landscape shifts.
• Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below.
• Hold a clear, evidence-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever.

Agentic AI Portfolio

• Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives.
• Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts.
• Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step-level tracing, regression testing, audit, and incident response.
• Define the agent registry, tool catalog, memory and state services, and lifecycle from prototype to monitored production asset, and apply agentic patterns – spec-driven development, AI-assisted code and test generation – to our own engineering practice.

Governance, Trust and Security

• Define responsible AI standards – bias/fairness testing, transparency, explainability, and human oversight on high-risk outputs – aligned with enterprise data governance policy rather than parallel to it.
• Establish AI security patterns for prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreaks, and model/supply-chain risk; partner with the Data Governance team on classification, stewardship, certified sources, and access controls – Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, Unity Catalog, row-level security, PII handling, and retention.
• Classify use cases by risk, drive attestation with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Risk, and lead third-party model/vendor technical review, translating findings into architecture constraints.

Observability, Economics and Platform Engineering

• Instrument tracing, telemetry, and drift signals from day one so agent behavior is observable before it's questioned; build cost attribution and drive cost per successful answer as a first-class metric.
• Contribute to the instrumentation that ties AI investment to measurable outcomes –partnering with platform and finance teams so unit economics are a first-class design constraint.
• Define the Azure-native platform stack and lifecycle with MLOps and Engineering – Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML, AKS, model/agent registry, CI/CD, landing-zone and environment strategy, Entra ID and network patterns, capacity, and LLMOps/AgentOps for versioning, promotion, and rollback.
• Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams on data readiness, certified metrics, lineage, and data contracts, and with Engineering on turning reference patterns into shipped services – defining the sanctioned builder environment so teams move fast without bypassing controls.

Technical Leadership

• Raise the bar across Engineering and solution architecture through design reviews, system-level reasoning, and mentorship – driving rigor without direct reporting relationships.
• Translate architecture trade-offs into clear, decision-oriented narratives for senior technology leaders and peer architects, and lead cross-team decisions with partners such as Microsoft, Databricks, strategic AI vendors, and systems integrators.
• Write architecture decision records, reference patterns, and reusable accelerators, and develop proof-of-concept reference implementations that help teams move AI solutions from concept through production without rebuilding the controls.

• Deep enterprise architecture and systems-design expertise. Proven ability to design end-to-end AI platforms spanning applications, models, data, APIs, integration, identity, infrastructure, and operations. Strong grounding in distributed systems, event-driven and service-oriented patterns, resilience, high availability, fault tolerance, and disciplined architectural decision-making.
• Strong foundations in AI, machine learning, and generative AI. Deep understanding of classical ML, deep learning, NLP, foundation models, transformers, embeddings, semantic retrieval, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodal AI, and agentic or multi-agent architectures, including when to use each approach, how to weigh the trade-offs, and where each one can fail.
• Data, retrieval, and knowledge architecture expertise. Ability to design structured and unstructured data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text-to-SQL, multi-turn dialogue).
• Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM-as-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles.
• Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply-chain risk.
• Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality-versus-performance trade-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale.
• Business and value-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs.
• End-to-end delivery with hands-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross-layer failures, and defend technical trade-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving.
• Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike.
• Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP.
• Experience in retail, restaurant, e-commerce, or supply chain with high-volume, real-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management.
• Production multi-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU-accelerated serving stacks.
• Contributions to open-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement.

Benefits:

• Paid Holidays and Vacation
• Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
• No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
• Childcare tuition discounts
• No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
• Fertility benefits
• Adoption assistance
• 401k matching contributions
• 15% off the purchase price of stock
• Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Copywriter
jobs.description:
Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. Our first product, a home equity investment, gives homeowners the opportunity to quickly access the equity they’ve built in their home to pay for what’s most important to them, from handling debt to finally making much-needed renovations, without taking on debt.

We work hard, and have some fun along the way, too. You don’t have to take our word for it: The Boston Globe and Forbes have recognized us as a great place to work, and we’ve been honored for our commitment to innovation in the fintech space by Inc., HousingWire, and more!

In case you need any more convincing, we also provide competitive compensation, healthcare coverage, generous PTO, a meaningful equity package, and a strong culture with plenty of opportunities for team-building and camaraderie.

Interested in joining us on our mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible? We’d love to talk.

Who you are

As our Senior Brand Copywriter, you will act as a creative and brand stakeholder across the organization and use language to communicate our brand story and drive new business. You’ll work closely with our Marketing, People Ops, and Legal teams to gather relevant information, and business requirements, collaborate and strengthen our brand voice, and bring creative solutions to market across paid, owned, and internal channels through content (blogs, emails, social media posts, video. etc.) and ads (social media ads, SEM, audio, video, etc).

What you'll do

• Creating compelling, strategic copy, with the goal of reaching and engaging homeowners, creating awareness, educating stakeholders, and generating leads

• The development of a broad range of materials driven by your superior writing ability across multiple platforms, use cases and personas

• Understanding and adhering to established brand guidelines and copy style guidelines; helping build and shape future iterations

• Collaborating with other creative team members to concept ideas and deliver solutions that work holistically to tell a story

• Creatively bringing to life various initiatives, while ensuring that all materials we produce are consistent with our brand

• Exploring several viable options and walking creative leaders and stakeholders through thinking to support creative decision-making

• Owning the copy (and flexing as needed) throughout the entire creative process, through design to final product

• Collaboration and information gathering across a broad range of stakeholders including marketing, design, product, legal, and underwriting

• Researching and becoming an expert in the consumer finance industry, specifically within the home equity lending and investment space

• Working cross-functionally to plan, execute and track brand marketing initiatives and campaigns

• Working in alignment with creative direction provided by the Associate Creative Director, Creative Director, or Head of Brand Marketing

What you bring

• 7-10 years experience, specifically with B2C copywriting environments, either agency or in-house

• Experience collaborating closely with art direction/design counterparts

• Experience writing copy across web, ads, product, email, video and more

• Experience utilizing AI across the creative process and applying human judgment to AI-generated outputs

• Ability to use language effectively to drive business results

• Strong presentation skills

• Strong understanding of how to work from a strategic brief

• Autonomous, ability to produce results with limited oversight

• Willingness to internalize and incorporate feedback from creative leadership and the broader marketing team

• Technical background not required, but ability to write technically

• A strong portfolio to support your work - required to be considered for this position

• Bonus Points: Experience working for a startup and/or consumer finance company

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $120,000, depending on your experience, skills, location, and other factors. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, so you can share in our growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Hometap is on a mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible. Our home equity investment product provides homeowners with a fast, simple, and straightforward way to access the equity in their home without taking out a loan or having to sell. By investing alongside homeowners, Hometap offers debt-free cash in exchange for a share of their home’s future value — all without any monthly payments over the life of the investment. Through a combination of financial innovation and best-in-class customer service, Hometap enables people to get more from homeownership so they can get more from life.

Hometap believes that our differences are what bring us together, and one of our biggest priorities is creating a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member’s unique perspective, background, and ideas. All roles here are filled based solely on candidates’ qualifications and our business needs.

Hometap is an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, pregnancy, marital, veteran, or disability status. If there is an accommodation that would support your ability to apply and interview with Hometap, please let us know by emailing work@hometap.com.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, SMB
jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our mission

Customer Success Managers help existing Zocdoc providers get more value from the platform and grow their practices. Through strategic outreach, they communicate the value of meeting with a CSM, and when running those meetings, they learn each practice’s goals, address operational challenges, and recommend ways to expand the partnership. This can include adding new providers to the platform, improving setup, or increasing the practice’s visibility. As product experts and trusted partners, CSMs help practices drive patient bookings, improve performance, and adopt features that support their growth.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

• Passionate about provider success and enjoy understanding practices’ goals and challenges to help drive feature adoption, utilization, and retention

• Energized by proactive outreach and comfortable communicating the value of a meeting, then leading conversations about ways to grow a practice’s Zocdoc partnership

jobs.title: PA Remote Mental Health Therapist
jobs.description:
Marvin provides digital behavioral health services over telemedicine to medical first responders across the United States. Our mission is to end the one-size-fits-all approach to behavioral health, designing a unique treatment plan for each client, and providing culturally-adept care that best meets their needs.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced LCSW/ LMFT/ LPC or Licensed Psychologist to work part-time with healthcare professionals. The therapist will provide psychotherapy to medical first responders via telemedicine.

Administrative Support:

 - No Cost to Therapists: Marvin is completely free for therapists to use

 - Client Acquisition: We handle the contracts with healthcare systems and ensure that clients are matched with therapists based on their insurance and location. Marvin provides a searchable platform to help clients find therapists who meet their needs

 - Integrated Scheduling: Marvin offers an Acuity account, Zoom account, Gmail account, and a HIPAA-compliant, secure electronic health record (EHR) system for service documentation. Clients can easily book appointments through the platform

 - Training: Onboarding includes training with CEUs earned upon completion, and therapists are reimbursed for their training time

 - Scheduling Control: Ability to manage your own schedule and work with clients independently to pick times that work best for you both. Marvin does not believe in double booking

 - Reimbursement: Marvin will pay you half of your session rate for no shows and late cancellations

Clinical Support:

 - Therapist Support: A dedicated success team available to assist therapists with tech issues, scheduling challenges, and client outreach, including follow-ups for no-shows or late cancellations

 - Clinical Support Team: Provides hands-on assistance with scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, and any other clinical-related issues

 - Transfer Requests: Support for client transfers, ensuring smooth transitions

 - Scholarship Program: Financial assistance for clients who face insurance lapses, high copays, or deductible challenges, ensuring they can continue their care

 - Malpractice Insurance: Coverage of up to $3 million in malpractice insurance at no cost to the therapist

 - 24/7/365 Crisis Support Line: Around-the-clock support, offering therapists peace of mind whenever it's needed. This line is staffed with Masters level licensed clinicians who have been trained in debriefing and de-escalation techniques and who can navigate your client into a higher level of care if needed

 - Continuing Education Credits: Free virtual continuing education sessions with industry-leading experts, helping therapists stay up-to-date and expand their knowledge

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Conducting individual psychotherapy over telemedicine

 - Developing therapeutic treatment plans for healthcare workers

 - Maintaining appropriate records

 - Credentialing, referrals, appointment scheduling, billing and accounting duties handled by Marvin

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum qualifications:

 - Must be a LCSW/ LMFT/ LPC or Licensed Psychologist that is licensed in the state of PA

 - Have at least two years of clinical experience treating individuals that serve in healthcare

 - Have experience working with healthcare professionals or first-responders

 - Have a desire to learn and share experience among a diverse team of both clinical and non-clinical colleagues

 - Are open to learning new skills!

Preferred qualifications:

 - Strong interpersonal skills with sensitivity to diverse communication styles and priorities

 - Experience working with telemedicine-based tools or online video communications

 - Experience in practicing with evidence-based psychotherapies such as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavioral therapy (DBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), or interpersonal psychotherapy (IPT).

 - Experience incorporating clinical diagnostic and assessment instruments (e.g., PHQ-9) to monitor client progress and treatment outcomes

   - LCSW, LMFT, LPC: $60-70/Hr

jobs.title: Design Technologist
jobs.description:
Insurance touches people during some of the most challenging moments in their lives. Hi Marley is on a mission to transform how the P&C industry communicates, making those moments faster, easier, and more empathetic for carriers and the customers they serve. We build AI-powered software that keeps everyone in the claims conversation informed and connected. If you believe insurance can combine operational excellence and automation with a human touch, we’d love to meet you.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Design Technologist to help shape the platform experiences that power Hi Marley. You’ll work with two teams, Network and Core Services, whose work sits underneath every Hi Marley product: how carriers connect with their partners and vendors, and how they set up, manage, and monitor the platform itself.

This role is for a designer first. You bring strong interaction and visual design skills, an interest in complex configuration and data-heavy interfaces, and curiosity about how things are built. Over time, we want this role to grow into front-end work, so if you already write some code or are eager to learn, we’d love to hear from you.

You won’t be shipping production front-end code. Instead, you’ll bring designs to life in our coded prototypes, with Engineering owning the production build. You’ll report to the Director of Design, work closely with Product and Engineering on both teams, and learn alongside designers who work in design and code every day.

Teamwork and shared enthusiasm are a core part of our culture, which is why this role involves joining us in the Boston office for 3 days each week.

What You’ll Do:

• Design platform features: Work with PMs and engineers to take features across Network and Core Services from problem framing through final designs, covering user flows, edge cases, and interaction states.

• Help make complex configuration feel simple: Design admin and self-configuration experiences (settings, permissions, user and organization management, rules, and routing) that help carrier admins set up and run Hi Marley with confidence.

• Design clear, data-heavy screens: Create tables, filters, logs, dashboards, and status views that help admins and internal teams understand network activity, integration health, and system behavior at a glance.

• Work in our code prototypes: Use our coded prototype environment to test ideas, explore interactions, and show engineering how a design should behave, with support from the team as your front-end skills grow.

• Contribute to our design system: Use our design system consistently, spot patterns that repeat across both teams, and help turn them into reusable, documented components.

• Collaborate across two teams: Join team rituals, share work early, explain your design choices, and learn to balancebalance scope, speed, and quality with your PM and engineering partners.

• Learn from users: Help planPlan and run usability tests with carrier admins, operations leads, and internal teams, and turn what you learn into design changes.

What We’re Looking For:

Required

• 3+ years of relevant experience in Product, UX, or Interaction Design

• A portfolio that shows strong interaction and visual design craft, a clear process, and how you thought through edge cases and states

• Proficiency in Figma and comfort working within a design system

• Interest in designing for complex workflows, such as forms, settings, permissions, or data-heavy screens

• Working knowledge of accessibility basics, including keyboard navigation, focus states, and contrast

• Clear communication, curiosity, and a habit of seeking out feedback

• A genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, paired with the judgment to apply them thoughtfully and responsibly

Nice to Have

• Some front-end experience (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or React), or a clear interest in learning it. This is where we want the role to grow over time.

• Experience prototyping in code, including with AI-assisted coding tools

• Experience designing admin consoles, configuration tools, or dashboards

• Familiarity with integrations, APIs, or developer-facing tools

• Experience with B2B SaaS, insurance, or other operations-heavy products

Compensation, Benefits & Perks:
At Hi Marley, we are committed to fair and transparent pay practices. The annual base salary for this role is expected to fall within the range of $82,600–$129,800 depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Offers are determined based on these factors as well as internal peer equity. It’s most common for new hires to start near the midpoint of the range, allowing room for growth as employees develop in their role.

In addition to base pay, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports both your wellbeing and professional growth, including:

• Equity grants for all employees

• A 4% matching 401(k) program

• Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage for employees working 30+ hours per week

• Monthly wellness stipend

• Paid parental leave

• A flexible vacation policy - we all work hard and take time when we need it

Who We Are:
At Hi Marley, our culture is built on three core values that every employee embodies:

• Max Courage – We encourage our team, our customers, and their customers to dream big, try new ideas, and maximize impact by measuring risk.

• Be Humble – We lead with appreciation and promote a culture of humility, compassion, and openness to learn from anyone, anywhere.

• Ubuntu (“I am because we are”) – We believe true success is much bigger than any single individual or company. By aligning our individual aims behind a shared purpose, we can achieve our fullest potential — together.

Life at Hi Marley:

Life at Hi Marley is shaped by collaboration, learning, and genuine connection. We’re proud to foster an environment where people can do their best work, feel supported, and grow alongside a team that celebrates both individuality and shared purpose.

• A fun, lively startup culture that embraces creativity and innovation

• Core values-based leadership that guides our decision-making and daily interactions

• A culture of engagement, diversity, inclusion, and belonging — everyone’s voice matters

• Flexible, hybrid work environment that values balance and trust

• Ample opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make an impact in a fast-growing organization

• Meaningful work that directly supports our mission to help people and organizations communicate with empathy and clarity

Hi Marley is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, race, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building an inclusive work environment representing a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, where all employees are encouraged to be their authentic selves.

• Labels sample containers and all related paperwork, documenting location of sample, date, and time of collection.
• Delivers samples to laboratory for analysis.
• Prepares samples, performs their reduction and division of appropriate sizes.
• Performs sample screening and/or other related physical tests.
• Ensures all equipment and containers are organized and cleaned before and after use.
• Ensures all personal protective equipment (PPE) relevant for tasks is worn at all times.

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

TEGNA, one of the most geographically diverse broadcasters in the U.S., is seeking an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Shared Services team. This position will be part of the TEGNA corporate team with company-wide responsibility but will be physically located at our NBC Affiliate in Indianapolis, WTHR. The Accounts Receivable Specialist will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the accounts receivable sub-ledger for assigned stations/accounts. Additionally, in collaboration with collector and stations sales, the Specialist will resolve credit balances – refund, application, or transfer. Overall, this position is responsible for a “clean” aging providing collectors accurate balances when making their collection calls.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

•    Identify balances needing adjustment and prepares online adjustment requests for routing
•    Work with station personnel to move adjustment requests through the process per policy
•    Reconcile customer receivable accounts and timely applies prepayments to invoices
•    Research and reconcile account balances and account activity per station/customer request
•    Provide account statements upon request
•    Conduct research for short pay discrepancies and resolve to proper next actions
•    Build and maintain positive relationships with station personnel and collectors
•    Provide a high standard of customer service to both internal and external customers

Requirements:

•    High School Diploma or GED
•    2 years of active experience with accounts receivable balances using an aged balance report as the primary source tool in a high-volume entry environment with responsibility for hundreds of accounts and collaborating with remote personnel
•    Knowledge of the accounting journal entry resulting from actions taken to resolve balances
•    Understanding of cash application and AR procedures and is a “numbers” person
•    Ability to quickly learn and achieve proficiency in new software applications as needed
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills including superior customer service skills
•    Professionalism and strong work ethic
•    Strong time-management and organizational skills

Preferred Qualifications:

•    Two or four-year degree
•    4 or more years of experience
•    Intermediate Excel skills – comfort exporting to Excel and manipulating results
•    Broadcast Industry experience
•    Wide Orbit Software experience

Benefits:

jobs.title: SEO Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what’s going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We’re a technology-led service with a human touch.

About the Role

As a SEO Manager, you will play a critical and dynamic role in client-facing interactions and providing crucial support to Account Managers. Your responsibilities extend beyond direct communication with clients to encompass strategic oversight of the implementation plans aimed at achieving organic ranking goals. Additionally, you will actively contribute to product revenue growth through the identification and execution of upsell opportunities, ensuring not only the achievement of client goals but also the enhancement of overall product offerings. Your role includes proactive assessments of overall Ranking performance for individual clients, addressing client concerns through reactive SEO work as needed, and ensuring a seamless onboarding experience. Reporting directly to the Director of Ranking, your position stands as an anchor in fostering success, both for Scorpion and our valued clients, emphasizing the integral nature of your contributions to broader organizational goals.

Important Application Information: This posting is reserved for a designated group of candidates who have been contacted directly and invited to apply. If you have not received an invitation, we encourage you to explore our other open positions. Thank you for your understanding and interest!

Application due date:  November 1, 2026

Internal Title:  Optimization Strategist

What Your Success Will Look Like

• Communicate directly with Account Managers and clients, addressing their questions and ensuring overall product satisfaction.

• Support Account Managers in product revenue growth through effective upselling presentations and related information.

• Provide additional reactive SEO work as required to address client concerns and optimize performance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance product offerings and client success.

• Contribute to the strategic oversight of ranking plans to drive client satisfaction and goal achievement.

Who You Are And What You Bring

• Proven experience in client-facing roles, within an SEO environment

• Strong understanding of organic ranking strategies and SEO best practices.

• Proficiency in SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, and third-party SEO platforms.

• Detail-oriented and organized, with the capacity to oversee and create complex plans on time.

• Experience with upselling and revenue growth strategies is a plus.

Our Scorpion Values

• Winning Mindset: When our clients win, we win.

• Genuine Care: We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.

• Unmatched Results: We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.

• Constant Improvement: We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask “What if?” we build and then do it again.

• Unbeatable Teamwork: We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

Compensation

We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.

• The base salary range is $65,000 (entry-level) - $80,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.

• The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

Our Benefits

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work

• Paid parental leave

• Paid cell phone and service

• Remote office allowance

• Professional development and development courses

• Regular manager check-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice

Work Location & Flexibility

Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.

[Reasonable Accommodations]

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to Scorpion. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Продавач - консултант - Mall Galleria
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

Като продавач - консултант ти ще заемаш ключова роля в създаването на изключително клиентско преживяване. Посрещайки нашите клиенти, ще им помагаш в техния избор, като същевременно ще ги запознаваш с нашите нови продукти и колекции. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Споделяш модните си познания, така че клиентите ни да изберат най-доброто за себе си.

• Работиш заедно с екипа, за да осигурите перфектно обслужване на клента, включително активно промотиране на лоялната ни програма

• Подсигуряваш етажа и складовите помещения заредени и подредени.

• Помагаш с процедурите по отварянето и затварянето на магазина.

• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.

​

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

​

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в обслужването на клиенти в сферата на търговията ще е предимство.

• Удоволствие от общуването с клиенти и интерес към модата – ние ще те научим на всичко останало!

И човек, който е…​

• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения.

• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.

• Адаптивен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

Нашите цености, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

За да успеем да обработим голямото количество кандидатури за позицията продавач-консултант, използваме онлайн метод за оценка на уменията за подбор в някои от нашите магазини. Трябва да го попълниш като част от процеса на кандидатстване и селекция. Твоите отговори ще бъдат оценени с помощта на инструмент за оценка, който прилага предварително зададени критерии от H&M Group.

За повече информация относно това как обработваме твоите лични данни, моля, виж нашето уведомление за конфиденциалност.
