jobs.title: Senior Field Service Engineer
jobs.location: North Brunswick Township, NJ, United States
jobs.description:
The Senior FSE is considered a subject matter expert in the field of Calibrations, Preventative Maintenance and Repairs and the technical authority for the calibration and certification of clean rooms, biosafety cabinets and other controlled environments. They are expected to be CETA certified, write protocols, methods and SOP’s within their field of expertise, train and direct calibrations, qualifications, and certifications, and review and approve certification work carried out by other field service personnel.

The role holds the professional credential on which the business's certification registration depends. The business will operate initially under CETA registration, and the role is accountable for building the operating record, testing hours and customer endorsements required to obtain NEBB Cleanroom Performance Testing firm certification, and for holding the NEBB certification personally on the firm's behalf.

Certification Delivery

• Perform and authenticate certification and requalification of cleanrooms and controlled environments, including:
• Airflow velocity and volume testing, unidirectional and non-unidirectional
• HEPA and ULPA filter installation leak testing by aerosol photometer or discrete particle counter scanning
• Room pressurization and pressure cascade verification
• Airflow visualization studies, including recording and interpretation
• Recovery testing and containment leak testing
• Non-viable airborne particle counting and ISO classification, including sample location determination
• Biosafety cabinet and fume hood certification to NSF/ANSI 49
• Isolator, RABS and glovebox testing, including glove integrity
• Author test methods, certification protocols and standard operating procedures for the service line, and maintain them through revision.
• Review and approve certification reports produced by other engineers and technicians.
• Investigate out-of-specification results and support customer deviation and corrective action processes
• Train and direct field service personnel carrying out clean room certifications, including technicians outside of the direct reporting line.
• Establish and maintain the business's CETA registration, and deliver all certification work to CETA standards from appointment.
• Build the record required for NEBB CPT firm certification — continuous operating history, annual cleanroom testing hours, instrument ownership, local chapter membership and endorsement letters — and manage the application.
• Obtain NEBB CPT certification personally, completing the Technician examinations and subsequently the Certified Professional examinations, so that the business can authenticate NEBB Certified Reports.
• Maintain relationships with customers and awarding authorities who may provide endorsement in support of firm certification.
• Support the evaluation and, if pursued, the technical scope of ISO 17025 accreditation for physical certification.

Team

• Establish the training and qualification pathway for certification engineers and technicians within and outside the direct reporting line.
• Train, mentor and assess engineers and technicians toward CETA and NEBB certification, and sign their competency records.

Instruments

• Specify, commission and maintain the certification instrument set, including particle counters, aerosol photometers and generators, balometers and flow hoods, thermal and vane anemometers, and micromanometers. Assist in the calibration of similar equipment used by other Eurofins businesses.
• Perform troubleshooting, preventative maintenance and repair both in the field and in the lab of various types of laboratory equipment including balances, pH meters, environmental monitoring equipment, hoods, biosafety cabinets, room HEPA filters, plate readers and chambers.
• Manage personal parts inventory effectively.
• Provide feedback to Director regarding any issue impacting service delivery, particularly issues impacting turnaround times.

Commercial and administrative

• Provide the technical basis for quotations, including room counts, classification, test scope and frequency.
• Represent the business technically to customers during scoping discussions and audits.
• Complete administrative paperwork and reports promptly and accurately.
• Follow good documentation practices (GDP) as applicable to daily activities.
• Contact customers on time and schedule service efficiently.
• Adhere to environmental health and safety guidelines.
• Effectively communicate with clients and other internal and external parties.
• Follow Eurofins work policies and all applicable SOPs. Ensure that training on both remains current.
• Maintain client confidentiality, specifically if information about the customer is obtained from sources other than the customer (e.g. complainant, assessors).
• Act impartially within the management system.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by Management.

Requirements

• Four-year degree in a related field (e.g., chemistry, analytical chemistry, electronic engineering, or similar) plus 7-10 years’ experience in a related field, preferably as a Field Service Engineer.
• SME on providing field service support for clean room certifications, hoods, biosafety cabinets, HEPA filters and other controlled environments.
• CETA certification held and in good standing, obtained or renewed within the past five years — CNBT, RCP-CT, or equivalent CETA credential appropriate to the scope of work.
• NEBB Cleanroom Performance Testing certification is an advantage, at either Certified Professional or Certified Technician level, held and in good standing. AABC certification will also be considered.
• Clear, respectful, and timely verbal and written communication. Proven ability to author protocols, methods, qualification/validation documents and SOP’s.
• Experience representing a certification firm during customer quality audits, state board of pharmacy inspections or FDA inspections is preferred.
• Demonstrable knowledge of ISO 14644 Parts 1, 2 and 3, and ISO 14644-7 where isolators, RABS and gloveboxes are within scope.
• NSF/ANSI 49 for biosafety cabinet and hood calibrations and certifications
• USP <797> and USP <800>, including state board of pharmacy certification and recertification requirements. Where this knowledge is not already held, it must be acquired within the first six months.
• Physical ability to lift and transport equipment and perform tasks in various lab environments
• Experience with technical troubleshooting and problem solving
• Must be self-motivated and proactive
• Valid drivers license
• Clean driving record
• Ability to travel within customer territory up to 5 days per week Monday-Friday. Overnight travel as needed.

Position is full-time, Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm with overtime as needed. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of North Brunswick, NJ are encouraged to apply.

Pay range: $100,000 - $130,000 annually depending on related experience and qualification.

Excellent full time benefits including

• Comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London or Austin

About the Department

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.

Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.

Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We’re looking for someone excited to deliver products so domain owners can control this experience, while identifying the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.

You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our Monetization Gateway. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around payment rails and cryptographic auth, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.

At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

What you'll do

• Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across high-throughput payment pipelines, agent authentication, and web-scale commerce architecture.

• Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.

• Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.

• Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.

• Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.

• Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.

• Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.

• Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.

• Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.

• Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

Responsibilities

We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:

• You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.

• You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or payment platforms, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.

• You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (like digital wallets, payment protocols, and web authorization) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.

• You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.

• You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.

• You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, low-latency transaction processing, API design, web security, or adjacent areas.

• Experience building or operating products involving traditional payment rails, digital wallets, or open authorization/authentication standards (e.g., OAuth, WebAuthn, Web Bot Auth).

• Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.

• A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

• Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.

• Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

Bonus Points

• Familiarity with emerging agentic/machine-to-machine payment protocols (x402, AP2, ACP, UCP).

• Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure.

• Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.

• Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.

• Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.

• Previous experience working in payments and on payments technology

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager (Versant Media)
jobs.location: Englewood Cliffs, NEW JERSEY, United States
jobs.description:
Versant is seeking a Manager, Finance Transformation to be a core member of the controllership and finance workstreams for the Company’s finance transformation agenda. Reporting to Senior Director, Finance Transformation, this role will serve as a business partner to Finance and Technology and will play a central role in the design, implementation, and adoption of next-generation finance processes, data, controls, and systems, including the Company’s ERP modernization program.

The Finance Transformation team will help translate business and reporting requirements into scalable, fit-to-standard solutions; establish governance and execution discipline across the finance transformation portfolio; and help ensure that the future-state operating model supports accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, efficient close processes, and sustainable growth as a newly independent public company.

The Manager will work closely with the Senior Director serving as a critical bridge between finance, technology, business units, and external partners, ensuring that finance requirements and strategic priorities are effectively translated into scalable processes, systems, data, and ways of working.

The ideal candidate combines finance process and controllership experience, including ERP transformation, strong program management skills, and the ability to operate and work with others in a dynamic media environment.

Finance Transformation Strategy & Program

• Core member of team leading the finance transformation roadmap and associated workstreams, aligning priorities, sequencing, operating-model decisions, and delivery plans with the Company’s strategic, financial reporting, and control objectives.
• Finance liaison to the ERP core team, O&T, system integrator, BU finance teams, and other transformation partners from design through deployment and stabilization.
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment around core design principles, fit-to-standard decisions, and the future-state finance operating model; identify and resolve cross-functional dependencies and escalations.
• Drive digital enablement, automation, AI, and continuous improvement across Finance, ensuring investments deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, controls, scalability, and business value.
• Support transformation-driven savings and efficiency targets aligned to the Company’s financial commitments.

Finance Process, Data & Systems Design

• Translate finance, accounting, reporting, and control requirements into fit-to-standard ERP process, master data, and reporting designs across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, and related finance processes.
• Participate in design workshops covering business process analysis, process reengineering, chart of accounts and code block design, organizational structures, master data, and workflows.
• Help identify opportunities to simplify and standardize and ensure business critical requirements are incorporated into the future state technology enabled processes with optimized organizational structures leveraging centralized onshore and offshore delivery centers.
• Guide data conversion, validation, reconciliation, and readiness activities across legacy and future-state environments, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and integrity of master / transactional data
• Support integration architecture decisions between the ERP and boundary systems (e.g., billing, revenue management, etc.), ensuring requirements are met across the technology landscape.
• Ensure future-state solutions accommodate Versant’s complex, multi-stream revenue models spanning advertising, subscriptions, content licensing, and ancillary revenue.

Controls, Reporting & Close Enablement

• Embed financial reporting, SOX, and internal-control requirements into process and system designs, in partnership with Corporate Controllership, Technical Accounting, Internal Audit, Risk & Compliance, and external auditors.
• Ensure future-state solutions support timely, accurate, and efficient close, account reconciliations, journal entry governance, consolidation, management reporting, and external reporting processes.
• Design sustainable documentation, test plans, control evidence, and operating procedures that enable audit readiness and effective ownership following implementation.

Delivery, Adoption & Continuous Improvement

• Act as a change agent for finance by helping teams understand the rationale for new processes and controls, adopt standard ways of working, and build long-term capability.
• Help define and monitor transformation KPIs, adoption measures, and business outcomes to ensure initiatives achieve intended objectives and enable sustained improvement.
• Support the relationship and service integration with third-party partners, ensuring alignment between operations and the future-state operating model during and after the ERP transition.
• Key Finance counterpart to the system integrator throughout the implementation lifecycle, managing scope, deliverables, and quality expectations on behalf of finance leadership.
• Partner with the Finance teams and enterprise AI governance to identify, prioritize, and adopt AI and agentic solutions within Finance processes, supporting the AI enablement roadmap.

Required Qualifications[A1]

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
• CPA, MBA, or comparable advanced finance, accounting, or technology credential preferred.
• 12+ years of progressive experience in finance transformation, controllership, finance systems, accounting operations, or related roles, including significant leadership responsibility within a large, complex organization.
• Significant experience leading enterprise ERP or finance-system transformation programs, preferably including SAP S/4HANA or another modern cloud ERP platform.
• Strong understanding of end-to-end finance processes, including Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash and master data governance.
• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, public-company reporting, internal controls, and SOX requirements, with the ability to translate those requirements into scalable process and system designs.
• Demonstrated experience with business-process redesign, data conversion and reconciliation, testing, cutover, organizational change management, and post-go-live stabilization.
• Experience working effectively with technology organizations, system integrators, and third-party implementation partners in a matrixed environment.
• Experience in media, entertainment, digital, advertising, networks, streaming, technology, or another complex, high-volume industry preferred.
• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead and develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive execution in a fast-paced environment.
• Deep analytical, organizational, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
• Experience managing BPO/managed services relationships and integrating outsourced operations into a transformed finance operating model.
• Experience applying AI, automation, analytics, or emerging technologies within Finance.

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

• Strategic, enterprise-minded leadership paired with strong execution discipline
• Deep understanding of finance and data processes, balanced with practical ERP and transformation delivery experience.
• Ability to build alignment across finance, technology, business units, and external partners while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
• A continuous improvement orientation with a passion for simplification, standardization, automation, and scalable operating models.
• High integrity, sound judgment, and commitment to financial stewardship, strong governance, and sustainable change.
• A collaborative leadership style focused on developing talent, building accountable teams, and fostering an inclusive, performance-driven culture.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Sr. Quality Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Quality Automation Engineer

About Authenticx
Authenticx is a fast-growing, venture-backed, enterprise AI company transforming healthcare through conversation intelligence. We help healthcare organizations uncover insights hidden in millions of customer interactions to improve patient, member, and business outcomes.

Role Summary
The Senior Quality Automation Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and integrating automated tests across Authenticx's healthcare conversation intelligence platform. You will translate customer workflows, product requirements, user personas, and healthcare realities into automated coverage that protects the experiences that matter most. You will own automation for critical product areas and prioritize coverage based on customer impact, product risk, release frequency, and business value.
You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to improve product quality, testability, and release confidence. We are looking for someone who brings strong technical judgment, product sense, curiosity, and ownership to quality engineering in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You'll Do
Build Automation Around Real Customer Use Cases
•    Learn how Authenticx customers use the platform across healthcare quality, coaching, compliance, operations, analytics, and customer experience workflows.
•    Translate workflows, acceptance criteria, production issues, and known risk areas into meaningful automated test scenarios.
•    Determine what should be automated, which testing layer is most appropriate, and the level of coverage needed.
•    Balance UI, API, integration, and data-level testing to create reliable and maintainable coverage.

Build and Maintain Automated Coverage
•    Design, write, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests for UI workflows, APIs, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, reporting, and AI-powered features.
•    Build and maintain smoke, regression, acceptance, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
•    Use Playwright to automate critical user journeys and product workflows.
•    Use Bruno/Postman to validate APIs, payloads, integrations, authentication, error handling, and backend behavior.
•    Use SQL to validate data accuracy, workflow integrity, processing outcomes, reporting outputs, and customer-facing analytics.
•    Build reusable automation utilities, fixtures, helpers, and test data patterns.
•    Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide earlier and more reliable quality signals.
•    Investigate flaky tests, environmental issues, timing problems, and test-data failures, and distinguish them from true product defects.
•    Identify high-risk coverage gaps and build automation to address them.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Improve Quality
•    Work with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to understand requirements, risks, and real-world usage.
•    Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, logging, test data setup, and API contracts.
•    Use logs, monitoring tools, database queries, API responses, and product data to investigate failures and validate system behavior.
•    Communicate defects, automation gaps, and release risks clearly.
•    Share automation patterns and testing practices that strengthen the broader quality engineering discipline.

Validate AI-Powered Product Experiences
•    Build automated validation for classifications, model outputs, prompt and configuration changes, structured responses, extraction workflows, and downstream behavior.
•    Develop repeatable test scenarios for deterministic and semi-deterministic AI behaviors.
•    Validate expected outputs, required fields, edge cases, failure conditions, and downstream workflow impacts.
•    Use representative test data and known expected outcomes to detect regressions.
•    Partner with Data Science and Engineering to improve the testability and regression coverage of AI-powered features.

Required Qualifications
•    5+ years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering, with hands on ownership of automated suites
•    Production level coding in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or Python
•    Playwright or equivalent modern UI automation on complex web applications
•    REST API testing (Bruno, Postman, or code based), covering authentication, payload validation, and error handling
•    SQL proficiency to validate data integrity and processing outcomes
•    CI/CD integration, including failure triage, flaky test diagnosis, and test data management
•    Ability to assess product risk and choose the right test layer (UI, API, or data) without having every case defined for you
•    Experience validating asynchronous, multi service workflows

Preferred Qualifications
•    C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, and Azure
•    Experience testing LLM or ML features using representative datasets, expected outcomes, and threshold based regression checks
•    Ingestion pipelines, event driven systems, and third party integrations
•    Healthcare, contact center, or regulated environment experience
•    AI assisted development tools for test creation and debugging

Title: Director, Quality and Reliability Engineering – AI Hardware


The Role:

d-Matrix is seeking an experienced quality and reliability leader to own product, supplier, manufacturing, and customer quality, reliability engineering, and component engineering for AI hardware platforms spanning ASIC, cards, servers, racks, and clusters. This leader is accountable for quality, reliability, field performance, and customer confidence for high-performance AI systems deployed at data center scale.

The role operates at the intersection of hardware engineering, manufacturing operations, supply chain, and customers, embedding quality and reliability into design, supplier, and manufacturing decisions. d-Matrix is already shipping first-generation Rack Scale products in volume. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity to build and lead a top-notch team to achieve world-class quality, reliability, and availability performance.


This Role Owns

 - Quality Management System (QMS) and audit readiness, aligned to ISO 9001 or equivalent

 - Product Quality and Reliability Engineering, including qualification, RDT, MTBF, ORT, and fault-tolerant design

 - Supplier Quality across ODMs, Contract Manufacturers, and component suppliers

 - Manufacturing Quality at ODM and CM sites, including process control, yield, DPPM, and shipment readiness

 - Customer Quality, including RMA, reverse logistics, failure analysis, and customer escalations

 - Component Engineering for board-level products and above, including qualification, AVL governance, and second sourcing

 - Quality metrics and executive reporting with independent reporting to leadership

jobs.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

What you'll do:

Clinical Escalations Across the Member Journey

• Own resolution of clinical escalations end-to-end: order processing and coding issues, protocol mismatches, authorization complications, facility capability gaps, and appointment-day problems

• Partner with ordering providers, imaging facilities, and payers to resolve issues quickly and keep members moving toward appointment completion

• Identify escalation patterns and drive root-cause fixes back into workflows, training, and product — so the same problem doesn't happen twice

• Serve as the escalation point for frontline teams on clinical questions that arise during scheduling, order intake, and appointment coordination

Operational Workflows, Training & Talk Tracks

• Review and continuously refine clinically-informed operational workflows across the member imaging journey to reduce friction

• Build and deliver training for internal teams on radiology fundamentals — modalities, protocols, contrast considerations, prep requirements, and site-of-care nuances

• Review and refine member- and provider-facing talk tracks that are clinically accurate, plain-language, and empathetic

Product Development

• When relevant, act as the embedded radiology SME for our product team — informing requirements, reviewing designs, and pressure-testing assumptions against real-world clinical and operational practice

• Help define what "clinically correct" looks like in product logic — from order-to-CPT mapping to appropriateness and site-of-care routing

About you:

• 5+ years of experience in radiology operations, with hands-on exposure across both health system/hospital-based imaging and outpatient/freestanding imaging center environments

• Deep working knowledge of the imaging order lifecycle: order intake, CPT/ICD-10 coding, protocoling, prior authorization, scheduling, prep and contrast requirements, and appointment completion

• Fluency across modalities (MRI, CT, PET, ultrasound, X-ray, mammography, DEXA) and their operational and clinical nuances

• Demonstrated ability to translate clinical knowledge for non-clinical audiences — you can explain protocoling to an engineer and prior auth to a new member services rep

• Strong escalation management instincts: calm under pressure, resourceful, and relentless about getting members to a resolved outcome

Startup Readiness

• Comfort operating in a fast-moving, dynamically changing environment where priorities shift and processes are still being built

• A builder's mentality — you see gaps as opportunities to create something, not blockers to progress

• Low ego, high ownership: no task is beneath you

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do

CoreWeave’s Strategic Programs and Global Expansion organization delivers the physical capacity behind The Essential Cloud for AI. Within it, the Self-Development group carries sites from acquisition through construction handoff: diligence, entitlements and permitting, pre-development design, utility coordination, and the budget, schedule, and risk controls that bring a site to construction start. The team is small, experienced, and accountable for the critical path on projects that enable CoreWeave’s compute growth.

About the Role

This role manages day-to-day execution for assigned self-development sites, partnering with the Principals who lead development strategy and key commercial decisions. You will maintain integrated schedules, track budgets and risks, coordinate internal teams and external consultants, and prepare each site for construction handoff. Principals retain accountability for investment recommendations, material budget and schedule changes, and development decisions.

• Manage integrated project delivery for assigned self-development sites from acquisition through construction handoff, coordinating internal functions and external parties against agreed milestones and dated deliverables.

• Build and maintain the integrated project schedule, including the critical path, milestone exit criteria, dependencies, and deliverables across contributing teams.

• Maintain the Owner’s Budget through handoff, including cash flow forecasting, variance reporting against approved capital, and escalation of changes requiring approval.

• Coordinate entitlement and permitting workstreams with development leads and external consultants, maintaining the permit matrix, submittal schedule, and approval dependencies, and supporting relationships with authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs).

• Coordinate diligence and closing workstreams with Legal and technical leads—including title, survey, geotechnical, and environmental reviews—tracking conditions precedent through satisfaction or approved waiver.

• Coordinate delivery across Design, Construction, Power, Legal, Environmental Health and Safety, and Corporate Affairs and Government Affairs, running site meetings and maintaining action logs with named owners and dated commitments.

• Maintain the site risk register, track mitigation actions with named owners, and escalate issues against defined thresholds.

• Prepare executive-facing status reports and maintain a consistent source of truth across project trackers, pipeline reporting, and site records.

• Coordinate pre-construction consultant scope, onboarding, statements of work, purchase orders, and invoice validation within established approval processes.

• Coordinate handoff to Construction against defined exit criteria: site control closed; permits secured or sequenced with dated approvals; budget and schedule baselined; risk register transferred with named owners; required utility agreements executed; and documentation and system access transferred.

Who You Are

• 5+ years of relevant project or program management experience in data center, mission-critical, or large-scale capital development, preferably on the owner’s side.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with local permitting and utility processes and their sequencing.

• PMP or equivalent formal project management certification.

• Experience establishing or improving project controls and reporting processes.

On our Perception team, you have the opportunity to work with world-class ML engineers and research scientists to make self-driving vehicles a reality. The Perception Platform team is central to this mission, operating at the intersection of ML Infrastructure and Perception. We build the foundational frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and tooling that enable our Perception team to scale their work on the tech stack responsible for perceiving the dynamic world around our robo-taxi.

These foundational systems include our large-scale data pipelines,  which are critical for efficient end-to-end ML development (e.g. data transformation, model training, and model evaluation) of our on-car and off-car Perception solutions. It also includes our evaluation and visualization tools, which provide intuitive insights into dataset distributions, model behavior, system performance, and edge-case scenarios. Finally, our active learning loop which continuously selects and incorporates high-value data to improve model accuracy and robustness over time.

What you’ll be doing:

• Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and career development opportunities to team members

What We’re Looking for:

jobs.title: Staff Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.



Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery—from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.



Solvd is migrating a Tier-1 US payments platform from a single AWS region to a multi-region architecture.

 
We're hiring multiple Database Engineers to implement the DynamoDB replication, failover, and operational tooling for this program. You'll work under the Principal Database Architect and partner with the client's data and SRE teams.




WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - Implement and operate cross-region replication using Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables, ensuring reliable multi-region data replication, high availability, consistency, and disaster recovery.

 - Codify everything in Terraform (or CDK).

 - Build the observability layer for replication health: lag metrics, consistency checks, alarm thresholds, and runbook automation. Datadog is the primary observability stack; CloudWatch is the baseline.

 - Author and execute failover and failback runbooks. Run game-days using AWS Fault Injection Service. Measure and report against RTO and RPO targets.

 - Implement KMS cross-account replication, IAM service principals for replication roles, and the secrets and parameter strategy for region-local dependencies.

 - Support data extraction from the monolith into microservices: build CDC pipelines (DMS, DynamoDB Streams, Kafka Connect, Debezium), validate data integrity, and own the cutover sequence for individual extractions.

 - Pair with application engineers on connection-string abstraction, retry and idempotency patterns, and graceful degradation during region failover.

 - Write design docs and runbooks the client team can take over after the engagement. 




WHAT YOU'LL BRING (REQUIRED) 

 - 8+ years in production database engineering on AWS, with hands-on responsibility for at least one of: payments, banking, brokerage, or comparable financial-services workloads.

 - Deep production experience with DynamoDB and at least two of: Aurora MySQL, Cassandra, ElastiCache (Redis or Valkey), DocumentDB, Neptune. Working knowledge of at least two more.

 - Practical experience with cross-region replication in production using DynamoDB Global Tables: you've configured and operated multi-region DynamoDB deployments and handled failure scenarios such as replication conflicts, regional outages, replication delays, and consistency or version-skew issues.

 - Strong Terraform (or CDK). You can build a multi-region module from scratch and explain the trade-offs.

 - Comfort with CDC tooling (DMS, DDB Streams, Kafka Connect, or Debezium) and the operational gotchas (schema drift, ordering guarantees, replay).

 - Linux, networking fundamentals (VPC, Transit Gateway, peering, DNS), and IAM / KMS proficiency.

 - Solid written communication and ability to operate in a regulated client environment.




NICE TO HAVE 

 - Cassandra multi-DC operations experience at scale (nodetool workflows, repair strategy, tombstone management, cross-region anti-entropy).

 - AWS MSK or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 experience for cross-region event replication.

 - Experience with Datadog Database Monitoring and custom CloudWatch metrics.

 - AWS Database Specialty or Solutions Architect Associate / Professional certifications.

When you join Solvd, you'll…

jobs.title: PSYPACT Licensed Psychologist Remote Therapist
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARVIN BEHAVIORAL HEALTH

At Marvin Behavioral Health, we deliver teletherapy designed specifically for doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals, addressing the unique challenges of their demanding work. Marvin was developed by Healthcare Leader and CEO John Bracaglia, along with a psychiatrist co-founder, both sharing a vision to build a company that gives back to the medical community.

We are a multidisciplinary team of therapists, psychiatrists, engineers, data scientists, and healthcare leaders united by one mission: reshaping mental health support for the healthcare workforce. Join our clinical team to make a lasting impact by providing therapy to those who care for others!




WHY JOIN?

As a clinician-founded company, we understand what providers need to thrive: autonomy, community, and support.

 - 100% remote work – freedom to live and work anywhere in the U.S.

 - Control your schedule – choose your hours and caseload (starting at 10-15 hours per week)

 - No-show & late-cancellation compensation – your time is valued

 - Full administrative support – we fill your caseload, manage billing, and offer real-time support from our Provider Success team

 - Client matching & crisis support  – We’ll match you with clients who fit your expertise, and they’ll have 24/7 access to Marvin’s crisis support

 - Professional perks – free CEUs, compensated onboarding, and malpractice insurance

 - Community & connection – join peer consultation groups and a supportive network of fellow clinicians

 - Mission-driven work – make an impact by supporting the mental health of healthcare professionals




YOUR ROLE

As a psychologist with Marvin, you’ll provide evidence-based virtual individual and couples therapy to adult healthcare professionals. Role details include:

 - Deliver high-quality, confidential teletherapy sessions on our HIPAA-compliant video platform to doctors, nurses and healthcare professionals

 - Use evidence-based practices such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Internal Family Systems (IFS), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), or Gottman Method

 - Complete biopsychosocial assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, and progress notes in our streamlined EHR

 - Incorporate measurement-based tools (e.g., PHQ-9, GAD-7) to monitor progress and improve outcomes




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - To be considered for this role, you must currently have ALL THREE of the following: 
   
   - Independent licensure as a Licensed Psychologist in a PSYPACT participating state
   
   - Active PSYPACT credentials allowing you to provide telehealth services across PSYPACT states
   
   - Experience and training in couples therapy
     
      (Visit our Careers Page https://www.meetmarvin.com/for-therapists for other clinical roles we’re hiring for)

 - Minimum of 2 years of post-licensure experience providing therapy to adults and couples

 - Experience providing therapy to healthcare professionals, mental healthcare workers, and/or first responders

 - Availability for 10 hours per week

 - Comfort delivering individual and couples therapy via video platforms, using EHRs, digital scheduling tools, and Google Workspace

 - Ability to incorporate assessment and measurement-based tools (i.e. PHQ-9) to monitor progress and improve treatment outcomes

 - Experience utilizing evidence-based practices such as CBT, DBT, ACT, IFS, EMDR or Gottman Method

 - Commitment to practicing cultural humility and patient-centered care

 - Passion for supporting the mental health of healthcare professionals!



COMPENSATION

We value your time and expertise. As a remote independent contractor, you’ll receive competitive hourly pay, we provide malpractice insurance, and offer free CEUs. Because your time matters, you’ll also be compensated 50% of your rate for late cancellations or no-shows.

 - Licensed PSYPACT Psychologist: $80/hr




NEXT STEP

 - Apply today to schedule an exploratory video call with one of our Talent Acquisition partners and learn more about joining Marvin!




INCLUSION & ACCESSIBILITY

Marvin Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all contractors and welcome applicants from every background.

Research shows women, people of color, and underrepresented clinicians may hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you’re passionate about our mission, we encourage you to apply — even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align.



All communication will come from an @MeetMarvin.com http://MeetMarvin.com email address. Please stay alert for potential recruitment fraud.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant – Clean Energy | Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Location: Santa Monica, Los Angeles, CA
Company: Piper Maddox | Part of LHi Group
Industry: Renewable Energy, Clean Energy & CleanTech Recruitment
Salary: $50,000 Base + $10,000 Guaranteed Commission + Uncapped Commission
Average First-Year Earnings: $70,000–$80,000+
Experience: Entry-Level | No Recruitment Experience Required
Training: 12-Week Structured Sales & Recruitment Training Program

Start Your Career in Recruitment & Sales

Looking for an entry-level sales job in Los Angeles where your ambition, work ethic, and performance can directly influence your earnings and career progression?

Piper Maddox, part of LHi Group, is hiring an Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant to join our growing team in Santa Monica, Los Angeles, California.

Whether you're a recent college graduate, have experience in sales, customer service or hospitality, or are looking to transition into a new career, this opportunity offers a pathway into specialist recruitment, business development, and professional sales.

No previous recruitment experience or university degree is required.

You'll receive comprehensive training, ongoing mentorship, and the opportunity to develop valuable commercial skills while building relationships with businesses and professionals across the renewable energy and CleanTech industries.

If you're competitive, motivated by targets, enjoy connecting with people, and want a career with uncapped earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

What Is an Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant?

Recruitment consulting is a fast-paced, people-focused career combining sales, business development, talent acquisition, and relationship management.

As an Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant, you'll connect companies looking to hire specialist professionals with candidates exploring their next career opportunity.

You'll learn how to identify new business opportunities, build client relationships, source candidates, negotiate offers, and manage the recruitment process from start to finish.

This is a commercial, sales-driven recruitment position, not an internal HR or administrative recruiting role.

From day one, you'll receive structured training and hands-on coaching from experienced recruitment consultants. As your skills develop, you'll gradually take ownership of your own clients, candidates, and recruitment processes.

Your success will create opportunities to increase your earnings, develop specialist market expertise, and progress into senior recruitment or leadership positions.

Why Piper Maddox? Renewable Energy & CleanTech Recruitment

Piper Maddox is a specialist recruitment business operating across the global Clean Energy, Renewable Energy, and Clean Technology industries.

We partner with organizations developing technologies, delivering energy projects, and building the teams needed to transform how energy is generated, stored, distributed, and used.

Our specialist recruitment markets include:

• Renewable Energy
• Solar and Wind Energy
• Energy Storage and Battery Technology
• Electric Mobility (eMobility)
• Nuclear Power
• Energy Trading
• Clean Technology and Energy Innovation

As a Renewable Energy Recruitment Consultant, you'll develop an understanding of the energy industry while building professional relationships with companies and candidates working in these evolving markets.

You'll become knowledgeable about specialist talent markets, hiring challenges, emerging technologies, and commercial opportunities across the energy sector.

No previous energy industry experience is required. We'll provide the specialist industry knowledge and recruitment training you need.

Why Join LHi Group?

Piper Maddox is part of LHi Group, a global, 100% employee-owned specialist talent solutions business.

Joining Piper Maddox means benefiting from the entrepreneurial environment and specialist expertise of a dedicated recruitment brand, supported by LHi Group's international resources, training, and career development opportunities.

Here's what makes LHi Group different:

• 100% Employee-Owned Business: Be part of a company where employees have a stake in its long-term success.
• Learning & Development: Receive structured recruitment and sales training, continuous coaching, and professional development.
• Merit-Based Career Progression: Develop your career through performance, skill development, and ambition.
• International Career Opportunities: With offices across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe, opportunities for international career development may be available.
• Specialist Recruitment Expertise: Build a professional network and develop expertise within a dedicated recruitment market.
• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside ambitious colleagues in an environment that recognizes performance, celebrates success, and encourages professional growth.

Salary, Commission & Benefits – Los Angeles

We offer a competitive compensation package, uncapped earning potential, comprehensive benefits, and a structured training program designed to help you succeed.

Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission

• $50,000 annual base salary
• $10,000 guaranteed commission during training, paid biweekly
• Uncapped performance-based commission
• Average first-year total earnings of $70,000–$80,000+, including base salary and commission
• Opportunities to increase earnings as your sales performance and recruitment experience develop

Generous Paid Time Off

• 20+ days of paid time off
• 13 company holidays including your birthday off
• 5 sick days
• 2 Mind & Body Days
• 1 volunteering day
• Summer Fridays

Comprehensive Employee Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) retirement plan with company match
• Commuter benefits
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee ownership opportunities, including eligibility for shareholder equity after 12 months

Recruitment Training & Career Development

• Structured 12-week sales and recruitment training program
• Ongoing one-on-one coaching from your manager
• Hands-on business development and sales training
• Specialist renewable energy market training
• Clear career progression opportunities
• Opportunities to develop into senior recruitment and leadership positions

Team Culture, Rewards & Incentives

• Weekly sales incentives and performance recognition
• Summer and holiday parties
• Monthly promotion lunches
• Breakfast clubs and quarterly lunch clubs
• Opportunities to earn up to two international incentive trips per year
• Employee-led equity, diversity, and inclusion initiatives
• Long-service rewards, including additional paid time off, international office trips, sabbatical opportunities, and luxury rewards

What You'll Do as a Recruitment Consultant

As an Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant in Los Angeles, you'll develop the skills to manage a full recruitment process while building relationships with clients and candidates across the renewable energy and CleanTech sectors.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Sales & Business Development: Identify prospective clients, generate new business opportunities, and develop relationships with organizations hiring specialist talent.
• Lead Generation & Prospecting: Use cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, and other sales strategies to connect with prospective clients and candidates.
• Candidate Sourcing: Identify, attract, screen, and interview professionals for specialist opportunities within renewable energy and clean technology.
• Client Relationship Management: Understand client hiring requirements, provide recruitment solutions, and develop long-term business relationships.
• Recruitment Process Management: Coordinate interviews, manage candidate feedback, support offer negotiations, and guide clients and candidates through the hiring process.
• Sales Targets & KPIs: Work toward daily, weekly, and monthly activity targets, sales goals, and revenue objectives.
• Salary & Contract Negotiation: Support discussions between clients and candidates to secure successful placements.
• Market Research: Develop expertise in renewable energy, CleanTech, and specialist talent markets through industry research, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
• Account Management: Maintain relationships with existing clients and identify opportunities to expand recruitment partnerships.
• Consultative Selling: Learn how to understand client challenges, communicate value, and provide tailored recruitment solutions.

You'll receive ongoing support as you learn, with increasing responsibility as your confidence, commercial skills, and experience develop.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for ambitious, motivated, and commercially minded individuals who want to build a successful career in recruitment, sales, and business development.

You don't need previous recruitment experience to apply.

You could be a great fit if you're:

• Sales-Driven: Motivated by goals, competition, financial rewards, and measurable results.
• Ambitious: Looking for a long-term career with opportunities to increase your earnings and progress professionally.
• Confident Communicator: Comfortable speaking with new people, building relationships, and developing your communication skills.
• Resilient: Able to stay motivated, learn from setbacks, and work toward challenging targets.
• Proactive: Willing to take initiative, learn new skills, and step outside your comfort zone.
• Relationship-Focused: Enjoy connecting with people and developing professional relationships.
• Coachable: Open to feedback, training, and continuous improvement.
• Team-Oriented: Bring a positive attitude and embody LHi Group's Good Human ethos, contributing to a supportive and collaborative workplace.
• Interested in Clean Energy: Excited by the opportunity to develop knowledge of renewable energy, CleanTech, and emerging energy technologies.

Previous Experience That Could Be Relevant

Experience in any of the following areas may be beneficial, but is not required:

• Sales or business development
• Customer service
• Hospitality or retail
• Account management
• Marketing or lead generation
• Recruiting or talent acquisition
• Other customer-facing or target-driven roles

Recent graduates, career changers, and candidates without a university degree are encouraged to apply.

We hire for potential, attitude, ambition, and willingness to learn.

Entry-Level Recruitment Training & Career Progression

We don't expect you to know everything about recruitment when you join Piper Maddox.

Our 12-week structured training program is designed to introduce you to the fundamentals of recruitment consulting, professional sales, and business development.

Your training will cover:

• Recruitment fundamentals and the end-to-end recruitment process
• Sales prospecting and lead generation
• Cold calling and client outreach
• Business development and consultative selling
• Candidate sourcing, screening, and interviewing
• Client relationship and account management
• Salary negotiations and closing techniques
• Market mapping and industry research
• Professional networking and personal branding
• Renewable energy and CleanTech market knowledge

You'll also receive ongoing desk-based coaching, regular feedback, and support from experienced consultants and managers.

Recruitment Consultant Career Path

As you develop your skills and deliver results, you'll have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and progress your career.

Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant → Recruitment Consultant → Senior Recruitment Consultant → Principal Consultant or Team Leader

Further progression opportunities may include senior individual contributor positions, team management, and leadership roles, depending on your performance, development, and career ambitions.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I Need Recruitment Experience to Apply?

No. This is an entry-level recruitment position, and previous recruiting experience is not required.

You'll receive structured training, ongoing mentorship, and practical experience to help you build the skills needed to succeed.

Do I Need a College Degree?

No. A university degree is not required.

We welcome recent graduates, experienced professionals changing careers, and individuals who have developed relevant skills through employment or other experiences.

Is Recruitment Consulting a Sales Job?

Yes. Recruitment consulting is a commercially focused career combining sales, business development, relationship building, and talent acquisition.

You'll generate new business opportunities, develop client relationships, recruit specialist professionals, and earn commission through successful placements.

How Much Does an Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant Earn in Los Angeles?

This position offers a $50,000 annual base salary plus $10,000 in guaranteed commission during training, paid biweekly.

You'll also have the opportunity to earn uncapped performance-based commission.

Average first-year total earnings are $70,000–$80,000+, including base salary and commission. Actual earnings depend on individual performance.

Do I Need Renewable Energy Industry Experience?

No. Previous renewable energy or CleanTech experience is not required.

You'll receive training to help you understand your specialist market, develop industry knowledge, and build relationships with companies and professionals across the energy sector.

Where Is the Job Located?

This position is based in Santa Monica, Los Angeles, California, within Piper Maddox's Los Angeles team.

Apply Today – Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant Jobs in Los Angeles

Ready to start a career where your ambition, work ethic, and performance can directly influence your success?

Join Piper Maddox, part of LHi Group, and build a career in recruitment, sales, and business development while developing specialist expertise in renewable energy and CleanTech.

Whether you're a recent graduate, transitioning from a customer-facing role, or exploring a new professional direction, we want to hear from you.

Apply today for our Entry-Level Recruitment Consultant position in Santa Monica, Los Angeles, CA.

LHi Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a key position to support our employees throughout the business or functions that they support and will bring an energetic, diligent and empathetic mindset. The HRBP is responsible (with the support of management) for the implementation and coordination of the organization’s human resource strategies in their scope of responsibilities. The HRBP anticipates, manages and delivers services to our employees in the areas of recruitment, training and development, performance management, employee relations, compliance, and employee recognition. All HRBP works in collaboration with our HR Center of Excellence (Talent Management, HR Operations, Total Rewards, DE&I and other HR Partners to deliver exceptional customer service to the business.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Serves as the HR subject matter expert to managers and employees and establishes HR as a credible and trustworthy resource.
• Collaborate closely with leaders to understand their goals, challenges, and workforce needs. Provide strategic counsel and recommendations on HR initiatives that support the achievement of business objectives.
• Ensures HR is providing customer-oriented service to the business including talent management and organizational effectiveness, supports onboarding, employee relations, conflict management, termination, etc.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on employee relations matters, including policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and performance management. Provide guidance and coaching to managers on handling complex employee relations issues.
• Ensure compliance with labor laws, regulations, and company policies. Identify and mitigate potential risks related to HR practices, and implement proactive measures to address them.
• Fosters a positive, diverse and inclusive culture through education, communication, and initiatives. Facilitates performance management through coaching, systems and processes.
• Develops and coordinates learning and development plans to transfer knowledge and provide career growth.
• Conducts investigations of workplace policy violations and mediates difficult employee relations issues.
• Facilitate change management processes, and support the implementation of organizational restructuring or transformation initiatives.
• Analyze HR data and metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
• Participate in all other Human Resources activities with the HR Leadership team.
• Other duties as assigned by management.

Work Environment:

• As a hybrid role, this position can be based out of the Veolia’s office.
• Typical office environment including heavy computer usage and sitting for long periods of time.
• A fast-paced, varied environment is expected with this position.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline required.
• 6+ years related work experience required with a min of 3 years in strategic HR experience supporting a multi-state matrix organization preferred.
• Experience providing HR support to executive clients required.
• General knowledge of varying types of Health and Welfare plans.
• Human Resources Information System (“HRIS”) or other related mainframe systems. ADP/Success Factor experience strongly preferred but not limited to.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Demonstrated understanding of effective human resource management and support for business.
• Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal and presentation communication skills.
• Accountable and responsive to employee requests.
• Must demonstrate effective oral communication skills with good vocabulary, good grammar and a passion for excellence in customer service.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate with all levels of personnel, as well as external suppliers and organizations.
• Ability to execute tasks independently. Ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive data.
• Excellent organization and time management skills to handle multiple tasks in an environment with large volumes of data and paperwork.
• Significant attention to detail required.
• Must demonstrate ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
• Excellent proficiency in document and spreadsheet processing (utilizing Google Suite).
• Ability to develop spreadsheets and modify formats in order to complete assignments and ability to recommend improvements.

Pay Range: $110,000 to $130,000 Per Year.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Job title: Territory Account Executive, Philadelphia, PA

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

• Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.

• Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

• Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.

• Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.

• Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

• Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.

• Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

• Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.

• Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

• Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.

• Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.

• Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

• 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience

• Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals

• Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)

• Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving

• A collaborative and team player mentality

• Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent

• Even better:

• 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)

• 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)
