jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Senior SSO Architect & Team Lead to direct our Single Sign-On engineering squad and serve as the technical authority for enterprise authentication. In this role, you will maintain high availability for our core Ping federation environment, lead our active migration to PingOne Workforce Cloud, and partner across architecture and security teams to build a modern, Zero Trust authentication ecosystem for 70,000+ corporate and clinical teammates across the Village.

Key Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership & Architecture Governance

• Squad Leadership: Lead, mentor, and technically direct the SSO engineering squad in an Agile/Scrum framework, fostering engineering excellence and operational rigor.
• Architecture Alignment: Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture and Security Architects to align SSO roadmaps with enterprise blueprints and represent SSO on Architecture Review Boards (ARB).
• Authorization Modernization: Collaborate with adjacent IAM teams evaluating PingAuthorize and modern IDM/IGA solutions to replace legacy authorization systems (Oracle Entitlement Server / OES).
• Microsoft Ecosystem Collaboration: Partner with the Microsoft/M365 team to ensure seamless federation, PRT evaluation, Conditional Access handoffs, and a cohesive user experience.

2. Operational Reliability & Current Environment

• Tier-0 High Availability: Maintain 24x7 operational reliability and high availability (99.99%+) for enterprise federation infrastructure, including PingFederate, PingDirectory, and PingID.
• Workforce & CIAM Integrations: Manage integrations for PingOne Customer (CIAM) and support enterprise workforce authentication across dedicated endpoints, shared clinical kiosks, and Citrix VDI.
• Application Federation: Onboard and support core clinical applications (CWOW, HWOW, PATH, Epic, Cerner) and enterprise SaaS platforms using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
• Certificate & Key Lifecycle: Standardize and automate cryptographic certificate management, token signing, and encryption keys to eliminate unplanned outages.

3. Modernization & Future Architecture

• Cloud Workforce Migration: Lead the active migration of workforce authentication to PingOne Workforce Cloud and drive cloud-native identity modernization.
• Standards Enforcement: Champion and enforce Client SSO Enterprise Standards ('Configuration over Customization'), establishing strict governance for application onboarding and exception reviews.
• Legacy Grant Deprecation: Deprecate legacy authentication methods and eliminate insecure grants (e.g., migrating applications off Resource Owner Password Credentials / ROPC to OAuth 2.0 Auth Code with PKCE).
• Identity Orchestration (DaVinci): Architect dynamic identity orchestration workflows and user journeys using PingOne DaVinci, integrating adaptive MFA (PingOne Protect), risk signals, and passwordless authentication (FIDO2, WebAuthn).
• GCP Cloud DevOps: Drive GCP DevOps automation for identity services, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments on Google Cloud (GKE).
• Future Cloud IdP Readiness: Maintain architectural readiness for potential future adoption of cloud identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID.
• Developer Experience: Streamline developer onboarding through self-service tools, dynamic JWKS key discovery, and CI/CD automation.

• Total Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM) and enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) engineering.
• Technical Leadership: 2+ years of experience leading engineering squads, mentoring developers, and partnering with Enterprise Architecture and Security Architecture groups.
• Enterprise Scale: Proven track record supporting high-availability, mission-critical environments (healthcare and HIPAA compliance experience preferred).

Technical Competencies

• Ping Identity & DaVinci Orchestration: Deep expertise in PingFederate, PingID, PingDirectory, PingCentral, PingOne Workforce Cloud, PingOne Customer (CIAM), and strong hands-on skills in PingOne DaVinci for identity orchestration and flow design. (Note: PingAccess is not used in this environment).
• Authorization & Identity Modernization: Solid understanding of fine-grained authorization (ABAC/PBAC) and how modern externalized authorization platforms (e.g., PingAuthorize) integrate with SSO to replace legacy policy engines (OES).
• Federation Protocols & Standards: Expert mastery of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and SCIM; deep knowledge of modern grant flows (Auth Code + PKCE, Token Exchange) and legacy grant remediation.
• Microsoft Federation & Cloud Identity: Strong familiarity with Microsoft 365 federation, Hybrid Identity, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) concepts (Conditional Access, Intune, PRT) to optimize user login flows and assess future cloud IdP opportunities.
• Endpoints & Session Controls: Experience designing session policies, Single Logout (SLO), and MFA rules for corporate laptops, shared clinical workstations, and Citrix VDI.
• GCP & Cloud DevOps: Strong hands-on DevOps expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes (GKE), Docker, CI/CD pipeline automation (Jenkins/GitLab CI), REST APIs, and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).

Core Soft Skills

• Strategic Problem Solver: Balances rigorous security controls with frictionless clinical and teammate user workflows.
• Collaborative Communicator: Effectively translates enterprise architectural blueprints into technical implementations and communicates clearly across all levels.
• Team Coach: Dedicated to developing engineering talent and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Preferred Certifications

• Ping Identity Certified Professional / Architect (PingFederate / PingOne)
• Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) / Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
• Google Cloud Certified: Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer / Cloud Security Engineer
• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
• Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM)

Discover some of the global benefits that empower our people to become the best version of themselves:

• Finance: Competitive salary package, share plan, company performance bonuses, value-based recognition awards, referral bonus;
• Career Development: Career coaching, global career opportunities, non-linear career paths, internal development programmes for management and technical leadership;
• Learning Opportunities: Complex projects, rotations, internal tech communities, training, certifications, coaching, online learning platforms subscriptions, pass-it-on sessions, workshops, conferences;

jobs.description:

• Mandatory Saturday and Sunday starting at 8:30 am
• Perform animal restraint using safe and low-stress techniques while maintaining composure in dynamic situations
• Conduct triage of incoming patients and assess their medical needs with attention to detail
• Collect, prepare, and analyze laboratory samples, including blood, urine, fecal, and skin specimens

• Prepare surgical sites and provide skilled assistance during surgical procedures
• Administer anesthesia and monitor patients throughout anesthetic procedures with precision

• Communicate treatment plans and medical updates to clients in a clear and empathetic manner
• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of veterinary procedures, preventative care protocols, and hospital operations
• Support the veterinary team in delivering efficient, high-quality patient care in a fast-paced environment
• Demonstrate commitment to professional ethics, animal welfare, and continuous professional development

Minimum 2+ years of professional veterinary technician experience (preferred)

• Demonstrated expertise in safe animal restraint techniques and low-stress handling methods
• Proficiency in collecting and analyzing various laboratory samples
• Experience with radiographic positioning and diagnostic imaging procedures
• Competency in anesthesia administration and surgical monitoring
• Strong client communication and medical record management skills
• Comprehensive knowledge of veterinary procedures, preventative care, and hospital operations

• Physical stamina and ability to work in a fast-paced environment with exposure to animal-related hazards, including bites, scratches, animal waste, and potentially contagious diseases

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively with veterinarians and team members
• Resilience and stress management capabilities in high-pressure situations
• Unwavering commitment to professional ethics, animal welfare, and continuous learning

jobs.description:
The Health Unit Coordinator reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Performs unit-based reception, clerical, medical record and patient registration functions. Is capable of setting priorities and handling emergency situations in a calm manner. Is customer oriented and able to communicate with all levels of staff and patients and their families. Serves as liaison between patient care units and all other patient related departments. Manages the overall unit workflow in concert with the charge RN and/or assistant manager.

Responsibilities:

• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers.
• Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so.
• Provides directions or help to patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments.
• Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Communicates effectively and works cooperatively with other team members.
• Has respect for and understanding of other disciplines.
• Coordinates all work with the Manager and Charge Nurse.
• Communicates appropriately and clearly to Manager, Charge Nurse, co-workers and physicians.
• Consults other departments as appropriate to provide for an interdisciplinary approach to the patient's needs.
• Retrieves all lab results from computer and bring results to the attention of the nurse caring for the patient.
• Interacts professionally with patients/family and provides explanations and verbal reassurance as necessary.

• Demonstrates the ability to be flexible, organized and function under stressful situations.
• Demonstrates confidence and success with multiple, high level, time sensitive tasks.
• Answers telephone, monitors unit closed circuit camera, and intercom/door entry system in a polite manner and communicates information to the appropriate staff/family.
• Utilizes critical thinking skills to successfully demonstrate the ability to prioritize and complete unit work quickly as the needs of the unit, patients, and staff change.
• Monitors patient's type in the computer against actual status and makes corrections when necessary.
• Performs pre-census and validates daily admission, discharge and census lists.

jobs.title: Area Equipment & Fleet Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The SouthArea Equipment & Fleet Manager is responsible for overseeing the management, utilization, accountability, maintenance, compliance, and operational readiness of company-owned equipment and fleet assets across the Southeast Area under the direct leadership of the Southeast Regional Equipment & Fleet Maintenance Manager, and the National Equipment & Fleet Manager. This position serves as the primary equipment and fleet liaison between area operations, field supervision, regional leadership, maintenance partners, procurement, and yard personnel to ensure assets are available, safe, compliant, cost-effective, and properly tracked throughout their lifecycle.

The South Area Equipment & Fleet Manager is accountable for maximizing fleet and equipment utilization, minimizing downtime and unnecessary rental spend, ensuring asset readiness, supporting project teams, and driving process improvements that improve operational efficiency, safety performance, and financial results across the Southeast Area.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment & Fleet Asset Management

• Manage company-owned equipment, leased, and rented equipment & fleet assets assigned to the Southeast Area.

• Monitor asset utilization, availability, redeployment opportunities, and fleet readiness across active projects, yards, and support locations.

• Ensure equipment and fleet inventory accuracy across jobsites, service locations, and staging yards.

• Conduct periodic asset audits, inspections, and reconciliation activities.

• Implement tracking, assignment, and accountability procedures for equipment and fleet assets.

• Maintain accurate records within company equipment, fleet, telematics, and asset management systems.

Equipment Planning & Operational Support

• Partner with South Area Operations, Project Management, and Field Leadership to forecast equipment and fleet needs.

• Coordinate equipment transfers, assignments, returns, and redeployments between projects, yards, and regions.

• Ensure project sites receive required equipment and fleet support on schedule.

• Support project mobilization and demobilization efforts for equipment and fleet resources.

• Identify shortages, downtime risks, and utilization gaps, and proactively source internal or rental solutions when needed.

Maintenance & Compliance

• Develop and oversee preventative maintenance programs for South Area equipment and fleet assets under the direction of the Regional Equipment & Fleet Maintenance Manager.

• Coordinate repairs, inspections, service scheduling, and vendor support with maintenance personnel and approved service providers.

• Ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, manufacturer recommendations, company standards, and customer/site requirements.

• Maintain inspection records, maintenance history, registration, certification, and compliance documentation.

• Remove unsafe, non-compliant, or unreliable equipment and fleet assets from service until corrected.

Financial Management

• Manage South Area equipment and fleet operating budgets under the direction of the Regional Equipment & Fleet Maintenance Manager.

• Monitor repair costs, maintenance spend, rental expense, replacement expenditures, and utilization metrics.

• Identify opportunities to reduce rental spend through internal asset optimization and disciplined redeployment.

• Support annual capital planning, disposal planning, and replacement forecasting for equipment and fleet assets.

• Assist with equipment acquisition, standardization, and lifecycle recommendations.

Yard, Inventory & Asset Control

• Oversee South Area equipment yards, staging areas, and regional storage locations related to equipment and fleet assets.

• Establish asset control procedures and best practices for equipment check-out, return, staging, inspection, and transfer.

• Monitor fleet support items, attachments, and critical equipment-related inventory needed to maintain operational readiness.

• Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, and Maintenance to maintain appropriate support levels for assigned equipment and fleet assets.

• Reduce asset loss, misuse, damage, and avoidable downtime through improved controls and field accountability.

Team Leadership

• Supervise Equipment Coordinators, Fleet Coordinators, area base mechanics, yard Personnel, or other assigned equipment and fleet support staff.

• Provide coaching, performance management, and development opportunities.

• Develop standard operating procedures and process documentation for Southeast Area equipment and fleet practices.

• Foster a culture of accountability, safety, responsiveness, and customer service to operations.

Technology & Reporting

• Utilize fleet management, asset management, and telematics platforms to monitor utilization, condition, maintenance status, and operating performance.

• Generate utilization, maintenance, downtime, inventory, compliance, and financial reports for Southeast Area leadership.

• Analyze trends and make recommendations for continuous improvement, cost control, and asset reliability.

• Support implementation of new technology, telematics, and tracking solutions for equipment and fleet assets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The South Area Equipment & Fleet Manager will be measured on:

• Equipment and fleet utilization rates

• Asset inventory accuracy

• Equipment readiness, reliability, and uptime

• Downtime reduction and service turnaround performance

• Rental expense reduction

• Preventative maintenance compliance

• Budget performance

• Fleet and equipment audit results

• Customer satisfaction from operations teams

• Safety, DOT, OSHA, and company compliance metrics

Minimum Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Construction Management, Equipment Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field preferred.

• Or Equivalent industry experience may substitute for formal education.

Experience

• 5+ years of equipment, fleet, maintenance, logistics, asset management, or field operations support experience.

• 2+ years of leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

• Experience supporting construction, industrial, energy, utility, infrastructure, heavy equipment, or fleet-intensive operations.

• Proficiency with equipment/fleet management software, telematics systems, and reporting tools.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong understanding of equipment and fleet lifecycle management.

• Knowledge of preventative maintenance, repair coordination, asset utilization, fleet compliance, and equipment readiness practices.

• Knowledge of OSHA, DOT, and equipment safety requirements.

• Strong analytical and financial acumen.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities across a multi-state Southeast Area operating environment.

• Advanced Microsoft Office, reporting, and data analysis capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Equipment Manager (CEM)

• Certified Fleet Manager (CFM)

• Lean or Continuous Improvement training

• Experience with telematics systems

• Experience with ERP, fleet management, or asset management systems such as SAP, Oracle, Viewpoint, or similar platforms

• Multi-site or multi-state Southeast operational experience

Physical Requirements

• Ability to visit active construction and industrial jobsites.

• Ability to walk uneven terrain and inspect equipment.

• Occasional lifting up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to travel throughout assigned territory.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Talent Development Manager (Learning& Leadership Development)
jobs.description:
The Talent Development Manager will help build the leadership, management, and organizational capabilities required for Acumatica to scale successfully.

This role translates business strategy, talent priorities, and organizational capability needs into practical, engaging, and scalable development experiences, content, tools, and resources. The Talent Development Manager will design and deliver solutions for people managers, employees, and HR Business Partners, with particular focus on the critical capabilities identified by the organization.

The role will connect learning and development to leadership expectations, career growth, and broader talent priorities through a thoughtful combination of experiences, exposures, education, practical tools, and on-the-job application.

A key part of the role is creating leverage. Rather than personally delivering every development experience, this individual will build resources, facilitator materials, and train-the-trainer solutions that equip HR Business Partners and leaders to reinforce and cascade learning throughout the organization.

The role will also create and maintain centralized leader and employee toolkits that make expectations, key organizational messages, resources, and practices easy to understand and apply. This supports Acumatica’s goal of scaling while preserving and strengthening the culture and ways of working that make the company distinctive.

This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring someone who can move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution, from designing a leadership-development program or facilitating a workshop to building an intuitive SharePoint resource center.

Key Responsibilities:

Learning & Capability Development

• Translate business strategy, HR and talent priorities, employee insights, and identified capability gaps into focused development priorities and solutions.

• Design and develop learning experiences focused on leadership effectiveness, manager effectiveness, professional capabilities, and other priority organizational needs.

• Create development pathways that combine facilitated learning, self-directed education, practical tools, developmental experiences and exposures, on-the-job application, and reinforcement.

• Connect development experiences, exposures, education, and resources to career profiles, capability expectations, and broader talent priorities, helping employees and managers make development more intentional and relevant to career growth.

• Develop high-quality workshops, presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, job aids, playbooks, and digital learning content.

• Facilitate leadership, manager, employee, and HR development sessions as appropriate.

• Curate external and internal learning resources to complement internally developed content.

Leadership & Manager Enablement

• Build scalable development experiences that strengthen leadership and people-manager effectiveness.

• Translate leadership expectations into practical behaviors, tools, learning experiences, and resources that leaders can apply in their day-to-day work.

• Develop leader toolkits and playbooks covering critical leadership and management practices such as goal setting, feedback, 1:1s, career conversations, communication, accountability, and team leadership.

• Partner with the Director of Talent & Organizational Capability and HR Business Partners to identify emerging leadership and management capability needs.

• Create reinforcement mechanisms that help move development from one-time training to sustained behavior and organizational practice.

• Equip managers to support employee growth through effective development planning, career conversations, feedback, coaching, and identification of meaningful development opportunities.

HRBP Enablement & Train-the-Trainer

• Develop train-the-trainer approaches that enable HR Business Partners to facilitate and reinforce learning within the businesses they support.

• Prepare HRBPs with facilitator guides, discussion materials, tools, talking points, FAQs, and supporting resources.

• Facilitate enablement sessions and practice opportunities that build HRBP capability and confidence in facilitating and reinforcing development experiences.

• Establish consistent standards while allowing appropriate adaptation for different functions, geographies, and audiences.

• Gather feedback from HRBPs and participants and use it to continuously improve content and delivery.

Leader Toolkits & Organizational Enablement

• Translate business and HR priorities, leadership expectations, cultural principles, and key people practices into clear, practical resources and experiences for leaders and employees.

• Develop scalable leader communication and enablement toolkits that provide consistent messages while enabling leaders to make them relevant to their teams.

• Create resources that help leaders reinforce the company's vision, culture, ways of working, and leadership expectations as the organization grows.

• Partner across HR and with internal stakeholders to ensure leader resources are accurate, coordinated, timely, and easy to use.

• Help create a consistent employee and manager experience without creating unnecessary process or bureaucracy.

Digital Learning & Knowledge Experience

• Build and maintain user-friendly SharePoint sites and digital resource hubs for learning, leadership, and manager enablement.

• Organize learning content and leader resources so employees and managers can quickly find what they need.

• Apply strong information architecture, navigation, content management, and user-experience principles to digital resources.

• Publish and maintain content, ensuring information remains current, accessible, consistent, and easy to navigate.

• Experiment with new digital and AI-enabled approaches to content creation, learning, knowledge sharing, and employee enablement.

• Partner with appropriate technology stakeholders when more advanced technical solutions are required.

Program Management, Measurement & Continuous Improvement

• Manage multiple learning and capability initiatives from concept through design, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

• Establish clear objectives and success measures for key development initiatives.

• Track participation, experience, adoption, application, and other relevant indicators to understand effectiveness.

• Use employee feedback, leader input, talent insights, and program data to continuously improve solutions.

• Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to capability-building initiatives that may begin with ambiguous business requirements.

• 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Leadership Development, Organizational Development, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience designing leadership, manager, or professional development programs from discovery through implementation.

• Strong learning-design and content-development capability, with the ability to turn complex business, organizational, and talent concepts into practical, compelling development experiences.

• Strong facilitation and presentation skills across employee, manager, leader, and HR audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to create professional learning materials, toolkits, playbooks, facilitator guides, presentations, and digital resources.

• Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or enabling others to deliver learning solutions.

• Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• Strong consulting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to operate independently and successfully navigate ambiguity.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including SharePoint, with demonstrated ability to create, structure, publish, and maintain intuitive digital content experiences.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Learning, Business, Organizational Psychology, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in a global, high-growth technology or SaaS organization.

• Experience working with HR Business Partners as a delivery or enablement channel.

• Experience translating competency or capability frameworks, leadership models, career profiles, talent insights, or organizational-culture priorities into practical development solutions.

• Experience creating SharePoint learning portals, knowledge hubs, or manager resource centers.

• Exposure to learning-management platforms, digital authoring tools, video/content development, or AI-enabled learning tools.

• Experience measuring learning effectiveness and translating insights into program improvements.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will ultimately be reflected in:

• Priority leadership and manager capability programs delivered and adopted.

• Improved accessibility and usability of learning and leader resources.

• HRBPs increasingly able to facilitate and cascade development solutions.

• Greater consistency in leadership and manager practices across the organization.

• Strong utilization and user experience of leader toolkits and SharePoint resources.

• Evidence that development experiences are translating into application, not simply participation.

• Development infrastructure that can scale as Acumatica grows without requiring the Talent & Organizational Capability team to deliver everything centrally.

• Meaningful connection of development pathways and resources to career profiles, capability expectations, and employee growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Claims Specialist
jobs.description:
Authentic helps insurance brokers create better insurance products for their clients. We provide the technology platform and behind-the-scenes support that lets brokers build custom insurance solutions for specific industries or customer groups. Think of us as the operating system that powers these specialized insurance offerings. For brokers, this means they can offer unique products their competitors don't have, earn more money, and spend less time on paperwork and administrative tasks. We handle the complex (technology, compliance, and partnerships with highly-rated insurance carriers), so they can focus on serving their customers and growing their business.

We are looking for a Senior Claims specialist to strengthen oversight for our complex commercial liability claims. This is a new role reporting directly to our Head of Claims.

What you'll do

• Review complex and litigated commercial claims handled by our TPA partner, assessing liability, coverage, reserves, and settlement exposure.

• Monitor litigation developments and explain where each claim is heading, from early defense strategy through mediation and trial.

• Evaluate claim handling and defense strategy, and flag files that aren't progressing appropriately.

• Identify emerging exposures early and escalate them with clear, well-supported recommendations.

• Present findings and recommendations to the Head of Claims, who makes final reserve and settlement decisions.

• Work with TPA adjusters, defense counsel, brokers, and carrier partners to keep claims on track.

• Help strengthen how we oversee claim handling across our TPA relationship.

What you'll bring

• 6+ years of commercial claims experience, with substantial hands-on work on complex or litigated claims. We're flexible on years for candidates who can clearly demonstrate strong litigation experience.

• Strong experience in commercial GL, bodily injury, construction defect, or other high-exposure liability claims.

• The ability to evaluate liability, coverage, reserves, litigation strategy, and settlement exposure, and to explain where a claim is heading.

• Experience working with defense counsel, adjusters, brokers, or carrier partners.

• Strong communication and analytical skills, with the confidence to review claims independently and present recommendations.

• An active adjuster license where required.

Nice to have

• AIC, CPCU, or an equivalent designation.

• Legal education (a plus, not required).

Our (FTE) benefits

• Competitive salary, equity, and role trajectory

• Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid parental leave

About Authentic

Authentic builds the infrastructure that program insurance runs on. We partner with leading brokerages to design and manage custom insurance programs, backed by A and A- rated carriers operating nationwide. Brokers bring the data and distribution. We bring everything else: the technology, the capacity, and the underwriting expertise to stand up specialized programs at speed and build them to last.  We’re a Series A company backed by top investors, including FirstMark Capital, Zigg Capital, Slow Ventures, Clocktower, Commerce Ventures, and Altai. We’ve grown over 15x in the past year with a massive market opportunity ahead.

Authentic is committed to building an inclusive working environment regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race, education, age, or other personal characteristics. We believe that people do their best work when they can be themselves, and different perspectives and experiences make us stronger as a team. We’re proud of the supportive and inclusive workplace we're building together and are always working to make it even better.

jobs.title: Machine Operator - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
First Shift: M-TH 5am-3pm

The role of the Machine Operator will be responsible for processing mesh fabric material into semi-finished and finished product by performing various slitting, cutting, and stapling techniques.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

• Safely and efficiently perform slitting functions to ensure materials meet width specifications, by:Scanning bar code(s) on work order(s) and reading work order(s) instructions for product specifications such as run quantities, configuration of components and raw material.Selecting appropriate raw material (rolls), placing on slitter, setting up slitter by positioning blades in the proper sequence and spacing, and initiating the slitting process.Attaching slit ends to new cardboard tube in rewinder, running machine to slit and rewind material, and cutting full tube to length.Removing slit width rolls and placing in queue for cutting to length or packaging as finished product.Completing work order traveler by capturing material usage, number of parts produced, rejected material, and ending job using the bar code scanner.
• Safely and efficiently perform klicker/guillotine cutter functions, by:Scanning bar code(s) on work order(s) and reading work order(s) instructions for product specifications such as run quantities, configuration of components and raw material.Setting up machine by selecting required parameters and appropriate carton size quantity for finished product, and attaching pre-print labels.Sealing cartons and stacking on pallet.Completing work order traveler by capturing material usage, number of parts produced, rejected material, and ending job using the bar code scanner.
• Safely and efficiently perform mold press functions, by:Scanning bar code(s) on work order(s) and reading work order(s) instructions for product specifications such as run quantities, configuration of components and raw material.Loading material(s) into mold press, and unloading finished product when automatic press opens.Trimming, stacking, and packing cups.Completing work order traveler by capturing material usage, number of parts produced, rejected material, and ending job using the bar code scanner.
• Safely and efficiently perform assembly functions, by:Scanning bar code(s) on work order(s) and reading work order(s) instructions for product specifications such as run quantities, configuration of components and raw material.Performing assemblies by rolling, folding, or applying multiple components.Stapling components using a foot-activated, electric powered industrial stapler, or modifying using a band saw, drill press or table saw.Completing work order traveler by capturing material usage, number of parts produced, rejected material, and ending job using the bar code scanner.
• Promptly notify supervisor(s) of any problems or machine malfunctions that create barriers for meeting output requirements.

Education/Experience

• One (1) year of manufacturing or machine operation experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

• Manufacturing/Technical Skills. Ability to read, interpret and apply basic drawings. Ability to perform basic mathematical skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) utilizing a calculator, including forms of measurement and other work material calculations. Working knowledge of tools, equipment, and devices, and ability to use hand operated and power tools. Proficiency with performing tasks with precision and manual dexterity. Ability to obtain and maintain forklift certification.
• Computer/Applications Skills. Basic computer skills and ability to use a variety of software applications systems to access material, record labor hours and access ADP Employee Self Service.
• Professional Investment: Demonstrated commitment to own personal professional development and learning. Willingness and ability to be cross trained in other department(s).
• Flexibility. Ability to work outside of standard schedule to meet department expectations and deadlines.

Physical/Sensory Requirements

The following physical activities described here are representative of those required by a Team Member to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation, if feasible, will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions of position.

While performing the functions of this position, the Team Member is continuously required to talk or hear; regularly required to stand, walk, use stairs, bend and reach, use hands and fingers to grasp, handle and feel. Frequently lift material weighing up to 40 pounds. Occasionally team lift, maneuver/handle material weighing up to 100 pounds. Communicate effectively in English by telephone, in person and in writing. Specific vision abilities require both up close and distant sight abilities.

Working Environment

While performing the essential responsibilities of this position, Team Member generally will work in a manufacturing environment with frequent exposure to loud noise, moving mechanical parts, and fumes or airborne particles.  Periodic exposure to outdoor environment through open doors. PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) such as approved footwear, respirators, safety glasses/goggles, may be required.

jobs.title: Systems Specialist, Physical Safety and Security
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

About the Role

At Adyen, the safety and security of our people, workplaces and assets is a global priority. Our Physical Safety & Security program protects a growing international organization through a risk-based, technology-enabled approach.

Reporting to the Global Head of Physical Safety & Security, you will be the technical owner and subject matter expert for Adyen’s global physical safety and security technology environment. This includes access control and credentialing, video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, emergency communication and emerging AI-enabled technologies.

You will be the primary technical point of contact for physical safety and security systems across Adyen’s global office network. You will help shape technology strategy, define technical standards, design solutions for new and existing offices, manage system administration and troubleshooting, and lead technical integrations, migrations and deployments.

For new offices, relocations and major workplace projects, you will work with Workplace, IT, contractors and specialist partners to define the physical safety and security technology architecture from design through implementation. This includes system selection, infrastructure and networking requirements, device placement, integrations, commissioning, testing and handover.

This is a hands-on global role. You will ensure systems remain reliable, secure and scalable while improving automation, integrations and AI-enabled capabilities.

What You’ll Do

Physical Safety & Security Systems

• Own the technical lifecycle of Adyen’s physical safety and security systems, from architecture and configuration through deployment, upgrades, maintenance and decommissioning.

• Manage and support enterprise access control, credentialing and badging, CCTV, intrusion detection, visitor management, intercoms and related technologies.

• Support technology interfaces with fire and life-safety systems, emergency communication, mass notification and emergency response systems.

• Ensure operational availability, reliability and appropriate configuration of physical safety and security platforms.

• Manage system administration, device onboarding, configuration and technical dependencies.

• Troubleshoot hardware, software, network and system issues and coordinate resolution with IT, integrators and external vendors.

• Manage technical system incidents, provide timely updates, identify root causes and drive corrective actions.

• Maintain accurate system documentation, architecture diagrams, technical standards and asset information.

Security Technology Architecture & Design

• Design physical safety and security technology solutions for new offices, relocations, expansions and major workplace projects.

• Translate security requirements, risk assessments and business needs into practical technical designs.

• Define requirements for access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, visitor management, emergency communication and supporting infrastructure.

• Ensure safety and security systems work together effectively during emergency scenarios.

• Review technical drawings, system designs and vendor proposals.

• Work with Workplace, IT, contractors and security integrators throughout design and implementation.

• Lead technical commissioning, testing, acceptance and handover.

• Develop and maintain global physical safety and security technology standards and reference architectures.

Access Control & Identity

• Own the technical administration of Adyen’s global access-control environment, including Genea and related technologies.

• Create and maintain access profiles, groups, permissions and system configurations.

• Support employee access issues, credential problems, reader failures and routine access-control requests.

• Partner with IT and HR on identity and employee lifecycle integrations.

• Improve automation around joiner, mover and leaver processes.

• Drive consistent access-control architecture and configuration across Adyen’s global offices.

Integrations, Automation & AI

• Develop and support integrations between physical safety and security platforms and enterprise systems.

• Work with APIs, cloud platforms, automation tools and identity systems to improve security operations and employee experience.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive physical safety and security processes.

• Support the development, testing and deployment of AI-enabled physical safety and security capabilities.

• Work with internal technology teams and vendors to maintain and troubleshoot AI-enabled solutions.

• Use system data, operational metrics and incident trends to identify issues, measure effectiveness and prioritize improvements.

• Conduct technical research and proof-of-concept testing for emerging security technologies.

Projects, Migrations & Resilience

• Lead the technical delivery of physical safety and security technology projects across Adyen offices.

• Support new office openings, relocations, expansions, migrations and technology upgrades.

• Plan and execute software updates, firmware upgrades, patches and configuration changes.

• Ensure appropriate testing, validation and rollback procedures for critical changes.

• Plan and execute migrations from legacy platforms to Adyen’s strategic systems.

• Support backup, recovery, failover and business continuity arrangements for critical systems.

Operational Support & Investigations

• Provide first-line technical support for routine physical safety and security technology requests across Adyen offices.

• Troubleshoot access-control, CCTV, alarm, emergency communication and visitor-management issues.

• Support physical security investigations through access records, video, system data and other technical evidence.

Vendor & Partner Management

• Act as the technical point of contact for physical safety and security technology vendors, integrators and specialist providers.

• Review technical proposals, designs, statements of work and implementation plans.

• Support vendor selection, technical evaluations and due diligence.

• Coordinate maintenance, troubleshooting and project delivery with external partners.

• Monitor technical performance and service levels and drive resolution of issues.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in physical security technology, electronic security systems or a closely related field.

• Strong hands-on experience with enterprise access control and CCTV systems.

• Experience with Genea or comparable enterprise physical security platforms.

• Experience designing and delivering physical safety and security technology solutions across multiple sites.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networks and integrations.

• Experience with system migrations, upgrades and technology lifecycle management.

• Experience integrating physical security systems with enterprise IT, identity or HR platforms.

• Comfortable working with APIs, cloud technologies, automation and system integrations.

• Strong understanding of IP-based physical security systems and networking concepts such as TCP/IP, VLANs, PoE, VPNs and firewall requirements.

• Strong interest in cloud-based security platforms, AI/ML applications, video analytics and modern authentication technologies.

• Experience supporting or integrating AI-enabled security solutions is preferred.

• Experience delivering complex, multi-site technical projects from design through implementation and handover.

• Comfortable working with technology vendors, security integrators and contractors.

• Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills.

• Able to work independently across multiple countries and time zones.

• Hands-on, curious and comfortable operating at both technical and architectural levels.

Qualifications

• Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in engineering, information technology, electronic security or a related field preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will help establish a reliable, scalable and well-managed technical foundation for Adyen’s global physical safety and security program.

• Establish consistent technology standards and architectures for existing and new offices.

• Improve the availability, reliability and resilience of access control, CCTV and related systems.

• Reduce dependency on external vendors for routine technical support and troubleshooting.

• Successfully deliver security technology deployments, migrations and new office projects.

• Improve automation and integrations across physical safety and security systems.

• Support the rollout and ongoing operation of AI-enabled security technologies.

• Strengthen technical documentation, system ownership and lifecycle management.

This role gives you the opportunity to shape the technology foundation behind a global physical safety and security program.

You will work across Security, Technology and Workplace, design and deploy systems across multiple countries, and help introduce new approaches in automation, AI and integrated physical safety and security technology.

Your work will have a direct impact on how Adyen protects its people, workplaces and assets while continuing to scale globally.

jobs.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

As part of Anaplan’s Supply Chain Center of Excellence, this role is key to delivering Supply Chain and Retail Applications that are consistent, scalable, and aligned with Anaplan’s quality standards. The focus is on ensuring customer business process needs are met through the effective implementation of these applications. Success requires deep expertise in Supply Chain Planning Or Retail Planning, hands-on experience with planning tool implementations (Anaplan or comparable platforms), and strong knowledge of Anaplan’s Supply Chain / Retail Applications to support professional services teams both internally and across our partner ecosystem.

Key responsibilities include shaping implementation approaches, leading the creation and delivery of documentation and content, enabling internal and external teams, and serving as an on-call resource for business process expertise. This role provides product guidance, validates and approves implementation plans, monitors delivery, and ensures feedback is incorporated into future product enhancements. If you have exceptional collaboration skills, a strong grasp of Supply Chain Planning Or Retail Planning use cases, applications expertise, professional services experience, and an innovative, detail-oriented mindset with a focus on meeting deadlines, this is your opportunity to make a global impact while helping customers achieve real results.

Your Impact

• Partner with Anaplan’s Product Management, Professional Services, and GTM Enablement Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain / Retail Applications into Anaplan’s GTM and delivery motion by:

• Serving as the subject matter the Applications, guiding effective implementation strategies.

• Developing and overseeing functional enablement programs, including training, guides, comprehensive documentation for internal and partner use. Drive ecosystem enablement by developing scalable knowledge-sharing initiatives.

• Uphold and enhance implementation standards to maintain Anaplan’s brand integrity.

• Empower partners through training, advisory and supporting services, scaling Anaplan's service delivery capacity and driving implementation success, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

• Support key and late-stage sales opportunities as a process expert, guiding customers on best practices for implementing Supply Chain / Retail Applications. Deliver actionable feedback from the field to the Product Team to improve our applications.

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers and partners, including presenting Anaplan’s Supply Chain / Retail Applications vision, and demonstrate the solutions at key internal and external events.

• Drive the enablement of Professional Services and Partner Teams to increase and maintain their understanding of the applications, their functionality and implementation implications.

• Ensure the successful implementation of the applications, by providing guidance and advice to the implementation teams.

Your Qualifications

• Deep expertise in supply chain / Retail planning processes, and experience in implementing systems to support these processes. Broad experience across all aspects of end-to-end supply chain is necessary (demand, inventory, production, procurement etc.).

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge-sharing skills, with a demonstrated ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.

• Solid understanding of Anaplan’s platform and how it can be applied to address complex business challenges. This position does not require deep technical or architectural expertise in Anaplan.

• Understanding of product management, GTM operations and enablement.

• A results-driven mindset, able to collaborate across teams, with a focus on contributing deliverables of the highest possible quality and impact.

Base Salary Range:

$152,000—$219,000 USD

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

• Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.

• Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

jobs.description:
Penguin Random House is seeking a dynamic, self-motivated Customer Service Representative to join our growing Distribution Services Support Center in Westminster, Maryland. This role is essential to delivering an exceptional customer experience by supporting order fulfillment, resolving customer inquiries, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate service. This position can either be office based or remote.

Regular working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern time.

Our Customer Service organization continues to evolve, representatives will work within a team environment, and within an integrated customer service environment utilizing ticketing and communication platforms alongside SAP and other business applications.  The ideal candidate must be analytical, customer-focused, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where organization, sound judgment, and accountability are essential, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Candidates must demonstrate a professional and approachable communication style, strong listening skills, and a commitment to exceptional customer service and the highest standards of professional ethics. Skills assessment may be part of the consideration process.

Key Responsibilities:

• Customer Communication and Support: Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, sales representatives, and internal and external business partners, responding to inquiries received through phone and email channels. Maintain accurate interaction records, and provide timely, professional responses.
• Order Facilitation and Fulfillment: Research and process customer orders, investigate order status and fulfillment issues, and support accurate and timely order processing using SAP and related business applications.
• Shipment Tracking and Issue Resolution: Research shipment status, delivery concerns, shortages, damages, missing items, and other order-related issues; coordinate with warehouse, transportation, and other internal teams to identify solutions and communicate updates to customers.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner within team environment as well as internal departments and business stakeholders to research and resolve complex inquiries, address fulfillment challenges, and support an exceptional customer experience.

We are seeking candidates with the following qualifications and capabilities:

• High school diploma or equivalent required; some college preferred.
• Two to three years of prior customer service experience; experience in a distribution, order fulfillment, or support center environment preferred.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with a diverse customer base.
• Excellent listening, problem-solving, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple inquiries and deadlines simultaneously.
• Demonstrate ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take ownership of responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a team.
• Proficiency with computers and business applications, including Microsoft Excel and Outlook and email-based customer support.
• Ability to learn and navigate multiple systems, research information, analyze data, document findings accurately, and apply established procedures to resolve customer issues.
• Experience with SAP and MARC is a plus.
• Experience with ticketing, case management, contact center, or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms is preferred.
• Professional, patient, and empathetic phone presence, with the ability to remain composed and solution-oriented when addressing challenging customer situations.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when processing orders, documenting customer interactions, and communicating order or shipment information.
• Bilingual or multilingual fluency is a plus. German, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, and French are desirable but not required.

The salary for this position is $45,225 per year. This position is eligible for bonus or profit share, contingent on the company's results.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

We are looking for a self-motivated, highly organized and fast-paced Executive Assistant, to provide support for the Technology organizations here at Braze. You are great at collaborating cross-functionally to ensure cohesive and efficient communications and know how to manage discretion and confidentiality. You have a track record of success, are proactive, and are reliable.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage calendars, appointments and scheduling for the CTO and key engineering VPs

• Handle expense reporting for engineering leadership

• Plan and coordinate departmental events (All-hands meetings, team events)

• Manage unscheduled requests with attention to detail, efficiency and quality

• Perform potentially confidential and complex administrative duties, including preparing documents

• Help with project coordination and management, new hire onboarding tasks, and other Technology Service org duties, as identified

WHO YOU ARE

• 2-5 years of experience supporting a high-level executive in a fast-paced environment

• Experience in collaborating and communicating with American-based senior leadership teams

• Experience with productivity, project management, and travel management apps

• Experience in leading projects, developing scope, managing schedules, and following up with stakeholders appropriately

• Organizational skills, including excellent written and verbal communication

• Willing to travel (Less than 5%)

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $63,000 and $89,000/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $70,000 and $100,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

• To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

• To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com.

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

This role uniquely combines hands-on technical leadership with strategic thinking: you will architect end-to-end solutions, build working prototypes, mentor the team in design thinking and agentic development, and ensure every solution drives tangible efficiency gains and value for stakeholders.

This role reports to the Associate Director, BTS Corporate Services within the Business Technology Solutions department. We set the vision for how data, analytics and AI automation enhance our enterprise systems. We work closely with business partners and technical implementors to bring that vision to life. This is a hybrid role required to be on-site Tuesday through Thursday every week in Lake County, IL.

Responsibilities:
