jobs.title: Senior Policy Data Analyst
jobs.location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland

• Travel is encouraged approximately once every 6 months to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation:  $120,000

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Hires remotely in: United States

Experience: 5+ years of full-time, professional work experience

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Senior Policy Data Analyst to join our team! We’re a small, fast-moving group that works with complex criminal justice data from our state partners and develops analyses and tools that target the drivers of incarceration. That’s where you come in. We’re looking for someone who has creativity and inquisitiveness to identify and solve open-ended problems, clarity to think through complex and variable data, flexibility to adjust in a rapidly evolving environment, and above all else, a collaborative, kind nature to add to our culture.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

Recidiviz's policy team works with state DOC leaders who want to rewrite old policies or write new ones, grounded in evidence and analytics, to improve outcomes. We use administrative datasets to generate context-responsive insights that expand momentum for policy change. We answer questions like:

• What earned sentence credit structure creates the strongest reward system given the distribution of sentence lengths and program availability?

• How do the factors that drive parole board decisions align with the factors most quantitatively predictive of post-release outcomes? How would outcomes change if dynamic factors were weighted more heavily?

• How will a new supervision contact standard affect the alignment between supervision officer bandwidth and high-need clients?

By translating policy concepts into concrete modeling, we help states make smarter and more ambitious changes.

Senior Policy Data Analysts are high-autonomy technical contributors. They own an end to end analytic process — breaking project objectives into analytical products, designing the approach, derisking the timeline, producing the findings, and preparing the materials that go in front of decision-makers. The core skill is decision-support: building analysis for a decision rather than for a research finding.

This role is as much about making judgment calls as it is about running analytical work. Most of our projects are first of their kind, which requires designing the approach as you go. Projects change mid-flight as our understanding of system dynamics develops and the needs of stakeholders shift. This role works closely with a Partnerships Lead, who coordinates with state partners to determine project objectives. The Senior Policy Data Analyst sets the analysis strategy to meet those objectives. Success is measured by the impact your interventions drive.

Core responsibilities

• Building analysis from corrections and parole data. You'll use SQL and Python to wrangle administrative data to articulate how a system behaves. You ramp up on new data quickly, going deep where it changes the answer and making defensible simplifying assumptions where it doesn’t.

• Modeling policy scenarios and quantifying tradeoffs. Apply statistical methods like regressions, time series, stock-and-flow modeling or distributional analysis to project how outcomes change under different policy designs, and assess what the data can and can't support. A core judgment is developing simple and elegant approaches that cut to the heart of the decision point.

• Communicating findings to the people making the decision. You work backward from what information a stakeholder needs to advance decision-making in the room. You'll create the decks and memos that go to DOC leadership, find the frameworks that make a complicated tradeoff digestible, and take responsibility for tailoring your work to the audience to motivate action.

• Running your projects end to end. You'll translate project objectives into an analysis strategy, set project roadmaps, and identify and address unknowns. You’ll adjust course as project objectives change, and rightsize analysis with impact.

• Collaborating across Recidiviz. You'll collaborate across the organization to obtain state context, understand underlying data infrastructure, and support policy implementation.

• Finding the next opportunity. You’ll go deeper on the states you work in — spotting where additional analysis could unlock a decision, and running the early exploration to assess whether it’s worth pursuing.

Wild success

A year from now:

• You've driven impact. Your work has directly shaped several policy reforms across the country.

• You’ve uncovered new opportunities. You spotted a new opportunity in your states that became new work for the team.

• You've made your projects more effective. The people around you have less scramble, clearer ownership, and smoother handoffs, making it easier for everyone to focus on driving towards impact.

• You've leveled up our analytical team. Approaches you designed, like a modeling pattern or a framework for a recurring question, are now being reused by teammates on other states.

Minimum qualifications

• 5 or more years of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and processing complex datasets

• Professional experience using SQL with large datasets, including high proficiency writing efficient queries for complex extraction and transformation

• Professional experience with Python, particularly pandas, for statistical analysis and data visualization

• Sufficient statistical background to reason about analysis design, examine results closely, and prepare analyses that hold up to scrutiny

• Experience scoping and delivering analytical work — particularly balancing depth and speed when navigating short timelines and shifting priorities

• Experience on teams where ownership is shared across functions, including proactively seeking context you're missing and flagging risks before they become blockers.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience adapting quantitative methods to introduce intuitively meaningful metrics in ambiguous, unconstrained contexts

• Experience working with large administrative datasets from the public sector, especially related to criminal justice

• Familiarity with our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The compensation for this role is: $120,000.

What we offer

• Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters

• 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents

• Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period

• Complimentary One Medical membership (depending on location)

• Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits

• Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness

• Free mental health support via Talkspace

• Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose

• An annual company offsite each spring and other ad-hoc gatherings

• All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we’ve built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator’s 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners – big and small, red and blue – and covers more than 46% of the US incarcerated population. We have helped to get tens of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably, and saved states nearly $1 billion. In the next five years, Recidiviz plans to partner with 40 states and help 250,000 people who are stuck in the system to get out and stay out. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2025 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk.

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

On GA’s Digital Team, our team of digital experts works to democratize fundraising and set new standards for innovation. We can – and do – try something new every day, thanks to the power and scale of our database.

We’re seeking a Digital Strategist with the flexibility, creativity, and confidence of fundraising experience to deliver for both peer to peer clients and full-service programs in our Digital Lab. This is a position designed for growth, as the Strategist develops a balance of independent leadership and 360º project management with a team of collaborators.

You’ll have the chance to work with a wide variety of campaign, PAC, and nonprofit accounts, ranging from small, local campaigns and organizations, all the way to major federal campaigns and international organizations.

• Drive the strategy and execution for clients, across channels such as text, email, digital ads, and new digital channels

• Proactively recommend content ideas, particularly around unique deadlines and hooks for clients to maximize dollars raised and donors acquired

Qualifications

While social media, action advocacy, and marketing experience are valuable and welcome, none is the job at hand. jobs.title: Print Production Account Specialist
jobs.description:
Coordinate production of printed materials, or print-related services for the company's customers. Maintain positive customer relations through active engagement of the customer through all stages of the manufacturing process from initial contact through final disposition of the customer's product.

Responsibilities:

• Engage customers to gather job requirements and translate customer requirements in to detailed manufacturing/kitting instructions and shipping/postal instructions for disposition of the customers & products.
• May make suggestions to customers regarding workflow/process improvements to proposed jobs to maximize the benefits to both the customer and the company.
• Provide quality review for other Print Production Specialists to ensure all information is accounted for and accurate before the commencement of production.
• Ensure job instructions are entered and verified in the various manufacturing systems and queued in to the production schedule.
• Confer with customers throughout production to keep them informed of the status of jobs, solicit additional information needed for current jobs, and coordinate changes to jobs.
• May forward/review proofs with customer, obtain approval of materials, such as artwork, color separations, or ink samples.
• Coordinate production of components with other internal plants and/or external vendors as required.
• Coordinate the resolution of customer or manufacturing issues with customer jobs. Engage appropriate departments to verify the issue and determine the root cause.
• May make recommendations to management on the appropriate responses to issues that are in the best interest of the customer and the company.
• Communicate with customers regarding the resolution of issues.
• May provide pre-sales support with customers and discuss the manufacturing capabilities and requirements needed to produce a successful job.
• Monitor progress of jobs throughout production, confer with manufacturing operations on counts and final runs and ensure the final product meets customer requirements and company standards.
• Tally the final production runs and work performed to assemble paperwork for billing purposes.

• May have responsibility for determining the supplies and paper needed for jobs including the use of vendors to supply components of the customer product.
• May assist sales in the RFP process by supplying estimates and determining how to efficiently process a complete job.
• May have responsibility for the composition and/or copy prep of the customers & products.
• Performs other related duties and participates in special projects as assigned.

• Requires excellent knowledge of the functional area(s) related to the job or good knowledge related to a professional field of work.
• Able to consistently apply applicable policies, procedures, regulations, and program objectives when carrying out the duties of the job.
• May provide oversight of work conducted by junior-level staff and/or review/audit work for accuracy.
• Must have advanced knowledge of technology including computers and software programs such as MS Office or MAC word processing, spreadsheets, or other programs specific to the job in order to complete job duties successfully.

jobs.title: Regional Training and Operations Technician - Water Technologies
jobs.description:
Job Summary

This position is responsible for operating multiple Veolia contracted client water and wastewater facilities. The primary purpose of this position is to cover vacations & absences at existing facilities, assist in the training and development of local operations teams, and to serve in a support role at new account start-ups. This position will be responsible for assisting with the overall operation and maintenance of accounts in their area. In between time at designated accounts, this position will be responsible for the development of training resources for general water and wastewater industry knowledge, as well as site-specific treatment training for all technicians in their region.

Essential Operational Duties and Responsibilities:

• Maintain complete operational coverage of the Veolia-operated facilities in your designated region as vacations and unplanned absences arise
• Coverage will be required on both day shifts and night shifts as absences arise, requiring significant schedule flexibility
• Assist in the operational development of all local technicians within your designated region
• Ensure that industry standards and best practices are in use at all Veolia-operated facilities in your designated region
• Support new account start-up projects as they arise
• Provide knowledgeable support to local technicians within your designated region to assist in troubleshooting process issues as they arise
• Operate and control electric motors, pumps, and valves to regulate the flow of water into the Wastewater treatment plant
• Collect and test Wastewater samples to determine concentration levels and impurities at the designated testing frequency
• Responsible for accurate record keeping of client data such as residual content of chemicals, water turbidity, and water pressure
• Comply with all Veolia and multiple's safety parameters/programs
• Analyze lab data to uncover potential treatment issues and then implement process changes to prevent non-compliance
• This position may be responsible for compiling data for the Environmental Protection Agency or state regulatory body
• Coordinate with other operators throughout the multiple facilities to maintain the plant's wastewater treatment equipment
• Consult with management in the operations of their Wastewater plant to determine the best treatment for their Wastewater
• Independent scheduling of workload
• Participation in team meetings and discussions is required. Collaboration with team members on a regular basis is expected

Essential Maintenance Duties and Responsibilities:

• Coordinate third-party maintenance support for all maintenance projects that are outside of Veolia's scope of work
• Complete all preventative maintenance defined by Veolia and multiple management at the designated frequency
• Complete, or assist in the completion of, all minor and intermediate maintenance projects that may arise to ensure the Wastewater treatment facility remains operating effectively and efficiently
• Management of inventories including lab supplies, consumable items, and equipment parts

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• Willingness and availability to work with fellow operators on off-shifts when problems arise or if the operator needs assistance
• 24/7 availability to the Wastewater operators and multiple management
• Communicate frequently with the Veolia Account Manager regarding the operation of the Wastewater plant
• Provide supervision and leadership to the other team members by exemplifying hard work, attention to detail, fair treatment of each member of the team, and taking responsibility for results
• Provide direction to the team on the daily operation and maintenance of the Wastewater plant to ensure compliance
• Provide training and/or facilitate training of operators for all facets of the operation/management of the multiple wastewater facilities
• Provide clear verbal and written instructions to the team on the proper operation and maintenance of the Wastewater treatment plant and the equipment
• Continually optimize the operation of the wastewater treatment plant, chemistry, and equipment to improve operating efficiency and reduce operating costs

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Knowledge of the operation and control of electric motors, pumps, and valves
• Excellent attention to detail
• Strong time management skills
• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
• Excellent leadership and management skills
• Good computer skills
• Proficiency with Google Suite
• Ability and desire to build and maintain a "team mentality"

Education & Experience:

Required

• High school diploma or equivalent
• 3+ years of experience in wastewater treatment plant operations or related field

Preferred

• Prior experience in a traveling work role
• Operational experience with site-specific equipment
• Strong mechanical aptitude

Working Conditions:

• Typical working conditions for this position include a wastewater treatment plant and the outdoors
• This position may be exposed to extreme heat and cold weather conditions, burns, chemicals, dangerous systems, dirt and dust, electrical hazards, grease and oil, loud noises, vibrations, steam and high levels of moisture, and other hazardous conditions
• This position requires the job holder to lift and/or carry up to 75 pounds, climb a vertical ladder up to 30 feet, stand for long periods of time, walk on uneven surfaces, regularly bend, climb onto and safely exit a forklift, use extension ladders daily, and the ability to climb into and maneuver the body in tight spaces
• This position is required to work both day and night shifts, as needed, including 12-hour shifts as needed
• Must have the availability for emergency call-ins or phone support
• Must comply with all Veolia and multiple safety parameters/programs; mindfulness of safety is key

At Veolia, we realize diverse teams make smarter decisions, deliver better results, and build stronger communities. jobs.title: Transportation Supervisor
jobs.description:
Summary: The supervisor oversees a team of drivers [Class A and B] delivering to Domino’s Pizza stores. The supervisor is responsible for scheduling drivers, routing trucks, reviewing trip sheets for accuracy and ensuring compliance with DOT regulations, state, local laws, and company policies and programs. Effectively and efficiently handle customer complaints and concerns. Train new drivers in job duties, safely, and complete Job Safety Observations (JSO). The supervisor must be comfortable working in a diverse, fast paced environment.

• Salary: 75-78K + 10% TAD Bonus

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Leadership:

• Recruit, interview, select, and mentor new and tenured drivers
• Support driver engagement initiatives
• Monitor driver's performance and hold them accountable when performance is below expectations, using coaching and/or progressive discipline as needed
• Complete driver’s annual performance reviews
• Review driver’s lytx and logs and coach according to company
• Collaborate in driver onboarding and training
• Ensure safe work environment in compliance with FMCSA, OSHA, company standards, local, state, and federal requirements
• Effectively communicate day-to-day with drivers, departments, and vendors
• Create positive environment, morale, and respect among team members
• Attend and participate in classroom or virtual Leadership & Development trainings
• Coordinate safety/team/quarterly meetings

Reporting/Budget:

• Prepare and assist with Transportation generated reports
• Monitor budget and fuel cards to ensure funds are maximized
• Participate in the development of budgets

Routing, Scheduling, Hours of Service, and Maintenance:

• Weekly schedule driver routes and re-routing as necessary to ensure route coverage
• Conduct route analysis and recommend saving opportunities to Manager
• Monitor driver hours of service via the onboard system
• Conduct route observations to ensure Drivers are safely performing their duties as required by company and DOT standards (The number of observations per period is determined by the number of drivers at the SCC)
• Maintain and monitor food safety standards in compliance with company and franchisee requirements
• Perform payroll duties when necessary and review driver payroll for accuracy
• Monitor misdelivers, and make recommendations to the manager on avoidance strategies
• Maintain driver qualification file
• Schedule truck maintenance and maintain fleet image
• Conduct accident investigations
• Coordinate deliveries and backhaul activities
• Assist the Transportation Manager with truck leasing meetings to ensure PMs are met to Domino’s standard and repairs are completed in a timely manner
• Perform other duties as assigned by leadership
• As needed, if qualified, drive a company vehicle or straight truck for deliveries or to the leasing company for service/maintenance, and on occasion, work the yard
• Willingness to support a 24-hour operation, including carrying an emergency cell phone as needed

Customer Relations:

• Maintain positive customer relationships
• Customer Surveys

• High School Diploma, some college hours, 2-year degree preferred
• 2-3 years of documented supervisory experience
• 2-3 years route scheduling experience
• Knowledge of Department of Transportation, FMSCA rules and regulations
• MS Office, SAP, Transportation Management Systems (TMS), computers, and scanner equipment/software
• Results-oriented with strong organizational, decision making and people skills
• Successfully pass a background check every third year on your anniversary date
• Commercial Driver’s License Class A, a plus

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to stand and/or walk for extended periods of time, climb stairs, and lift to 25 lbs. frequently and 50 lbs. on occasion
• Ability to bend, twist, reach, push, and pull throughout the shift
• Ability to work in extreme temperatures (non-airconditioned warehouse), both indoors and outdoors, including refrigerated conditions [33-38]
• Ability to work in an environment with exposure to loud machinery
• Must be able to work around yeast and flour

Domino's offers:

• Competitive wages

• Paid Holidays and Vacation

• Positive work environment

• Benefits on first day of employment!

• 401k matching contributions

• 15% off the purchase price of stock

• Company bonus

• Referral bonuses

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Counsel
jobs.description:
About Public

Public is the world’s first agentic brokerage, combining a comprehensive multi-asset investing experience with all the advantages of AI Agents.

Members can invest in stocks, options, bonds, crypto, and event contracts, and manage a variety of accounts including their personal brokerage, margin, retirement accounts, and business accounts—all in the same place.

Since 2019, Public has raised $400 million. Investors include Accel, Tiger Global, Will Smith's Dreamers VC, The Chainsmokers' Mantis VC, as well as renowned figures in business and culture, like Maria Sharapova, Tony Hawk, and NYU Stern professor Scott Galloway.

About the role

We’re looking for a sharp, enthusiastic attorney to join our Legal team. This is a generalist role with an emphasis on litigation, regulatory matters, compliance, privacy, and product counseling. You will also help expand our AI governance program.

Public is a highly regulated financial services and technology company. Experience in a regulated financial field is a plus, but this role would also suit a strong generalist who is willing to climb the regulatory learning curve.

This role is based in New York City, and you’ll work from our office Monday through Thursday.

What you’ll do

You’ll handle a little bit of everything, including:

• Litigation, investigations, and exams. You’ll manage disputes from start to finish, including escalated customer complaints, FINRA arbitrations, privacy claims, and civil litigation, handling many matters yourself and overseeing outside counsel on others. On the regulatory side, you’ll respond to inquiries and investigations, partner with Compliance on examinations, and help turn lessons learned into better products and processes.

• Broker-dealer, investment adviser, and prediction markets regulation. Public owns an SEC-registered investment adviser and a FINRA-member broker-dealer that is also a CFTC-registered futures commission merchant. You’ll partner with Compliance on our SEC, FINRA, CFTC, and NFA obligations, including AML, regulatory filings, and registrations. You’ll also monitor regulatory developments, help keep our policies and procedures current, and translate complex rules into practical advice and training for our business teams.

• AI governance. You’ll work on the program that governs both our customer-facing AI products and the AI tools our teams use internally. That includes setting practical policies and quality assurance processes, assessing new AI use cases, and tracking emerging laws and guidance.

• Privacy and cybersecurity. You’ll own our privacy program, from privacy notices and consumer requests to data mapping and record retention. You’ll also partner with Engineering and IT on cybersecurity, fraud prevention, and incident response, including any resulting customer remediation.

• Product counseling. Regulations shape every part of our business, from the customer-facing product to back-end operations. You’ll work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams from concept through launch, spotting risks early and finding practical ways to navigate those rules.

• Contract negotiation. You’ll help draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including vendor, marketing, and data agreements.

• Legal processes and systems. You’ll build playbooks and templates that help our business teams navigate legal and compliance requirements and negotiate the best deals possible. You’ll also keep improving the tools, systems, and processes our team relies on, using AI to make our work faster and more efficient.

Qualifications

• J.D. from an ABA-approved law school (or foreign equivalent)

• Admission to at least one U.S. bar, in good standing

• 2-5 years of legal experience, ideally at a top law firm and then in-house at a technology or financial services company / start-up

• Experience with a broad range of legal matters

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence senior stakeholders

• A high level of integrity and the ability to balance legal and compliance obligations with business objectives

• Comfort with ambiguity and pressure, and the ability to identify, prioritize, and resolve issues quickly and independently

• A track record of quickly learning and using new software, such as project management and compliance tools

• Experience using AI tools responsibly to make legal processes and systems more efficient, or a demonstrated willingness to learn

Bonus points

Experience with any of the following:

• Litigation, arbitration (especially FINRA), or regulatory examinations and investigations

• Broker-dealer, investment adviser, or futures regulation

• Privacy, cybersecurity, or AI governance programs

• Negotiating commercial agreements, such as vendor, marketing, and market data agreements

• Partnering with compliance teams to build efficient, effective compliance systems and processes

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 to $170,000 plus equity, depending on skills and experience.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

• Generous PTO and parental leave policy

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Public is an equal employment opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We celebrate people of all race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Nexthink's Revenue Acceleration team is building a world-class enablement function to support ~400 GTM reps across seven distinct roles in the US, EMEA, META, and APAC. We're hiring a Senior Enablement Manager to own the most foundational piece of that system: how new reps ramp.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for someone who can operate with significant autonomy - diagnosing what's broken, designing what's better, and driving execution across a complex, global organization. You'll own Nexthink's end-to-end ramp program from day-one orientation through confirmed productivity, and you'll hold the accountability and influence to make it genuinely excellent.

What You Will Own

Ramp Program Architecture & Execution

• Redesign and own Nexthink's onboarding experience end-to-end — from pre-hire welcome through first deal close — across all GTM roles (AEs, BDRs, CSMs, SEs, and beyond)

• Build a structured ramp curriculum that sequences product knowledge, competitive positioning, sales methodology, tool proficiency, and deal execution into a coherent rep journey

• Define and track time-to-productivity benchmarks by role; use data to continuously improve ramp outcomes

• Ensure new hires reach competency faster and retain it longer

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Serve as the connective tissue between Revenue Acceleration, Sales, CS, Product Marketing, and RevOps to ensure onboarding reflects current GTM motion

• Partner with hiring managers and frontline leaders to align onboarding to real-world workflow, not just slide decks

• Coordinate with the broader enablement team on content governance, tool access, and methodology alignment so new reps are set up consistently from day one

Productivity Agenda

• Own the strategic view of what "ready to sell" means at Nexthink and keep that definition current as the product, market, and competitive landscape evolve

• Identify and close gaps between what new reps learn in onboarding and what they actually need in the field

• Champion rep readiness in leadership forums; bring data and recommendations, not just observations

• 6+ years in sales enablement, revenue operations, or GTM learning & development — ideally at a B2B SaaS company with a complex enterprise sales motion

• Demonstrated ownership of a full ramp or onboarding program, including redesign from a prior state

• Strong cross-functional operator: comfortable working across Sales, CS, Product Marketing, and RevOps without a heavy process to lean on

• Analytical mindset — can define what "good" looks like, instrument it, and iterate from evidence

• Excellent facilitator and communicator; can run a training session and write a tight exec summary with equal confidence

• Experience with modern GTM tools (Seismic, Gong or equivalent CI, Salesforce/CRM, LMS platforms)

• Comfortable working across time zones; EMEA and META exposure is a plus

• A builder mentality — this role involves creating structure where there isn't enough of it yet

Why Join Us?

• Pioneer the Future: Join the trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of work.

• Innovation & Impact: Our solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback to solve complex technical challenges.

• "One Team" Culture: We collaborate across 75+ nationalities to continuously grow and innovate.

Total Rewards @ Nexthink

At Nexthink, we offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans.  Your total rewards compensation package includes base salary and may also include a commission or performance bonus plan.  We provide our US employees with 100% covered company benefits that consist of health, dental, vision as well as access to life insurance, long-term disability, and accidental death/personal loss coverage.

In addition, we offer:

• 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 15 days of holidays we offer), 11 company-paid holidays, and 3 extra days for volunteering.
• 🏡 Hybrid work model that balances office and remote work, with structured onboarding to foster connections and team integration.
• 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
• 🍼 Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents/primary caregivers, 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
• 💰 Plan for the future with a 401(k) plan featuring up to 4% company matching contributions, vesting immediately, to grow your retirement savings.
• 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management
jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Program Manager, Drug Development will partner with the Program Lead and cross-functional Development Team to shape and execute integrated program strategy and long-range plans from preclinical development through regulatory approval and commercialization. This role will drive team alignment and disciplined execution across scope, schedule, risks and issues, budget, resources, governance, and stakeholder communications. The Senior Program Manager will connect research, CMC, nonclinical, clinical, regulatory, and commercial functions to ensure clear goals, informed decisions, and coordinated delivery of key program milestones.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will partner with Program Team Lead to lead integrated program planning and execution, enable effective cross-functional governance, and help teams anticipate and navigate key development decisions.

• Support Program Lead and Development Team members to develop, maintain, and execute the cross-functional program strategy and integrated development plan.

• Establish and maintain functionally integrated program schedules that enable accurate analysis of critical path activities, dependencies, milestones, and resource constraints.

• Identify, assess, and track program risks and issues; facilitate mitigation and contingency planning and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.

• Support Program Lead and Development Team members to develop scenario planning around key milestones and decision points, helping teams evaluate trade-offs, prepare alternative outcomes, and identify opportunities to accelerate development.

• Connect short-, mid-, and long-term plans across functions and proactively highlight interdependencies, assumptions, and potential impacts to program objectives.

• Partners with the program lead to facilitate cross-functional team and governance meetings, including agenda development, decision framing, documentation of outcomes, and follow-through actions.

• Drive timely, transparent program reporting for stakeholders and leadership, including progress against milestones, key decisions, risks, resource needs, and team accomplishments.

• Build strong relationships with functional partners and leaders across research, CMC, nonclinical, clinical development and operations, regulatory, and commercial teams.

• Serve as a Program Management subject matter resource and contribute to the continued evolution of Program Management tools, processes, standards, and ways of working.

• Contribute to Program Management department goals and initiatives; may provide coaching, mentorship, or oversight to other Program Management staff.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

• BA/BS in a life sciences discipline with 5+ years of multidisciplinary pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience in program management; or a master’s or PhD degree with 4+ years of relevant experience.

• Experience supporting l drug development programs through key clinical and/or regulatory milestones demonstrating knowledge of the drug development process.

• Demonstrated understanding of program and project management practices, tools, and methodologies, including integrated planning, critical path analysis, risk management, scenario planning, and status reporting.

• Ability to facilitate cross-functional teams, manage conflict, build consensus, and promote timely, high-quality decision making without direct authority.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, problem-solving, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

• Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, objectives, timelines, and deadlines across programs or workstreams.

• Proficiency with planning tools such as Microsoft Project, or comparable project management software desired.

• Experience in AI tools use or implementation desired.

• PMP certification a plus but not required.

Leadership Attributes:

• Collaborative team member who creates clarity, accountability, and alignment across diverse functional perspectives.

• Ability to connect program-level decisions to portfolio and company priorities.

• Pragmatic problem solver who anticipates challenges, frames options, and drives action.

• Credible partner who communicates with transparency and adapts effectively to different audiences, including senior leaders.

• Continuous-improvement mindset with a willingness to introduce and scale effective tools and practices.

The salary range for this position is $180,000 to $200,000 USD. jobs.title: Gestor de Relatórios de Negócios CIB
jobs.description:
Ensure the timely preparation, review and validation of financial statements across all legal entities within Wealth International (SBO), providing technical accounting leadership, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements, and maintaining a robust financial reporting control framework to safeguard the accuracy, integrity and reliability of financial information.

Funções Essenciais

Reporte Financeiro e Conformidade Regulamentar

• Desenvolver e coordenar os planos de reporte financeiro anual e intercalar, assegurando o alinhamento com os prazos de reporte estatutário locais e do Grupo, bem como com os calendários do Comité de Auditoria do Conselho de Administração (BAC) e do Conselho de Administração.
• Liderar a preparação das demonstrações financeiras anuais estatutárias de todas as subsidiárias do Standard Bank Offshore (SBO) e demais entidades relacionadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos de auditoria e das obrigações de submissão às autoridades reguladoras competentes.
• Assegurar que as demonstrações financeiras estatutárias são preparadas em conformidade com as Normas Internacionais de Relato Financeiro (IFRS) aplicáveis, os requisitos regulamentares locais e as políticas contabilísticas do Grupo.

Consolidação Financeira e Reporte Externo do Grupo

• Preparar e disponibilizar, de forma rigorosa, completa e atempada, os Pacotes de Informação Financeira (Financial Information Packs – FIPs), necessários ao processo de consolidação e reporte financeiro externo do Grupo.
• Garantir a integridade, consistência e fiabilidade da informação financeira submetida ao Grupo, contribuindo para um processo de consolidação eficiente e sustentado por mecanismos de controlo robustos.

Gestão do Risco de Pensões e Governação

• Prestar orientação técnica e assegurar a supervisão estratégica da gestão dos riscos associados aos planos de pensões de benefício definido, garantindo o alinhamento com as estratégias de gestão de risco aprovadas e os requisitos de governação aplicáveis.
• Liderar e coordenar iniciativas destinadas à implementação das estratégias de gestão do risco de pensões, em conformidade com as decisões dos órgãos de governação competentes.
• Supervisionar a preparação e apresentação dos relatórios mensais, trimestrais e anuais relativos ao risco de pensões, assegurando a qualidade, exactidão e disponibilização atempada da informação aos respectivos comités de governação e supervisão.

Controlo Financeiro e Integridade do Balanço

• Supervisionar a revisão diária dos balancetes contabilísticos das entidades legais, assegurando a exactidão, integridade e validação adequada dos lançamentos contabilísticos efectuados.
• Promover um processo de fecho contabilístico mensal eficiente e rigoroso, optimizando o processamento dos lançamentos contabilísticos e reduzindo os prazos de disponibilização da informação financeira.
• Rever e validar os processos de reconciliação e justificação dos saldos das contas de balanço classificadas como de elevado risco, assegurando o cumprimento dos requisitos de controlo interno e reporte financeiro.
• Reforçar a eficácia dos mecanismos de controlo financeiro, identificando oportunidades de melhoria da qualidade da informação, eficiência operacional e mitigação dos riscos financeiros.

Contabilidade Técnica e Conformidade com as IFRS

• Assegurar uma articulação contínua com a equipa de Contabilidade Técnica do Grupo, garantindo o alinhamento das práticas contabilísticas do SBO com as interpretações das IFRS, as políticas contabilísticas e as normas de reporte financeiro do Grupo.
• Prestar aconselhamento técnico especializado sobre alterações e desenvolvimentos nas IFRS, avaliando os respectivos impactos financeiros, operacionais e regulamentares.
• Liderar e apoiar iniciativas e projectos estratégicos destinados a assegurar a preparação organizacional, implementação eficaz e adopção de novas normas contabilísticas e requisitos regulamentares.
• Supervisionar os processos de valorização específicos das demonstrações financeiras, incluindo a avaliação de instrumentos financeiros classificados no Nível 3 da hierarquia do justo valor, os testes de imparidade de activos intangíveis e outras estimativas contabilísticas complexas.
• Assegurar liderança técnica na análise e resolução de matérias contabilísticas complexas, promovendo a aplicação de critérios técnicos consistentes, o exercício de julgamento profissional fundamentado e a integridade do reporte financeiro.

Contabilidade Técnica e Conformidade com as Normas Internacionais de Relato Financeiro (IFRS)

• Assegurar uma articulação contínua com a equipa de Contabilidade Técnica do Grupo, garantindo o alinhamento e a conformidade das práticas contabilísticas do Standard Bank Offshore (SBO) com as Normas Internacionais de Relato Financeiro (IFRS) e demais políticas contabilísticas do Grupo.
• Prestar orientação técnica especializada sobre alterações e desenvolvimentos nas normas contabilísticas, nomeadamente nas IFRS, avaliando os respectivos impactos e liderando iniciativas e projectos que assegurem a preparação, implementação e adopção eficaz de novos requisitos contabilísticos no âmbito do WIN.
• Liderar e supervisionar os processos de valorização associados à preparação das demonstrações financeiras, incluindo a aplicação de modelos de avaliação de instrumentos financeiros classificados no Nível 3 da hierarquia do justo valor, a realização de testes de imparidade de activos intangíveis e outras avaliações contabilísticas complexas.

Liderança, Gestão de Equipas e Desenvolvimento de Talento

• Liderar, coordenar e supervisionar a equipa, assegurando uma gestão eficaz dos recursos, a definição clara de prioridades e responsabilidades e o cumprimento dos objectivos estabelecidos.
• Inspirar, motivar e desenvolver os membros da equipa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, orientado para a excelência, a aprendizagem contínua, o desenvolvimento profissional e a melhoria sustentada do desempenho.
• Contribuir activamente para a concretização dos objectivos estratégicos do Grupo em matéria de gestão e desenvolvimento de talento, promovendo o fortalecimento das competências, a valorização do potencial individual e o desenvolvimento de equipas de elevado desempenho.

- 3 a 4 anos de experiência na preparação ou auditoria de demonstrações financeiras em instituições do sector financeiro, incluindo experiência na liderança e coordenação de equipas, assegurando o rigor técnico, o cumprimento dos requisitos regulamentares e a qualidade da informação financeira.

Senior Safety Specialist

Night Shift available

Factor a brand of HelloFresh is seeking an experienced Sr. Safety Specialist to join our team! As Sr. Safety Specialist, you will join forces with the Manager of Safety and Loss Prevention to head up workplace safety initiatives for one of our distribution center operations! You will be on the front lines of production and immerse yourself in the trenches to promote HelloFresh’s vision, inspire change, raise the bar on safety performance, and champion a culture of safety!

You will…

• Work with integrity and the utmost regard for the safety and health at HelloFresh

• Provides subject matter expertise either through education, training, and/or experience in multiple areas including environmental management, compliance, occupational safety, risk management and/or occupational health

• Ensure OSHA compliance within a HelloFresh/Green Chef Facility including but not limited to: Powered Industrial Trucks (PIT’s); New Hire safety training and ongoing safety training; Lockout/Tagout, Machine Guarding and Chemical Safety; all necessary recordkeeping and reporting including OSHA 300 Logs

• Assist management team during accident or injury investigations and root cause analysis

• Act as the management team’s subject matter expert for safety and security questions

• Ensure visibility of HSE initiatives at the site level (Behavior Safety, Safe Work Permit process, Safety Observations, Near Miss, etc) to all levels of operations management and recommend improvements in effectiveness. Demonstrate sound judgment based on observations and evaluation, by site, to determine safety meeting effectiveness and appropriate level of mentoring for safety meeting facilitators. Collect and analyze data to identify safety or injury trends and develop corrective actions

• Ensure contractors and visitors follow HelloFresh safety policies during their time on-site

• Assist with the site emergency action plan and liaison with local first responders when needed

• Conduct a Job Safety Analysis (JSA) of all routine and non-routine tasks performed on-site

• Promote safer forklift operations through training, observation and coaching operators

• Develop training materials including toolbox talks, standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and others

• Manage the relationship with site security and ensures security services are being provided for each DC

• Assist with inventory shrinkage and other deliberate damage/product theft investigations as needed

• Support other departments including quality, food safety, production and logistics as needed

• Use continuous improvement principles to identify ways to improve our processes and results

You are…

• Partner: you effectively listen, build rapport and communicate at all levels; you’re confident sharing ideas and are a trusted advisor for workplace safety

• Results-driven: you recognize and resolve situations that are ambiguous or challenging, focus effort on meeting or exceeding goals, and pave the way for efficiency.

• Programmatic: able to identify the system component that is causing the error, as well as the options available for resolving it and completing the task.

• Inspirational: you know how to make an impact and deliver presentations that inspire and influence change

• Versatile: you roll with the punches and don’t get overwhelmed easily; you enjoy grinding away at issues and have a knack for driving results in hyper-growth, constantly changing environments

You have…

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in occupational safety experience with knowledge of manufacturing/industrial EHS

• Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Occupational Health, or Environmental Health & Safety preferred; will consider high school diploma with 4+ years EHS experience

• Preferred Safety Certification: CSP, ASP, OHST, etc.

• Expertise in OSHA compliance, especially with powered industrial trucks, lockout/tagout, strain and sprain prevention.

• Superior communication and presentation skills with ability to influence across all levels of an organization

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Power Point) and Google app (Gmail, drive, sheets, etc.)

You'll get…

• Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous parental leave of 16 weeks & PTO policy, as well as paid holidays off

• $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans

• Amazing discounts, including up to 75% off HelloFresh subscription

• Flexible shift scheduling & advancement opportunities

• Emergency child and adult care services

• Snacks & monthly catered lunches

• Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

You’ll get…

• Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities

• Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy

jobs.title: Administrador de Sistemas
jobs.description:
O Administrador de Sistemas é responsável pela instalação, configuração, administração, manutenção, monitorização e otimização da infraestrutura de TI da organização. Esta função garante a disponibilidade, a segurança, a fiabilidade e o desempenho dos servidores, das plataformas de virtualização, dos sistemas de armazenamento, dos ambientes de cópia de segurança e das tecnologias de apoio.

O Administrador de Sistemas trabalha em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Rede, Segurança, Bases de Dados, Aplicações e Projetos para dar apoio a serviços críticos para o negócio, resolver incidentes, implementar melhorias na infraestrutura e garantir a conformidade com as normas da organização e os requisitos regulamentares.

Funções Essenciais

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas relacionados com componentes de infraestrutura, incluindo servidores, sistemas de armazenamento, plataformas de virtualização e microservices. Tratar incidentes, realizar análises das causas profundas e implementar medidas corretivas sob a supervisão de especialistas séniores da área.

Desempenhar tarefas abrangentes de administração de sistemas, incluindo a instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas operativos, bases de dados e outro software de infraestrutura.

As responsabilidades incluem a aplicação de atualizações de software e hardware, patches e correções, garantindo uma segurança robusta do sistema e otimizando o desempenho para obter a máxima

eficiência.

Monitorizar o desempenho da infraestrutura de TI e identificar oportunidades de otimização. Implementar ferramentas de monitorização, analisar métricas de desempenho e colaborar na implementação de melhorias para aumentar a fiabilidade e a eficiência do sistema.

Garantir que os componentes da infraestrutura de TI cumprem as políticas e normas de segurança. Implementar proativamente medidas de segurança, realizar auditorias de segurança exaustivas e participar em avaliações abrangentes de vulnerabilidades para mitigar eficazmente os riscos e reforçar a segurança geral do sistema.

Contribuir para a documentação meticulosa das configurações de infraestrutura, procedimentos e passos de resolução de problemas, de modo a garantir clareza e continuidade nas operações técnicas.

Colaborar eficazmente com as equipas de TI, incluindo engenheiros de rede, administradores de sistemas e programadores de aplicações, para resolver problemas e garantir uma integração harmoniosa dos componentes da infraestrutura.

Interagir de forma decisiva com os utilizadores finais e as partes interessadas internas para prestar assistência técnica e resolver problemas de forma rápida e eficaz, dando ênfase à comunicação proativa para antecipar necessidades e prevenir potenciais problemas.

Resolver incidentes e problemas de forma rápida, encaminhar para o apoio de nível superior quando necessário e coordenar a prestação de apoio para garantir que a restauração do serviço cumpra os acordos de nível de serviço. Enfatizar a resolução proativa de problemas para antecipar e abordar potenciais problemas antes que se agravem.

Realizar exercícios de recuperação de desastres conforme orientado pelo regime de Gestão da Continuidade de Negócios (BCM), com o apoio de especialistas técnicos.

Manter uma vantagem competitiva, manter-se atualizado quanto às tendências tecnológicas do setor, melhorias e desenvolvimentos futuros em infraestruturas.

Manter e atualizar continuamente os conhecimentos sobre o domínio técnico relevante das TI, incluindo tecnologias emergentes como a Inteligência Artificial (IA).

Tipo de qualificação: Licenciatura

Área de estudo: Tecnologias da Informação

Certificações preferenciais

• Certificações Microsoft Windows Server
• Administrador de Sistemas Certificado pela Red Hat (RHCSA)
• Engenheiro Certificado pela Red Hat (RHCE)
• Profissional Certificado pela VMware (VCP)

Experiência exigida

Tecnológicas / Produção de Infraestruturas

3-4 anos

Um mínimo de 3 anos de experiência num ambiente de infraestruturas, podendo incluir servidores, plataformas de virtualização, sistemas de armazenamento e microservices. Bom domínio dos princípios ITIL, particularmente na área de Operação de Serviços, abrangendo o Serviço de Assistência, a Gestão de Incidentes, a Gestão de Problemas e a Gestão do Conhecimento.

Competências Comportamentais:

• Adotar abordagens práticas
• Verificar os detalhes
• Documentar os factos
• Aceitar a mudança
• Estabelecer uma boa relação
• Seguir procedimentos
• Interpretar dados
• Cumprir prazos
• Produzir resultados
• Mostrar serenidade
• Tomar medidas
• Trabalho em equipa

Competências Técnicas:

• Microsoft Windows Server
• Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
• Oracle Linux
• Virtualização
• OpenShift Cluster Platform
• Administração de SAN e NAS
• NetApp Storages
• NetBackup
• Armazenamento e Cópias de Segurança

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
D.A. Davidson Companies is an independent, employee-owned company with a rich history spanning 90 years. We are dedicated to conducting our business in accordance with the highest standards of integrity and ethics, and delivering outstanding service to our clients and each other. We support a friendly, open and supportive culture, and encourage candid communication and productive engagement that make our companies and each of us better. Just as we work to improve our clients’ financial well-being, we also work to strengthen local communities—and giving back is one of our core values. You can learn more about our company culture and impact in our latest annual report.


Summary/Function: 
Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chairman & Chief Executive Officer and the Chief Financial Officer of D.A. Davidson Companies, contributing to efficient and effective business operations. Represents the firm as well as the CEO and CFO with both internal and external parties.  Facilitates professional communication with external parties and associates, using sound judgment to determine when escalation is appropriate. 
Qualifications: 
•    Minimum of five years’ experience as an executive assistant, preferably in a professional, regulated and client-facing industry. 
•    Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills. 
•    Sound judgment, initiative and good decision-making and organizational skills. 
•    Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information in an appropriate and professional manner. 
•    Ability to work independently and in higher-pressure situations with no direction. 
•    High attention to detail and drive for accuracy in work product. 
•    Ability to leverage the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and learn new software or systems as needed (e.g. travel & expense system, portal for Board materials). 
•    Ability to proactively work and collaborate effectively both within and across teams to accomplish work responsibilities and objectives. 
•    Ability to maintain regular, predictable attendance and work in the office as required for this position.  
•    Ability to travel from time to time, as business needs require, may include shareholders’ meetings, reward trips, leadership meetings, or other Firm events.
 
Duties: 
•    Perform duties of a highly confidential and time-sensitive nature. Use independent judgment and initiative to complete tasks. This may include attending and participating in confidential meetings. 
•    Coordinate and support Executives’ activities, including calendar management, travel arrangements, expense report preparation and review, coordination of internal and external meetings, and communication between the Executives and Board members, senior executives, associates, clients, prospects or recruits. 
•    Establish sufficient working knowledge of the business operations of the Firm, key company personnel and outside contacts. 
•    Follow policies and procedures. Maintain confidentiality. 
•    Compose, edit and review routing and advanced highly confidential correspondence, including letters, memoranda and reports. This may include taking raw text and transforming it into a professional, well-organized document. 
•    Support Board of Directors and other senior management meeting planning, including preparation of materials, event and logistic coordination, communications, and other administrative duties. 
•    Serve as liaison between the Executives and the Firm’s associates. Provide assistance, troubleshoot problems, provide recommendations and input as requested.
•    Plan, organize and prioritize work to meet deadlines and accomplish tasks within established timeframes. 
•    Assist others within the corporate office and various departments within the company with projects as time allows. Projects may be on-going or short-term. 
•    Support and, as appropriate, lead Great Falls and Firm-centered employee events and activities, including coordination, communication, logistics, and partnership with internal stakeholders.
•    Perform any other duties as assigned. 
 
What we offer:
Competitive salary plus excellent benefits and perks including, but not limited to: 
•    Medical, dental and vision
•    Company 401(k)and ESOP contribution
•    Generous sick, vacation, and maternity/parental leave
•    Paid holidays
•    Professional development opportunities
•    Tuition reimbursement ($15,000 lifetime cap)
•    Discounted personal insurance including home, auto and recreational vehicles
•    Davidson Day of Giving – Our tradition of positively impacting communities in which we live and work!
The compensation offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis considering a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the skills, relevant work experience, and geographic location of each specific candidate.

jobs.description:
Forge Your Future with Us:

At Forge Biologics, we believe in turning bold ideas into life-changing realities. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to enable access to life-changing gene therapies and help bring them from ideas into reality. We partner with scientists, physicians, biotech and pharma innovators, and patient communities — all united by one goal: improving lives. If you’re driven by purpose and excited to make a tangible impact, this is where your journey begins.

Our team works out of The Hearth, a state-of-the-art, 200,000-square-foot cGMP facility in Columbus, Ohio. Here, you won’t just watch innovation happen — you’ll be part of it. Whether you’re scaling AAV manufacturing, collaborating on cutting-edge therapies, or supporting complex technical projects, you’ll play a key role in bringing hope to patients with genetic diseases.

What sets Forge apart is our culture of H.O.P.E. We are hardworking, showing up each day with determination and grit. We are open, creating a space where ideas flow freely and every voice is valued. We are purpose-driven, with every task directly tied to changing lives. And we are engaged, energized by the challenges we face and the milestones we achieve together.

At Forge, your growth matters. We’re committed to helping you expand your skills, take on new challenges, and develop your career through mentorship, hands-on learning, and opportunities for advancement. Our people are our greatest investment, and we’re proud to see team members grow with us.

If you’re ready to use your talent to help deliver hope to patients around the world, join us — and be part of something bigger than yourself.

About The Role:

We are currently seeking a Compliance Specialist Lead, to join the Forge Biologics team. This position will drive both the strategy and the delivery for Regulatory and Quality Compliance Initiatives, and this individual also oversees the GMP Internal Audit program. This person will support improvement initiatives related to the Quality Management Review (QMR), and support External Audit program, and processes to ensure Forge’s compliance with the appropriate regulatory agency requirements, internal company standards, client requirements, and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs).

Responsibilities:

• Ownership of the Internal Audit process, planning, execution and verification of actions.

• Support Regulatory Compliance/Quality Representatives and apply regulatory knowledge and judgment to identify potential compliance concerns and identify potential remediation action.

• Track corrective actions as a result of audit observations and obtains and reviews objective evidence as actions are completed in accordance with prescribed commitments.

• Support and update Site Governance and Standard Operating Procedures, Training and content/delivery. Promote audit/ inspection ready culture.

• Support the coordination of Management Review includes monitoring the overall health of the Quality system through evaluation of KPIs, effectiveness checks, and risk management.

• Partner with internal departments (e.g. Manufacturing, Quality, Facilities and Engineering) to ensure end-to-end compliance throughout the product lifecycle and commercial readiness.

• Exemplifies good quality and compliance practices while championing Quality Culture throughout the organization.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in related discipline with 5+ years of compliance experience in a regulated industry (i.e., regulatory compliance experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or biologics GMP regulated manufacturing environment).

• Excellent analytical, communication, and problem solving skills

Preferred Skills:

Primarily office-based with extended computer use. Regular interaction with internal teams and external stakeholders. When on-site, adherence to safety requirements and use of PPE may be necessary.

Position requires prolonged sitting, reviewing detailed documentation, occasional standing/walking during site audits, and the ability to lift up to 15 pounds (e.g., files or laptop equipment).

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Data Center Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Department

Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.

You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.

The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.

This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership

• Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.
• Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.
• Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.

Site Delivery

• Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.
• Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.
• Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.

Production Operations

• Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.
• Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.

Documentation and DCIM

• Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.
• Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.
• Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.

Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle

• Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.
• Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.

Security and Compliance

• Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.
• Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.
• Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.

Automation and Operational Efficiency

• Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.
• Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.
• Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.

Business Reporting

• Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.
• Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.

Who You Are

A builder who stays to operate. You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.

A leader of distributed teams. You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.

Firm with partners. You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.

Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist. You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.

Automation-first. When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.

Required Experience

• 6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.
• A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.
• Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.
• Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.
• Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.
• Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.
• Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.
• Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.
• Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.
• Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.
• Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.
• Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.
• A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.
• Ability to travel regularly to data center sites. Expect more frequent travel during site builds, shifting to periodic visits as sites reach steady state.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience standing up a new data center operations function or region from zero.
• Background at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly fast-scaling infrastructure company.
• Experience with ITAD vendor programs and secure destruction requirements.
• Experience with PagerDuty or similar on-call and incident tooling.
• Familiarity with DCIM and source-of-truth tooling such as NetBox or Nlyte, Jira-based operational workflows, and Confluence documentation practices.
• Experience with remote-hands programs and vendor scorecards.
• Background in hardware diagnostics, burn-in or automated build validation.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
