jobs.description:
LLR Partners is hiring a Principal, Investor Relations and Capital Formation to partner with LLR’s Head of Investor Relations across fundraising strategy, execution, and team leverage. This is a senior, high trust role to help translate LLR’s investment approach and value-creation capabilities into clear fundraising strategy and compelling communications for current and prospective investors, while building the operating discipline required for a scalable IR function. The role combines complex project leadership and content development with direct Limited Partner (LP), consultant, and placement-agent engagement.

Accountabilities

• Partner with the Head of Investor Relations on the integrated plan for LLR’s next fundraising cycle, including priorities, workplans, milestones, and cross-functional execution.

• Own a meaningful coverage lane with selected LPs, consultants, placement agents, and other capital partners; build trusted relationships and coordinate timely, tailored communications.

• Create a reliable operating cadence across Investor Relations, Finance, Legal, the investment team, Value Creation, and external providers, with clear ownership, deadlines, approvals, and version control.

• Strengthen the team’s systems, CRM discipline, pipeline visibility, reporting, and repeatable processes as LLR continues to grow.

• Help shape team priorities, ways of working, and development while concurrently supporting the quality and consistency of the firm’s investor-facing work.

• 10+ years of experience in investor relations, capital formation, placement advisory, private-markets consulting, asset management, or a related private-markets role.

jobs.title: Project Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.


POSITION SUMMARY

We are hiring a Maintenance Mechanic for our new project team at our Moab site, formerly Lisbon Mines, to assemble and install equipment for new projects.

The ideal candidate is motivated by change and wants to be part of a growing company. The work varies week to week, from setting up equipment and supporting construction builds to helping controls projects come together. As one of the first members of a new project team, you'll often own a job from start to finish and build new skills along the way.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Assemble, install, and set up equipment for new and ongoing projects

 - Support construction-type projects, from small builds to equipment installs

 - Work with mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems as projects require

 - Plan and carry out small projects independently, from materials to completion

 - Partner with the project electrician and project engineer to bring projects online

 - Troubleshoot and solve problems on the fly when things don't go to plan

 - Keep work areas safe, organized, and compliant with site safety standards


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Mid-level experience as a maintenance mechanic, millwright, industrial mechanic, or similar

 - Strong mechanical aptitude and a proven ability to assemble and install equipment

 - Working knowledge across multiple areas, such as hydraulics, pneumatics, fabrication, or light electrical

 - Comfort working independently on small projects with minimal supervision

 - Ability to read mechanical drawings and schematics

 - A willingness to take on work outside your comfort zone

 - Mining or construction experience is welcome but not required; manufacturing and other industrial backgrounds are a great fit


SCHEDULE

 - Monday-Friday days


WORKING ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Lift at least 50 lbs, with exposure to dust, noise, vibration and diesel

 - Wear all required PPE (hard hat, steel toes, safety glasses, hi-vis, hearing protection, and a respirator when required)


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.title: Senior Guidance, Navigation, and Controls (GNC) Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

As a Senior Guidance, Navigation, and Controls (GNC) Engineer, you will own the full life cycle of GNC development at Varda, from design through to unit, hardware-in-the-loop, on-vehicle functionality, and flight testing. You will perform system analyses, including simulations and Monte Carlo, to satisfy specifications and requirements and to drive system-level architectural and business decisions. You will contribute to a sophisticated multi-degree of freedom in-house aerospace simulation and test framework and develop and maintain design descriptions and supporting documentation. You'll see end to end execution of the GNC subsystem from initial analysis/design through vehicle integration, mission planning and flight through support of on-orbit and reentry mission operations.

Responsibilities

• ADCS hardware performance specification including sizing of reaction wheels, torque rods, IMU/GPS, and star trackers

• Design and implementation of autonomous satellite attitude control, collision avoidance, orbital rendezvous, burn planning and atmospheric re-entry algorithms

• Perform trajectory design, optimization, and dispersion analysis for the reentry of a space capsule

• Develop 6 degree of freedom vehicle simulation using C++, Python and MATLAB/Simulink

• Running Monte Carlo analysis to characterize performance of new vehicle and mission capabilities

• Integration and testing of GNC sensors, actuators, and software in hardware-in-the-loop environment

• Design and implementation of ground tooling necessary to facilitate fully automated maneuver responsibility and maneuver scheduling decisions

• Monitoring on-orbit system performance; troubleshooting where necessary

• Coordination with other spacecraft operators, 3rd party agencies, and the US government

Basic Qualifications

• B.S. degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or related field

• 5+ proven years of experience, or PhD with 3+ years of relevant experience

• Demonstrated knowledge in designing, modeling, testing, and flying aerospace guidance, navigation, and control systems

• Highly adept software and model development skills, particularly in C++/Python

• Understanding of orbital mechanics, modeling and simulation, and software development

• Experience anchoring/fitting first principles models to test data or high-fidelity external simulations

• Proven system engineering and configuration management skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Master's degree in engineering or physics

• Experience with spacecraft attitude determination and control system design

• Experience with GMAT, POST2, or similar tools

• Understanding of multi-body dynamics, flexible body dynamics, gas dynamics, fluids, and thermodynamics

• Experience developing and verifying physical models for the purpose of control design, component sizing, and system performance evaluation

• Experience supporting safety critical flight tests or spacecraft

• Ability to continuously manage risk and provide solutions with lean and state of the art software development techniques

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior GNC: $169,067 - $216,031/per year

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance

• You will be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The News Product team at The New York Times is looking for a Staff iOS Engineer. You will work with our Native squad to lay the foundations for satisfying native app experiences. You will deliver world-class journalism to millions of daily readers in a responsive and performant medium. You will lead efforts to enhance the quality, performance, and long-term maintainability of the News app codebase. You will establishing a technical vision that ensures our native experiences remain responsive and reliable for all readers. As part of the News Product organization, you will work with designers, other mobile engineers, and web engineers, and more on a team.

This is an opportunity to use different tools, ranging from SwiftUI to hybrid web technologies - whatever will best solve the problem at hand. You'll be part of an engineering organization that values transparency and openness, diversity, learning, community, and continuous improvement.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

You express:

• Belief in our mission: You have passion with the news and for making the Times an indispensable daily destination for our readers.

• Technical competency: You have knowledge of iOS frameworks and Swift, and keep up to date on changes in the frameworks, language and overall developer community.

• Code cleanliness: You understand what makes code well structured, maintainable and flexible and aim to create a culture where quality code is valued.

• User focus: You care about how design, engineering and product decisions help create a seamless, engaging and enjoyable user experience.

Responsibilities:

• You will lead the design and implementation of core architectures, shared frameworks, and infrastructure using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit that accelerate our feature teams.

• You will work with your team to build solutions that are scalable, maintainable and reliable.

• You will guide app-wide architectural decisions, shape the long-term technical roadmap, and set engineering standards for the iOS platform.

• You will lead technical understanding, collaborating with backend engineers, web teams, and other internal dependency owners.

• You will help promote standards in iOS and Swift delivery, and engage with the community of iOS developers at the Times.

• You will lead programs to help the quality, performance and maintainability of the News app codebase

• You will mentor engineers and contribute to/participate in Communities of Practice

• Where applicable, you will integrate with broader New York Times Swift platform code

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on large-scale iOS applications.

• Experience setting technical direction, guiding engineering teams, and leading mobile architecture.

• Deep mastery of iOS runtime mechanics, memory management, advanced design patterns, and Swift Concurrency.

• Hands-on experience designing complex data persistence layers, advanced networking, and scalable test suites.

• Expertise in mobile performance engineering, including app launch optimization, binary size reduction, and memory profiling.

• Experience designing client-side observability infrastructure using Datadog or similar platforms.

• Experience orchestrating large-scale architectural migrations (e.g., UI framework shifts, monolithic decoupling, automated refactoring).

• Experience with framework design and modularization, including internal SDK development.

• Product and Developer Experience (DX) mindset with the vision to translate complex goals and developer friction into scalable code.

jobs.title: Director, People Business Partnership
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Your core mandate is to help make Imprint, person for person, the most extraordinary group of builders anyone will ever have the privilege to work alongside and ensure every seat stays extraordinary.⁠

As a trusted people partner to leaders across the business, you’ll build teams where every role matters and people can do the best work of their careers. At the heart of that mission: making Imprint the home of the best managers people will ever work for.

You’ll set a high bar and help leaders meet it through clear expectations, honest feedback, and evidence-based coaching. This is hands-on, heart-in work: asking brave questions, challenging decisions, and helping leaders build teams that achieve extraordinary things—and grow stronger along the way.


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Shape the decisions that shape the business. Partner with executives as a trusted advisor who knows their teams, plans, and pressure points as well as they do. Anticipate needs before they become problems and challenge people decisions with evidence.

 - Make Imprint the home of the best leaders. Hold the bar for management. Ensure that every employee at Imprint has the best manager of their career. Define clear expectations for what great management looks like here and give managers the coaching, tools, data, and tight feedback loops that show them at any moment where they need to get stronger. Combine employee feedback, team outcomes, and people data to identify where leaders need support or intervention

 - Make clarity and feedback an everyday experience. Help managers translate company priorities into clear individual expectations and observable standards of great work. Build a rhythm of meaningful check-ins, timely recognition, and direct, actionable feedback so employees always know where they stand. Make performance reviews a useful reflection of ongoing conversations, not the first time someone hears how they are doing.

 - Turn strong performance into extraordinary growth. Help managers turn real work into meaningful development through stretch opportunities, coaching, and clear career conversations. Partner on career frameworks, succession, and internal mobility so employees can see a future at Imprint and leaders build the next generation of talent, not just deliver the next milestone.

 - Build teams that sustain extraordinary performance. Help leaders build the conditions for ambitious work that people can sustain. Surface overloaded teams, conflicting priorities, and single points of failure early. Coach managers to make explicit trade-offs about what to do, what to stop, and what to resource differently, so success comes from focus, strong systems, and growing capability, not recurring heroics.

 - Shape how Imprint is built to grow. Partner with leaders and Finance on team structures, spans and layers, and organizational changes. Establish a consistent planning framework so teams are adequately staffed for major partner launches.

 - Lead the company through change. Partner with executives to plan and execute major transitions, including reorgs, pivots, and shifts in strategy. Own the change management and communication plans, equip managers to lead their teams through each move, and measure whether the change landed.

 - Leverage people data to drive real change. Use exit interviews, engagement surveys, and workforce data to identify root causes, recommend action, and measure results.

 - Be the standard for fairness. Handle complex employee relations matters and investigations with discretion, sound judgment, consistent standards, and appropriate legal partnership across California, New York, and other states.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 7-10+ years of HR experience, including significant experience partnering with senior executives in a high-growth or scaling company.

 - Substantial experience handling employee relations matters and involuntary departures, with the ability to coach leaders through difficult conversations with candor and care.

 - Deep expertise in organization design, performance management, and leadership development and the judgment to diagnose what a leader or team actually needs.

 - A data-informed approach: you use quantitative and qualitative evidence to diagnose problems, build the case for change, and assess whether it worked.

 - A track record of improving how managers lead, not just delivering manager training. You have helped leaders establish clear expectations, give useful feedback, develop talent, and address unsustainable ways of working, with evidence that employees experienced the difference.

 - The ability to earn credibility with executives, including technical leaders, and deliver advice that is clear, direct, and grounded in the business.

 - Self-starter who moves with urgency and takes initiative without waiting for permission

 - Proven ability to lead through high-growth moments, organizational crises, and company pivots.

 - Exceptionally high emotional intelligence. You are able to navigate sensitive conversations with directness and care

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building useful structure rather than waiting for it.

 - Practical AI fluency and curiosity about how agents and automation can improve the way HR works.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.

 - Experience as an executive coach.

 - Experience leading a team of HR Business Partners.

 - Experience supporting a multi-state workforce, particularly in California and New York.




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity
   
   

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Not just resolving the issue, but leaving the person on the other end feeling like they were heard, helped, and didn't have to explain themselves twice. You've worked a queue before. You know what it means to triage well, communicate clearly under pressure, and stay patient when the person you're talking to isn't.

At Fixify, we're building an AI-native IT automation platform that combines technology with a human touch. The "human touch" part isn't a tagline. It's the job. Our Help Desk Analysts are the people who make that real for our customers every day. You'll work directly with end users, collaborate with customer IT teams, and partner with Engineering to improve the workflows that reduce toil for everyone. The work you do shows up immediately, in real customer experiences, across companies that depend on us to keep things running.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the queue, on the tools, and in the conversation, covering shifts across a 24/7/365 support operation. If you want to do real support work at a company where support actually matters, this is it.

What we can do for you

• Put you at the center of a product where IT support is the whole point, not a cost center.

• Give you direct exposure to automation and AI workflows that are actively changing how IT support gets done.

• Surround you with analysts, engineers, and customer IT teams who take quality seriously and share what they know.

• Give you space to build expertise across a broad technical stack in a fast-moving environment.

What you can do for us

• Deliver prompt, high-quality technical support to end users — diagnosing and resolving issues across productivity tools, operating systems, and identity and access management.

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers through every interaction, including the complicated ones.

• Collaborate with Engineering to develop and improve IT automation workflows that reduce manual work over time.

• Participate in shift rotations as part of a 24/7/365 support operation.

What you should bring with you

• 2+ years of experience in an IT support role.

• Working knowledge of productivity tools, including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Slack — and the ability to troubleshoot and explain them to others.

• Working knowledge of Windows and macOS for diagnosing and resolving common issues.

• Working knowledge of help desk and ticketing systems, including tools like Jira, ServiceNow, and Freshdesk.

• Working knowledge of identity and access management practices and tools.

• Working knowledge of TCP/IP and common network protocols, with the ability to address typical network issues.

• Familiarity with Mobile Device Management platforms — experience with JAMF is a plus.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills; you can explain technical issues to non-technical people without making them feel small.

• Strong instincts for prioritisation and decision-making when multiple things need attention at once.

• A collaborative working style — you're effective across teams, time zones, and org boundaries.

Perks & benefits

• Flexible work environment: 100% remote with flexible core working hours

• Time to recharge: Unlimited PTO plus 12 paid federal holidays

• Connectivity stipend: $150 monthly to support cell phone, internet, or equipment expenses

• Retirement: Participation in our 401(k) program

• Equity: Option grants to purchase shares through Fixify's equity program

• Health insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of your deductible covered by Fixify

• Parental leave: Paid parental leave for birth, adoption, or surrogacy

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
This role is based in our Irving, TX office.

The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying and securing new business opportunities. While focused on a specific brand, the role also requires adaptability across multiple brands. Emphasizing consultative sales, you will proactively engage prospective clients to expand Informa’s market presence, increase customer acquisition, and drive new revenue streams.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and engage high-value prospects with compelling proposals, guiding them through the buying process.
• Apply consultative selling techniques to uncover customer needs and present tailored solutions.
• Build industry-specific knowledge by attending competitor events, analyzing market trends, and sharing insights across the team.
• Collaborate with Marketing to create packages and campaigns that attract new customers and support revenue growth.
• Leverage insights into customer buying trends to develop effective sales plans and approaches targeting new accounts.
• Use Salesforce to track client interactions, opportunities, and forecasts that are up to date and accurate.

• Represent Informa at industry events, competitor shows, and networking opportunities to generate leads and expand market reach.
• Build and maintain relationships with senior-level decision-makers to secure new partnerships and sponsorships.
• Conduct market research to identify emerging trends and opportunities for business growth.
• Actively engage with prospective clients to position Informa as a trusted partner in their industry.

• Prepare detailed reports on sales performance, market trends, and ROI for senior leadership.
• Develop pricing strategies and proposals to maximize profitability and close deals effectively.
• Meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly sales activity and revenue targets.

Performance Targets

• Lead Generation: Achieve daily call/email quotas to identify and qualify new prospects.
• Revenue Growth: Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets through new business acquisition.
• Market Expansion: Secure new accounts and partnerships to increase Informa’s market share.
• Sales Activity: Maintain consistent outreach and engagement with prospective clients.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• 5-7 years of B2B sales experience ideally in media, sponsorship, or B2B events, with proven revenue achievement

• Strong expertise in lead generation, consultative selling, and closing high-value deals.
• Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to develop creative solutions and identify new opportunities for growth.
• Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) for pipeline management and reporting.
• High energy and resilience to thrive in a competitive sales environment.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive approach to managing sales territory.
• Willingness to travel up to 50% for client meetings, industry events, and business development activities.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

We work hard to make sure Life at Informa is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. Here’s some of what you can expect when you join us. But don’t just take our word for it – see what our colleagues have to say at LifeAt.Informa.com

Our benefits include:

• Great community: a welcoming culture with in-person and online social events, our fantastic Walk the World charity day and active colleague groups and networks promoting a positive, supportive, and collaborative work environment
• Broader impact: take up to four days per year to volunteer, with charity match funding available too
• Career opportunity: the opportunity to develop your career with bespoke training and learning, mentoring platforms and on-demand access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning. When it’s time for the next step, we encourage and support internal job moves
• Time out: 15 days PTO rising to 20 after three years and 25 after six years, plus 10 national holidays, a birthday leave day and the chance to work from (almost!) anywhere for up to four weeks a year
• Competitive benefits, including a 401k match, health, vision and dental insurance, parental leave and an ESPP offering company shares at a minimum 15% discount
• Strong wellbeing support through EAP assistance, mental health first aiders, free access to a wellness app and more
• Recognition for great work, with global awards and kudos programs
• As an international company, the chance to collaborate with teams around the world

This posting will expire on Nov 2, 2026.

We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills. We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll their sleeves up, join in and help make things happen. If it sounds like a match and you have most – although not all – of the skills and experience listed, we welcome your application.

Your request will be reviewed and considered in confidence. At Informa, you'll find inclusive experiences and environments where all perspectives and backgrounds are welcomed. jobs.title: Electrical Technician
jobs.description:
The Electrical Technician will build and test electrical systems to specifications, install industrial equipment, and support maintenance activities that help keep operations running efficiently. Work with electrical schematics, assembling components, and solving technical challenges.

What You'll Do

• Build & Wire: Complete point-to-point wiring and install electrical, electronic, and electromechanical components according to schematics, blueprints, and specifications.
• Test & Troubleshoot: Install, test, and troubleshoot electrical components, assemblies, and systems to ensure quality and reliable performance.
• Support Manufacturing Operations: Assist with the installation of industrial plant equipment and help improve assembly efficiency and productivity.
• Work with Industrial Systems: Support the installation of pneumatic and hydraulic lines, valves, regulators, pumps, and related equipment.
• Perform Hands-On Fabrication: Use hand and power tools to drill, grind, cut, bend, thread, deburr, and fabricate components as needed.
• Partner with Maintenance: Assist with preventive maintenance, mechanical troubleshooting and repairs, facility upkeep, and other maintenance activities.
• Maintain a Safe Workplace: Follow established procedures, use equipment properly, maintain an organized work area, and consistently support Pyrotek's safety program.
• Document Your Work: Maintain accurate departmental records and complete required paperwork and computer transactions.

What You'll Bring

Required:

• High school diploma or GED/TASC equivalent.
• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, blueprints, and technical drawings.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical instructions and established safety procedures.
• Hands-on capability using a variety of hand and power tools.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
• Commitment to workplace safety, quality workmanship, and continuous learning.

Preferred:

• Three or more years of experience building and troubleshooting electrical projects in an industrial environment.
• Working knowledge of electrical circuits, switches, sensors, actuators, motors, grounding, electromechanical devices, and electrical control systems.
• Basic knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
• Experience with industrial equipment and material-handling devices such as forklifts, overhead cranes, or electric pallet jacks.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

Your Work Environment

This is a hands-on role in a shop-floor industrial manufacturing setting. Will work around industrial machinery, overhead cranes, moving vehicles, vibration, and airborne particles. The environment can be noisy, and appropriate personal protective equipment is required.

The position involves frequent standing, walking, and hands-on work, with occasional lifting or moving of items weighing up to 50 pounds.

jobs.title: Sr. Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This is a high-trust Executive Assistant role supporting three VPs within Mozilla's Core Services Leadership Team: VP, Engineering; VP, Information Technology; and VP, Security. Together, these leaders oversee the infrastructure, systems, and technical operations that power Mozilla's products and protect our users and organization.

You'll be the operational backbone for three fast-moving senior leaders, keeping their time and priorities running smoothly while navigating a complex, cross-functional environment with discretion and sound judgment. You'll work regularly with executive leadership (and their EAs), technical teams, and external partners, so poise, adaptability, and a proactive mindset matter as much as strong execution.

What you'll do:

• Act as a key point of contact between executives, their teams, and internal/external partners, ensuring timely communication and follow-up.

• Handle sensitive information with the highest degree of discretion.

• Manage a wide range of administrative tasks including calendar management, domestic and international travel coordination, expense reports, etc.

• Support execs across US time zones.

• Coordinate internal and external meetings.

• Plan logistics and events for team and exec offsites and work weeks.

• Build relationships within the organization. Establish and maintain trusted working partnerships through regular communication, a clear understanding of stakeholder needs, and consistent follow-through.

What you'll bring:

• 5+ years of administrative experience in a technology company and multi location environment working on administrative tasks for 1 or more executives (e.g., travel management, expense reports, calendar management, etc.).

• Experience in coordinating with sensitive, high stakes external teams.

• Attention to detail, manage ambiguity, and foster a team culture.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Great at taking initiative and solving problems.

• Experience with Google Suite.

• Commitment to our values:

• Welcoming differences

• Being relationship-minded

• Practicing responsible participation

• Having grit

What you’ll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

• Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

• Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

• One-time home office stipend

• Annual professional development budget

• Quarterly well-being stipend

• Considerable paid parental leave

• Employee referral bonus program

• Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

jobs.title: Global EA Finance Business Partner
jobs.description:
The Global EA Finance Business Partner delivers strategic financial insight and constructive challenge to senior leadership, leads initiatives to enhance financial performance, and provides leadership to finance teams across assigned business areas. The role is responsible for driving financial performance, developing talent, ensuring strong financial governance, and supporting strategic business decision-making across the EA organization.

This position ensures optimum performance, accountability, and financial transparency for the EA business, working closely with sector leadership and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment of financial objectives, forecasts, and operational performance.

The role is suited to an experienced finance professional with a minimum of 7 years of progressive finance experience and a minimum 2 years of direct people management responsibility, capable of influencing senior stakeholders and leading finance teams within a complex global environment.

Responsibilities will comprise supporting multiple areas, including but not limited to:

Business Partnering and Commercial Support

• Provide finance business partnering support to senior commercial and operational leaders, offering clear financial insights and constructive challenge.
• Prepare, review, and present the annual corporate budget and periodic reforecasts for assigned accounts.
• Ensure alignment between global and regional EA financial budgets, forecasts, and actual performance.
• Review, challenge, and validate assumptions provided by accounts across the region regarding business activities and financial outcomes.
• Support decision-making through forward-looking analysis, forecasting, scenario modelling, and risk assessment.
• Identify and prioritize financial improvement initiatives that enhance profitability, efficiency, compliance, and business performance.
• Work alongside the FP&A team to produce budgets, forecasts, bid and commercial reviews, and ad hoc financial analysis.
• Support the Financial Control team in the production of monthly variance analysis and management commentary.
• Ensure financial controls and accounting policies are applied consistently, working in partnership with the Financial Control team.
• Oversee the financial integrity of contracts within the assigned sector, ensuring compliance with company policies and accounting requirements.
• Drive standardization, simplification, and best practices across contract accounting and financial management processes.
• Influence strategic and operational decision-making through financial analysis, performance insights, and recommendations.
• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across finance, commercial, and operational functions.
• Ensure accurate and timely reporting of financial performance, risks, and opportunities.

People Leadership and Team Management

• Lead, manage, and develop finance team members, establishing clear objectives and performance expectations.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus within the finance team.
• Provide coaching, mentoring, and development opportunities to build team capability and support career progression.
• Drive succession planning and talent development to ensure a sustainable and high-performing finance function.
• Support organizational change initiatives and promote adoption of new processes and ways of working.

Governance and Compliance

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, financial controls, and governance requirements.
• Support internal and external audit activities as required.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role and must be adhered to where applicable.

• Minimum 7 years' progressive experience in finance, commercial finance, FP&A, finance business partnering, or related finance roles.
• Minimum 2 years of direct people management experience, including responsibility for coaching, performance management, talent development, and leading high-performing teams.
• Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
• Strong commercial awareness and the ability to provide constructive challenge to support business decision-making.
• Experience partnering with senior commercial and operational leaders within a complex business environment.
• Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling, and performance reporting processes.
• Strong understanding of financial reporting, contract profitability, revenue recognition principles, and financial controls.
• Ability to manage a diverse portfolio of contracts, prioritizing issues, risks, and interventions effectively.
• Experience driving process improvement, standardization, and financial governance across multiple business areas.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
• Ability to work independently while effectively managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Brand Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Brand Strategy Lead to own the Base brand as we grow into the country’s most beloved energy company.

 

Base started by serving early adopters in Texas. Now we’re bringing reliable, affordable home backup to households who have never heard of us. That takes a brand built on a deep understanding of our members, and it takes campaigns that turn that understanding into growth.

 

You will be the owner of brand strategy at Base. You’ll build the research systems that make you the voice of the member. You’ll write the positioning that every touchpoint is built on, and you’ll lead the brand campaigns that introduce Base to new markets. You’ll work closely with design, growth, sales, and leadership. You’ll get the strategy right, and you’ll make sure the work ships.

 

This role is for a strategist who is also a doer. You have strong opinions on brand, you can back them up with data, and you hold every campaign to a number.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and run research systems that show how our members think, decide, and talk about Base, using sales call recordings, social listening, qualitative interviews, and quantitative surveys

 - Turn research into sharp insights and campaign strategies, and be the voice of the member across the company

 - Partner with design as a thought partner to build creative that stays true to the brand and also moves it forward

 - Write clear, distinctive positioning for each product and market, and keep it consistent across every marketing touchpoint

 - Lead integrated brand campaigns from brief to launch, including market launches in new states

 - Test creative concepts with real audiences before committing media spend

 - Set campaign goals tied to business outcomes

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of experience in brand strategy, strategic planning, or brand marketing, at an agency, a consumer brand, or both

 - A portfolio of integrated campaigns you led from strategy through execution, with clear results

 - Hands-on experience running qualitative and quantitative research and turning it into positioning

 - Strong creative taste and the ability to give clear, useful direction to designers and creative partners

 - Comfort working through a full funnel, from awareness to signup, and building an ideal customer profile (ICP) from data

 - A doer’s mentality: you write the brief, sit in on sales calls, and stay close to the work

 - First principles thinking, grit, and a bias toward shipping

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Marketing team owns how homeowners first hear about Base, come to understand it, and decide to join. Most of the people we reach have never thought about where their power comes from until it goes out. Our job is to make a new kind of power company feel simple, credible, and obvious. We work side by side with sales, product, and design, and our results directly decide how fast Base can grow into new markets.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
The Legal team at Asana works collaboratively across functions to achieve our ambitious mission of fostering effortless teamwork for everyone. We are a tightly-knit and cooperative group committed to supporting teams throughout the organization, ensuring they have the necessary resources for success while protecting Asana's core values and interests. Within our team, we exchange ideas, collectively solve problems, and collaborate with other groups to navigate through challenging issues. We’re looking for a Commercial Counsel to join our Commercial Legal team, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders with a primary focus on supporting our global sales organization. In this role, you will report directly to the Global Head of Commercial Legal.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Partner closely with sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders—including Finance, Deal Desk, Privacy, and Security—to support high-velocity deal cycles in the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and Japan regions.

• Draft, negotiate, and advise on outbound commercial agreements and strategic partnership agreements with enterprise customers, including SaaS agreements and related agreements such as DPAs, BAAs, Product-Specific Terms, and AI terms.

• Act as a trusted legal advisor to sales teams, delivering timely and practical guidance, and driving transaction structures that align with Asana’s policies and business objectives.

• Train sales teams on common commercial issues and best practices in support of closing transactions efficiently.

• Apply innovative thinking to the development and scaling of commercial legal team best practices and resources—including internal knowledge-sharing materials, scalable frameworks, legal playbooks, and standards that drive deal velocity and quality.

• Stay current on emerging global laws, regulatory shifts, and judicial decisions relevant to our business (including competition and data protection laws), conducting thorough research to proactively adapt internal legal guidelines.

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

• J.D. degree from an accredited institution and active membership in good standing with a U.S. state bar association.

• 4+ years of experience practicing law, including significant in-house experience at a technology company supporting a sales organization on complex, high-velocity outbound revenue transactions with enterprise customers, including SaaS agreements and related agreements such as DPAs, BAAs, Product-Specific Terms, and AI terms.

• Proven background collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Revenue Accounting, Deal Desk, Privacy, Security, and Legal Operations to move deals toward closing.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $202,000 - $229,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. jobs.title: Lead Business Process Improvement
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Business Process Improvement (BPI) Lead you are responsible for driving large-scale, cross-functional improvement projects that help to improve customer support for our community.

You will deliver new process designs and process improvements for key priority Community Support (CS) Roadmap programs, where you will take on responsibilities for process analysis, process design, pilot design and execution, and control plan development to improve the user experience.

You will work cross-functionally with other Shared Services functions, Policy, and Product  teams to lead the process impact assessment and subsequent process design for high priority changes. You will drive continuous improvement with these cross functional partners to increase overall operational efficiency, customer experience, and process quality.

You will use and improve AI tools in order to design and implement process measurement systems, analyze process data and utilize this information to drive decision making, successful improvement projects to completion, and propose Continuous Improvement projects. You will create queries and utilize data analytics tools to support process improvement efforts. You will validate analytics with your data partners.

You will be responsible for the delivery of successful improvement projects with measurable positive impact and also transition these solutions to operations for sustained results including feature launches throughout the year.

A Typical Day:

• Leads large cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.

• Apply systems thinking: mapping full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.

• Design processes for AI-readiness and automation, including designing around three standards: reduce agent and customer burden, measurable from day one, and ability to be automated or self-correcting over time.

• Build some AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.

• Use some basic process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.

• Continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.

• Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.

• Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.

• Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.

• Communicate progress and findings to leadership, distilling complex analysis into clear narratives with a line of sight to measurable outcomes

• Organizes their work, keeps project stakeholders updated, and is able to work autonomously to drive progress across stakeholders.

Your Expertise:

• Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.

• 5+ years of post-graduate experience in operations (industrial engineering or similar preferred experience)

• Advanced knowledge of customer service and contact center operations

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certified or equivalent process engineering expertise. Additional consideration given to Agile, service design, and Industrial and Systems Engineering experience.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve quality and efficiency within internal workflows.

• Demonstrated ability to design processes for AI-readiness and automation.

• Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity with creative problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with minimal direction.

• Strong statistical and data-driven analytical skills, including statistical process control methods, regression analysis, and measurement system analysis.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to travel up to 20% of time

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$132,000—$155,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Senior Build Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Build Reliability Engineer partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

Responsibilities

• Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.

• Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.

• Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.

• Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.

• Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.

• Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.

• Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.

• 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.

• Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.

• Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.

• Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.

• Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).

• Proficiency with quality tools such as measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem-solving approaches.

• Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, additive manufacturing, casting, welding, fastening, or other special manufacturing processes.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

jobs.description:
Director, Accounting -  TV Networks HQ Central

We are seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Director, Accounting – TV Networks HQ Central to lead critical accounting operations supporting the TV Networks businesses at Versant. Reporting to the Controller, TV Networks, this role will help to oversee the accounting and reporting of the Central Services Agreement (CSA) between Versant and NBCUniversal and serve as the key accounting partner to the Content Distribution business.

The Director will lead centralization efforts across the TV Networks Controllership organization, driving process improvements, ERP transformation and help to build the accounting foundation of a newly independent public company.  The ideal candidate thrives in environments of change, enjoys building structure within evolving organizations, and brings a combination of strong technical accounting expertise, operational leadership, and process improvement experience.

About Versant TV Networks

TV Networks is home to Versant's portfolio of leading news, sports, and entertainment brands, including CNBC, MSNBC, E!, Oxygen, SYFY, and Golf Channel. The Central Accounting team supports these iconic brands by providing financial stewardship and delivering accounting operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Leadership

• Manage the accounting and governance of the Central Services Agreement (CSA) between Versant and NBCUniversal, including shared services supporting advertising sales, TV content distribution, and other transition service arrangements.
• Lead accounting for the Content Distribution business, including journal entries, reconciliations, variance analysis, subscriber audits and financial reporting.
• Manage month-end close activities, balance sheet integrity, reconciliations, and reporting for the Central Accounting team.
• Oversee accounting for cross-brand transactions and strategic initiatives.

Business Partnership & Transformation

• Partner with Technical Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Business Unit Controllership, Treasury, Legal, Accounting Operations, FP&A, Tax, Technology, Internal Audit, and external auditors to support business initiatives and resolve complex accounting matters.
• Lead accounting process improvements, standardization, documentation, and ERP implementation initiatives to build scalable processes and strengthen internal controls.

• Identify accounting issues, implement sustainable solutions, and improve processes through automation, standardization, and strong governance.
• Ensure compliance with US GAAP, SOX requirements, and company accounting policies.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or a related field; CPA required
• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leadership responsibility within a complex organization.
• Big Four or other similar public accounting experience and/or public company experience preferred.
• Strong technical accounting knowledge, including financial reporting, month-end close, reconciliations, balance sheet governance, and SOX.
• Experience in media, entertainment, advertising sales, content distribution, licensing, or other complex revenue environments preferred.
• Ability to interpret contracts and translate key terms into appropriate accounting treatment and reporting requirements.
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to partner effectively with Accounting, Finance, Content Distribution, Corporate and external auditors.
• Detail-oriented and highly organized, with a strong commitment to accuracy, completeness, and process discipline.
• Proactive problem-solver who can identify issues, investigate root causes, and drive practical resolutions.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced close environment with competing priorities and evolving business needs.
• Collaborative team player with the ability to lead through influence, build relationships, and support team development.
• Strong systems aptitude, including experience with ERP systems, reporting tools, and reconciliation or close-management platforms preferred.

Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to process documentation, with the ability to establish scalable, well-controlled accounting processes and maintain high standards of accuracy and accountability

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Subject to change based on business need. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

This is a rare opportunity to help build the accounting foundation of a newly independent media company. Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Job Overview

Align is seeking an Operations Manager to drive operational excellence across our Managed Services and Professional Services organizations. This role will develop the operating processes, performance insights, dashboards, forecasting models, and AI-enabled solutions that help leaders make better decisions and improve execution.

The ideal candidate is an operations leader who is highly analytical and comfortable working across business functions. This individual will not simply report on performance; they will establish scalable operating rhythms, improve workflows, translate data into action, and help the organization use AI and automation to work more effectively.

• The hybrid position out of our New York City office.

• This is a full-time position offering full benefits, a base salary in the $140,000-$160,000 range (commensurate with experience), paid training and performance-based bonuses.

Responsibilities

• Process & Workflow Optimization: Design and implement scalable procedures, tools, and operational rhythms that improve efficiency, consistency, accountability, and service delivery.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Managed Services, Professional Services, Finance, People Operations, Sales, Technology, and executive leadership to execute company priorities and align reporting and operational needs.

• Budget & Financial Management: Track operational expenditures and financial performance, monitor KPIs, and conduct cost-benefit and return-on-investment analyses to support sound business decisions.

• Strategic Planning: Support planning cycles, manage milestones for key operational initiatives, and translate complex information into clear executive-level recommendations.

• Performance Management: Establish operational scorecards, business reviews, and accountability mechanisms that connect team activities to business outcomes.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify bottlenecks, control gaps, and opportunities for standardization, then lead practical improvements that can be measured and sustained.

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

• Design, build, and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions using Power BI and related tools.

• Analyze operational, financial, project, and service-delivery data to identify trends, risks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.

• Develop forecasting models for resource planning, utilization, project performance, revenue, backlog, capacity, and service operations.

• Consolidate and validate information from multiple business systems to create consistent, decision-ready reporting.

• Translate complex datasets into clear findings, business implications, and recommended actions for leadership.

• Increase dashboard adoption by presenting solutions, gathering stakeholder feedback, and providing guidance to users.

AI, Automation & Innovation

• Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to operational workflows, reporting, knowledge management, and decision support.

• Design and implement practical AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate, and other approved technologies.

• Reduce repetitive manual work by automating reporting, data preparation, notifications, approvals, and other recurring processes.

• Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and recommend business use cases based on operational value, feasibility, responsible use, and measurable outcomes.

• Partner with business stakeholders to support adoption, document solutions, and establish repeatable practices.

Data Governance & Quality

• Establish standards for data accuracy, consistency, ownership, and metric definitions.

• Document core reports, dashboards, data sources, calculations, and operating procedures.

• Investigate data discrepancies, determine root causes, and coordinate corrective actions.

• Promote reliable and consistent use of operational data across Managed Services and Professional Services.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in operations management, business operations, data analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience improving operational processes and establishing scalable workflows or operating rhythms.

• Advanced experience building dashboards and reports using Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.

• Strong analytical, forecasting, financial analysis, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Advanced proficiency with Excel and experience combining data from multiple business systems.

• Ability to convert business needs into meaningful metrics, reporting, analysis, and action plans.

• Strong communication, presentation, project management, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work across functions, manage competing priorities, and influence decisions without relying solely on formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in Managed Services, Professional Services, consulting, or a technology services environment.

• Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, or similar technologies.

• Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, data architecture, and business intelligence best practices.

• Experience with resource planning, utilization reporting, project forecasting, profitability analysis, and service-delivery metrics.

• Experience leading cross-functional process improvement, automation, or operational transformation initiatives.

Core Competencies

• Data Analytics

• Business Intelligence

• AI & Automation

• Dashboard Development

• Financial Acumen

• Strategic Planning

• Process Improvement

• Executive Communication

• Cross-Functional Leadership

• Project Management

Measures of Success
