jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

LeanX (Part of Lean) is quickly expanding beyond remittance into a new generation of financial products, from embedded wallets to corporate, and this role sits at the heart of that expansion. The ideal candidate brings experience in crypto or blockchain products, such as a good understanding of wallets, exchanges, custody, on-chain movements, and the ecosystem in general.

As a Senior Engineer, you will design and build the backend systems and integrations that power these products, working in a small, high-ownership team that moves fast and ships real things. Your work will directly determine how quickly LeanX (Part of Lean) can unlock a $50B+ addressable market across the region.




ABOUT LEAN

 

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

 

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

 

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 450+ clients - from Tabby and Tas'heel to Hungerstation - and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.

 

About LeanX: LeanX is Lean's cross-border and stablecoin business. Our clients are remittance companies, exchange houses and businesses moving money across borders, mostly for person-to-person remittance and business payouts. LeanX operates under Lean's regulated entities and is built by a dedicated engineering team in Sarajevo.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-availability backend services in Java (Quarkus) and Python

 - Build and maintain integrations with external systems - payment providers, exchanges, banks, blockchain networks, ClickHouse, and identity services

 - Own the reliability, security, and consistency of transactions and financial data across systems

 - Drive performance improvements, architecture decisions, and reduction of technical debt over time

 - Review code, set engineering standards, and mentor other engineers on the team

 - Translate product requirements into technical solutions in close collaboration with the Product team

 - Proactively communicate progress, risks, and blockers to the team and stakeholders


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years building and running backend systems in production
   
   - Strong Java (17+) with a modern framework - we use Quarkus; solid hands-on Python
   
   - Experience designing REST APIs and working in a microservices architecture.
   
   - Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching (Redis)
   
   - Experience with messaging or event streaming systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
   
   - Strong testing habits (unit and integration) and a track record of rigorous code review
   
   - Security-aware engineering: authentication, secrets handling, and secure coding practices
   
   - Experience building and operating high-throughput, low-latency, or high-availability systems
   
   - Familiarity with ClickHouse or other analytical databases

 - Crypto or blockchain product experience: wallets, exchanges, custody, on-chain data, or interacting with nodes (Web3j, web3.py http://web3.py)
   
   - Understanding of cryptography fundamentals: key management, signing, HSMs
   
   - Fintech, payments, or regulated environment background (KYC/AML, compliance)

 - Calm and delivery-focused under pressure - you drive tasks to completion, raise blockers early, and don’t wait to be chased
   
   - Pragmatic: you balance quality with speed and know when “good enough” ships
   
   - Proactive communicator: you report reliably on status and risks in writing and stand-ups
   
   - Takes ownership of outcomes, including mistakes, and follows through
   
   - Curious and a fast learner. You pick up new tools, technologies, and domains quickly
   
   - Clear communication in English



NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!




WHY JOIN US?

We’re building the financial infrastructure for MENA. Not as a slogan, as a fact.

Since 2019, we’ve become the first regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We’ve processed billions of dollars. We connect millions of accounts. We enable companies like Binance, Careem, and Etisalat to build products that were previously impossible in this region.

Our recent $67.5M Series B from General Catalyst and Sequoia isn’t just validation: it’s fuel. We’re expanding into new markets, launching new products, and setting the pace for what financial innovation looks like in MENA.

We solve hard problems. We move fast. We hold ourselves to a high standard. And we’re looking for people who’ve done this before to help us do it right.

If you’re motivated by building something that lasts, not just something that scales, Lean is where you need to be.



Not only do we offer competitive salaries, private healthcare, and flexible office hours, but we also insist that every member of the team hold a meaningful equity stake in the business to ensure long-term alignment. We'd love you to join us for this journey!



Lean is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.



When applying for a job at Lean Technologies, we will need to collect, use and share Personal Data about you with different members of our team during the application process. This may mean transferring your data to members of the team in one of our office locations worldwide outside of the country you are in. Please refer to our Privacy Notice on our website for more information about how we may use and store your Personal Data

jobs.title: Associate Director, Programmatic
jobs.description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s. Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring an Associate Director, Programmatic to build and lead Darkroom's programmatic capability inside the Paid Media function. This is a foundational hire, not a standard channel-management role. Today, Darkroom is strongest across Meta and Google. Our next stage requires deeper expertise across Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, Retail Media Networks, high-impact display, and privacy-safe media environments, and you'll be the person who builds that sub-function from the ground up.

The ideal candidate is a senior programmatic strategist with hands-on experience activating and scaling programmatic media across high-growth brands, someone who knows how to use Amazon DSP, streaming video, OLV, CTV, and broader programmatic channels to create demand, prove incrementality, and connect media investment back to business outcomes.

Programmatic is the primary focus of this role, but it's not a full-time channel on every account at every point in time. When programmatic work is light or between test cycles, you'll flex into Paid Social execution across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Pinterest, so the role is built for someone who wants deep specialization without losing a holistic, hands-on media skill set.

You'll report to the Managing Director of Paid Media and partner closely with Paid Social, Paid Search, Creative, Growth Strategy, and Analytics.




WHAT WE'RE BUILDING

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer, providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.




THE AGENCY BEHIND THE PRODUCT

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom, a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the programmatic function you build here gets tested against real client budgets and real business outcomes from day one, and feeds directly into Shadow's programmatic backbone.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - With support from the Paid Media MD, build Darkroom's programmatic media capability across Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, RMNs, display, and high-impact media.

 - Lead strategy, planning, activation, optimization, and measurement for programmatic campaigns across key client accounts.

 - Serve as the internal subject matter expert for Amazon DSP, retail media, streaming video, connected TV, online video, and programmatic buying strategy.

 - Develop test plans that connect programmatic investment to business outcomes, not just impressions, reach, or platform-reported conversions.

 - Partner with Analytics and Growth Strategy to design incrementality-minded test structures across geo holdouts, matched-market tests, exposure-log measurement, clean rooms, and lift studies.

 - Build clear client-facing narratives around the role of programmatic in a broader growth system.

 - Evaluate programmatic partners, publishers, DSPs, RMNs, and measurement vendors.

 - Establish programmatic best practices, SOPs, QA standards, pacing rules, and reporting expectations.

 - Collaborate with Creative to define channel-specific creative requirements across video, display, high-impact, and RMN environments.

 - Create case studies that prove programmatic's incremental impact and support future new business.

 - Educate the broader Paid Media team on programmatic strategy, terminology, platform capabilities, measurement expectations, and client use cases.

 - Help define the long-term roadmap for building a programmatic practice inside Darkroom.

 - Work closely with the Shadow product team to enhance Shadow's programmatic backbone.

 - Step in on Paid Social campaign management and optimization across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Pinterest when programmatic priorities are lighter, acting as a flexible resource for the broader Paid Media team.


MUST HAVE

 - 6-8+ years of programmatic media experience, preferably in a fast-paced agency or high-growth brand environment.

 - Deep experience with Amazon DSP is required.

 - Strong experience planning or activating CTV and OLV campaigns.

 - Experience with Retail Media Networks and audience-led media environments.

 - Hands-on Paid Social media buying experience across at least two of Meta, TikTok, Reddit, or Pinterest, comfortable executing and optimizing campaigns when programmatic priorities allow.

 - Ability to build programmatic strategies that connect to business outcomes, incrementality, and budget decisioning.

 - Strong understanding of programmatic buying models, inventory quality, audience strategy, frequency management, supply paths, brand safety, and measurement limitations.

 - Experience working with streaming video, display, high-impact, contextual, publisher-direct, and DSP-based media.

 - Comfort building test plans, media forecasts, budget recommendations, and client-facing measurement readouts.

 - Experience partnering with analytics or measurement teams on incrementality testing, lift studies, clean rooms, exposure logs, or MMM inputs.

 - Strong client communication skills. You can explain complex programmatic concepts in plain English and make a clear recommendation.

 - High ownership mindset. This is a new function, so you should be excited to build systems, not just inherit them.

 - Comfort operating in a remote, fast-moving, high-accountability environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with MMM, MTA, and strong measurement points of view.

 - Ability to not only execute incrementality tests, but to interpret data outputs, translate next steps into media strategy, and get client buy-in.

 - Experience managing programmatic and paid social together on the same account, with a point of view on how the two channels should work together in a full-funnel strategy.

 - Hands-on experience across the full Paid Social set (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Pinterest), rather than just one or two platforms.


CULTURE FIT

 - You're fluent in Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, and programmatic media, and can explain why programmatic matters beyond reach and impressions.

 - You know how to pressure-test whether a channel is actually creating incremental impact.

 - You're excited by the idea of being the first dedicated programmatic lead inside a growing Paid Media department, and want to help build the operating system: SOPs, best practices, QA, partner POVs, case studies, internal training.

 - You want to help Darkroom expand beyond Meta and Google into a more sophisticated full-funnel media practice.

 - You're comfortable moving between deep specialization and hands-on execution. Building a new function some weeks, running paid social campaigns across a broad channel mix the next, without treating either as beneath you.

Not the bar: no Amazon DSP experience, no meaningful CTV or OLV experience, execution-only backgrounds with no strategic or client-facing ability, an inability to explain programmatic measurement beyond platform-reported metrics, or no interest in building a function from the ground up.




WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT DARKROOM

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape, just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

 - Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

 - Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

 - Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

 - Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

 - Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.


COMPENSATION:

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for performance-based compensation. A summary of benefits is listed above.

 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.description:
Founded by games industry veterans, Rushdown was created with a simple philosophy in mind: We believe that when talented developers are consistently challenged and given clear ownership of their work, extraordinary things will happen. As a co-dev game studio, we now focus on solving some of the most difficult problems that face multiplayer games — and we bring our experience working on games like PUBG, League of Legends, and Rocket League with us. We truly love the work we do and we want to funnel our passion and expertise into features and games that billions of players will enjoy worldwide.

Our Role

Rushdown Studios is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join us in support of an existing partner studio! In this role, you’ll work alongside our existing team to improve infrastructure reliability and automate infrastructure creation and tools for a large-scale game development project.

Our ideal candidate is a self-motivated and demonstrated team player with the ability to juggle and jump between different tasks as necessary. Game development experience is preferred due to the nature of this project, but it’s not mandatory; we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements listed below!

Work Location: Rushdown Studios is based in Saratoga Springs, NY and we have a strong preference for local candidates willing to work from our office on a hybrid basis (i.e., Tuesday-Thursday) or fully remote candidates in the Eastern United States. However, we're always open to expanding our list of remote-eligible states for the right candidate, as well.

Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure for game development and live-service games using one or more cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Deploy infrastructure-as-code for cloud resources using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, or Azure Resource Manager templates.

• Promote cloud security best practices and compliance requirements for gaming infrastructure.

• Design and develop CI/CD pipelines for builds and deployments.

• Respond to live support issues for a live-service game.

• Empower multiple teams through development environment automation.

Requirements

• Four (4) years of professional experience with Microsoft Azure.

• Experience scripting with languages like Python, PowerShell, or Groovy.

• Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Understanding of game packaging and deployment requirements for different platforms.

• Experience compiling code and/or managing pipelines that compile code.

• Experience monitoring and profiling applications (DataDog, CloudWatch, Prometheus)

• Ability to debug unexpected issues that arise during development.

• Willingness to selflessly put player experiences first before even your own code and ego.

• Proactive approach to communication, particularly when it comes to unblocking yourself and navigating obstacles as part of a team.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with build systems like Jenkins, TeamCity, or Azure DevOps, specifically for game development projects.

• Experience working with additional cloud providers (e.g., AWS, GCP).

• Knowledge of game development workflows and asset management.

• Experience with the Go programming language.

• Experience running multi-cloud applications.

• Previous work using version control for game development (e.g., Perforce, Git LFS).

Benefits:

jobs.title: Research Staff, Applied Voice AI
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We're building the engine that solves customer challenges at scale. When customers hit a limit in our voice AI, you'll measure it, fix it, and ship the fix to every customer in weeks.

Example projects:

 - Expanding our models to new languages and regions

 - Improving how text-to-speech pronounces names, terms, and numbers

 - Isolating a speaker's voice from background noise and crosstalk

 - Giving customers early access to new voice capabilities, like steerable and cloned voices, and using their feedback to guide the research methodology

 - Releasing new benchmarks for Voice AI use-cases
   


THE ROLE

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

 - Turning vague customer problems into clear metrics

 - Using whatever works to fix them, including fine-tuning, new data, and external models

 - Shipping work that customers use within weeks
   


THE CHALLENGE

We are seeking researchers who:

 - Own a customer problem until it measurably improves in production

 - Find the fastest path to a fix, even if it's an approach no one has tried

 - Can tell when a result is ready for customers

If these expectations energize you, you might be the person we need. This role takes focus on the customer's problem, creativity in approach, and a strong drive to ship.



WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - Find where our models fall short and set targets for improvement

 - Design evaluations that show whether a model is better and why

 - Curate and generate data and fine-tune models

 - Build working systems quickly and ship them to production

We don't require a specific degree. Show us hard problems you've solved in past projects, shipped systems, or open source work.



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Deep experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models

 - Strong Python and PyTorch skills

 - A track record of shipping ML to production

 - A habit of owning problems end to end and learning what you need along the way

 - Good judgment about which problems matter and when a result is ready to ship



STRONG CANDIDATES MAY HAVE

 - Experience with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or voice agents

 - Experience with distributed training

 - Published papers, open source contributions, or public benchmarks

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Supply Analyst
jobs.description:
Simtra BioPharma Solutions (Simtra) is a world-class Contract Development Manufacturing Organization, partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring their sterile injectable products to market. With facilities in Bloomington, Indiana, US and Halle/Westfalen, Germany, we offer a wide range of delivery systems including pre-filled syringes, liquid/lyophilized vials, diluents for reconstitution, powder-filled vials and sterile crystallization.

Our product types include biologics and small molecules, cytotoxics, highly potent compounds, diluents for reconstitution and vaccines – which are all directly injected into patients worldwide.  As such, there is a strong emphasis on quality and continuous improvement at Simtra.  We hold ourselves to the highest quality and regulatory standards.

While our primary focus is cGMP manufacturing, we offer many support services including formulation and development, lyophilization optimization, global regulatory support and secondary packaging.  Our teams are driven to help clients scale, innovate and bring life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.

Why join Team Simtra? Because we:

Make it HAPPEN – We bring a growth mindset to every opportunity, developing new skillsets and exceeding our expectations and those of our customers.

Make it TOGETHER – We work as one, respecting each voice and tapping into our unique strengths across teams—so we can solve problems in new ways.

Make it RIGHT – We hold ourselves to a high standard of excellence, fulfilling our commitments to the customer, their patients, and our team members.

Make it COUNT – We take pride in our day-to-day work, knowing the impact we make – taking on challenges big and small to improve patient health.

This role:

The Supply Chain Supply Analyst is responsible for supporting supply chain operations across all buildings with a primary focus on supply readiness, inventory reporting, KPI reporting, item creation, and ERP data accuracy. This position serves as a key link between Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehouse, Procurement, Technical Services, and the Business Management Team to help ensure materials, items, data, and operational inputs are aligned to support overall commitments to the client. The Supply Chain Supply Analyst monitors, prepares, and communicates key supply chain reports and identifies constraints or risks impacting supply readiness. This position reports to the Supply Chain Manager.

The Responsibilities:
• Support supply chain operations across all buildings with emphasis on supply readiness, inventory, KPI reporting, item creation, and appropriate follow-up with the necessary teams
• Review upcoming supply needs to confirm material reservations, item setup, supply chain data, and operational requirements are ready to support production and client commitments
• Create, maintain, and validate item-related setup, planning data, and ERP fields needed to support production, inventory control, and cross-building operations
• Prepare, analyze, and distribute inventory reports, KPI dashboards, supply readiness updates, and operational performance summaries for Supply Chain and building leadership
• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Warehouse, Procurement, and Technical Services to resolve issues impacting supply readiness, material availability, inventory accuracy, and operational execution
• Develop, maintain, and improve supply chain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support consistent processes, operational alignment, and execution of client commitments across all buildings
• Communicate supply readiness status, inventory concerns, KPI trends, supply chain priorities, and support needs through daily, weekly, and monthly cross-functional meetings
• Monitor and report supply chain KPIs, including OTD (On Time Delivery), plan versus actual performance, and schedule adherence
• Support S&OP and supply chain review processes
• Maintain planning parameters, item master data, routings, production rates, and other ERP master data needed to support supply readiness and accurate inventory reporting
• Open, maintain, update, and troubleshoot sales orders, production orders, inventory balancing activities, and related ERP transactions to support supply readiness, operational execution, and client commitments

The Requirements (Education, Experience and Qualifications):

You will combine your deep technical expertise with analytical rigor to solve complex engineering challenges and drive innovation in power conversion technologies. This position offers the opportunity to mentor junior engineers while contributing to cutting-edge projects that shape the future of power electronics.

• Design, develop, and optimize power electronics systems including DC-DC converters, AC-DC rectifiers, and inverter topologies
• Conduct detailed circuit analysis and perform simulations using industry-standard tools such as SPICE, MATLAB, and Simulink
• Lead technical projects from concept through production, ensuring adherence to specifications, timelines, and quality standards
• Perform comprehensive testing, validation, and troubleshooting of power electronics hardware and control systems
• Analyze thermal management requirements and implement effective cooling strategies to ensure system reliability
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, test reports, and system architecture diagrams
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including firmware, mechanical, and manufacturing engineers to ensure seamless system integration
• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence
• Ensure all designs comply with relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) requirements
• Evaluate and recommend power semiconductor devices and components based on performance, cost, and reliability criteria

**Required Qualifications:**

• 8+ years of professional experience in power electronics design and development
• Strong expertise in power conversion systems, including DC-DC converters, AC-DC converters, and inverters
• Proficiency with circuit simulation and design tools such as SPICE, MATLAB, Simulink, and PCB design software
• Solid understanding of power semiconductor devices (MOSFETs, IGBTs, diodes) and their applications
• Experience with thermal analysis, thermal management, and reliability engineering
• Demonstrated ability to conduct system-level integration and hardware testing
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Experience with technical documentation and design specification development

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience designing power electronics systems for automotive or industrial applications

• Experience with power factor correction (PFC) and energy efficiency optimization
• Proven track record of mentoring and leading technical teams

jobs.title: Content Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What we do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role overview

We are looking for a Content Engineer to help operate and improve the systems and workflows that power CarGurus content.

This is a content-operations role with strong technical fluency. You will manage structured content in our headless CMS and related databases, coordinate multiple workflows for producing and updating content, and help ensure that every workflow produces accurate, useful, on-brand, and search-friendly work. You will work closely with editors, SEO partners, engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to turn content requirements into repeatable processes.

You do not need to be a traditional software engineer. You should be comfortable learning technical systems, working with structured data, troubleshooting workflow issues, and using tools such as AirOps and LLM-based content workflows to improve the speed and quality of production.

What you’ll do

• Manage and maintain a structured database of content, including records, fields, statuses, metadata, templates, relationships, and update schedules.

• Operate day-to-day publishing and refresh workflows across multiple content types, markets, and production queues.

• Coordinate work from intake through review, revision, approval, publishing, and post-publication quality checks.

• Configure and maintain Contentful models, entries, templates, and workflow states within established standards.

• Use AirOps, LLM tools, and related AI-assisted workflows to support content creation, enrichment, updating, and quality control.

• Review generated or data-informed content for accuracy, completeness, clarity, consistency, brand voice, and usefulness to car shoppers.

• Monitor workflow output and investigate issues such as missing data, incorrect formatting, duplicate records, broken links, stale content, or failed production steps.

• Track answer-engine optimization (AEO) performance and citation visibility across AI and LLM search experiences; monitor where and how CarGurus content is cited, and use citation data to improve briefs, content structure, internal linking, prompts, and workflow outputs.

• Partner with editors and SEO stakeholders to translate briefs, content standards, and search intent into clear workflow requirements.

• Maintain production trackers, documentation, QA checklists, and process guides so that work is visible, repeatable, and easy for others to follow.

• Identify recurring friction or quality issues and recommend practical improvements to templates, prompts, validations, queue design, and operating procedures.

• Support testing of new content formats, data sources, and workflow changes; document results and help determine whether successful approaches should be expanded.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

• Keep assigned content databases accurate, organized, and up to date.

• Run multiple content-production and refresh workflows reliably against agreed timelines.

• Catch and resolve quality issues before they reach customers, or escalate them with clear context when they require another team’s support.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I - Immune Cell Depletion & Discovery Biology
jobs.description:
Conceive and implement novel experimental approaches to address key scientific questions in immune cell depletion. Investigate, identify, and optimize new methods, assays, and techniques relevant to pathogenic cell target discovery, depletion therapeutic development, and immunological mechanisms of action. Contribute scientific insights to projects, particularly in areas such as inflammatory pathways, immune cell trafficking, immune receptor modulation, receptor targeting, target density in tissues, and receptor occupancy. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, and technology groups, to drive technical problem-solving and integrate efforts across projects. We are looking for a Senior Scientist I with a strong background in immunology, cell biology, and therapeutic discovery to join AbbVie’s Immunology Discovery organization. This lab-based position supports IND-enabling and early-stage discovery programs, as well as research and innovation in selective pathogenic cell depletion. The role involves hands-on experimentation using translational in vitro and ex vivo assays and PK/PD assessments, including autoimmune disease efficacy models, to evaluate depletion strategies and therapeutic candidates.

Responsibilities:

​​• Innovative Research & Method Development: Consistently demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity by exploring novel experimental approaches and developing new immunological methods to address complex research questions.

​• Autonomous Experimental Design & Troubleshooting: Operate with a high degree of autonomy in the lab, independently designing experiments and troubleshooting technical challenges with minimal supervision while maintaining rigorous scientific standards in support of pathogenic cell depletion programs.

​• Immunological Assays & Complex Cellular Systems: Design and execute a broad range of immunological assays, including ELISPOT, cytokine profiling, cellular potency assays, and whole blood assays, and use complex cellular systems to characterize immune responses, target engagement, depletion activity, selectivity, and recovery associated with therapeutic candidates.

​• PK/PD Relationships: Apply advanced analytical techniques, including multicolor flow cytometry for detailed cellular phenotyping and molecular assays such as digital PCR, qPCR, RNA extraction, and sequencing, to quantify biomarkers and gene expression changes and establish PK/PD relationships.

​• AI-Assisted Bioinformatics and Computational Target Discovery: Leverage AI-assisted bioinformatics and computational approaches to identify and prioritize disease-relevant targets for selective pathogenic cell depletion, integrating multi-omics and human disease data into experimentally testable hypotheses.

​• Data Analysis & Follow-Up Experiments: Analyze and interpret experimental data, draw meaningful conclusions, and proactively design follow-up experiments to test new hypotheses and guide subsequent project decisions.

​• Scientific Communication: Prepare clear and detailed technical reports and documentation of results, and effectively communicate findings through presentations and peer-reviewed publications, upholding AbbVie’s standards of scientific excellence.

​• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively participate in cross-functional team discussions and collaborative troubleshooting sessions with in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, and other internal teams, fostering a cooperative environment to overcome challenges and advance program goals.

​​

​​• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Immunology or a related biological science, with typically 10+ years (BS), 8+ years (MS), or 0 years (PhD) of relevant experience

​• Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of immunology and related biological sciences, including cell biology and cell signaling. Experience in autoimmune disease biology, pathogenic immune cell populations, target validation, or immune cell depletion is preferred.

​• Technical Expertise (Immunological Assays): Hands-on experience with multi-color flow cytometry, cellular potency assays, cell depletion assays, and cytokine-based cellular assays.

​• Proven ability to design, execute, and troubleshoot complex experiments independently. Excellent organizational skills and meticulous documentation practices to ensure data accuracy and integrity.

​• Excellent scientific communication skills (written and oral) for effective report writing, data presentation, and team discussions.

​• Strong collaboration skills with the ability to contribute effectively in cross-functional team environments.

​• Demonstrated adaptability and curiosity, with a willingness to learn and apply new techniques and methodologies.

​Preferred/nice-to-have:

​• Technical Expertise in Live Cell Imaging (Incucyte, xCELLigence) and Molecular Biology (digital PCR (ddPCR) and quantitative PCR (qPCR), as well as RNA isolation)

​• Bioinformatics and computational biology: Experience applying bioinformatics and computational biology approaches to analyze high-dimensional immunology datasets, including single-cell RNA sequencing, bulk transcriptomics, immune-receptor repertoire data, or multi-omics, and translating results into testable biological hypotheses and drug discovery decisions.

jobs.description:
**Clinical Nurse- Radiology Department Full-time Evenings**

Northwestern Medicine is seeking an experience nurse for our Radiology Department. This role is Full-time, 3/12 hour Evening Shifts. 11am-11:30pm. There is also a weekend requirement: 2 weekend shifts in a 6-week period.

The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels

• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students

• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care

Required:

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Developer (Contract)
jobs.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We're hiring a Senior Developer with deep mobile expertise for a small, self-contained innovation group (Initial three-month contract, with opportunity for extension or move to full-time). Working alongside a Product Manager and a web-focused developer, you will take an ambiguous business problem, turn it into a testable product bet, and build the smallest end-to-end experience that can generate meaningful evidence, often in roughly one to two weeks. You will bring early versions back to customers and the market validation group, gather feedback, and rapidly iterate through V1, V2, V3, and beyond. Once the concept is validated, the group will shift from proving the idea to determining what must change for it to become secure, reliable, scalable, and ready for handoff.

The group operates like an entrepreneurial startup within the larger organization and owns the path from problem discovery through rapid prototyping, customer and market validation, iterative development, and a validated proof of concept. From there, it determines what is required to harden and scale the product before handing it to the core product and engineering team.

The operating principle is simple: build to learn first, then build to scale. During validation, speed comes from controlling scope and making deliberate, reversible technical choices—not from designing the final production architecture before the opportunity is proven. Security, privacy, and responsible data handling remain non-negotiable throughout. Once an idea demonstrates value, you will work with our Core team at key technical integration points to harden, refactor, or redesign what is needed for scale. That judgment lets us discard weak ideas cheaply and invest deeply in the ones that earn it.

This is a fit for someone with strong product and commercial instincts, sound technical judgment, and a high degree of ownership. You identify gaps, propose a path forward, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect requirements. You own outcomes, make clear trade-offs to meet timelines, and raise consequential risks early.

What you'll do:

• Work with the Project Lead, Product Manager and Web Developer to turn ambiguous problems into unified driver-and-admin experiences

• Build the smallest end-to-end prototype that can test the idea, often within one to two weeks

• Bring prototypes to customers and the market validation group, then rapidly translate feedback into V2, V3, and beyond

• Challenge assumptions, cut scope, and keep the group moving without waiting for perfect requirements

• Make deliberate, reversible technical choices during validation while protecting security, privacy, and data integrity

• Build within the shared codebase, behind feature flags and in isolated modules that can be removed cleanly

• Integrate with our platform backend and third-party APIs using existing contracts and patterns

• Once a concept is validated, identify and complete the work required to harden, scale, test, and release it

• Prepare validated features and technical context for a clean handoff to the core product and engineering team

What you'll bring:

Core Experience

• 6–8 years as a software engineer at a senior level, with a track record of product work at startups and in fast-paced environments

• You've built from nothing, cut scope under time pressure, and shipped

• Comfortable with ambiguity: you can take an unfamiliar domain and an under-specified problem and make progress without waiting to be handed a spec

• Strong product thinker who can connect driver and administrator needs, commercial value, and technical choices across mobile and web

• Strong communicator who identifies gaps, proposes a path forward, and keeps the work moving

• High ownership, sound judgment under time pressure, and a track record of delivering against commitments without hiding material trade-offs

• Comfortable working in a small, autonomous group where priorities can change quickly as new evidence emerges

Technical

• Very comfortable with React Native, plus native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development

• Familiar with the full mobile release process for both iOS and Android, including store submission and review

• Solid integrating against REST / backend APIs and handling auth, tokens, and SSO on device

• Comfortable collaborating across mobile, web, and backend boundaries to create one coherent product experience

• You adopt the existing patterns and conventions of the mobile codebase rather than introducing your own

• You know how to code and understand good software design. You are not strictly a "vibe coder": you can reason about architecture and trade-offs, not just prompt your way to output

AI-Native Mindset

• You've adopted modern AI development workflows and use tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot as part of how you ship

• You understand AI skills, agents, and code-spec workflows, and how to use them without losing engineering rigour

• You lean on AI to move faster on prototypes and to hold quality up during hardening

Bonus (nice to have)

• Ability to flex onto the Portal stack (TypeScript / Next.js / NestJS / PostgreSQL) when a bet calls for it

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

jobs.title: Sr. Lead, Marketing Strategy, Capital Formation
jobs.description:
WE’RE FINANCING THE FUTURE OF ENERGY

Crux is the capital platform for the clean economy. We modernize capital raising and deployment for clean energy and critical infrastructure with solutions across advisory, investments, technology, and intelligence.

Our team is composed of experts in energy, tax, finance, policy, tech, and beyond. We have raised $77 million in capital from top investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Lowercarbon Capital, New System Ventures, Overture, Ardent Venture Partners, QED, Canapi, and others. These funds are joined by strategic investors including Pattern Energy, Clearway Energy, EDF Renewables, Intersect Power, LS Power, Orsted, Hartree Partners, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures, MassMutual Ventures, and OMERS Ventures.




AN INFLECTION POINT IN AMERICAN ENERGY AND MANUFACTURING

Energy demand is growing for the first time in decades, driving an urgent need for more affordable and reliable electricity. More electricity requires new clean energy infrastructure and strong domestic supply chains for minerals and components as well as large amounts of capital.

Traditional project finance is opaque, fragmented, and analog. At Crux, we’re changing that. Through unmatched insights and expertise, white-glove service, purpose-built tools, and risk underwriting, we power a more prosperous, clean, and secure energy future.

We are scaling quickly and looking for team members who are eager to combine deep expertise with an AI- and tech-forward mindset.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Crux is hiring a Senior Lead of Marketing Strategy to shape how we bring our capital solutions to market for clean energy developers and sponsors. This is a senior, hands-on role at the intersection of marketing, commercial strategy, and product, with meaningful ownership over how we position our offerings, reach our customers, and drive commercial results.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing Strategy, you'll lead marketing strategy for our capital-seeker audience: the developers and sponsors navigating complex financing decisions to get projects built. You'll turn a deep understanding of their needs, challenges, and decision-making processes into differentiated positioning, effective go-to-market programs, and actionable insights that inform business strategy.

You'll work closely with commercial and product leaders, as well as your counterpart focused on capital providers. You'll own initiatives from strategy through execution, developing a clear point of view, influencing decisions, and translating ideas into measurable impact.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead go-to-market strategy: Own GTM planning and execution for products, services, and features serving developers and sponsors. Define target segments, shape launch strategies, and prioritize opportunities in partnership with product, commercial, and marketing teams.

 - Shape positioning and messaging: Develop differentiated narratives and value propositions that connect Crux's capabilities to the financing needs and business priorities of capital seekers. Ensure our story is clear, compelling, and consistent across customer touchpoints.

 - Bring deep customer understanding: Serve as a voice of the developer and sponsor audience, applying your knowledge of project development, financing structures, and capital markets to positioning, product strategy, and commercial priorities.

 - Turn insight into strategy: Connect customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market trends to identify opportunities, sharpen our differentiation, and recommend where and how Crux should compete.

 - Enable commercial success: Equip customer-facing teams with the messaging, tools, and training they need to have more effective conversations and win business. Develop high-impact materials, including training programs, competitive battlecards, and sales plays, and measure their effectiveness.

 - Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner with product, commercial, market intelligence, and marketing leaders to translate business priorities into coordinated action. Collaborate closely with your capital-provider counterpart to ensure our strategies connect across both sides of the market.




WHAT YOU BRING




REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - Direct experience with clean energy developers or sponsors, with a strong understanding of project development, financing needs, and the decisions that drive capital formation.

 - 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, product marketing, commercial strategy, or a related strategic function, including experience in a startup or high-growth environment.

 - Demonstrated ownership of strategic initiatives, from identifying opportunities and developing recommendations through execution and measurement.

 - Experience developing positioning and go-to-market strategies for complex products or services, ideally across multiple customer segments or buyer personas.

 - Proven ability to translate technical and financial complexity into clear, differentiated messaging that resonates with customers.

 - Experience developing commercial enablement programs and materials that improve customer-facing effectiveness and contribute to business outcomes.

 - Strong cross-functional influence and relationship-building skills, including the ability to earn trust, challenge assumptions, and align senior stakeholders without direct authority.

 - Structured, analytical thinking and sound commercial judgment, with the ability to synthesize ambiguous information into clear recommendations and action.




WHAT WE BRING

 - Backing, traction & brand:
   
   - We have raised $77 million in capital from some of the best venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Lowercarbon Capital, New System Ventures, Ardent Venture Partners, Pattern, Clearway, EDFR, Intersect, LS Power, Orsted, Hartree Partners, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures, MassMutual Ventures, and OMERS Ventures.
   
   - $500m warehouse facility from Nuveen to invest in clean energy.
   
   - Have been profitable and are growing exponentially
   
   - We have closed over 180+ transactions in just the last 2 years, facilitating billions of dollars of capital flowing into renewables projects

 - Culture & working dynamic
   
   - Remote-first operating model: Work from anywhere in the US and Canada, or work from one of our optional offices in DC, NYC, Denver, & SF. Co-working pod in Seattle.
   
   - High growth & high ownership culture: We grow quickly by giving extremely talented people a lot of responsibility.
   
   - Best of financial services & technology: We have brought together a team that are experts in clean energy finance, and the best technologies. Use your expertise while getting to be on the cutting edge of applying AI to your day and your clients’ experience.
   
   - Regular team offsites: We sustain culture by bringing the entire company together 2 times a year. Individual teams may also meet up more frequently.

 - Benefits
   
   - Healthcare: We cover 100% of premiums for employees with a variety of plans on Aetna (nationwide) and Kaiser (WA and California) and subsidize 80% for dependents (total as a group), if relevant.
   
   - Dental & vision: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and 80% for dependents (each), if relevant.
   
   - Family forming & fertility support
   
   - Parental leave: 16 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.
   
   - Holidays: 10 company holidays per year.
   
   - Paid time off: 20 days per year.
   
   - 401k: account fees supported by Crux.
     

 - Compensation:
   
   - Compensation: $160,000 - $200,000+, depending on leveling. We are open on title and compensation for the right candidate. Independent of equity value and company wide bonus. 
   
   - Company wide bonus: tied to revenue goals. 
   
   - Stock options in a rapidly growing company.
     
     Values
     
     - Care for each other: We want to work on a team where people support each other - in their growth, in their work, and towards our shared mission. When we do that, we have fun.
     
     - Build and improve rapidly: We move quickly. To do that, we focus, consistently ask ourselves if we are prioritizing the right things, and execute them as best as possible.
     
     - Focus unremittingly on customers: Our first obligation is to our customers and partners, and we keep their needs front and center in everything we do.
     
     - Demonstrate ownership: We are all owners of Crux. This is our team, our company, our product and we show that to each other.
     
     - Convene a team that reflects the breadth of experiences in the country: We’re building a team with a wide range of backgrounds and a culture where everyone can thrive.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 



Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals.




YOU WILL

 - Act as the Designee for the 503A pharmacy in accordance with applicable regulations and USP for the appropriate functional area.

 - Ensure active state pharmacist licensure in applicable jurisdictions and fulfill backup PIC responsibilities as needed.

 - Act as a member of the CQI Committee, facilitate the CQI process according to the SOP.

 - Ensure ongoing compliance with USP <797> and <800> (as applicable), state board of pharmacy requirements, and internal policies

 - Design, execute and maintain a self-inspection program for sterile compounding to support continuous quality improvements.

 - Implement changes to ensure compliance and complete Board of Pharmacy compliance checklists as applicable.

 - Support the PIC in maintaining pharmacy licensure, registrations, and regulatory readiness and recordkeeping

 - Oversee compliance aspects of sterile compounding operations, including aseptic technique, environmental controls, cleaning, and disinfection in partnership with Quality.

 - Assist in the review and approval of sterile compounding SOPs, documentation, and records to ensure regulatory alignment

 - Monitor regulatory changes and assess operational impact; partner with stakeholders to implement updates

 - Support environmental monitoring, personnel qualification, media fills, and competency programs in partnership with training and quality departments.

 - Participate in investigations, root cause analyses, and CAPA development related to deviations or quality events

 - Prepare for and support state board inspections, internal audits, and third-party assessments

 - Ensure training programs and competencies are in line with regulatory standards and appropriately documented

 - Track and ensure timely resolution of inspection findings and audit observations

 - Partner cross-functionally with pharmacy operations, quality, and leadership to proactively manage compliance risks

 - Escalate significant compliance issues and trends to the PIC as appropriate

This critical role is responsible for ensuring the highest levels of regulatory adherence and quality assurance within the 503A sterile compounding pharmacy. The Compliance Pharmacist will serve as the primary expert on all applicable state and federal regulations, driving a culture of continuous compliance and quality excellence.



 


YOU HAVE

 - 5 years of Sterile compounding experience

 - Pharmacy degree from an ACPE-accredited school of pharmacy

 - Board Certified Sterile Compounding Pharmacist (BCSCP) certification

 - Active, unrestricted Pharmacist license in the state of practice

 - Eligibility and willingness to obtain reciprocal licenses in other states

 - Experience in sterile compounding, pharmacy compliance, or quality roles

 - Strong working knowledge of USP <797>, <800>, and state board of pharmacy regulations applicable to 503A pharmacies

 - Experience supporting audits, inspections, or regulatory inquiries

 - Excellent attention to detail with strong documentation and organizational skills

 - Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical, scalable processes

 - Willingness to travel
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Prior experience serving as a Designated Person (DP) or PIC Designee

 - Experience in high-growth or regulated healthcare environments

 - Background in working with cross-functional teams including quality and legal

 - Advanced training or certification in sterile compounding or pharmacy quality
   


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HIMS & HERS

 - You’ll have a direct impact on patient safety and regulatory excellence

 - You’ll partner with smart, mission-driven teams across pharmacy and operations
   You’ll help scale compliant, high-quality pharmacy operations in a fast-growing healthcare company





We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.title: Principal Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's science factories run on a fast-growing, multi-site network that spans corporate offices, autonomous labs, and OT/robotics environments across Cambridge (Alewife), OCP, San Francisco, and London. As Principal Network Engineer, you will be the senior technical owner of that network: building the in-house engineering capability to design, secure, and scale it, while increasing the value and effectiveness of our managed service provider relationships.

You'll partner closely with Identity, Endpoints, Security, and OT/Controls engineering teams as we build the corporate engineering function. You’ll have real influence over the network architecture decisions that determine how quickly and safely we can bring new labs and AI Science Factories online.

This is a hands-on, senior IC role for someone who can set technical direction, operate deeply in the details, and shape the network engineering function as it matures.

What You'll Be Building

• Own the architecture, design, and roadmap for Lila’s global network, including SD-WAN/SASE, enterprise firewalls, and secure remote access.

• Lead VLAN, subnet, and segmentation design across corporate IT, lab, and OT environments.

• Design IT/OT convergence patterns that keep production labs safe, segmented, observable, and reliable.

• Drive network infrastructure migration and hardening, including firewall-to-SASE cutovers and maintenance windows.

• Build network visibility, monitoring, and telemetry to detect issues before they affect scientists or lab operations.

• Establish scalable standards for DNS, IP addressing, and naming conventions across labs, buildings, and geographies.

• Serve as the senior escalation point for complex network incidents, and create runbooks that help the broader IT team self-serve.

• Manage network-focused MSPs and vendors while insourcing the highest-value engineering work over time.

• Mentor other network engineers and represent network engineering in planning for lab buildouts and facility expansions.

• Advise leadership on network architecture tradeoffs across security, cost, reliability, and delivery speed.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Typically 10+ years of progressive network engineering experience, or equivalent depth in designing and operating multi-site networks.

• Deep hands-on expertise with SD-WAN/SASE platforms such as Cato Networks or similar.

• Strong experience with enterprise firewalls, routing platforms, switching, VLAN segmentation, and subnetting at scale.

• Experience securing and connecting both corporate IT and OT, industrial, or lab-instrumentation networks.

• Practical experience implementing network segmentation, zero-trust concepts, and secure remote access.

• Proven ability to manage MSPs and vendors while improving technical outcomes and accountability.

• Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort serving as the senior escalation point for production-impacting network issues.

• Excellent communication skills, including translating network architecture decisions for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus Points For

• Experience in life sciences, biotech, pharma, or advanced manufacturing environments with lab automation or robotics on the network.

• Industry certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent.

• Cloud networking experience with AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, or similar.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code for network configuration, such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar.

• Familiarity with identity and access patterns, such as SSO/IdP, Keycloak, or similar, as they intersect with network and remote access design.

• Experience operating in SOC 2 or similarly regulated security environments.

• Prior experience building an internal network engineering function that reduced reliance on outside vendors or MSPs.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$204,000—$272,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Waymark

Waymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology-enabled, human-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We’re designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what’s possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery.

Our Values

At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another:

• Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology.

• Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions.

• Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance.

• Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results.

If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark.

About This Role

The Partner Success team is the face of Waymark with MCO and health system partners. This team builds relationships with stakeholders across our partners and is responsible for partner retention, growth and strategic account management. Partner Success forms a deep understanding of our partners’ needs and collaborates with teams across Waymark to ensure we meet these needs.

This role will play a vital role strengthening our approach to partner management. This is critical as Waymark scales. You will be responsible for managing and evolving the tools and processes that support strong partnerships. Reporting to the VP of Partner Success, you will use your project management and analytical skills to drive strategic initiatives and ensure smooth execution of projects. You should be an excellent communicator who enjoys synthesizing information for customers, but also loves sharing insights from customers with teams internally to strengthen our products and services.

Key Responsibilities

• Relationship Management: Partner with VP Partner Success to strengthen relationships with partners by learning varied stakeholders’ needs and interests, proposing solutions, and ensuring execution of commitments. Independently own smaller accounts and serve as the day-to-day lead for partner meetings, ongoing relationship management, issue resolution and reporting. Work with colleagues from Operations, Clinical and other Waymark teams to action partner priorities and capture success stories that demonstrate impact.

• Account Planning: Drive ongoing account planning by monitoring performance, identifying risks and opportunities, and coordinating execution across internal teams. Partner with VP Partner Success to develop account strategies that support retention, growth, and partner outcomes.

• Joint Operating Committees (JOCs) & Reporting: Lead preparation of executive-ready materials that communicate Waymark's performance and impact and gain support for changes that can increase performance. Track and action partner requests that emerge from JOCs. Create and share additional performance reports with partners as needed.

• Partner Success (PS) Operations: Continuously improve the systems, processes, and tools that enable effective account management at scale. Drive cross-functional and strategic initiatives. Manage cross-market PS meetings to support strategy, learning and team progress.

• Voice of the Customer (VOC): Learn what matters to partners. Bring partner feedback back to internal teams to inform initiatives and product development.

• Strategic Initiatives: Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve partner performance, strengthen scalability, and enhance the partner experience. Influence stakeholders across teams to ensure initiatives are executed effectively and deliver measurable outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

• 7 years of experience that includes roles in consulting, customer success, account management, operations, and/or project management, including experience within healthcare services or health technology.

• Strong project management and creative problem solving experience, with a proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused mindset

• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders internally and externally and drive outcomes without direct authority.

• Experience collecting and analyzing data, and making data-driven presentations

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Self-motivated and eager to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with a track record of meeting or exceeding customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion goals

• Flexible and adaptable to the changing needs of a fast growing start up

• Deep commitment to improving healthcare for underserved populations

Preferred Qualifications

• Medicaid and healthcare transformation experience

• Experience with value-based contracts and primary care providers

Hiring Range

$82,000 - $137,000

In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here’s what you can expect:

• Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company’s growth.

• Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.

• Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy.

• Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind.

• Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays.

• Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non-birthing parents.

• Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule.

• Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs.

• Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth.

Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advanced degree/professional license verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process.

Don’t check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! Studies have shown that some of us may be less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification.
