jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Marketplace)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRABA



Traba is building the AI operating layer for the light industrial supply chain.



We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships.



But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale.



We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.




THE ROLE



The product is the labor itself: the workers we match and deploy into warehouses and manufacturing facilities across the country (and eventually, the world). Every product decision impacts supply, demand, fulfillment, customer outcomes, and marketplace health.



We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to own and evolve our staffing product that sits at the center of Traba’s marketplace. You'll own the staffing product at the center of Traba's marketplace, working across both sides: the enterprise customers who run distribution centers and manufacturing lines, and the workers whose trust and reliability are what those customers are actually buying.



In addition to collaborating with software engineers, product designers, data analysts, and other product managers on the team, you’ll also work closely with our operations and field teams to design, build, and ship practical solutions into industrial facilities.



This role reports directly to our VP of Product.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Architect and steward our product strategy across critical staffing and marketplace workflows

 - Solve complex marketplace problems by balancing customer needs, operational realities, and business outcomes

 - Write detailed product requirements and partner closely with engineering teams to execute solutions

 - Build systems that improve marketplace liquidity, fulfillment, matching quality, and operational efficiency

 - Use data to uncover hidden patterns and answer critical marketplace and customer questions

 - Translate operational complexity into scalable product systems

 - Scale operations by designing smart internal tooling and technical solutions

 - Launch and iterate products across customers, regions, and operational environments

 - Visualize and communicate complex ideas from systems and workflows to operational models and product strategy

 - Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Customer-obsessed. Product judgment is downstream of customer truth, and you act like it. You spend time on-site with the people using your product, on both sides of the marketplace. When the team debates a decision, you're the one who's already talked to three customers and two workers about it.

AI-native operator. You've changed how you work because of AI, not just added it to your stack. You prototype before writing a spec. You check in code to the production repo. You build internal agents to do research and analysis that used to take days. This shows up in how you operate, not how you describe yourself.

Marketplace operator. You have deep experience building products in two-sided marketplaces where supply and demand dynamics are real and operational complexity matters. You understand marketplace liquidity, matching systems, incentives, fulfillment, trust, and the tradeoffs required to maintain marketplace health at scale.

Enterprise B2B muscle. You have built products for complex customers with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and operational rollout challenges. You are comfortable navigating environments with regional operators, warehouse leadership, procurement processes, and layered customer organizations.

First-principles thinker. You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks.

Operations systems builder. You have built operational products or internal tools that powered real businesses. You understand workflows deeply and know how to create leverage through systems that help teams operate more efficiently.

Builder mentality. Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process.

Deeply collaborative. You work seamlessly across product, design, engineering, data, operations, sales, customer teams, and leadership. You know how to align stakeholders and build trust across functions.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING



 - 5 - 7 years of experience as a Product Manager

 - Evidence of shipping products that materially moved business outcomes

 - Strong experience in two-sided marketplaces with real supply and demand dynamics

 - Experience building enterprise products with multi-stakeholder customers and complex operational environments

 - Experience building internal operational tooling or systems that supported real business execution

 - Strong technical fluency and ability to work deeply with engineering teams

 - Experience operating in startup environments where speed and ownership matter

 - Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area

 - A strong work ethic and desire to build a category-defining company




BENEFITS



 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 💰 Competitive Salary

 - 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

 - 🍽️ Dinner Provided via Grubhub & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🎤 Team building events

 - 🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health




SALARY RANGE DETAILS



The compensation range for this position is set between $180,000 and $210,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long-term success and upside of the business.



The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high-performing team in a fast-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real-time decision-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem-solving that drives meaningful impact.





EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER



Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.




OUR VALUES



Dream Big - We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic - Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset - We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

Customer Obsession - We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems

• Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite.
• Ability to travel 20-30%. International travel required.
• The role will be based in Madrid with office days on Tue, Wed & Thu.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

 - Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles

jobs.title: Customer Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join the Mitsubishi Motors North America (MMNA) Team!

At Mitsubishi Motors NA, we are driving innovation, quality, and excellence in the automotive industry. Our commitment to delivering cutting-edge vehicles goes hand in hand with our dedication to fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment.

Our team members are the driving force behind our success, and we believe in empowering individuals to contribute their unique skills and perspectives. We are a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement.

At MMNA, your career is not just a job but a journey of growth. Benefit from ongoing employee development programs, contribute to our impactful Community Relations initiatives, and enjoy a range of employee benefits that make your experience with us exceptional.

Be part of a company proud of its heritage and excited about the future where together, we shape the future of mobility and drive success in every mile.

About the Job:

The Customer Connections team serves as a critical link between our customers, dealers, and business partners, helping ensure concerns are resolved with care, urgency, and professionalism. As our organization continues to grow and evolve, we are investing in leadership that can strengthen employee development, elevate the customer experience, and build stronger connections across the business. The Customer Connections Supervisor will play an important role in shaping the future of the team by fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and customer advocacy while supporting the delivery of exceptional service to both customers and dealers. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader who is passionate about developing people, driving positive change, and making a visible impact within the organization.

Summary of Role:

The Customer Connections Supervisor provides day-to-day leadership, coaching, and support for the Customer Connections team. This role is responsible for developing employees, overseeing the resolution of complex customer and dealer concerns, and ensuring the team consistently delivers a high-quality customer experience. The Supervisor works closely with cross-functional partners and department leadership to support operational excellence, employee engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the success of the department and the broader organization.

As a Customer Connections Supervisor, You Will:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Connections Coordinators, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer advocacy.

• Monitor team performance and key operational metrics, providing coaching and feedback to drive customer satisfaction and service excellence.

• Oversee the resolution of complex customer concerns, dealership escalations, and warranty-related issues.

• Conduct performance reviews, quality monitoring, and regular one-on-one meetings to support employee development and engagement.

• Partner with Warranty, Service, Parts, Product Quality, Connected Services, Legal, Field Operations, and Dealer Development to develop and deliver cross-functional training opportunities.

• Analyze customer feedback and operational trends to identify opportunities for process improvements and enhanced service delivery.

• Support onboarding, training, and development activities for new and existing team members.

• Assist with the implementation of new programs, systems, policies, and processes within the department.

• Support departmental goals and continuous improvement initiatives through effective execution and collaboration.

• Promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.

• Other job duties as assigned.

Measuring Your Momentum (Success Metrics):

First 90 Days – Getting Up To Speed

• Learn the Customer Connections operation, team processes, key stakeholders, and performance objectives.

• Build strong relationships with cross-functional teams and dealership partners to support issue resolution and collaboration.

• Analyze customer feedback, operational trends, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Support departmental goals, process improvements, and customer experience initiatives.

• Partner with leadership to align team priorities with business objectives.

Year 1 Victory Lap

• Lead onboarding, training, and development efforts that strengthen employee performance and consistency.

• Establish ongoing cross-functional learning opportunities that enhance team knowledge and collaboration.

• Implement process improvements that positively impact customer satisfaction, quality, or operational efficiency.

• Coach and develop team members through meaningful development discussions and growth opportunities.

• Build a high-performing culture focused on accountability, continuous learning, customer advocacy, and employee engagement.

Ready to Join The Team? You Should Have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

• 3+ years of experience in customer service, customer relations, contact center, dealership support, warranty operations, or a related customer-facing environment.

• 1+ years of experience leading, coaching, mentoring, or supervising employees.

• Experience handling complex customer concerns, escalations, and issue resolution.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments.

• Experience using customer service metrics, quality monitoring, and performance data to support team performance.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

Extra Horsepower (Profile Differentiators):

• Previous supervisory experience in an automotive, manufacturing, dealership, warranty, or customer experience environment.

• Experience supporting customer advocacy, dealership relations, or warranty-related operations.

• Experience developing or delivering employee training, onboarding, or coaching programs.

• Knowledge of customer experience (CX) best practices and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Experience analyzing customer feedback and operational trends to identify improvement opportunities.

• Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) systems and contact center technologies.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Warranty, Product Quality, Service Operations, Dealer Development, Legal, or Field Operations.

• Demonstrated ability to lead projects, process improvements, or change initiatives.

Why Join Us:

• Be part of a team where continuous improvement is at the core of our culture, giving you the opportunity to influence processes, develop employees, and help deliver exceptional customer experiences.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners across the organization to drive meaningful changes that improve service delivery, customer satisfaction, and dealership support.

• Make a visible impact on initiatives focused on customer retention, long-term customer loyalty, and operational excellence while growing your leadership career with Mitsubishi Motors North America.

Pay Transparency:

The base salary for this position ranges between $70,000 to $80,000. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes 401k with company match, Mitsubishi Lease Program, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

Perks and Benefits:

• Family First: Enjoy comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans.

• Be a Proud Mitsubishi Ambassador: Take advantage of our Discounted Employee Lease Car program, covering insurance, maintenance, and registration fees, with no down payment or credit check required.

• Secure Your Future: Benefit from our 401(k) with Company match and annual contributions based on years of service.

• Fuel Your Growth: Access professional development opportunities, including training, tuition reimbursement, and employee resource groups.

• Take Time for Yourself: Enjoy up to 30 days of paid time off, including holidays, vacation, and other leave options.

• Hybrid Working Environment: Experience the perfect balance of remote and in-office work (~2 days remote, 3 days in-office) at our modern office, located in the vibrant Franklin, TN area.

• Thrive in an Open Environment: Experience our collaborative workspace where ideas flow freely.

The MMC Way:

Our values form the foundation of everything we do. At Mitsubishi Motors, we are committed to a set of core principles that guide our actions, decisions, and interactions. Our values reflect who we are as a company, how we collaborate, and the impact we aspire to make. These values are what we call the MMC Way:

• Think of Our Customers, Strengthen Trust

• Enrich Society

• Welcome All Facts, Share Difficult News First

• Conduct and Challenge Yourself Professionally

• Respect All, Work as a Broader Team

Diversity and How to Apply:

At MMNA, we embrace the strength that diverse perspectives and experiences bring to our team. Our application process is designed to champion inclusion and equity. We're on the lookout for the ideal fit for each role, valuing skills and experiences over traditional education or specific company backgrounds. Feel encouraged to apply, even if your profile doesn't precisely match the job description. We invite you to delve into a few thought-provoking questions in our application, offering you the opportunity to showcase your unique talents and insights right from the start.

Once you've submitted your application, expect to hear from us within 7 business days. We're committed to keeping you informed about the status of your application, ensuring transparency and open communication throughout the process. We understand that perfection is a journey, and if you ever have questions about your application or the process itself, don't hesitate to reach out to your recruiter.

Mitsubishi Motors is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, excited about collaborating with talented individuals of all identities. We do not discriminate based on identity, aligning with our commitment to fostering a diverse workplace. Our code of conduct serves as a guiding light for the company we aspire to be, celebrating our differences as the driving force behind a product that serves a global user base.

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities and is prepared to provide reasonable accommodations. If you require such accommodations for the job application or interview process, please email mmna-talent_acquisition@na.mitsubishi-motors.com.

We hope you will join us on this journey where your dedication aligns with our values, creating an environment that fosters growth, collaboration, and meaningful contributions.

Click here to learn more about what it's like at MMNA!

We value your privacy. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice to learn how your personal information is collected, used, and safeguarded throughout the application and hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Space Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Embedded Software Engineer on the Flight Software team is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves & operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. They are responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

• Develop reliable firmware to control how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate through the entire mission.

• Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.

• Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.

• Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.

• Build highly reliable and available software systems.

• Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) techniques.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.

• Experience developing and testing real-time embedded hardware / software systems.

• Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of language concepts.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.

• Experience with additional programming languages such as Python or Rust.

• Strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, data structures, and computer networking.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior Software: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. Mineralys is a fully remote company.

HR Technology & Analytics Specialist

The HR Technology and Analytics Specialist is a hybrid role responsible for supporting and optimizing HR technology platforms, with a primary focus on Workday, while delivering high-quality workforce reporting, analytics, and insights. The role provides day-to-day functional support, contributes to system enhancements and releases, develops reports and dashboards, and helps maintain the quality, consistency, and security of HR data.
Serving as a key resource for HR technology, reporting and workforce analytics, this position partners with HR, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable system solutions, meaningful workforce insights, and improved HR processes.  The Specialist supports Workday enhancements and releases, promotes employee and manager self-service, develops standardized metrics and dashboards, and helps maintain the quality, consistency, security, and usability of HR data.
The ideal candidate combines hands-on HR systems and reporting experience with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

HR Technology Support

• Provide day-to-day functional support for Workday and other HR technology platforms.

• Troubleshoot HR technology issues, research root causes, and coordinate resolution with HR, IT, vendors, and other stakeholders.

• Gather and document business requirements and partner with HR Technology resources to design, test, and deploy Workday configuration changes.

• Drive continuous improvement of Workday business processes by evaluating system releases, identifying quick-win enhancements, and contributing to the longer-term HR technology roadmap initiatives.

• Promote employee and manager self-service adoption through system enhancements, user guidance, training, and ongoing process improvement.

• Support HR technology projects, implementations, integrations, and process improvement initiatives.

• Create and maintain system configuration documentation, process guides and end-user support materials for HR technology platforms and processes.

HR Analytics and Reporting

• Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics to support HR and business requirements.

• Build and maintain calculated fields and report logic within Workday to support complex workforce reporting requirements.

• Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities to analyze workforce trends and support HR and business decision-making.

• Develop and support recurring and ad hoc HR compliance reporting, including data validation and reconciliation to promote accuracy and timely delivery.

• Develop standardized HR metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and scorecards for HR and business leadership.

• Translate analytical findings into clear insights and actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Partner with HR leadership to identify opportunities where analytics can improve workforce outcomes and HR effectiveness.

• Partner with IT to define HR data requirements and support the integration of workforce data into the corporate data lake and broader cross-functional dashboards.

Data Governance and Quality

• Maintain a centralized inventory of HR reports and documented definitions for workforce data and metrics.

• Monitor HR data quality and proactively identify inconsistencies or data integrity issues.

• Partner with HR stakeholders to establish and maintain HR data standards and governance practices.

• Perform audits and reconciliations to ensure HR data is accurate, complete, and reliable.

• Support the development and maintenance of standardized definitions for key workforce metrics and reporting dimensions in partnership with HR stakeholders.

• Maintain appropriate confidentiality and security when working with sensitive employee information.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, Analytics, or related field.

• 6+ years of experience in HRIS, HR analytics, HR reporting, or a related discipline.

• Hands-on experience with Workday HCM.

• Experience developing Workday Advanced and Matrix reports, dashboards, and calculated fields.

• Strong understanding of HR data structures, workforce metrics, and HR business processes.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with demonstrated ability to translate data into business insights.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience handling confidential and sensitive employee information.

Preferred

• Experience using a business intelligence or visualization platform, preferably Power BI, to develop dashboards and communicate workforce insights.

• Knowledge of HR data governance and reporting security.

• Experience supporting workforce planning, organizational analytics, or executive HR dashboards.

Travel

•    10% for occasional team and company meetings

jobs.title: Senior Product Scientist
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

The Senior Product Scientist serves as a contributing member of multiple product pods building and deploying scientific agents across the real-world evidence (RWE) study workflow.  The Senior Product Scientist partners with the Director of Product Science to ensure the scientific credibility and rigor of Datavant Life Sciences’ real-world evidence and data discovery agents. The Senior Product Scientist works as a contributing member of and responsible party within the product pods to ensure agent conceptualization, development, and evaluation meet the needs of Datavant’s scientific customers and the scientific standards of the Datavant science team. Specifically, the Senior Product Scientist works within product pods (e.g. algorithm builder, explore assistant) and with the Director of Product Science to deliver on the following in a responsible and/or supporting role:

• Scientific agent conceptualization (e.g. why is the agent needed? and for whom?)

• Scientific problem statement

• Agent task and bounds

• Scientific workflow design & subject matter expert (SME) review/decision points

• Scientific reference set and agent context

• Scientific evaluation design and application

• Scientific internal testing requirements and execution

The scope of this role includes agents built to complete scientific tasks requiring domain knowledge and expertise in pharmacoepidemiology and RWE as well as agent systems such as end-to-end RWE study agents. As a SME working within the product pods and zones, the product scientist contributes to the scientific submissions product/roadmap governance, including eval sets, agent performance metrics, etc. The role also serves as a SME on the scientific workflows relevant to the agent/agent system.

The Product Scientist serves as the study lead for the scientific delivery of agent co-build/co-development/co-design partnerships with Datavant’s pharma and data ecosystem customers. In this role, the Product Scientist is responsible for embedding scientific standards and SME into the build and delivery of the contracted scientific work, which may include the design of customer-specific agentic RWE workflows, application of those workflows to customer SOPs, design and development of customer-specific agents for RWE tasks across the workflow, and evaluation of those agents.

What You Need to Succeed

• Master’s or doctoral degree in epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, public health, biostatistics, or a related analytic field. Candidates with a master’s degree should have at least 2 years of professional research experience for Senior Scientist consideration or 4 years for Associate Director consideration.

• Experience using healthcare data to conduct pharmacoepidemiology, HEOR, or real-world evidence (RWE) research.

• Knowledge of feasibility assessment, observational study design, data analysis, and the principled application of research methods to generate RWE.

• Ability to design studies, draft protocols, document methodological decisions, and work with research and analytics colleagues to implement studies.

• Strong scientific writing and communication skills, including the ability to prepare protocols, results presentations, and reports; interpret findings; and explain study strengths and limitations.

• Strong critical thinking, organization, attention to detail, and commitment to scientific quality

• Experience leveraging AI tools (agents or LLMs) for scientific work products and fluency in basic AI terminology

What Helps You Stand Out

• Experience with multiple types of healthcare data used in pharmacoepidemiology or HEOR.

• Proficiency with R/Python coding, an evidence generation platform such as Substantiate, or other relevant analytic tools.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
Simtra BioPharma Solutions (Simtra) is a world-class Contract Development Manufacturing Organization, partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring their sterile injectable products to market. With facilities in Bloomington, Indiana, US and Halle/Westfalen, Germany, we offer a wide range of delivery systems including pre-filled syringes, liquid/lyophilized vials, diluents for reconstitution, powder-filled vials and sterile crystallization.

Our product types include biologics and small molecules, cytotoxics, highly potent compounds, diluents for reconstitution and vaccines – which are all directly injected into patients worldwide.  As such, there is a strong emphasis on quality and continuous improvement at Simtra.  We hold ourselves to the highest quality and regulatory standards.

While our primary focus is cGMP manufacturing, we offer many support services including formulation and development, lyophilization optimization, global regulatory support and secondary packaging.  Our teams are driven to help clients scale, innovate and bring life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.

Why join Team Simtra? Because we:

Make it HAPPEN – We bring a growth mindset to every opportunity, developing new skillsets and exceeding our expectations and those of our customers.

Make it TOGETHER – We work as one, respecting each voice and tapping into our unique strengths across teams—so we can solve problems in new ways.

Make it RIGHT – We hold ourselves to a high standard of excellence, fulfilling our commitments to the customer, their patients, and our team members.

Make it COUNT – We take pride in our day-to-day work, knowing the impact we make – taking on challenges big and small to improve patient health.

This Role:

ABOUT TALON.ONE:

Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform.

You’ll own day-to-day IT for our US employees, keeping their tools, devices and access running smoothly and securely. You’ll take charge of defined systems and outcomes, use your judgment to prioritize, and bring clear recommendations when an issue needs a second pair of eyes. This is a full-time role based in Chicago or New York.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

You’ll partner closely with our IT Operations team in our Berlin HQ, to help shape a consistent IT experience for everyone at Talon.One.

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

• Own US IT support by triaging tickets from our ITSM system, email and chat, resolving issues, documenting outcomes and keeping users informed

• Escalate complex or higher-risk cases to Berlin IT with a clear recommendation

• Administer Google Workspace, JAMF, Notion, Slack and Zoom, maintaining accounts, groups, policies and configurations with user and security impact in mind

• Set up and support meeting-room AV, including Google Meet hardware or Zoom Rooms, and troubleshoot audio, video and connectivity issues

• Run identity and access across onboarding, role changes and offboarding, supporting SSO and provisioning and applying least privilege alongside system owners

• Manage the US device lifecycle and asset inventory, from procurement and shipping to repairs, returns and secure offboarding with our hardware and logistics partners

• Support endpoint security and compliance by following established controls, helping triage security alerts and keeping device and account configurations secure

• Improve how IT works by documenting processes and runbooks, spotting repeat problems and implementing practical fixes

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

• Bring 3+ years in IT support or administration, including service-desk practices and end-user computing

• Know Google Workspace and JAMF well, and work confidently on macOS and Windows

• Show familiarity with collaboration tools and meeting-room AV

• Diagnose issues methodically, find root causes and know when to escalate

• Apply SSO, least privilege, endpoint security, data privacy and secure device handling in your daily work

• Prioritize your workload, follow through reliably and document your work clearly

• Collaborate effectively across time zones, with fluent English

jobs.title: Operator Education Lead
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Every clinical decision at Neko Health starts with a scan, and the quality of that scan depends on the operator performing it. As our Global Operator Education Lead, you will set the standard for how operators learn, get signed off, and become ready to work unsupervised in every market.

About the role

You will design the operator curriculum once, globally, define what competent looks like in observable terms, and hold accuracy sign-off on everything operators are taught. You will lead the market educators who deliver the program, and decide when someone is ready to scan members independently. The scope spans device and SOP training, clinical skills such as doppler, ECG and phlebotomy, lab and echo education, and clinic operator lead education, with AI as both a tool and a topic.

What you will do

 - Design and own the global operator curriculum, from onboarding through to expert practice, with local adaptation only where regulation requires it.

 - Define the operator competency framework, assessment design and sign-off standard, so readiness is judged against criteria and not the calendar.

 - Ensure every new or updated device, SOP and workflow reaches every operator before go-live, with understanding verified.

 - Hold accuracy sign-off on every operator-facing asset before it is published.

 - Line manage the operator market educators and the launch trainer, holding one standard across very different markets.

 - Prepare clinic operator leads to run competency conversations and improvement plans, working with the Global Clinician Education Lead.

 - Use scan quality data, audit findings and assessment results to decide what the curriculum teaches next.

 - Teach operators to question AI output, and build AI-supported simulation and assessment.

Requirements

 - Registered healthcare professional with current registration and 5+ years of post-registration experience in a fast-paced, high-volume clinical setting.

 - 3+ years designing and delivering clinical or technical education end to end, including owning the curriculum, competency framework and outcome data.

 - 3+ years building competency-based assessment, where readiness is a judgement against criteria rather than a record of attendance.

 - 3+ years leading or coaching clinical educators or trainers, holding a consistent standard across more than one site.

 - 3+ years building training for devices, procedures or technical skills where technique affects output quality.

 - 3+ years using outcome data to improve a program, and at least 1 year using AI tools in your own work with a considered view on where human review is required.

 - Working style: warm, direct and curious. You build trust across cultures, surface problems early, and hold a high standard while staying close to the people doing the work.

Nice to have

 - Experience in health technology, digital health or a medical device environment where the product changes quickly.

 - Experience building education across more than one country, or scaling a training model into a new market.

 - Instructor status in a relevant clinical skill, such as basic life support, phlebotomy or ultrasound.

 - Familiarity with learning management systems and modern authoring tools, including simulation.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

• San Francisco, CA

About the team

The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes, and serving as a trusted voice to the public markets, the Board, and our shareholders. The Investor Relations team is a small, high-impact group that tells Cloudflare’s financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.

About the role

Cloudflare is looking for an Associate, Investor Relations & Strategic Finance to join our lean IR team and help power how we engage with Wall Street. You will be a core contributor to the quarterly earnings cycle, our consensus and financial modeling work, investor events including our annual Investor Day, and strategic finance projects for senior leadership.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. The work you produce will go directly to the CFO, CEO, Board, and public markets, so we hold ourselves to an exceptionally high bar on accuracy. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team, and you will get broad exposure to the business and to the public markets. We are AI-native in how we work, and we expect you to treat modern tooling as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, and rigor.

What you’ll do

Quarterly earnings and consensus

• Support the end-to-end quarterly earnings process, helping draft and assemble the press release, supplemental financial information, prepared remarks, Q&A prep, and investor deck.

• Build and maintain our consensus model: collect and analyze sell-side estimates and models, and benchmark them against internal forecasts.

• Support the guidance process, including share count forecasting, sensitivity analyses, and supporting materials for leadership.

• Drive tie-out and validation work so that every figure, claim, and disclosure across the press release, supplemental, scripts, Q&A, deck, 10-Q, and 10-K is accurate and consistent.

• Help prepare for earnings Q&A: anticipated questions, peer transcript research, key stats and proof points, and live-call backup material.

• Coordinate the post-earnings analyst callback program, including scheduling, notes, and feedback summaries.

Investor engagement

• Support day-to-day engagement with sell-side analysts and institutional investors, including responding to inbound requests and maintaining our investor database.

• Help plan and run investor events, including sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and non-deal roadshows.

• Prepare briefing materials for the CEO, CFO, and other executives ahead of investor meetings, including investor profiles, talking points, and Q&A prep.

• Maintain core IR collateral, including the investor presentation, fact sheets, and IR website content.

• Analyze shareholder ownership and support investor targeting.

Investor Day and strategic finance projects

• Support the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day, including the invite tracker and registration, content drafting, validation, and day-of logistics.

• Contribute to strategic finance projects such as peer benchmarking, competitive analyses, long-range financial modeling, and ad-hoc analyses for senior leadership.

Analytics and tooling

• Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer results, investor sentiment, and industry trends into clear, actionable summaries for leadership.

• Build and maintain the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation tools that let a small team operate at scale.

• Use AI-native tooling and automation to improve speed, accuracy, and insight across the IR function.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• 3–5 years of experience in investment banking, equity research, investor relations, FP&A, corporate finance, or equity investing; exposure to public technology companies is a plus. Strong financial modeling skills, including building and maintaining operating models, consensus models, and share count and dilution forecasts. Solid understanding of financial statements, public-company reporting, and valuation; familiarity with SaaS or consumption-based revenue models is a plus. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, concise materials for senior executives and to turn complex financial or technical concepts into simple narratives. Exceptional attention to detail, and pride in getting every number right. An ownership mindset: you are organized, take initiative, and can manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment, especially during earnings season. High-trust collaboration, with the ability to work effectively with teams across Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Communications. AI-native curiosity and skill: fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. Sound judgment with confidential information, including awareness of materiality, fair disclosure, and Reg FD (or a strong willingness to learn). Genuine interest in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or AI, and in the public markets.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $117,000 - $161,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer, AMER
jobs.location: Boston, Chicago, New York, San Francisco
jobs.description:
ABOUT TALON.ONE:

Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform.
Built for enterprise scale and security, Talon.One helps businesses design and deliver incentives that drive real customer behavior.

Today, over 300 of the world’s most-loved brands including Sephora, Gymshark and Costa Coffee work with Talon.One to turn their incentives into a reliable growth engine.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you'll be the technical advisor our most strategic clients turn to when they're weighing complex architectural decisions. You'll bridge what they need with what Talon.One can do, and you'll do it as a long-term partner, not a one-deal specialist. You'll also work closely with our technology and agency partners, giving them the technical guidance they need to integrate with and build on Talon.One's Incentive engine, and helping them unlock value.

This role is based in one of our US hubs (Boston, NYC, Chicago, San Francisco), with occasional travel (10-20% of your time).

ABOUT THE TEAM:

You'll join a 6-person Sales Engineering team in AMER, part of a 14-person global SE org, reporting to our Head of Sales Engineering AMER. We're shifting from fast, transactional deals toward deep, trust-based partnerships with accounts like the ones you'd recognize from retail and e-commerce, so this role exists specifically to give that shift the technical weight it needs.

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

• Run deep technical discovery with existing clients, mapping their architecture, gaps, and requirements

• Design and architect solutions, including custom POCs, that hold up under real client scrutiny

• Own the technical thread of RFI/RFP responses for major enterprise accounts, shaping how we differentiate early

• Adapt demo material and messaging to fit each client's business, challenges, and audience

• Guide technology and agency partners through technical onboarding and training so they can launch their first Talon.One projects successfully

• Build and maintain relationships with technical stakeholders up to CTO and CPO level

• Execute Proofs of Technology, on-site or remote, that convert technical trust into commercial momentum

• Partner closely with the Strategic Account team to turn discovery into a sharp, tailored value proposition

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

• Bring 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Business Analyst consultant, ideally in commerce or customer engagement

• Understand modern application architecture deeply, including REST APIs, microservices, and container deployment

• Show experience navigating technically complex products that touch multiple departments, like Marketing, Tech, Loyalty, Procurement, Pricing, or Merchandising

• Demonstrate a track record of long-tenured, relationship-driven work rather than fast quarterly deal cycles

• Build consensus across technical and business stakeholders in large organizations

• Explain complex technical ideas in plain, concise language to both technical and business audiences

The estimated total compensation for this role is $215,000 - $235,000, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time.

Perform entrance control: Enforce the District’s entry and identification system which includes operating security screening equipment to detect weapons, contraband, and prohibited items, checking items such as handbags, briefcases, computers, packages, baby carriages, wheelchairs, etc.

Perform roving patrol: Patrol court facilities and grounds of the facility in accordance with applicable post orders.

Perform stationary post assignments: Stand guard at stationary posts which include (but not limited to) monitoring closed-circuit television, duress alarm systems and other security equipment, courtrooms, judge chambers, and jury rooms.

Perform escort duties: When directed, provide armed escort services for judges, court personnel, jurors, and other designated individuals.

Perform garage parking and pedestrian control: Where applicable, direct traffic and control lights on court facility properties, as described in the post orders and/or standard operating procedures.

Enforce law and order: Enforce federal law while in the performance of assigned duties. This includes (but not limited to) detaining any person attempting to gain unauthorized access to Government property, or a court proceeding(s), or attempting to commit acts that imperil the safety and security of Government employees, property, and the public.

Prepare reports and records: Prepare various reports and records regarding contract performance issues, such as labor hours worked, accidents, fire, bomb threats, unusual incidents, or unlawful acts that occurred within the court facility area.

Court attendance: Responsible for securing unattended courtrooms, an inspection of courtrooms prior to a proceeding, testing of security devices, and other duties concerning security of the court area.

Preserve order: Responsible for providing security presence in the courtroom, enforcing federal law and judicial orders within the courtroom, enforcing local court rules regarding prohibited items, and providing protection to court proceedings as circumstances dictate.

Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or general education degree (GED). At least three (3) calendar years of verifiable experience as a certified law enforcement officer or its military equivalency (Master-at-Arms, CGPD, Security Forces Specialist, etc.); all three (3) years must have occurred within the last seven (7) years. The experience must have included general arrest authority.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Must possess the ability to understand, explain, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, directives, and procedures.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Must have a valid driver's license from state of residency and a safe driving record for the past five years; Must receive clearance from the Department of Justice. Must have completed or graduated from certified Federal, state, county, local or military law enforcement training academy and able to provide certification as proof.

Other Qualifications: Must be at least 21 years of age; Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check.

jobs.title: Information Security Specialist
jobs.description:
All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution.

Position Overview

Data Systems Analysts, Inc. (DSA) is seeking an experienced Information Security Specialist Subject Matter Expert (SME) to serve as the Assistant Information System Security Manager (A-ISSM) supporting the Scalable GEOINT mission at Fort Gordon, GA.

In this role, you will help ensure classified intelligence systems remain secure, compliant, operational, and authorized to support critical Army and Intelligence Community missions.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in cybersecurity management, Risk Management Framework (RMF) accreditation, security policy development, and classified information system security. You will work closely with government security leadership, Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), system administrators, and Authorizing Officials to manage security risks and maintain compliance with Department of Defense (DoD), Army, and Intelligence Community requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the Government Information System Security Manager (ISSM) in developing, implementing, and overseeing information system security policies and procedures.

• Lead and coordinate Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, including security authorization, continuous monitoring, and maintaining Authorizations to Operate (ATOs).

• Develop, implement, assess, and monitor security controls in accordance with NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 and applicable DoD, Army, and Intelligence Community requirements.

• Identify, assess, document, and mitigate cybersecurity vulnerabilities and risks.

• Develop and maintain Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), ensuring identified security deficiencies are tracked through remediation or resolution.

• Ensure compliance with Defense Information Systems Agency Security Technical Implementation Guides (DISA STIGs) and Information Assurance Vulnerability Management (IAVM) requirements.

• Oversee security compliance across Windows, Windows Server, and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.

• Support the implementation and management of endpoint security, vulnerability management, and logging solutions, including Tanium, Trellix/HBSS/AESS, and Splunk.

• Coordinate access management, account security, and privileged access controls.

• Investigate and document security incidents, violations, and potential compliance deficiencies.

• Develop and maintain security documentation, contingency plans, emergency procedures, and security awareness materials.

• Collaborate with government stakeholders, ISSOs, system administrators, external vendors, inspectors, and the Authorizing Official's chain throughout security assessments and accreditation activities.

• Provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance to ensure the continued security and operational readiness of classified GEOINT systems.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• 10+ years of experience in information security management, including responsibility for cybersecurity governance, security compliance, and risk management.

• Demonstrated subject matter expertise in developing, implementing, and overseeing information security policies.

• Extensive hands-on experience supporting DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) accreditation and security authorization processes.

• Strong working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5, security control assessments, continuous monitoring, and POA&M management.

• Experience implementing and maintaining DISA STIG and IAVM compliance across Windows, Windows Server, and RHEL environments.

• Experience with cybersecurity tools and technologies, including Tanium, Trellix/HBSS/AESS, and Splunk.

• Experience identifying, evaluating, documenting, and mitigating information system security risks.

• Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

• Advanced information security management certification, such as CISSP or CISM.

• Ability to meet DoDM 8140.03 baseline certification requirements for the assigned cybersecurity work role at the start of employment.

• Ability to obtain the required computing environment certification before receiving privileged access.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience serving as an ISSM, Assistant ISSM, Deputy ISSM, or senior ISSO supporting classified DoD or Intelligence Community systems.

• Experience supporting DoDIIS, JWICS, or other classified intelligence information systems.

• Experience overseeing, mentoring, or coordinating teams of Information System Security Officers (ISSOs).

• Familiarity with cross-domain solutions, secure data transfer processes, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).

• Experience supporting Army intelligence, GEOINT, NGA, INSCOM, or similar national security programs.

• Additional advanced cybersecurity certifications, such as CCSP or CISSP-ISSMP.

Security Clearance Requirements

• Active, final Top Secret security clearance required at the start of employment.

• Must be eligible for access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI).

• Must meet all applicable security requirements for access to classified systems and facilities.

Why Join DSA?

This position offers the opportunity to play a meaningful role in protecting classified intelligence capabilities supporting U.S. Army and Intelligence Community operations.

As an A-ISSM, you will contribute directly to cybersecurity governance, risk management, and the continued operational readiness of mission-critical GEOINT systems. You will work alongside government security leadership and experienced cybersecurity professionals while helping shape the policies and security practices protecting sensitive national security environments.

About Data Systems Analysts, Inc.

Data Systems Analysts, Inc. (DSA) is an employee-owned technology and professional services company supporting federal government and commercial customers. DSA provides mission-focused solutions across cybersecurity, information technology, enterprise modernization, and systems engineering.

DSA offers a collaborative environment, professional growth opportunities, and the benefits of employee ownership.

Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Location

This position will be based in Charlotte, NC.

Reporting

This position will report to the Senior NetSuite Product Manager.

Summary of Role

The Senior Financial Systems Analyst will work as a technofunctional expert for all things Financial Systems. This role will help bridge the gap between the business users and the IT team for our technical system setups. This role will focus on NetSuite, Stampli, Workiva, and all other Financial systems. This role will be key in the documentation of enhancements and controls in our key systems.

Strategic & Tactical

• Technical Systems Expert

• Lead the end-to-end enhancement lifecycle for multiple applications concurrently (requirements, design, build, test, deploy).

• Configure roles, permissions, custom forms, workflows, and scripts.

• Manage the NetSuite subsidiary, location, and entity structure to support multi-entity consolidation.

• Document business requirements from Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.

• Standardize the requirements of development or external development partners.

• Translate functional needs into configuration specs, such as: saved searches, workflows, custom fields, and custom records.

• IT Controls

• Own and maintain ITGC controls, including: access controls, change management, and operations controls across all financial systems.

• Enforce SDLC documentation requirements for all development and automation efforts.

• Perform risk assessment for production changes and ensure all BRDs, FSDs, and UAT evidence are archived.

• Maintain the Segregation of Duties (SoD) matrix and review access conflicts quarterly.

• Act as the technical contact for internal and external auditors and quickly fix any findings.

• Monitor integrations across systems to ensure no data is lost and all key financial data is complete and accurate.

• Process Mapping and Automation

• Build a full catalog of end-to-end process maps across O2C, P2P, R2R and other cycles.

• Identify high-impact manual tasks and drive automation via workflows and third-party integrations.

• Design automated approval chains with proper SoD controls embedded at the workflow level.

• Proactively identify AI driven capabilities that can streamline financial / accounting system processes

• Test Scripts and UAT

• Design and own the test script library for any new NetSuite configurations and customizations.

• Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business process owners and document sign-off.

• Ensure defect tracking, retesting, and final approval follow SDLC documentation requirements.

• Master Data Management

• Identify each “source of truth” for key master data.

• Standardize and govern critical master data, including: Locations, Subsidiaries, Entities, COA, and Vendors.

• Ensure data integrity across all systems and integrated downstream systems (BI, payroll, etc.).

• Define and enforce naming conventions and data entry standards across the organization.

• Program Management

• Lead, facilitate, and drive key initiatives forward while engaging with 3rd party support vendors and/or internal stakeholders and delivery teams

Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on NetSuite Business Analysis or ERP experience.

• Functional expertise across O2C (Order-to-Cash), P2P (Procure-to-Pay), and R2R (Record-to-Report) cycles.

• Demonstrated experience authoring BRDs, IDDs and FSDs.

• Working knowledge of ITGCs and Application Controls within an integrated ERP environment.

• Proficiency with workflow automation, saved searches, reports, dashboards, custom fields, and forms in Netsuite.

• Strong understanding of Segregation of Duties (SoD) principles and access control governance.

• Ability to perform NetSuite system configuration independently without developer dependency for standard customizations.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

jobs.description:
Laurel is on a mission to return time. As the leading AI Time platform for professional services firms, we’re transforming how organizations capture, analyze, and optimize their most valuable resource: time. Our proprietary machine learning technology automates work time capture and connects time data to business outcomes, enabling firms to increase profitability, improve client delivery, and make data-driven strategic decisions. We serve many of the world's largest accounting and law firms, including EY, Aprio, Crowell & Moring, and Frost Brown Todd, and process over 1 billion work activities annually that have never been collected and aggregated before Laurel’s AI Time platform. 



Our team comprises top talent in AI, product development, and engineering—innovative, humble, and forward-thinking professionals committed to redefining productivity in the knowledge economy. We're building solutions that empower workers to deliver twice the value in half the time, giving people more time to be creative and impactful. If you're passionate about transforming how people work and building a lasting company that explores the essence of time itself, we'd love to meet you.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Customer Support team runs a 24/7 global operation supporting customers at major law and professional services firms worldwide. We have six team members across the U.S., U.K., and Australia, and work with two additional support agents in the Philippines.

Our mission is to resolve customer problems quickly and turn what we learn into a better product. We help customers get back to work, share recurring problems with Product and Engineering, and improve the guidance and processes our team uses every day.

We also make time to connect across time zones. On “Annoying Ticket Fridays,” we share frustrating tickets from the week and pick one thing to improve so the next similar case is less painful. Our monthly “BARREL OF FUN” calls give us time to play a game or just catch up.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer Support Associate, you’ll help Laurel customers troubleshoot issues and use the product effectively during your agreed schedule of either 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. or 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET). We’re adding this role to expand late U.S. afternoon and early APAC morning coverage as our customer base grows.

You’ll manage customer conversations through email and messaging, with occasional Zoom calls or screenshares. You’ll resolve common problems, document and escalate issues that need additional investigation, and keep customers informed through resolution. You’ll also contribute to documentation and support improvements with guidance from your teammates.

You’ll report to Jordan Knott and be paired with an onboarding buddy to help you learn the product and how the team works.


CORE DUTIES

 - Becoming an expert on the Laurel product.

 - Responding to and resolving inbound customer support inquiries promptly, with clear and accurate communication, during your agreed schedule of either 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. or 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET). This includes:
   
   - Resolving common capture, release, and configuration issues using training and documented procedures, and gathering evidence to escalate complex or unfamiliar issues.
   
   - Thoroughly documenting technical problems that users are encountering, and escalating them internally as needed.
   
   - Educating customers about our product.

 - Staying up-to-date on product changes through team updates, training, and documentation.

 - Thoroughly understanding customers’ needs and preferences, and articulating these internally on an as-needed basis.

 - Contributing to Help Center articles, internal documentation, and scoped support improvements with guidance from teammates. Flagging incorrect or incomplete AI answers and suggesting source improvements for review.

 - Identifying patterns across customer conversations and proactively surfacing improvements to documentation, processes, or the product.

 - Providing clear escalation details to Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, coordinating next steps, and keeping customers informed through resolution.


YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Are able to work a regular schedule of either 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. or 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET), based on team coverage needs and your availability. We’ll confirm the schedule during the hiring process.

 - Are based anywhere in the United States.

 - Have 3+ years of experience providing customer support in a SaaS or software environment.

 - Have superior written communication skills – you are an excellent “explainer.”

 - Have strong problem-solving skills, investigate software behavior systematically, and recognize when an issue needs escalation.

 - Have a proven track record of driving high customer satisfaction and following through on issues until they’re fully resolved.

 - Manage customer conversations efficiently and prioritize cases based on urgency and customer impact.

 - Can contribute to customer-facing or internal documentation, flag recurring issues, and complete scoped improvement tasks with guidance.

 - Have a proven track record of building strong working relationships with colleagues in a remote, distributed environment.

 - Learn new software, adapt to product changes, and apply feedback.

 - Can manage assigned cases independently after onboarding and ask for help when needed.


FLEXIBILITY AND LOGISTICS

Location: This is a remote role open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

Working hours: Your regular schedule will be either 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. or 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET), based on team coverage needs and your availability. We’ll confirm the schedule during the hiring process. Occasional weekend work may be required, along with some holiday coverage on a rotating basis.

Compensation: Competitive salary, generous equity, supplemental benefits. Final compensation amounts will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and expertise.

Flexible time off: Laurel has a flexible Paid Time Off policy and we encourage our team members to take time off regularly to rest and recharge. Because you will be working on a small team, you will be expected to thoughtfully coordinate time off with your manager and teammates.

Visa Sponsorship: Unfortunately we are unable to sponsor visas at this time.


WHY JOIN LAUREL:

 - To date, we've secured significant funding from renowned venture capitalists (Google Ventures, IVP, Anthos, Upfront Ventures), as well as notable individuals like Marc Benioff, Gokul Rajaram, Kevin Weil, and Alexis Ohanian

 - A smart, fun, collaborative, and inclusive team

 - Great employee benefits, including equity and 401K

 - Bi-annual, in-person company off-sites, in unique locations, to grow and share time with the team

 - An opportunity to perform at your best while growing, making a meaningful impact on the company's trajectory, and embodying our core values: understanding your "why," dancing in the rain, being your whole self, and sanctifying time

We encourage diverse perspectives and rigorous thinkers who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. Laurel is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are not able to support visa sponsorship or relocation assistance. 



If you think you'd be a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t perfectly match all the bullet points in the job description. At Laurel, we strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages people from all walks of life to bring their unique, diverse perspectives to work. Every day, we aim to build an environment that empowers us all to do the best work of our careers, and we can't wait to show you what we have to offer!
