jobs.title: Billing Specialist
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

Join Optimal Care as a Billing Specialist and become an essential member of our billing team, ensuring timely and accurate processing of all claims and payments.  As a Billing Specialist, you'll be responsible for the accurate and timely completion and submission of Medicare, Medicaid, private payer, and patient billing, along with accounts receivable tracking and follow-up. Reporting to the Billing Manager, you'll play a critical role in maintaining our revenue cycle by ensuring every claim is processed correctly and every account is monitored closely.  This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop your healthcare billing expertise in a supportive team environment. You'll work with cutting-edge billing systems, collaborate with an interdisciplinary team, and gain hands-on experience with diverse payer requirements while contributing to the financial health of our organization.

What You'll Do

Accurate Billing & Claims Processing

• Enter patient billing data accurately, including visit charges and supply charges, into the information system

• Process and bill Medicare, Medicaid, private payer, and patient claims in accordance with payer requirements and organizational policy

• Maintain complete and accurate billing and accounts receivable records

• Prepare remittances for data entry with precision and attention to detail

Accounts Receivable Management

• Monitor accounts receivable to support timely collection of payments

• Assist with collection efforts by resubmitting bills to overdue accounts

• Alert Billing Manager of seriously overdue accounts requiring escalation

• Track payment patterns and identify potential collection issues

Reporting & Analysis

• Assist in preparation of monthly billing and accounts receivable reports

• Maintain accurate Medicare and Medicaid billing analysis reports

• Provide data and insights that support billing performance monitoring

• Document billing activities and maintain organized records

Quality Assurance & Communication

• Alert management team members about late or missing documents required for billing

• Establish and maintain positive working relationships with patients, payers, and other customers

• Ensure all billing activities comply with payer requirements and organizational policies

• Support billing team goals through collaborative problem-solving

Special Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Perform specific projects relating to billing, data entry, and computer operations as required

• Identify opportunities to improve billing processes and efficiency

• Stay current on payer requirements and billing regulations

• Maintain confidentiality of patient and organizational information at all times

What We're Looking For

Required:

• High School Diploma or GED

• Home care or hospice care billing experience preferred

Preferred:

• Associate's degree

Essential Skills:

• Exceptional accuracy in data entry and claim processing

• Strong ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to work effectively as part of an interdisciplinary team

• Comfortable with billing software and information systems

Personal Qualities:

• Takes initiative with minimal supervision

• Handles frequent adjustments and shifting priorities with professionalism

• Maintains confidentiality and displays courtesy in all interactions

• Takes pride in accuracy and completeness of work

• Works cooperatively with colleagues and supports team success

Why Join Our Team?

• Work with an experienced Billing Manager and collaborative team

• Opportunities to advance your billing career and take on new responsibilities

• Office-based role with minimal travel and consistent schedule

Work Environment

This is an office-based position with minimal travel. The role requires moderate to high adaptability as you'll need to make frequent adjustments to respond to billing priorities, payer requirements, and organizational needs. You'll work in a collaborative team environment focused on accuracy, efficiency, and exceptional service.

Ready to Launch Your Healthcare Billing Career?

If you're detail-oriented, enjoy working with numbers and systems, and want to contribute to a healthcare organization's financial success, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Co-Op - Spring 2027
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and talented Embedded AI Software Engineering Intern/Co-op to join our team for the summer. As an intern, you will work on cutting-edge embedded AI and computer vision applications for mobile machines, with a focus on optimizing AI models and real-time processing pipelines for deployment on embedded hardware.

This role provides hands-on experience developing, deploying, profiling, and optimizing AI-powered vision systems on resource-constrained embedded platforms. You will work closely with our software engineering team to improve inference performance, reduce processing latency, and maximize hardware utilization while maintaining real-time system performance.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with the software development team to develop and optimize embedded AI and computer vision applications for mobile machines.
• Deploy, benchmark, and optimize AI models for execution on embedded targets, including platforms equipped with hardware AI accelerators.
• Optimize real-time video processing and AI inference pipelines to improve throughput, reduce latency, and minimize CPU, GPU, and memory utilization.
• Profile and troubleshoot on-target performance bottlenecks involving image acquisition, preprocessing, inference, postprocessing, and video output.
• Explore AI model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, and hardware-specific acceleration to improve inference efficiency.
• Develop and optimize software components in C/C++ for embedded Linux and real-time operating systems.
• Integrate AI models with camera systems, sensor inputs, and embedded communication interfaces.
• Develop testing and benchmarking tools to evaluate model accuracy, execution time, memory consumption, and end-to-end pipeline performance.
• Document software architecture, optimization strategies, performance results, and implementation details.
• Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and technical discussions.

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical field.
• Familiarity with C/C++ programming.
• Fundamental understanding of embedded systems and software development.
• Basic knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or computer vision concepts.
• Familiarity with Linux development environments.
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience deploying AI or computer vision models on embedded hardware.
• Familiarity with AI frameworks and deployment tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorFlow Lite, or ONNX.
• Experience optimizing neural networks through quantization, model compression, or hardware-specific inference acceleration.
• Familiarity with embedded AI accelerators, GPUs, or NPUs, including platforms such as Texas Instruments TDA4.
• Experience with real-time video processing frameworks such as GStreamer, OpenCV, or similar technologies.
• Experience with embedded Linux, QNX, or other real-time operating systems.
• Familiarity with performance profiling tools and optimization techniques for CPU, GPU, memory, and system-level bottlenecks.
• Knowledge of image processing, object detection, or semantic segmentation models.
• Experience with embedded communication protocols such as CAN or Ethernet.
• Familiarity with cross-compilation, hardware debugging, and on-target software development.

jobs.title: Subcontractor Default Underwriting Lead
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Commercial insurance still runs on processes built decades ago. Underwriting is slow, and pricing leans on broad averages instead of the specifics of each risk. Technology can change how commercial risk is priced and managed, as long as it's paired with real underwriting expertise. The companies that get this right will shape the next era of the industry, and Shepherd intends to lead it.

Shepherd is a Managing General Underwriter (MGU) building the fastest and smartest AI-native commercial risk platform in the industry, where underwriters, data, and automation work together. The result is faster decisions for our broker partners and pricing that reflects the actual risk.

We started where the gap is widest: construction and energy, two of the most complex and highest-hazard segments in commercial insurance. Today we write Primary and Excess Casualty, Builder’s Risk, and Workers' Compensation distributed through a nationwide network of retail brokers. Our mission is to make risk frictionless for the builders and operators shaping the physical world, from concept through construction and into decades of operation.

 


🚀 OUR INVESTORS

Shepherd has raised over $67M, including a $42M Series B led by Intact Private Capital. Intact also partners with Shepherd to provide capacity across its insurance products. Shepherd is also backed by leading institutional investors, including Costanoa Ventures, Spark Capital, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator.

 


🏗️ SUBCONTRACTOR DEFAULT UNDERWRITING LEAD

Shepherd is launching a Subcontractor Default Insurance (SDI) product in support of its existing Construction vertical. The Subcontractor Default Underwriting Lead will play a lead role in building and shaping the new SDI product expansion, and define how we best evaluate subcontractor prequalification controls and subcontractor management practices. This is an opportunity to help define the underwriting strategy, go-to-market, and drive long-term profitable growth for the core pillars of Shepherd’s business. We're looking for someone with 8+ years of SDI underwriting experience, a proven track record of leadership, deep broker relationships, and an entrepreneurial mindset who is excited to build something new with modern technology and a forward-thinking team.


🎯 ABOUT YOU

You are a builder who wants to shape the future of commercial insurance and do the best work of your career. You have deep subcontractor default insurance expertise, a loyal broker network, and the drive to turn a blank page into a profitable book.

You'd be a great fit if you have:

 - 8+ years of underwriting experience, with significant direct experience underwriting Subcontractor Default Insurance at an established SDI carrier or program. Contract surety underwriters with meaningful SDI exposure will also be considered.

 - Deep knowledge of general contractors and construction managers across the construction industry.

 - A proven record of building and growing an SDI portfolio profitably: originating new business, quoting, binding, and scaling premium while managing to loss-ratio and combined-ratio targets.

 - Strong financial analysis skills, including reviewing contractor financial statements, work-in-progress (WIP) schedules, backlog, working capital, and bank lines, and judging a contractor's capacity to perform.

 - Deep understanding of how general contractors prequalify, select, and manage subcontractors, and the ability to evaluate the strength of a contractor's prequalification, monitoring, and default-management practices.

 - Technical command of SDI program structure, including enrollment, per-loss deductibles, co-pays, per-loss and aggregate limits, project and annual programs, and how SDI compares to subcontractor bonds.

 - Sound judgment on policy wording, direct and indirect cost coverage, and default, cure, and completion scenarios, working closely with claims on complex losses.

 - Established broker relationships at the regional and national level that can drive submission flow from day one.

 - People leadership experience leading, mentoring, or managing underwriters, including setting authority and running underwriting audits.

 - Executive presence to present strategy and results to leadership, capacity partners, and reinsurers.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound decisions with incomplete information and adapt quickly as the business evolves.

 - Willingness to travel about 25% to meet brokers, partners, and the team.

 - A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. A background in construction accounting, finance, or law is a plus.


💼 ABOUT THE ROLE

Shepherd's underwriting approach is client-centric with a heavy emphasis on an efficient process. Our goal is to leverage our technology and data to make quick, informed underwriting decisions tailored to our clients' specific needs.

In this role, you will:

 - Define and build Shepherd’s SDI strategy,including target contractor profiles, construction sectors, program sizes, limits and retentions, geographies, appetite, and growth and loss-ratio targets.

 - Help establish the underwriting guidelines, authority framework, referral rules, and rating approach for the product.

 - Work with capacity partners to secure and structure the paper behind the program, and keep those partners informed on results.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to design the submission-to-bind workflow, contractor financial and prequalification analysis tools, and portfolio views.

 - Underwrite new and renewal SDI programs within your authority, including financial review, prequalification audits, and meetings with contractor leadership.

 - Set up procedures for monitoring in-force programs for changes in contractor financial health, backlog, and subcontractor enrollment, and take action when the risk changes.

 - Own premium, profit, loss-ratio, and retention results for the book.

 - Use your broker relationships to drive submission flow in the first year, and actively market Shepherd's SDI product at broker and client meetings, industry events, and through targeted business development.

 - Hire, coach, and grow a team of SDI underwriters as the book scales.

 - Track construction market trends, including labor, materials, and subcontractor financial stress, to keep Shepherd profitable and competitive.

 - Work with Risk Engineering, Actuarial, Corporate Underwriting, Claims, Customer Experience and Finance so the business is underwritten, serviced, and reported well.

This is a position based in our New York City, San Francisco, Chicago, Los Angeles, or Dallas–Fort Worth offices.


💰 COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $240,000, plus an annual performance bonus and equity in Shepherd. Offers within the range depend on experience and the relationships and market following you bring.


⚡ HOW WE WORK

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

 - 🚀 Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. You're building an SDI vertical meant to scale nationally, so the guidelines, products, and tools get designed for where the book is going, not just where it starts.

 - 🤝 Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. As the first underwriter in this vertical, you set the standard every SDI underwriter after you inherits.

 - 🔄 Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best underwriting tools here come from underwriters who sit with engineers and data scientists, and much of this job is making that partnership work.

 - 🔥 Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the appetite, the broker list, or the first submission. You build the plan, make the calls, and bind the first deal.


🌟 BENEFITS

🏥 Premium Healthcare
100% contribution to top-tier health, dental, and vision

👶 Fertility Benefits & Family Building Support

🌴 Unlimited PTO
Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform

🍽️ Daily Lunches, Dinners & Snacks
We work together, and enjoy meals together too

🏢 SF, NYC, Dallas–Fort Worth, Chicago & LA Offices

📈 Professional Development
Access to premium coaching, including leadership development

💵 Competitive 401(k) Plan

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office
Plenty of dogs to play with and make friends with in the SF office

#LI-Onsite


HOW WE WORK

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

 - Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy.

 - Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. Come set a standard the rest of the team inherits.

 - Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen.

 - Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters.

 


BENEFITS

100% contribution to top-tier health, dental, and vision

🥕 Fertility benefits and family building support

Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform

We work together, and enjoy meals together too

jobs.title: Professional Liability Underwriting Lead
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Commercial insurance still runs on processes built decades ago. Underwriting is slow, and pricing leans on broad averages instead of the specifics of each risk. Technology can change how commercial risk is priced and managed, as long as it's paired with real underwriting expertise. The companies that get this right will shape the next era of the industry, and Shepherd intends to lead it.

Shepherd is a Managing General Underwriter (MGU) building the fastest and smartest AI-native commercial risk platform in the industry, where underwriters, data, and automation work together. The result is faster decisions for our broker partners and pricing that reflects the actual risk.

We started where the gap is widest: construction and energy, two of the most complex and highest-hazard segments in commercial insurance. Today we write Primary and Excess Casualty, Builder’s Risk, and Workers' Compensation distributed through a nationwide network of retail brokers. Our mission is to make risk frictionless for the builders and operators shaping the physical world, from concept through construction and into decades of operation.

 


🚀 OUR INVESTORS

Shepherd has raised over $67M, including a $42M Series B led by Intact Private Capital. Intact also partners with Shepherd to provide capacity across its insurance products. Shepherd is also backed by leading institutional investors, including Costanoa Ventures, Spark Capital, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator.

 


🏗️ PROFESSIONAL LIABILITY UNDERWRITING LEAD

Shepherd is launching a Professional Liability product to support its existing Construction and Energy verticals as well as future verticals.The Professional Liability Underwriting Lead will play a lead role in building and shaping the new product expansion, with an initial focus on Errors & Omissions (E&O) and Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL). This is an opportunity to help define the underwriting strategy, go-to-market, and drive long-term profitable growth for the core pillars of Shepherd’s business. We're looking for someone with 8+ years of professional liability underwriting experience, a proven track record of leadership, deep broker relationships, and an entrepreneurial mindset who is excited to build something new with modern technology and a forward-thinking team.


🎯 ABOUT YOU

You are a builder who wants to shape the future of commercial insurance and do the best work of your career. You have deep professional liability expertise, a loyal broker network, and the drive to turn a blank page into a profitable book.

You'd be a great fit if you have:

 - 8+ years of professional liability underwriting, with deep expertise across architects and engineers E&O as well as exposure to other industries such as technology, financial services, real estate, manufacturing or healthcare.

 - A proven record of profitable growth: originating new business, quoting, binding, and building a professional liability book while managing to loss-ratio and combined-ratio targets.

 - Strong technical command of risk selection, underwriting models, exposure and loss analysis, loss development and trends, pricing, and coverage across E&O and MPL.

 - Strong technical command of risk selection, application and financial review, pricing, and coverage, including claims-made forms, retroactive dates, prior acts, extended reporting periods, retentions, and primary and excess structures.

 - Sound judgment on manuscript endorsements, contractual liability, and emerging exposures across professional services, including technology, regulatory, and litigation trends.

 - Established broker relationships at the regional and national level that can drive submission flow from day one.

 - People leadership experience leading, mentoring, or managing underwriters, including setting authority and running underwriting audits.

 - Executive presence to present strategy and results to leadership, capacity partners, and reinsurers.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound decisions with incomplete information and adapt quickly as the business evolves.

 - Willingness to travel about 25% to meet brokers, partners, and the team.

 - A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


💼 ABOUT THE ROLE

Shepherd's underwriting approach is client-centric with a heavy emphasis on an efficient process. Our goal is to leverage our technology and data to make quick, informed underwriting decisions tailored to our clients' specific needs.

In this role, you will:

 - Define the strategy for professional liability, including target classes, lines of business, limits, attachment points, geographies, appetite, and growth and loss-ratio targets.

 - Support the development of underwriting guidelines, rating approach, authority framework and referral rules.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to design the submission-to-bind workflow, pricing tools, and exposure and loss-trend views.

 - Underwrite new and renewal primary and excess professional liability within your authority.

 - Own premium, profit, loss-ratio, and retention results for the book.

 - Use your broker relationships to drive submission flow in the first year, and actively market Shepherd's professional lines products at broker and client meetings, industry events, and through targeted business development.

 - Hire, coach, and grow a team of professional liability underwriters as the book scales.

 - Work with Corporate Underwriting to help set letters of authority, run underwriting audits, and coach from the results.

 - Work with Claims, Actuarial, Customer Experience and Finance so the business is underwritten, serviced, and reported well.

This is a position based in our New York City, San Francisco, Chicago, Los Angeles, or Dallas–Fort Worth offices.


💰 COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $240,000, plus an annual performance bonus and equity in Shepherd. Offers within the range depend on experience and the relationships and market following you bring.


⚡ HOW WE WORK

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

 - 🚀 Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. You're building a professional lines vertical meant to scale nationally, so the guidelines, products, and tools get designed for where the book is going, not just where it starts.

 - 🤝 Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. As the first underwriter in this vertical, you set the standard for every professional liability underwriter after you inherit.

 - 🔄 Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best underwriting tools here come from underwriters who sit with engineers and data scientists, and much of this job is making that partnership work.

 - 🔥 Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the appetite, the broker list, or the first submission. You build the plan, make the calls, and bind the first deal.


🌟 BENEFITS

🏥 Premium Healthcare
100% contribution to top-tier health, dental, and vision

👶 Fertility Benefits & Family Building Support

🌴 Unlimited PTO
Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform

We work together, and enjoy meals together too

Access to premium coaching, including leadership development

jobs.title: Pipe Welder - Fabrication Shop
jobs.description:
Job Title: Pipe Welder

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Fabrication Shop
Location: Casper, WY
Reports to:  Foreman/Superintendent

Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

Loenbro is seeking experienced Fab Shop Pipe Welders to join our Casper Fabrication Shop team. This position is responsible for fabricating, fitting, and welding pipe spools and related assemblies for industrial and energy-sector projects. Candidates should have experience producing high-quality welds using GTAW (TIG) and GMAW (MIG/Wire Feed) processes while maintaining productivity, safety, and quality standards.

This is a full-time, long-term opportunity with a growing company that offers career advancement, competitive benefits, and the stability of consistent shop-based work.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Fabricate, fit, weld, and assemble pipe spools and related assemblies in a fabrication shop environment.

• Perform high-quality welds using GTAW (TIG) and GMAW (MIG/Wire Feed) processes in accordance with approved welding procedures.

• Read and interpret isometric drawings, fabrication drawings, blueprints, and weld symbols.

• Verify fit-up, dimensions, alignment, and weld quality before final completion.

• Select proper welding consumables, filler metals, and materials based on project requirements.

• Inspect completed welds to ensure compliance with applicable codes, specifications, and customer standards.

• Operate fabrication equipment and material-handling equipment safely and efficiently.

• Assist in training and mentoring welder helpers and apprentices.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

• Follow all company safety policies, quality requirements, and customer specifications.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• Minimum three (3) years of pipe welding experience in a fabrication shop, industrial construction, oil & gas, energy, mining, or related industry; or completion of a two-year welding program from an accredited technical or vocational school.

• Proficiency in GTAW (TIG) and GMAW (MIG/Wire Feed) welding processes.

• Experience welding carbon steel and/or stainless steel pipe.

• Ability to read and interpret isometric drawings, fabrication drawings, blueprints, and weld symbols.

• Knowledge of applicable welding codes, quality standards, and fabrication practices.

• Knowledge of weld shrinkage, distortion control, and fit-up techniques.

• Ability to pass a pre-employment weld test.

Preferred:

• Experience with SMAW and FCAW welding processes.

• OSHA 10 certification.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Work is performed primarily in a fabrication shop environment with exposure to varying temperatures, welding operations, cutting equipment, fabrication machinery, overhead cranes, and material handling equipment.

• Frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, lifting, and other physically demanding activities are required throughout the workday.

• Exposure to noise levels above 85 decibels, welding fumes, airborne particulates, and other industrial shop conditions is expected.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist, Labor & Employee Relations
jobs.description:
Forbes is an iconic global media brand that has symbolized success for over a century. Fueled by journalism that informs and inspires, Forbes spotlights the doers and doings shaping industries, achieving success and making an impact on the world. Forbes connects and convenes the most influential communities ranging from billionaires, business leaders and rising entrepreneurs to creators and innovators. The Forbes brand reaches more than 140 million people monthly worldwide through its trusted journalism, signature ForbesLive events and 49 licensed local editions in 81 countries.

Forbes is seeking an experienced HR Labor Generalist to manage a broad range of employee and labor relations matters for our union-represented employees and leaders. This person will serve as a trusted advisor to our newsroom leaders, providing practical guidance on employee relations, performance management, workplace investigations, collective bargaining agreement administration and day-to-day union matters.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working directly with employees, managers and union representatives and who can navigate complex workplace issues with sound judgment, discretion and a practical approach. This individual will also support broader HR/company initiatives, priorities and special projects as needed, partnering across the HR team and business.

This is a Hybrid role that must be based in the NJ tri-state area.  Position will require the individual to work in the Jersey City office a minimum of 2 days per week (Tuesdays & Wednesdays) as well as onsite at any other work location as needed.

Responsibilities:

Labor Relations

• Serve as a primary point of contact for day-to-day labor relations matters involving Forbes' union-represented employees.

• Develop and maintain constructive working relationships with union representatives and internal stakeholders.

• Serve as a management representative on joint management-union committees and participate in committee meetings, discussions and related initiatives.

• Interpret and administer collective bargaining agreements and advise newsroom leaders regarding contractual requirements and obligations.

• Manage grievances from initial filing through investigation, response and resolution.

• Prepare for and participate in grievance meetings and other labor-management discussions.

• Advise leaders regarding potential labor implications of business decisions, organizational changes, staffing changes and new workplace practices.

• Partner with HR, Legal, Payroll and business leaders to ensure consistent implementation of collective bargaining agreement provisions.

• Maintain accurate records and documentation relating to grievances, labor-management discussions and other labor matters.

Employee Relations

• Provide day-to-day employee relations guidance and support to managers and employees.

• Coach managers on performance management, corrective action, workplace conduct, attendance, policy interpretation and other employee matters.

• Conduct prompt, thorough and objective workplace investigations involving employee complaints, workplace conduct, harassment, discrimination, retaliation and potential policy violations.

• Prepare investigation findings and recommendations and partner with HR leadership and Legal, as appropriate, regarding next steps.

• Advise managers on difficult employee conversations and help ensure employee matters are handled consistently and appropriately.

• Review and provide guidance regarding performance improvement plans, written warnings and other corrective actions.

• Partner with HR leadership on employee separations, reorganizations, reductions in force and other workforce changes.

• Identify emerging employee relations issues and trends and recommend practical solutions before issues escalate.

• Maintain appropriate documentation and case records regarding investigations, performance matters, grievances and other employee relations activity.

Manager & HR Partnership

• Build strong relationships with leaders and serve as a practical, accessible resource on employee and labor relations matters.

• Provide managers with guidance and tools to address workplace issues effectively and consistently.

• Develop and deliver training for managers on employee relations, performance management, workplace investigations and responsibilities when managing union-represented employees.

• Partner closely with members of the HR team to ensure consistent application of company policies and employment practices.

• Work collaboratively with the Managing Editor, Legal, Payroll, Finance and other internal partners on matters involving employee and labor relations.

• Responsible for all union-related reporting and deliverables, as well as the administration of all contractual compensation requirements under the CBA.

Employment & Labor Compliance

• Maintain current knowledge of federal, state and local employment and labor laws and regulations, particularly those affecting employees in New York, New Jersey and Connecticut.

• Monitor developments in labor law, employee relations practices and workplace regulations and advise HR leadership regarding potential impact.

• Assist with updating policies, practices and manager guidance in response to changes in legal requirements, collective bargaining agreements or business needs.

The ideal candidate:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required.

• 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with significant experience in employee relations and labor relations.

• Demonstrated experience working in a unionized environment and administering collective bargaining agreements.

• Experience handling grievances and working directly with union representatives.

• Experience conducting complex workplace investigations and advising managers on sensitive employee relations matters.

• Strong understanding of federal and state employment and labor laws, including the National Labor Relations Act.

• Experience supporting collective bargaining or labor negotiations strongly preferred.

• Experience with arbitration, NLRB matters and other labor proceedings preferred.

• Experience working in media, publishing, digital media or another fast-paced professional environment is a plus.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with employees, managers, senior leaders and union representatives.

• Strong judgment and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.

• Ability to manage multiple matters simultaneously and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment.

• Practical and solutions-oriented approach with the ability to balance employee, contractual, legal and business considerations.

• Ability to work independently while knowing when matters should be escalated to HR leadership or Legal.

The annual base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $140,000

Forbes has estimated the compensation range set forth above in good faith.  The compensation range is what we believe we will offer, and ultimately pay, a successful candidate.  In determining this range, we consider the experience, level of education (if applicable to the role), knowledge, skills, and abilities required to be had by a successful candidate as well as the budget and the company’s pay rates, generally. This said, we may have to make changes to our compensation estimates and job descriptions from time to time and we expressly reserve the right to do so.  Should we make any such changes, this advertisement will be revised to reflect such revisions.  We encourage you to occasionally re-visit this advertisement to ensure that you are abreast of any changes.  Thank you for your interest in joining Forbes!

#LI-RL1
#LI-Hybrid

This role may evolve over time. While this job description outlines the primary responsibilities, additional duties may be assigned as business needs change. Forbes aims to offer employees the flexibility they need in order to be successful. Some positions may require candidates to be based in a specific location for consideration while some roles may be fully remote (within the U.S.) if it aligns with the needs of the position. This position is only open to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, & Washington. Due to business operations and compliance requirements, we are unable to consider applicants based outside these states at this time.

Forbes is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Tanzania Government Relations Coordinator (Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

Our Tanzania program, founded in 2013, supports more than 100,000 farmers with quality farm supplies, as well as fruit trees. Our team in Tanzania is headquartered in Iringa and supported by three smaller offices—Mbeya and Njombe in the southern highlands, and Moshi in the north where the team is focused on expanding our services to new clients. One Acre Fund works in select areas in the Iringa and Mbeya regions, with a growing presence in the country’s north.

About the Role

Seeking an experienced Government Relations Coordinator to strengthen LGA partnerships and regulatory alignment, reduce field risks, and unlock government collaboration to scale OAF’s farmer and agroforestry impact toward 2030

Responsibilities

LGA Partnerships & Government Relations

• Own key Local Government Authority (LGA) relationships and lead liaison efforts across regional and local authorities to unlock government collaboration and co-investment opportunities.

Regulatory Alignment & Risk Mitigation

• Translate evolving regulatory requirements—including carbon, agroforestry, tax, and environmental compliance—into practical field guidance while proactively identifying and mitigating operational risks.

Cross-Functional Support & Execution

• Partner internally with department leads and regional coordinators to align government strategy with field operations and ensure program execution meets organizational targets.

Team Leadership & System Building

• Supervise and mentor direct reports, build structured compliance systems, and establish scalable processes to enable sustainable expansion toward OAF's 2030 vision.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

• Bachelor's Degree in Government Relations, Public Policy, Public Administration, Development Studies, Law, or a related field.

• 3+ years of professional experience in local government relations, public sector engagement, or regulatory compliance in Tanzania.

• Demonstrated track record in building and managing strategic relationships with Local Government Authorities (LGAs) and regional stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of local regulatory frameworks, including carbon, agroforestry, tax, and environmental compliance.

• Proven team leadership experience, with the ability to manage direct reports and guide cross-functional teams under dynamic political environments.

• Excellent communication, risk mitigation, and stakeholder management skills with internal and external partners.

• Fluency in English and Swahili is required.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Iringa, Tanzania

Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

Contract Duration

1 year

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Tanzania.

Application Deadline

13 January 2027. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (CLEARANCE REQUIRED)
jobs.description:
About the Team

STR’s Analytics and C2 Division researches and develops novel technologies to solve challenging national security problems through advanced analytics. Our team consists of passionate and motivated engineers and scientists with advanced degrees in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, and data science. We use our expertise and creativity to take innovative ideas from conception to mature implementation to improve mission success of our customers.

The Signals Exploitation and Tracking (SET) Group in the Analytics and C2 Division focuses on applying machine learning, statistics, estimation theory, and information theory algorithms for signals exploitation, target tracking, predictive analytics, and system resource management.

The Role

As a Software Engineer at STR, you will help develop disruptive technologies focused on estimation theory, prediction and system resource management.  You will design and implement flexible software solutions and collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams. You will provide high-impact, unique solutions for our customers’ most important problems. We are looking for someone to join our team onsite as this position is based primarily in the Woburn, MA office.

Who you are:

• Active Top Secret Clearance Required with SCI eligibility, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

• BS + 2 years, Master's Degree, or equivalent experience

• Proficient in writing maintainable, well documented code and APIs

• Able to work and collaborate on multi-disciplinary teams

• Experience using Linux

• Expertise using C++, Python, and Java

• Experience with container-based software (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)

Even better:

• Have experience in intelligence or military-related mission areas

• Have experience with micro-service architecture and DevOps pipelines

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $115,000 - $145,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representatives – UK Sales Operations
jobs.description:
Take ownership of the operations behind a growing sales organisation

TOMRA Collection is looking for an experienced Sales Coordinator to join our team in Belgrade and become a key operational partner to our UK Key Account and Sales teams.

If your background is in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Sales Coordination or Sales Support, this is an opportunity to take on broader ownership and play an important role in how a busy international sales organisation operates.

This isn't a role about simply processing requests. You'll take ownership of the processes and coordination behind major customer opportunities, helping ensure that quotations, approvals, CRM data, technical information, proposals and internal actions keep moving.

What you'll own

Working closely with UK Key Account Managers and Sales Managers, you'll provide the structure and operational discipline that enables the sales team to concentrate on customers and commercial opportunities.

You'll:

• Drive sales operations and coordination, maintaining visibility of opportunities, actions, owners, deadlines and customer commitments.
• Own CRM and pipeline quality, helping maintain accurate account, opportunity, timing, value and next-action information in UPSales.
• Coordinate the quotation process, from customer requirements and internal approvals through to accurate commercial documentation.
• Support pipeline and forecasting activities, ensuring high-quality information is available for pipeline reviews and management reporting.
• Enable Key Account Managers, preparing information for important customer meetings and driving agreed actions afterwards.
• Coordinate commercial and technical information, connecting Sales with Technical, Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing and other specialists.
• Support proposals and tenders, coordinating inputs, documentation, deadlines and quality.
• Strengthen Sales-to-Operations handovers, ensuring won opportunities are properly documented before moving into execution.
• Improve commercial processes, identifying unnecessary delays, information gaps and opportunities to improve workflows, templates, CRM usage and standardisation.

More than traditional Sales Support

The Key Account Manager retains ownership of the customer relationship, commercial decisions, negotiations and closing. You own much of what makes the commercial process work effectively around them.

That means proactively following up actions, connecting stakeholders, resolving gaps and maintaining momentum until there is a clear outcome or agreed next step.

For someone coming from Sales Operations, this offers exposure across the commercial lifecycle, including CRM and pipeline management, quotations, proposals, technical coordination, operational handovers and process improvement.

Ready to make things happen?

Join TOMRA in Belgrade and help us build an efficient, responsive and scalable commercial operation supporting our UK business.

What you bring

We're particularly interested in people with 2+ years' experience across Sales Operations, Sales Coordination, Sales Support, Commercial Coordination, Customer Operations or a comparable B2B environment.

• Strong experience coordinating commercial processes and multiple stakeholders.

Why TOMRA?

jobs.title: Staff Detection & Response Engineer
jobs.description:

This is your chance to shape how a fast-growing AI company keeps its platform secure — not just by responding to threats, but by building the systems, playbooks, and automation that make every response faster and smarter.

jobs.title: Senior Demand Planning Specialist
jobs.description:
The Senior Demand Planner and Analyst balances the strategic process of driving cross-functional consensus with a deep focus on the statistical accuracy of the forecast, achieved through rigorous data cleansing and advanced modeling methodologies. This role is responsible for creating and managing demand plans and developing rolling statistical forecasts to ensure high product availability across all market cycles while optimizing global inventory levels. Positioned at the center of the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes, this role requires strong leadership, data analytics, and communication skills to drive consensus across Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain. This role is a key driver in balancing supply and demand to support the achievement of our strategic goals

Core Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain robust statistical forecast models over a rolling 24-to-33-month horizon to support mid/long-term Capacity Planning (CAPL).Manage the Statistical Forecast scenario as a direct feed into the Demand working scenario, ensuring only actively validated plans flow to S&OP cyclesAnalyze historical sales data, and market intelligence to identify underlying demand patterns, and disaggregate data from Site level down to Material-Site, Product Hierarchy , Core Business Field, or Customer level. Perform error analysis (e.g., MAPE) to continuously improve forecast quality and reduce biasTrack, analyze, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), focusing on Forecast Accuracy and bias mitigation, providing insightful analysis on variances and driving continuous improvement initiatives.Lead systematic monthly Root Cause Analysis (RC) and define actionable Measures (MC) for top-offending part numbers that fail accuracy targets. Set up automated alert parameters to identify and flag significant deviations between actual sales orders and the demand or consensus plans, with target to providing actionable insights for internal use and review with CustomersAnalyze past sales, seasonality, and market intelligence to identify and model underlying demand patterns.Facilitate monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Demand Validation meetings to align stakeholders on a single consensus forecastManage product lifecycles by maintaining planning master data (such as LifeCyclePhase), and seamlessly executing new product launches and product phase-outsEstablish and evaluate safety stock policies, Inventory planning strategies, and replenishment plans to balance customer service levels against inventory costsProvide ad-hoc analytical support and scenario planning to senior management for decision-making regarding volume mix changes and other business inquiries.

• Experience: 7+ years of experience in demand planning, supply chain analysis, or a similar role.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Statistics, or a related field. An MBA or advanced certification (e.g., IBF, APICS) is a asset.
• Possess a set of skills that include analytical capabilities, strong business discernment and judgment, and an ability to influence decisions by working across different organizational functions beyond the supply chain
• Advanced experience with statistical forecasting software, S/4HANA, and S&OP planning platforms (e.g., Kinaxis Rapid Response, SAP IBP, Anaplan).
• Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel (advanced modeling, formulas, data manipulation.
• Strong capabilities in business intelligence and data tools (SQL, Power BI, Tableau) for building performance dashboards and automating reports.
• Solid understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, including BOM-explosions, capacity planning, and financial planning alignment
• Analytical Mindset: Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail.
• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to lead cross-functional workshops, influence stakeholders, and drive business consensus.
• Excellent structured, analytical, and systematic approach to goal-oriented planning.
• Superior written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data structures into actionable executive insights Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

jobs.title: Vice President, Growth
jobs.description:
Vice President of Growth

Location: Remote (U.S.)
Employment type: Full-time
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Compensation: $200K, along with equity and incentive bonuses

About the role

SimpliFed is looking for a Vice President of Growth to build a predictable, capital-efficient growth engine around our best-in-class baby feeding and lactation care.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally develop executive relationships, negotiate and close partnerships, and turn those agreements into referrals, completed care, and sustainable revenue. You will own the growth strategy and the execution that makes it work.

Partnerships will remain our primary focus in 2027. You will expand that foundation, build relationships with larger consumer-facing organizations that complement our offering, and strengthen SimpliFed’s own consumer presence through brand positioning, organic discovery, earned media, and social engagement. You will also pursue selective OB opportunities that preserve our curated patient experience and meet our financial and operational requirements.

We are looking for someone who can show how their work produced measurable growth—and who understands that our clinical model, patient trust, and accountability for outcomes are central to our commercial value.

What you’ll own

• Partnership growth. Expand existing accounts and secure new partners. Build joint activation plans, strengthen referral workflows, and create predictable volume from partners that already reach families at scale.

• Strategic consumer partnerships. Identify and close relationships with complementary maternal health, mom and baby, and consumer health organizations. Use their established audiences, trusted brands, and marketing reach to connect more families to SimpliFed.

• Partner value and economics. Build business cases that demonstrate how SimpliFed improves a partner’s offering, engagement, and commercial performance. Prioritize opportunities based on referral potential, economics, implementation requirements, and strategic fit.

• Partnership execution. Own prospecting, negotiation, launch coordination, performance reviews, renewals, and expansion. Work with internal teams to ensure commercial commitments can be delivered and partners produce results after signing.

• Consumer channel foundation. Sharpen positioning; lead search engine optimization and answer engine optimization (SEO/AEO); develop earned media and placements on established mom and baby platforms; and reinvigorate social media to build credibility and organic acquisition.

• Selective OB expansion. Grow existing relationships and activate partners with established commercial teams. Evaluate RFPs and provider or professional services agreements against economics, operational fit, and preservation of SimpliFed’s care pathway. Keep this channel focused without building a broad field sales team.

• Growth planning and reporting. Own channel priorities, budgets, pipeline, forecasts, and performance reporting. Use demonstrated partnership economics to guide additional DTC investment.

• Team leadership. Lead a focused team and external specialists or agencies. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and add resources where results support the investment.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: You have assessed the pipeline, existing partner performance, and patient acquisition journey; established a growth baseline; and built a prioritized plan with owners, milestones, channel economics, and forecasts.

• First six months: Priority partners have clear activation and expansion plans, new opportunities are progressing toward launch, and the brand, SEO/AEO, earned media, and social strategy is being executed with measurable results.

• Ongoing: DME and complementary partnerships generate growing, predictable referrals and completed visits. Conversion, acquisition costs, channel contribution, revenue, and forecast accuracy are measured and improving, with patient experience and clinical outcomes monitored alongside growth.

What we’re looking for

Required

• Demonstrated success growing a healthcare, virtual care, or consumer health business through partnerships.

• Personal ownership of sourcing, negotiating, closing, and expanding complex commercial agreements.

• Evidence of converting signed partnerships into patient acquisition and revenue, with results you can explain and substantiate.

• Experience with B2B2C growth and an understanding of consumer acquisition.

• Ability to evaluate acquisition costs, conversion, retention, and contribution margin and use those measures to allocate resources.

• Experience leading brand and organic growth initiatives, directly or through specialists.

• Strong executive relationship skills and the ability to align clinical, operational, product, and finance teams around a commercial plan.

• Startup experience or demonstrated ability to execute with a small team and limited resources.

Preferred

• Relationships or experience within women’s health, virtual care, maternal health, baby feeding, or mom and baby consumer brands.

• Experience with OB networks and provider or professional services agreements.

• Experience activating referral, co-marketing, or integrated care partnerships.

• Familiarity with SEO/AEO, earned media, and social strategies in healthcare or consumer health.

• Experience growing an insurance-covered virtual care offering.

What we offer

• Ownership of a growth strategy with clear priorities and substantial room to build.

• Close collaboration with the CEO and leadership team on partnerships, positioning, and investment decisions.

• The opportunity to help define a category while improving access to care for parents and babies.

Compensation and Benefits

• Salary: $200K

• Incentive compensation and equity

• Paid time off, holidays, retirement benefits, and remote work arrangements

How we work

You will work across Clinical, Operations, Product, Finance, and Marketing to connect growth with our capacity to deliver excellent care. Expect clear priorities, direct feedback, and accountability for results. We value leaders who build relationships, stay close to execution, and surface problems with proposed solutions.

Our values are: Owners; Do what is right; Trust the team; Be students.

About SimpliFed

SimpliFed supports families with baby feeding and lactation care from pregnancy through their feeding journey. We are building a category-defining, best-in-class care experience that combines compassionate, evidence-backed support with a curated patient pathway and accountability for improving outcomes.

Our partnerships help families access that care at scale and help complementary organizations offer more comprehensive support. Growth must preserve the experience, clinical model, and results that make families and partners choose SimpliFed.

About You

• You care about our mission and the families we serve.

• You pair strategic judgment with a willingness to do the work.

• You communicate clearly across a distributed team.

• You take initiative and seek support early when you encounter obstacles.

• You approach unfamiliar challenges with curiosity and follow-through.

• You protect patient and provider information.

• You act with integrity and respect the realities of operating in healthcare.

• You collaborate well in a fast-moving environment.

• You are currently authorized to work full-time in the United States.

SimpliFed welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and is committed to equal employment opportunity for all qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIRCUITHUB

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.


THE ROLE

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

 - They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

 - They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

 - They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

 - They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

 - They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.


HOW WE BUILD

 - Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

 - Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

 - Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

 - Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.


RECENT WORK

 - Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

 - A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

 - Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

 - Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

 - A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

 - You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

 - You build the eval before you trust the result.

 - You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

 - Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.


STACK

 - Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown

 - Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL

 - Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry


PAY

UK £80k–£125k · US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity.

jobs.title: Field Officer
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year on year. And, we’re still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people’s everyday lives.

We are looking for a field officer to manage product rollouts as we launch our business in Malawi. You will also represent Wave, oversee our distribution and marketing, interact with and recruit users, and conduct interviews with individuals about their needs and concerns related to money transfer and financial services.

In this role, you'll;

• Identify and build a local agent network in Karonga and guarantee the agent network is fully trained on applications, the contents of the contract before signing, rebalancing options, fraud management, etc.

• Recruit target users and onboard them on the use of Wave products.

• Collaborate with Field Officers in different locations to progress the adoption of Wave products.

• Ensure agent quality and compliance with legal and policy requirements.

• Ensure all agents are well-branded and well-equipped. Monitor the cash and float availability at agent locations.

• Manage risk through routine visits to report emerging issues and assess agents' performance in your territory.

• Identify underperforming agents, close them, recover Wave items and equipment, and ensure that branding material is removed.

• Be the primary contact for all agency networks acquiring Wave products in your territory.

• Champion excellent customer service among distributors and agents within your territory.

• Support distribution activities;

• Coach, train and mentor your team to achieve the desired market impact and targets.

• Scout zones where distribution should happen and give guidance on the zone where possible distributors should work.

• Encourage and motivate distributors to perform to their fullest potential.

• Help with the training and smooth onboarding of new distributors and enforce a good work environment and team-building.

• Monitor progress related to distribution activities in the field.

Key Details

• Location: This is a field role and you will be based in a district/territory as assigned.

• Work authorization in Malawi is required.

• Contract type: Fixed-term contract (6-month renewable).

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Lunch and field facilitation are provided.

Requirements

• At least 3 years of relevant work experience, specifically managing an agent network in Malawi, including a minimum of 1 year of experience managing field-based teams

• Proven sales ability with a successful track record in sales, including identifying customer needs and connecting corridors.

• Language: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both English and a local language.

• Exceptional interpersonal skills in building and maintaining positive relationships.

• Willingness to relocate to assigned territories.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are excited about working in the field, as this is a largely field-operations role.

• Detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a clear and proactive communicator, able to independently follow through on tasks and able to manage team priorities effectively.

• Enjoy teamwork, but also know how to work well independently.

• Are intellectually curious, creative in the way you go about tackling problems, and embrace failure as a means to spark innovation and growth.

• Communicate effectively and often, both in writing and in person, to the point of over-communication.

• Demonstrate tenacity and a willingness to go the distance to get something done.

• Are tech-savvy: comfortable navigating Excel and onboarding new tools.

#LI-MM1

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Medewerker Back Office
