jobs.description:
The licensed Occupational Therapist (OTR/L) reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• A licensed occupational therapist who complies with the Code of Ethics/Standards of Practice as outlined by their professional organization and by the State of Illinois.
• The position includes direct patient care, teaching, participation on appropriate committees and departmental process improvement.
• Serves as a role model for all therapists and clinical interns in all aspects of professional, clinical, communication, education and leadership activities.

Responsibilities:

• Demonstrates the NM values of Patients First, Integrity, Teamwork, and Excellence.
• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, and acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Facilitates collaborative care with other healthcare team members.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Demonstrates essential skill competencies in selecting the appropriate evaluation in the use of treatment modalities, equipment and protocols. Performs re-evaluations according to department guidelines, adjusting the treatment plan accordingly. Evidenced by chart review.
• Demonstrates creative problem solving and diversity when adapting the treatment to special circumstances.
• Assumes complete responsibility over the course of OT patient management from the time of initial contact to discharge for functional progress, safety and treatment outcome as evidenced by team feedback and documentation. Maintains primary responsibility over patient plans of care through timely and consistent collaboration with treating COTA(s).
• Adheres to department policy regarding evaluations, progress notes, and discharge summaries. All notes reflect medical necessity and are accurately entered per policy into the electronic medical record.
• Completes daily notes that reflect patient's response to treatment, actual performance, and an assessment as to status, relevant to the treatment plan and eventual discharge needs as evidenced by chart review, meeting all regulatory documentation requirements (e.g., allows other therapists to continue treatment, allows for interpretation by payers, supports reimbursement).
• Provides educational materials and methods appropriate to the patient's level of understanding and motivation as evidenced by chart review, observation and team feedback.
• Participates in committees, department processes, and special projects in accordance with clinical expertise and individual performance plan.
• Creates a culture of respectful communication by listening, asking for input, open and honest conversation, approachability and timely acknowledgement of individual and team contributions.
• Works to develop and maintain professional relationships with members of healthcare teams (ex: physician, nurse, case manager). Participates in internal and external marketing per department expectations.
• Accepts constructive feedback and is able to make timely changes as evidenced by written coaching forms/chart audits and team feedback.
• Proactively completes non-patient care responsibilities within established time frames consistently (e.g. coverage notes, PTO/schedule change requests, bonus pay forms, discharge checklists, follow up phone calls).
• Contributes to educational efforts of department/clinic (e.g. in-services, Journal Club, new hire orientation, process improvement).
• Actively participates in student clinical or observation programs by serving as a clinical instructor, mentor, or observation host as per department expectations
• Maintains productivity standards per department expectations
• Completes all NM required education, competencies and training within required timeframes.
• Demonstrates willingness to accommodate patient care needs and department specific meetings as needed.
• Demonstrates willingness to flex schedule or assignment to meet patient care needs, staff meetings, and department specific meetings outside normal work hours

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Therapy
• Occupational Therapist License in the state of Illinois
• BLS from American Heart Association upon hire

Preferred:

• Masters or Doctoral degree in Occupational Therapy

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Rezident/ka logistiky  - príležitostný zástup na dohodu
jobs.description:
- Ideálne pre: uchádzačov/uchádzačky, ktorí hľadajú pravidelný vedľajší príjem popri hlavnom pracovnom pomere

- Miesto výkonu práce: Daejung, Nová Dubnica (BOSCH rezident/ka u dodávateľa: Daejung)

- Pracovný úväzok: Max. 10 hodín týždenne na dohodu o pracovnej činnosti (nárazovo, podľa potreby – zástup počas dovoleniek, PN-ky a iných výpadkov)

Nápĺň práce:

- Príprava zásielok: spracovanie príjmov a výdajov tovaru v systéme SAP (POE/PA5), tlač dodacích listov, pripojenie etikiet  a vizuálna kontrola zásielok

- Komunikácia s dopravcom, odovzdanie objednávky na vyzdvihnutie, dokumentov vodičom, dohliadanie na nakládku, následné sledovanie zásielok

- Riešenie požiadaviek a reklamácií, denných interakcií týkajúcich sa skladových zásob, nevybavených objednávok, výroby a logistiky

- Komunikácia so zamestnancami Daejungu v prípade problémov s objednávkami, kvalitou, balením či expedíciou

Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním: stredoškolské s maturitou

Jazykové znalosti: anglický jazyk (B2 - stredne pokročilý)

Ostatné znalosti: Microsoft Excel (pokročilý)

Ponúkame:

- Flexibilný pracovný čas

- Práca vhodná ako doplnkový príjem

- Možnosť získať skúsenosti v medzinárodnej spoločnosti

Mzdové podmienky (brutto)

12.00 EUR/hod.

Informácie o výberovom konaní

Vážime si Váš záujem o inzerovanú pracovnú ponuku, oslovíme však len tých uchádzačov/uchádzačky, ktorí budú vyhovovať stanoveným podmienkam. Ďakujeme za pochopenie.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Headquartered in Austin, TX with operations in Kermit and Monahans, TX, Atlas Energy Solutions is the leading provider of high-quality frac sand and innovative logistics solutions to Exploration & Production operators and oil field service providers in the Permian Basin. We are proud of what we do – we have state of the art manufacturing facilities, premium offerings, outstanding customer service, and exceptional work culture and a commitment to giving back to the community.

We’re very excited about what we see in front of us, and we think you will be too – so come join our team and contribute   to our growth!

Warehouse Associate

The Day Warehouse Associate is responsible for storing, cycle counting and housekeeping of parts/components/materials and managing inventory supporting Maintenance and Operations. This role will report to the Warehouse Manager.

Responsibilities:

• Locate, provide parts and components to both Maintenance and Production personnel.

• Properly store all items to Atlas warehouse standards.

• Stocks and unloads materials.

• Maintain updated parts and component cycle count, warehouse and laydown yards organization, manage parts life cycle via Epicor.

• Maintain cleanliness in warehouse, around the warehouses, all storage areas, and other designated areas.

• Ensure all on-hand inventory balances are accurate through the completion of monthly cycle counts and assist with reconciliation of any discrepant items.

• Prepare and forward all documentation – including but not limited to: inventory sign out log, pick ticket

• Performs regular inventories and cycle counts on parts/materials/components established by Warehouse Manager.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with plant personnel, and management

• Ability to operate warehouse equipment including a forklift and telehandler safely.

Qualifications:

• Excellent customer service, verbal and written communication and problem-solving skills.

• High sense of urgency and strong attention to detail.

• Ability to carry out instructions furnished in oral/diagrammatic or written form that involves standardized work with some latitude for independent judgement.

• High school or GED.

• Must be fluent in English.

• Local to the immediate Kermit region.

• Regular and on-time attendance is required

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.

• Ability to lift heavy objects up to 75 pounds.

• Frequent bending, kneeling, stooping, pushing, pulling, climbing stairs or ladders and reaching overhead may be required.

• Perform repetitive motions.

• Ability to work long periods of time in non-climate-controlled areas.

What You’ll Love About Us:

• Best People and Great Places to Work, Hire Vets, Top Place to Work For – Austin American Statesman

• Your Well-Being is a 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision

• Invest in Your 401K with company match, immediate vesting

jobs.title: Call Center Agent
jobs.description:
Multi-site Dermatology Group Seeks Call Center Agent

Advanced Dermatology and Skin Care Center is recruiting a full time Call Center Agent to join our growing Dermatology group in Boardman, OH. Advanced Dermatology is a partner of Optima Dermatology.

Responsibilities:

• Answering phones and handling a high volume of calls

• Data entry

• Scheduling appointments

• Work with provider schedules

• Dispatch calls as needed

Qualifications:

• Must have strong computer skills

• Familiarity with insurances, preferred

About Advanced Dermatology and Skin Care Center

At Advanced Dermatology and Skin Care Center, our mission to revolutionize skin care starts by partnering with outstanding, industry-leading dermatologists. We strive to be the best in everything we do, and we take pride in creating environments where our physicians and providers excel. Our powerhouse practice support and back-office teams are 100% focused on ensuring all aspects of the practice are optimized to fully support our exceptional providers. Our comprehensive approach gives our dermatologists the tools and the time to focus on doing what they love—providing great patient care. If you want to join a team dedicated to revolutionizing dermatology, we’d love to connect with you.

jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
About Typeface
We help the world’s biggest brands move from brief to fully personalized campaigns — in days, not months.

Founded by Abhay Parasnis and backed by Microsoft, GV, Salesforce, Lightspeed, Madrona and Menlo, we’re building category-defining technology at the intersection of creativity and AI with real impact. Join us to help shape the future of enterprise marketing.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Staff Infrastructure Engineer to help lead core parts of our platform. You'll design, build, and scale the cloud infrastructure that powers our AI and GenAI workloads — ensuring reliability, security, and performance as we grow.

This is your chance to shape the backbone of a platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies — building systems that are resilient, observable, and ready to scale with the next wave of AI.

How You'll Make an Impact:

• Design, deploy, and manage production-grade cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure to support AI/GenAI workloads at scale

• Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters and container orchestration pipelines for high-availability services

• Develop and evolve infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) to ensure reproducible, auditable environments

• Implement comprehensive observability — monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing — to maintain system health and accelerate incident response

• Harden infrastructure security posture through network policies, secrets management, IAM best practices, and compliance controls

• Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of GPU and compute-intensive workloads that power generative AI capabilities

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Security partners to define SLOs and drive continuous improvements in platform resilience

• Automate CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows to enable fast, safe releases across environments

• Mentor and support fellow engineers, contributing to a strong infrastructure engineering culture

What You Bring:

• 10+ years of Infrastructure, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating production systems at scale

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Deep expertise with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration in production environments

• Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including networking, compute, storage, and identity services

• Solid understanding of observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar) and incident management practices

• Experience with security best practices for cloud-native environments — including network segmentation, secrets management, and compliance frameworks

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive independently and in collaborative teams

• Bonus: Experience scaling infrastructure for AI/ML or generative AI workloads, including GPU orchestration

Location

This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, CA. We collaborate in-office 3 days a week.

Base Salary

The range for this role is $210,000-$240,000 plus equity. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation — including salary, equity, and 401(k)

• Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family

• HSA and FSA options to support your financial wellness

• Flexible time off — including parental leave

• Well-being programs — resources to support your mental and physical health

• Daily lunch & snacks

• Mentorship & impact — work closely with top AI leaders on products that ship

Equality Opportunity Statement
We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. To efficiently and effectively provide patient triage and a variety of nursing treatment functions including but not limited to; assessment of symptoms, prioritizing patient appointments, determining patient disposition, and providing feedback to provider.

• Debrief/communicate with provider as needed.

• Document all patient-provider-staff communication in EPIC.

• Communicates with insurance companies to obtain required authorizations, if applicable.

• Participate and oversee performance and quality improvement activities

• Work collaboratively with RN Care Managers, LPNs and Medical Assistants in support of clinical providers and patients’ needs

• Graduate of an accredited School of Nursing.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIRCUITHUB

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Product Engineer at CircuitHub, you will own entire production software systems end-to-end, from understanding operational problems on the factory floor through designing, building, deploying, and operating the software that solves them. You’ll be responsible for entire systems rather than isolated tickets, owning problems from discovery through deployment and operational impact.

This includes building and maintaining the internal operational stack that seamlessly connects planning, materials, purchasing, personnel, and factory processes, transforming complex manufacturing workflows into highly reliable, usable software. You’ll partner closely with factory operators, engineers, and company leadership to ensure CircuitHub’s factories scale smoothly as demand and Grid capabilities grow.

Example Projects:

 - Develop production planning tools and inventory/materials-flow systems

 - Improve factory operator workflows

 - Integrate new automation equipment

 - Apply AI and LLMs to automate operational decision making, from purchasing and production planning to machine diagnostics and debugging.

 - Build the software systems that coordinate thousands of manufacturing decisions across people, robots, inventory, and suppliers in real time.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

 - Strong PostgreSQL experience: complex queries, performance tuning, and schema design

 - Solid data modeling and systems-design judgment

 - Hands-on systems integration: stitching together APIs, tools, and workflows that hold up in production

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to ship production systems quickly and reliably.

 - Willingness and ability to travel regularly to CircuitHub factories (US and UK) and spend time on the factory floor partnering closely with operators and engineers.

Nice-to-haves

 - Familiarity with manufacturing, logistics, ERP/MRP, or supply-chain systems

 - Experience building internal tools or operational software

 - Experience keeping mission-critical operational systems fast and reliable

 - Comfortable collaborating closely with internal teams on regular basis

 


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll work directly with the Head of Internal Software and company leadership to identify bottlenecks and turn them into software systems that improve factory throughput. You'll join the internal software team and work alongside engineers, factory operators, and leadership.

In your first 6–12 months, success looks like owning a meaningful slice of the production operations stack outright and measurably improving the reliability and throughput of the operations it supports.

 


LOCATION & WORK ENVIRONMENT

 - Offices: South Deerfield MA, US; London and Cambridge, UK

 - Flexible arrangements: remote, hybrid, or in-person

 - This is potentially a remote role open to candidates who can maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both our US East Coast and UK teams.

 - While the role can be remote, successful candidates should expect regular travel to CircuitHub factories (in US and UK) and hands-on engagement with production operations.

 


COMPENSATION

 - UK: £80k–£125k

 - US: $125k–$250k

 - Plus equity

This is a single posting open across multiple levels. Your level and offer are calibrated to your experience, and we're happy to discuss where you'd land early in the process.

jobs.title: Terminal Junior Operator
jobs.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.

Join our Qrew!

The Terminal Junior Operator's primary responsibility will be to assist and support Terminal Operations and carry out their duties in a safe and efficient manner in accordance with established practices and procedures.  The Operator will be directly responsible to the Lead Operator on their shift.  In the absence of the Lead Operator, the Operator will assume the control room duties.  During the day shift, the Operator will assist the maintenance department in the performance of its duties.

The Terminal Junior Operator responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Monitor day-to-day operations of the storage tank and piping, refrigeration equipment, truck rack equipment, railcar unloading and related equipment and systems.

• Maintain hourly and daily operating logs.

• Assist with TP Vision Inventory Tracking and Control Program.

• Terminal security in accordance w/ MARSAC and USCG regulations.

• Ship unloading.

• Assist with terminal housekeeping and integrity.

• Perform routine maintenance tasks.

• May perform other general maintenance responsibilities as directed.

• Train new truck drivers on SEA-3/EQT truck rack loading procedures.

• Assist truck drivers with the operation of the loading skids.

• Works diligently and follows all safety requirements to prevent injuries, product contamination, spills and avoid product loss.

• Operating main plant and rail plant refrigeration systems.

• Additional duties as assigned.

Required Experience and Skills:

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Basic mathematical ability and understanding is required to successfully perform tank measurements, read gauges, set up product transfers into and out of tanks. This includes the ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide, convert fractions to decimals and vice versa, etc.

• Requires knowledge of refined product characteristics, measurement and safe handling practices.

• Mechanical abilities or experience with operating equipment is a plus.

• Experience operating with modern HMI control systems is a plus.

jobs.title: Chief Security and Privacy Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Viaduct, we are developing an Asset Performance Management system used by Manufacturers and Vehicle Fleet Operators.  The foundation of our products is a platform that hosts diverse data sources, including high-volume sensor and fault iOT data being generated by the devices.  We also incorporate many other types of data, including MES data, test data, asset attribute data, warranty claim data, and inspection data.  We have machine learning algorithms, anomaly detection algorithms, clustering algorithms and many other algorithms that support the type of analytics that help customers identify problems quickly and do root cause analysis.  We have two SAAS products, built from a common codebase. One is focused on Manufacturers, and one is focused on Fleet Operators.

Our applications are deployed in AWS in an EKS cluster. We use Postgres for application state and transactional data, and Clickhouse Cloud as our analytics database.  Our applications are TypeScript / React on the front end with REST APIs implemented in Go on the back end.  Many of our data processing pipelines are implemented in Python.

We have successfully completed four SOC 2 audits for Security, Availability, and Confidentiality with no exceptions.  Our audits are annual, and completed at the end of the first calendar quarter of the year.

Who You Are

You are an experienced Security leader who has a track record of defining and executing security policies and successfully passing security audits.  You are responsible for making sure that the data collected for audits is complete and accurate.  You understand the concepts behind SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and can help the company navigate audits, including audits for new standards such as ISO 42001.

Expected Skills

• 3+ years as an Chief Security Officer

• Experience with audited security frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001

• Track record of successful Security audits

• Excellent spoken and written communication skills

• Working knowledge of distributed/cloud compute platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)

• Ability to drive progress under tight deadlines

• Self-motivated and with a bias towards action

Security and Privacy Responsibilities

• Responsible for the Security posture of the company

• Responsible for compliance with US and International Privacy laws

• Security Team Member

• Privacy Team Member

• Provide Security and Privacy education and awareness training for new employees,

• Provide annual Security and Privacy awareness training for all employees

• Annually review, and update Security and Privacy Policies as necessary

• Responsible for Internal and external communication related to breaches, and security incidents

• Ensure that data collected for the Security and Privacy audits is complete and accurate

• Manage a constructive and collaborative relationship with our Security auditors

• Lead internal Security meetings required to support Security and/or Privacy audits

• Lead the audit meetings with our Security auditors

• Package security materials for customer review on demand or by implementing a Trust Portal

• Do security reviews for new sub-processors

• Do the annual Security review for all sub-processors

• Approve the license agreements for open source software used in our application

• Follow our policy and procedure documents related to security and privacy

• Follow the guidelines in the Employee Handbook

• Treat data security and privacy as one of your primary job responsibilities

• Report Security Incidents you discover or learn about as bugs in Jira

• Explicitly consider security implications when doing PR reviews

• Perform the Duties of Chief Privacy Officer

• Perform the Duties of Data Protection Officer

• Respond to Data Subject Requests

• Ensure that international customer contacts comply with US and International Privacy laws

• Responsible for awareness and compliance with US and International Privacy laws

• Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) as required by contracts

• Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) as required by contracts

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Director of Channel Partnerships & Business Development to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don’t improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization’s security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

CyberSheath is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Marketing to build and lead a high-performing marketing function during a pivotal period of market growth and increasing CMMC adoption. This leader will own the development and execution of an integrated marketing strategy that strengthens brand authority, creates qualified pipeline, accelerates revenue, and positions CyberSheath as the trusted cybersecurity compliance partner for the Defense Industrial Base.

The Director of Marketing will translate complex cybersecurity, regulatory, and technical concepts into clear, credible, audience-specific messaging that resonates with executive buyers, IT and security leaders, compliance stakeholders, and operational leaders at defense contractors. This person will combine strategic rigor with operational excellence—setting the go-to-market plan while remaining close to campaigns, content, events, demand generation, performance analytics, and sales alignment.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven B2B marketing leader with experience in cybersecurity, managed services, compliance technology, government contracting, or similarly complex technical markets. They are comfortable operating in a growth-stage, private equity-backed environment, understand long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying committees, and know how to create measurable marketing impact.

What You’ll Do

Marketing Strategy and Go-to-Market

• Develop and lead CyberSheath’s annual and quarterly marketing strategy in partnership with executive leadership, sales, solution engineering, customer success, and service delivery.

• Define target segments, ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, market priorities, and account-tiering strategies for defense contractors and subcontractors navigating CMMC, DFARS, and NIST SP 800-171 requirements.

• Build integrated go-to-market plans for CyberSheath’s core managed compliance, managed security, managed IT, assessment, implementation, and secure enclave offerings.

• Establish clear marketing priorities, budgets, milestones, operating cadences, and performance expectations tied to company revenue objectives.

• Identify market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer pain points that should inform messaging, campaigns, sales enablement, and product/service positioning.

• Support market expansion and new-service launches with disciplined positioning, audience targeting, launch planning, campaign execution, and performance measurement.

Demand Generation and Revenue Marketing

• Own the demand-generation engine from awareness through opportunity creation, working closely with Sales to drive pipeline quality, velocity, conversion, and revenue contribution.

• Create and optimize multi-channel campaigns across digital advertising, search, email nurture, webinars, content syndication, events, partner marketing, social media, and account-based marketing.

• Design programs that engage key buying-committee members, including CEOs, COOs, CFOs, CISOs, CIOs, IT leaders, compliance leaders, program managers, and operations executives.

• Partner with Sales leadership to define lead stages, service-level agreements, qualification criteria, routing processes, follow-up expectations, and closed-loop reporting.

• Build account-based marketing programs for priority accounts, strategic verticals, and high-value partner ecosystems.

• Develop nurture paths that educate prospective customers on compliance urgency, business risk, assessment readiness, remediation needs, and the operational requirements of maintaining CMMC compliance over time.

• Continuously test audience, channel, message, offer, and conversion-path hypotheses to improve marketing efficiency and pipeline outcomes.

Brand, Messaging, and Content

• Own CyberSheath’s brand strategy, voice, positioning, messaging architecture, and narrative across external and internal-facing marketing assets.

• Ensure CyberSheath clearly communicates its differentiation as a specialized, end-to-end cybersecurity compliance partner for defense contractors rather than a generalist technology or security provider.

• Lead development of high-value thought leadership, including executive articles, regulatory explainers, blogs, guides, case studies, solution briefs, webinars, customer stories, analyst-facing content, and event presentations.

• Translate highly technical and regulatory subject matter into accessible, commercially relevant content without sacrificing accuracy or credibility.

• Partner with internal subject-matter experts to develop compelling perspectives on CMMC 2.0, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, secure CUI environments, managed security, assessment readiness, and continuous compliance.

• Maintain a high editorial standard and a consistent content calendar that supports organic demand, customer education, sales enablement, search visibility, and executive thought leadership.

• Oversee website messaging, conversion paths, content governance, SEO priorities, and user experience improvements.

Product and Sales Enablement

• Partner with Sales, Solution Engineering, and Service Delivery to sharpen service positioning, customer value propositions, competitive differentiation, and proof points.

• Develop sales-enablement materials such as pitch decks, battlecards, solution briefs, case studies, industry-specific messaging, objection-handling resources, and customer presentation templates.

• Equip revenue teams with clear, current, and consistent messaging for every stage of the buyer journey.

• Create mechanisms to capture and distribute market intelligence from prospects, customers, partners, competitors, and frontline revenue teams.

• Support customer marketing initiatives, including advocacy, testimonials, referral programs, case studies, and expansion campaigns.

Events, Partnerships, and Field Marketing

• Refine CyberSheath’s strategy for industry events, trade shows, conferences, webinars, and executive programs relevant to the DIB, defense contracting, cybersecurity, compliance, and government technology markets.

• Ensure events are planned against measurable objectives, including target-account engagement, meeting generation, pipeline influence, partner activation, and revenue impact.

• Build co-marketing programs with strategic technology, channel, and ecosystem partners, including Microsoft and other organizations serving the compliance and defense-contractor market.

• Identify opportunities for CyberSheath executives and subject-matter experts to build visibility through speaking engagements, contributed content, media opportunities, and industry participation.

Analytics, Operations, and Team Leadership

• Establish a metrics-driven marketing operating model that measures awareness, engagement, marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced pipeline, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, campaign ROI, pipeline velocity, and revenue contribution.

• Build and maintain reliable dashboards and executive reporting that clearly communicate marketing performance, key insights, risks, and recommended actions.

• Manage marketing technology, data hygiene, attribution, campaign operations, and budget discipline in partnership with Revenue Operations and other internal stakeholders.

• Evaluate and optimize the marketing technology stack, vendors, agencies, freelancers, and internal resources to ensure efficient execution.

• Hire, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing marketing team as the organization grows.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, customer-centric culture that values speed, quality, experimentation, commercial impact, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6 to 12 months, the Director of Marketing will be expected to:

• Establish a clear, differentiated, and consistent market narrative for CyberSheath and its service portfolio.

• Implement an integrated demand-generation strategy that produces a predictable flow of qualified opportunities.

• Strengthen alignment between Marketing, Sales, Solution Engineering, and Customer Success around target accounts, lead management, messaging, and pipeline goals.

• Improve visibility into marketing performance through practical, trusted funnel and revenue reporting.

• Elevate CyberSheath’s thought-leadership presence in the CMMC, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, and broader DIB cybersecurity compliance market.

• Build a scalable content engine that supports organic growth, outbound sales efforts, customer education, and partner engagement.

• Improve conversion across core marketing journeys, including website engagement, webinar registration, gated-content conversion, demo requests, assessment inquiries, and sales-accepted leads.

• Establish a repeatable field, event, and partner-marketing framework tied to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

• 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including 3+ years in a marketing leadership role.

• Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable pipeline, revenue, and market growth.

• Experience marketing complex B2B services, technology solutions, cybersecurity offerings, managed services, compliance solutions, SaaS, or enterprise IT services.

• Strong command of demand generation, account-based marketing, content strategy, digital marketing, field marketing, campaign operations, and marketing analytics.

• Experience supporting sales organizations with long, complex sales cycles and multiple economic, technical, and operational stakeholders.

• Proven ability to translate technical concepts into customer-focused positioning, messaging, and content.

• Strong executive communication, presentation, writing, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Experience managing budgets, agencies, vendors, and marketing technology platforms.

• Track record of building and leading high-performing teams in fast-moving, growth-oriented environments.

• Analytical mindset and fluency with funnel metrics, attribution, conversion analysis, pipeline reporting, and campaign performance optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in cybersecurity, cybersecurity compliance, managed security services, managed IT services, GRC, risk management, or regulated technology markets.

• Familiarity with the Defense Industrial Base, federal contracting, CMMC 2.0, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, FedRAMP, CUI, or government cloud environments.

• Experience marketing to defense contractors, manufacturers, engineering firms, federal contractors, or regulated mid-market organizations.

• Experience working in a private equity-backed or high-growth business environment.

• Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, web analytics, SEO, paid media, intent-data, ABM, and attribution tools.

• Experience launching services, entering new markets, repositioning a brand, or scaling a marketing organization.

Work Environment

• Fully remote role with occasional travel for industry events and offsite meetings

CyberSheath is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

Budgeted Pay Range

$140,000—$175,000 USD

jobs.title: Pellet Mill Operator
jobs.description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world’s largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

As a Pellet Mill Operator, you will operate and maintain several pellet mills, ensuring optimal feed rates, adjusting rolls/dies, and monitoring pellet quality to meet company standards; assist in conducting QC testing, troubleshoot equipment malfunctions, perform ash tests, and maintain a clean work environment.

Responsibilities

• Analyze equipment performance and make necessary tooling and equipment changes to produce desired throughput and quality results.

• Perform and document required inspections of equipment and maintain equipment in good condition.

• Review work order specifications or instructions to determine materials, ingredients, procedures, extracting, forming, pressing and compacting materials to produce pellets.

• Adjust machine components to regulate speed, pressure and temperatures of machine, amount, dimensions and flow of materials and ingredients.

• Monitor machine operations and observes indicator lights and gauges, such as thermometers, voltage meters and timers to detect malfunctions.

• Perform/coordinate maintenance on equipment per job instructions.

• Perform/coordinate housekeeping to required standard.

• Maintain consistent production quality to required standard.

• Follow all workplace and job safety procedures.

• Complete accurate reporting as required.

• Communicate operational information as required.

• Enter maintenance work requests as applicable.

• Escalate issues promptly for proper resolution.

Qualifications

• Must demonstrate mechanical aptitude.

• Proficient in mathematics and measurements

• Ability to read data and trends to make appropriate process adjustments.

• Proven record in upholding safety standards.

Preferred Qualifications - What Sets You Apart

• High School Diploma or GED.

• At least two (2) years of previous manufacturing experience.

• Operation and Control - Controlling operations of equipment or systems.

• Operations Monitoring - Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

• Critical Thinking - Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

• Troubleshooting - Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.

• Equipment Maintenance - Performing routine maintenance on equipment and determining when and what kind of maintenance is needed.

Working conditions

• Must be able to work in outdoor environments and occasionally in temperatures above 100 degrees and below 32 degrees

• Willing and able to work in a hot, humid, cold and noisy industrial environment

• Willing and able to maintain strict adherence to safety rules and regulations, to include wearing safety equipment.

• Work at elevated heights and on slippery or uneven surfaces.

• Adapt to working within a team or alone, with minimal supervision.

Physical requirements

• Willing and able to perform tasks such as lifting, walking, climbing, stooping, standing, pushing and/or pulling for up to twelve (12) hours a day.

• Willing and able to work around moving equipment and machinery.

• Willing and able to pull and lift, up to 50 lbs.

• Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA.

• Ability to climb a crane in excess of 100 feet high.

• Ability to work from heights (at least 20 feet off the ground).

• Able to climb vertical ladders (fixable or portable) at unbroken lengths of up to 20 feet.

• Able to climb multiple flights of steps, angled ramps as needed.

• Able to work on computer screen format for up to twelve (12) hours a day.

This position is not eligible for visa support.

EEO Statement

Enviva is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity (EEO) in any term, condition or privilege of employment. Enviva does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniform service member, genetic information or any other status protected by law. Enviva complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we operate.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.
